The palate shows depth and tension, offering raspberry compote, Marasca cherry, licorice, clove and pipe tobacco alongside taut refined tannins. Hold for even more complexity. Drink 2019–2031.
title: Produttori del Barbaresco 2011 Rabajà Riserva  (Barbaresco)

description: If you love Italy and love elegantly oaked Chardonnay, this is your wine. Deep gold in color, Elena Walch delivers generous notes of apple, nut, spring flowers over lavish honey aromas. Opulent, modern and seductively smooth in the mouth, pair it with butter squash, turkey or roasted pork.
title: Elena Walch 2004 Castel Ringberg Riserva Chardonnay (Alto Adige)

description: Deep complexity is the first quality you'll notice in this wine. Dig deep to encounter penetrating notes of black cherry, nutty apple flavors, rose petals, crème brûlèe, carob powder, leather, exotic spice and dark chocolate. This is a wine painted in big brush strokes, with a vibrant personality, succulent tannins and great length. Pair it with roasted duck or grilled red meat.
title: Marion 2001  Amarone della Valpolicella

description: Here is a lively, buoyant wine that affords room for a wide array of aromatic nuances. Apple, almond, cherry cobbler and penetrating black tar are foreground notes with red fruit and sweet vanilla as soft background shadings. The intensity is as remarkable as its persistency.
title: Venturini Massimino 2001 Campomasua  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Smoke, coffee, leather, tobacco, spice, dried prune and currant berry characterize a modern, nicely aged wine with deep complexity and depth. It's also a distinctive wine with noticeable sweetness, firm tannins and excellent length. It's ready to drink now and would make a fine companion to any red meat dish.
title: Montezovo 1999  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico

description: Gianni Masciarelli has mastered the tricky art of growing Chardonnay in the Abruzzo and this sophisticated, barrique-aged wine shows his enormous talent. Dedicated to his wife, layered aromas here include vanilla extract, pineapple, honey and almond backed by elegant mineral nuances. Wood-driven flavors are underplayed in the mouth, allowing the quality of the fruit to show.
title: Masciarelli 2004 Marina Cvetic Chardonnay (Colline Teatine)

description: Here's a great value option for those looking for a chilled summer sipper by the pool or at an outdoor picnic. The wine is light and lean, but it also shows a very lively mouthfeel followed by sharp perlage, honey and peach.
title: Le Manzane NV Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Aged only in stainless steel, this fresh Soave Classico from the hills of northern Italy shows lemony and citrus-like freshness with simple lines and balanced acidity. There's a touch of sweet almond on the close.
title: Le Battistelle 2010 Battistelle  (Soave Classico)

description: This is a dark and brooding blend of Barbera and Bonarda that veers towards tobacco, leather and tar to such a far extreme, the fruit is almost overwhelmed in the bouquet. Prune and cassis do make an appearance on the palate, and there's a ripe-fruit note on the close.
title: La Stoppa 2007 Macchiona Red (Emilia)

description: Agostino Marsuret proposes this fresh sparkling wine made with Glera, Verdiso and Perera grapes. The soft sparkler offers just a touch of sweetness with easy layers of peach and grapefruit that pull back slowly.
title: Marsuret 2012 Millesimato Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: There's a bright, clean quality to this Prosecco Superiore that is reinforced by citrus, grapefruit and stone fruit aromas. Dried grass, honey and white flower also play supporting roles.
title: Le Manzane NV Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: From producer Guglielmo Bortolomiol, this Brut sparkling wine shows simple lines of dry mineral, white flower and crisp lime. Pair this informal Italian sparker with grilled shrimp encrusted with sweet sesame seeds.
title: Gemin 2012 Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This sparkling blend (50-50 Chardonnay and Pinot Nero) represents one of only a handful of barrel aged metodo classico wines from Friuli in northeast Italy. The wine's perlage is firm and steely and there are soft layers of toasted bread, stone fruit and honey at the back.
title: Dorigo NV Cuvée Brut Sparkling (Friuli)

description: This sparkling blend (50-50 Chardonnay and Pinot Nero) represents one of only a handful of barrel aged metodo classico wines from Friuli in northeast Italy. The wine's perlage is firm and steely and there are soft layers of toasted bread, stone fruit and honey at the back.
title: Dorigo NV Cuvée Brut Sparkling (Friuli)

description: This darkly concentrated Dolcetto offers fresh fruit aromas of blackberry, plum and ripe black cherry. There's loads of dark fruit intensity here followed by a plush, dark and slightly raw feel in the mouth.
title: Principiano Ferdinando 2010 Sant'Anna  (Dolcetto d'Alba)

description: This interpretation of Sangiovese opens with sweet fruit on the bouquet that recalls plump cherry and blueberry. The wine is tart and easy on the close with a pretty blast of fresh acidity.
title: Poderi Morini 2011 Torre di Oriolo  (Sangiovese di Romagna Superiore)

description: Le Rime is made as both a Chardonnay-Pinot Grigio blend and as a pure expression of Pinot Grigio for the U.S. market. Easy and fresh, this wine has touches of pear and citrus.
title: Banfi 2011 Le Rime Pinot Grigio (Toscana)

description: Natural winemaker Arianna Occhipinti offers this dark and velvety expression of Nero d'Avola with smokey, earthy notes at the back of mature fruit and small berry. There's an undeniable elegance and compactness to the mouthfeel.
title: Occhipinti 2008 Siccagno Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: Natural winemaker Arianna Occhipinti offers this dark and velvety expression of Nero d'Avola with smokey, earthy notes at the back of mature fruit and small berry. There's an undeniable elegance and compactness to the mouthfeel.
title: Occhipinti 2008 Siccagno Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: This leads with blue flower, camphor, crushed herb and red berry aromas. Firmly structured and linear, the palate delivers succulent red cherry, crushed strawberry, cinnamon and star anise flavors supported by a backbone of vibrant acidity and firm, refined tannins. Drink 2022–2032.
title: Negro Giuseppe 2014 Pian Cavallo  (Barbaresco)

description: This blended white from Friuli has pretty white flower and exotic fruit aromas. It has pineapple, pear and banana peel flavors, although it finishes a bit short.
title: Maculan 2012 Pino & Toi White (Veneto)

description: This blended white from Friuli has pretty white flower and exotic fruit aromas. It has pineapple, pear and banana peel flavors, although it finishes a bit short.
title: Maculan 2012 Pino & Toi White (Veneto)

description: This earthy wine has almost overripe fruit sensations alongside rustic notes that eventually blow off in the glass. The palate shows very ripe plum, black cherry and spice notes. Drink soon.
title: Le Bertarole 2010  Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso

description: This earthy wine has almost overripe fruit sensations alongside rustic notes that eventually blow off in the glass. The palate shows very ripe plum, black cherry and spice notes. Drink soon.
title: Le Bertarole 2010  Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso

description: Matured on its lees for eight months in barriques, this wine offers aromas of crushed tomato vine, evident oak and vanilla. The palate boasts cantaloupe and green melon flavors, along with vanilla and bitter wood sensations.
title: Vie di Romans 2011 Vieris Sauvignon (Friuli Isonzo)

description: This has a fragrance of oak and bell pepper, with a whiff of spice. The palate shows black currant, prune and oak, but above all, very evident alcohol.
title: Cantine Benedetti 2006 Croce del Gal  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Here's a simple but well made wine, with raspberry, cherry and red currant nuances punctuated by a hint of white pepper. It's soft and ready to drink young, with a nice freshness. This will go well with mushroom-stuffed ravioli.
title: Cantina di Soave 2011 Rocca Alata  (Valpolicella Ripasso)

description: This wine opens with tertiary aromas of damp earth and mineral, along with notes of brown-banana peel and beeswax. The palate shows a loss of fruit richness and oxidation.
title: Barberani 2012 VINOSO VIni NO SOlfiti  (Orvieto Classico)

description: Made with organically cultivated Primitivo grapes, this has enticing scents of red berry, wild flower, Mediterranean scrub and a whiff of pastry dough. The juicy delicious palate presents succulent morello cherry, raspberry, cinnamon and tangerine drop. It's a great example of why Puglia's rockin' the rosato scene in Italy.
title: Pietraventosa 2016 Est Rosa Rosato (Murgia)

description: This easygoing red offers aromas of wild berry, violet and a whiff of clove. The juicy, simple palate doles out ripe blackberry, Morello cherry and a hint of baking spice alongside soft, fleeting tannins.
title: Fazio 2013 Torre dei Venti Nero d'Avola (Erice)

description: This easygoing red opens with fruity aromas of plum, wild berry and a whiff of violet. The informal palate offers red cherry, pomegranate and a hint of clove alongside round, rather fleeting tannins.
title: Fazio 2013 Gabal Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: Dark berry and black cooking spice aromas lead the nose on this straightforward red. The dense, simple palate offers blackberry jam and a note of anise alongside compact, rounded tannins. Drink through 2016.
title: Cusumano 2014 Nero d'Avola (Terre Siciliane)

description: Subdued aromas of mature black-skinned berry, spice and a whiff of leather lead the nose on this fresh, simple red. The soft, smooth palate shows juicy black cherry, blackberry and a hint of licorice. It's made to be enjoyed young so drink soon.
title: Corvo 2013 Rosso Nero d'Avola (Terre Siciliane)

description: Subdued aromas of mature black-skinned berry, spice and a whiff of leather lead the nose on this fresh, simple red. The soft, smooth palate shows juicy black cherry, blackberry and a hint of licorice. It's made to be enjoyed young so drink soon.
title: Corvo 2013 Rosso Nero d'Avola (Terre Siciliane)

description: This straightforward red opens with aromas of blue flower, forest floor and dark-skinned berry. The fresh simple palate offers tart cherry and dark spice alongside zesty acidity and mouth-puckering but fleeting tannins.
title: SassodiSole 2014  Rosso di Montalcino

description: The nose delivers subtle aromas of vanilla and red plum while the palate shows sour cherry and toasted notes. Close-grained tannins leave an astringent, mouth-drying finish.
title: Parmoleto 2011  Montecucco

description: This has aromas suggesting leafy underbrush, menthol and dark spice. The robust one-dimensional palate offers dried fig, raisin, clove and a green note of powdered sage. Raspy tannins and the heat of evident alcohol dominate the astringent finish.
title: Domìni Veneti 2010 Vigneti di Jago  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: A blend of 80% Primitivo and 20% Aglianico, this dense wine opens with aromas of toasted oak, spearmint and spice alongside ripe black fruit and prune. The one-dimensional palate serves up mature—almost overripe—blackberry layered with hints of vanilla extract, bitter prune and sugared coffee.
title: Ager Falernus 2011 Vino e Anima Red (Falerno del Massico)

description: This Nero d'Avola has aromas of earth, black currants, game and a note of grilled bell peppers. The palate offers fleeting black cherry and black berry, accented by black pepper and a green note of dried sage. It finishes on a bitter note.
title: FiàNobile 2009 Nero Capitano Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: This straightforward blend of Nero d'Avola, Syrah and Merlot opens with aromas of mature black fruit, graphite and dark baking spice. The palate offers prune, black currant and intense black pepper supported by tight tannins. Pair this with pizza or hearty  pasta dishes.
title: Donnafugata 2012 Sedàra Red (Sicilia)

description: This robust rosato, made from the native grape Nerello Mascalese on the slopes of Mount Etna, is loaded with dark cherry and crushed strawberry sensations. The bright, juicy palate is accented by notes of cinnamon and vanilla. Pair this with appetizers, quiche or summer salads.
title: Cottanera 2013 Barbazzale Rosato Nerello Mascalese (Etna)

description: This enjoyable wine opens with aromas of red berry, blackberry, blueberry and hints of white pepper that carry on to the palate. It has an easy-drinking style thanks to fresh acidity and smooth, soft tannins.
title: Cantine Federiciane 2013 Piedirosso (Campi Flegrei)

description: This wine has an unusual combination of sweet and sour sensations that include ripe plum, sour cherry, vanilla, dark chocolate, hay, dill, sage and leather. It's still very young with nervous acidity and aggressive tannins that need time to tame.
title: Cascina Chicco 2010 Rocche di Castelletto  (Barolo)

description: This wine has an unusual combination of sweet and sour sensations that include ripe plum, sour cherry, vanilla, dark chocolate, hay, dill, sage and leather. It's still very young with nervous acidity and aggressive tannins that need time to tame.
title: Cascina Chicco 2010 Rocche di Castelletto  (Barolo)

description: This opens with aromas of crushed black fruit, mint, toasted oak and balsamic notes. The brooding palate offers up black cherry, licorice, black pepper and oak alongside raspy tannins that leave the mouth feeling dry. Drink after 2018.
title: Cantina del Nebbiolo 2010 Cannubi Boschis  (Barolo)

description: This delivers top quality at an attractive price point, with floral aromas of jasmine, honeysuckle and orange blossom. The finish is soft, feminine and very smooth.
title: Astoria NV Cuvée Lounge Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: This delivers top quality at an attractive price point, with floral aromas of jasmine, honeysuckle and orange blossom. The finish is soft, feminine and very smooth.
title: Astoria NV Cuvée Lounge Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: This is a bright, textbook Pinot Grigio that shows the very best of easy-drinking Italian white wine. Light fragrances of sweet nectarine and honey are followed by a palate with medium structure and crisp acidity.
title: Altanuta 2011 Pinot Grigio (Valdadige)

description: Fresh and bright, this has lasting aromas of stone fruit, lime and white flower. The mouthfeel is creamy and soft thanks to the foamy quality of bubbles.
title: Mionetto NV Il Prosecco  (Prosecco)

description: Fresh and bright, this has lasting aromas of stone fruit, lime and white flower. The mouthfeel is creamy and soft thanks to the foamy quality of bubbles.
title: Mionetto NV Il Prosecco  (Prosecco)

description: Beautiful mountain aromatics of wild flower and Granny Smith apple give this wine a youthful and superfresh personality. The finish is smooth, silky and polished.
title: Girlan 2011 Pinot Grigio (Alto Adige)

description: The quintessential summer sipping wine, this opens with fresh aromas of citrus, white flower and stone fruit. It follows to the palate with foamy bubbles and a bright touch of acidity.
title: Villa Sandi NV Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Simple and straightforward, this has honest aromas of yellow fruit and perfumed white flower. It's an easy-drinking sparkler that should pair well with salads or raw fish.
title: Valdellövo NV Anno Zero Extra Dry  (Prosecco Treviso)

description: Exceedingly fresh and fragrant, this has medium structure, with bright stone fruit and citrus aromas. It should pair with smoked salmon or tuna tartare.
title: Tramin 2011 Pinot Grigio (Alto Adige)

description: Steely effervescence, bright acidity and tonic crispness is followed by subtle tones of peach and white rose. This sparkler is clean and bone dry on the finish.
title: Tenuta Santomè NV Bosco Coste Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: An easy match to finger foods or appetizers, this lively Brut sparkler shows tonic perlage and fresh notes of white fruit, grapefruit and crushed stone. Its bright acidity will help keep the palate refreshed and clean.
title: Malibràn 2011 Ruio Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Simple, bright and refreshing, this offers aromas of white flower, stone fruit, citrus and crushed mineral. Flavors of sweet fruit and peach are followed by creamy foam and lemon-lime acidity.
title: Macaron NV  Prosecco

description: Here's a standard, well-made Pinot Grigio that shows bright aromas of citrus, apple, pear and honey. It is defined by a sharp, crisp vein of acidity on the finish.
title: Livon 2011 Pinot Grigio (Collio)

description: On the nose, this has aromas of stone fruit and melon that lend the wine depth and personality. The mouthfeel is bright, clean and refreshing.
title: Le Manzane NV Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: The aromatic delivery is bright, fresh and pristine. Bright acidity is backed by flavors of stone fruit, citrus and Golden Delicious apple. It's the kind of white to serve with summer salad lunches by the pool.
title: La Vis 2010 Intaglio Pinot Grigio (Trentino)

description: The aromatic delivery is bright, fresh and pristine. Bright acidity is backed by flavors of stone fruit, citrus and Golden Delicious apple. It's the kind of white to serve with summer salad lunches by the pool.
title: La Vis 2010 Intaglio Pinot Grigio (Trentino)

description: This shows bright floral tones of honeysuckle and citrus blossom backed by notes of stone fruit and dried grass. It's creamy and smooth, with a distant touch of sweetness on the finish.
title: La Gioiosa NV Etamorosa Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: A tiny percentage of Verdiso is added to the blend, lending this a bright green note of lime and honeydew. This Prosecco also shows extra depth and structure.
title: Il Follo NV Cuvée Rustot Brut  (Prosecco Treviso)

description: This Sagrantino passito offers a thick, austere nose that is ripe with notes of blackberry pie, plum cake, Indian spice, bramble and delicate nut. You can taste the tannins that are characteristic of this variety and that give the wine its heft and structure. Pair it with aged pecorino.
title: Antonelli 2004 Passito  (Sagrantino di Montefalco)

description: This Sagrantino passito offers a thick, austere nose that is ripe with notes of blackberry pie, plum cake, Indian spice, bramble and delicate nut. You can taste the tannins that are characteristic of this variety and that give the wine its heft and structure. Pair it with aged pecorino.
title: Antonelli 2004 Passito  (Sagrantino di Montefalco)

description: Here's a Sicilian dessert wine that stands out in a crowd thanks to its layered aromas of dried herbs, natural rubber, apricot, honey and citrus blossom. The wine boasts floral and fragrant flavors that enhance the natural sweetness you feel in the mouth.
title: Benanti 2007 Il Musico Moscato (Sicilia)

description: Here's a Sicilian dessert wine that stands out in a crowd thanks to its layered aromas of dried herbs, natural rubber, apricot, honey and citrus blossom. The wine boasts floral and fragrant flavors that enhance the natural sweetness you feel in the mouth.
title: Benanti 2007 Il Musico Moscato (Sicilia)

description: Deep burgundy in color, Felluga's interesting Moscato Rosa would make a good companion to stewed prunes or chocolate with cooked pears. The wine is easygoing and simple with aromas of blueberry and strawberry jam. Wood flavors come in at the rear to create a good balance between sweetness and tangy spice.
title: Marco Felluga 2004 Rosa Moscato (Delle Venezie)

description: Made with bush-trained vines that give very low yields, this delivers concentrated flavors of spiced plum, ripe blackberry, nutmeg, orange peel and black pepper. It's vibrant, smooth and balanced with firm, velvety tannins. The lingering finish closes on a licorice note.
title: Varvaglione Vigne & Vini 2012 Papale  (Primitivo di Manduria)

description: Exotic spice, wet earth, red cherry and black currant describe the nose of this medium-bodied Chianti Superiore. The wine is luminous and compact with a direct and immediate delivery of fruit flavors and good freshness.
title: Castello di Monastero 2004  Chianti Superiore

description: Castello d'Albola's Chianti Classico is a genuine and traditional expression of Tuscany with a good measure of wild berry, violet, spice and cola. It's a medium-bodied wine with fresh berry notes and ripe fruit flavors. Pair it with pasta or chicken.
title: Castello d'Albola 2005  Chianti Classico

description: Castello d'Albola's Chianti Classico is a genuine and traditional expression of Tuscany with a good measure of wild berry, violet, spice and cola. It's a medium-bodied wine with fresh berry notes and ripe fruit flavors. Pair it with pasta or chicken.
title: Castello d'Albola 2005  Chianti Classico

description: Traditional, compact and elegant, this Chianti Superiore offers bright luminosity and delicate aromas of red berry and spice. This is not a beefy or intense wine, nor was it meant to be. It would taste best with pasta or pizza.
title: Burchino 2005  Chianti Superiore

description: Aromas of mature blackberries, prunes and darkly concentrated fruit characterize this dense Rosso di Montepulciano. The wine is 90% Prugnolo Gentile and 10% Canaiolo Nero and it offers lasting aromas of clove, cinnamon and allspice. Great low price too.
title: Gattavecchi 2007  Rosso di Montepulciano

description: Made with 90% Sangiovese and 10% Canaiolo, this opens with earthy aromas of wet soil, underbrush and a whiff of barnyard. The simple palate offers overripe black cherry and a funky note of game alongside soft tannins.
title: Villa Corliano 2013 Briccole  (Chianti Colli Fiorentini)

description: Made with 90% Sangiovese and 10% Cabernet Sauvignon, this opens with funky aromas of leafy underbrush, scorched earth, toasted oak and a whiff of barnyard. The rustic palate displays game, leather, dried black cherry and bitter prune alongside astringent tannins.
title: Villa Corliano 2011 Briccole Riserva  (Chianti Colli Fiorentini)

description: Made with 90% Sangiovese and 10% Cabernet Sauvignon, this opens with funky aromas of leafy underbrush, scorched earth, toasted oak and a whiff of barnyard. The rustic palate displays game, leather, dried black cherry and bitter prune alongside astringent tannins.
title: Villa Corliano 2011 Briccole Riserva  (Chianti Colli Fiorentini)

description: This informal red opens with aromas of leafy underbrush, wet soil and dark plum. The simple palate offers up tart cherry, black raspberry and an earthy note of game alongside brisk acidity. Angular but fleeting tannins give it an abrupt finish. Drink now.
title: Lanciola 2012  Chianti Colli Fiorentini

description: White spring flower and citrus aromas lead the nose on this easygoing, savory white. The juicy palate offers juicy tangerine and a note of sea salt alongside fresh acidity. It's simple but well made.
title: Stefano Antonucci 2015  Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi

description: White spring flower and citrus aromas lead the nose on this easygoing, savory white. The juicy palate offers juicy tangerine and a note of sea salt alongside fresh acidity. It's simple but well made.
title: Stefano Antonucci 2015  Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi

description: Pretty scents of fragrant white wild flower and white stone fruit lift out of the glass. On the round, straightforward palate, fresh acidity offsets ripe Bosc pear, lemon zest and a hint of hazelnut.
title: Castello di Neive 2015 Montebertotto Arneis (Langhe)

description: Aromas of fragrant broom, white wild flower and a whiff of damp earth lead the nose on this straightforward wine. The vibrant palate offers green apple and tangerine alongside zesty acidity. A slightly bitter almond closes the finish.
region: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico
title: Brunori 2014 Le Gemme  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico)

description: Lightly scented, this medium-bodied white opens with whiffs of white spring flower and orchard fruit. The soft, round palate offers mature pear, citrus peel and a hint of toasted hazelnut.
title: Giacomo Vico 2015  Roero

description: Whiffs of violet, blackberry and mint set the tone while the no-frills palate offers blackberry, plum and a hint of dark spice. Mellow tannins provide the easygoing framework. Drink soon.
title: K. Martini & Son 2013 Rueslhof Lagrein (Alto Adige)

description: Whiffs of violet, blackberry and mint set the tone while the no-frills palate offers blackberry, plum and a hint of dark spice. Mellow tannins provide the easygoing framework. Drink soon.
title: K. Martini & Son 2013 Rueslhof Lagrein (Alto Adige)

description: Pear, apricot and honeysuckle scents lead carry over to the soft, round palate along with a hint of pear. A white almond note fills in the finish.
title: Malabaila 2015  Roero

description: Robust but informal, this opens with aromas of red berry, baking spice and a whiff of smoke. The savory palate doles out crushed black cherry, raspberry, cranberry, black pepper and a saline note alongside hearty tannins. Enjoy young to capture the juicy fruit flavors.
title: Librandi 2013 Rosso  (Cirò)

description: Robust but informal, this opens with aromas of red berry, baking spice and a whiff of smoke. The savory palate doles out crushed black cherry, raspberry, cranberry, black pepper and a saline note alongside hearty tannins. Enjoy young to capture the juicy fruit flavors.
title: Librandi 2013 Rosso  (Cirò)

description: Aromas of stone fruit and pineapple lead the nose. The vibrant palate doles out juicy yellow peach, nectarine zest and a hint of nutmeg. It's nicely balanced with tangy acidity.
title: Kettmeir 2013 Müller-Thurgau (Alto Adige)

description: Floral scents of peach blossom, broom and a whiff of pear mingle in the glass. On the bright palate, toasted almond and aromatic herb give interest to the core of Golden Delicious apple and citrus. It's refreshing and balanced with vibrant acidity.
title: Guerrieri Rizzardi 2013  Soave Classico

description: Made with Turbiana grapes grown near the shores of Lake Garda, this pretty white features delicate aromas of white flower and orchard fruit. The bright palate offers juicy yellow peach, nectarine and apple alongside brisk acidity.
title: Zenato 2014  Lugana

description: Made with Turbiana grapes grown near the shores of Lake Garda, this pretty white features delicate aromas of white flower and orchard fruit. The bright palate offers juicy yellow peach, nectarine and apple alongside brisk acidity.
title: Zenato 2014  Lugana

description: Aromas of candied citrus and bell pepper lead the nose. The firm palate offers toasted oak, baked yellow apple, vanilla and lemon drop, with the warmth of alcohol on the close. Drink sooner rather than later to enjoy the remaining fruit richness.
title: Vie di Romans 2012 Vieris Sauvignon (Friuli Isonzo)

description: This golden-colored wine conveys intense aromas of white rose petals and exotic spice. The rich palate offers dried apricot, candied ginger, nectarine zest and sage. An energizing shot of graphite marks the finish.
title: Tenuta Fernanda Cappello 2013 Traminer (Friuli Grave)

description: Delicate aromas suggest white spring flower and pear. On the linear palate, vibrant acidity balances tart apple and lemon-zest flavors. A light mineral note energizes the finish.
title: Suavia 2013  Soave Classico

description: Made exclusively from Sangiovese, this bold wine opens with intense aromas of underbrush, blue flower, oak and leather. The palate offers black cherry, vanilla, espresso and black pepper notes. Soft and ready to drink, with round tannins, it ends on a licorice note.
title: Il Borro 2010 Polissena Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: This is a subdued and elegant Prosecco with pretty aromas of cut grass, dried herbs, peach, citrus and green melon. There's a touch of piquant acidity backed by menthol flavors that taste great against all that creamy foam and bubbling.
title: Bortolotti NV Extra Dry 47  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Here's an easy, straightforward dessert wine from Montalcino, Tuscany that shows bright aromas of stone fruit, honey and white almond. The wine is silky smooth and nicely sweet on the close without being too heavy or cloying.
title: Villa Poggio Salvi 2003 Aurico 375 ml  (Moscadello di Montalcino)

description: Here's an easy, straightforward dessert wine from Montalcino, Tuscany that shows bright aromas of stone fruit, honey and white almond. The wine is silky smooth and nicely sweet on the close without being too heavy or cloying.
title: Villa Poggio Salvi 2003 Aurico 375 ml  (Moscadello di Montalcino)

description: This Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Sangiovese blend opens with dark berry aromas and a whiff of new leather. The straightforward palate offers black currant and cedar flavors, sweetened by a touch of vanilla and round tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Giovanni Chiappini 2014 Felciaino  (Bolgheri)

description: This Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Sangiovese blend opens with dark berry aromas and a whiff of new leather. The straightforward palate offers black currant and cedar flavors, sweetened by a touch of vanilla and round tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Giovanni Chiappini 2014 Felciaino  (Bolgheri)

description: Earthy game, scorched earth and black-skinned fruit aromas come together in this Brunello. The palate is dense and ripe, delivering raspberry jam, mochaand vanilla flavors, with mature tannins. Enjoy 2018–2022.
title: Fornacina 2012  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Earthy game, scorched earth and black-skinned fruit aromas come together in this Brunello. The palate is dense and ripe, delivering raspberry jam, mochaand vanilla flavors, with mature tannins. Enjoy 2018–2022.
title: Fornacina 2012  Brunello di Montalcino

description: This opens with prune, mocha and baking spice aromas. The palate shows black plum, tobacco and raspberry jam flavors with an evolved tannic structure. Drink through 2021.
title: Fattoria La Lecciaia 2012  Brunello di Montalcino

description: This robust red opens with scorched earth, new leather, underbrush and dark spice aromas. The palate is brawny and monolithic, offering licorice, dried cherry and clove flavors with the warmth of evident alcohol. It's framed by chewy tannins and should be drunk soon to capture the remaining fruit and freshness.
title: Fattoria del Pino 2012  Brunello di Montalcino

description: This robust red opens with scorched earth, new leather, underbrush and dark spice aromas. The palate is brawny and monolithic, offering licorice, dried cherry and clove flavors with the warmth of evident alcohol. It's framed by chewy tannins and should be drunk soon to capture the remaining fruit and freshness.
title: Fattoria del Pino 2012  Brunello di Montalcino

description: This opens with black-skinned berry, tobacco and underbrush aromas. The firm palate shows black plum, clove and white pepper flavors, with assertive tannins that leave a drying finish.
title: Donna Olga 2012 Le Cacce  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Blue flower, plum and toast notes lead the nose. The firm, tightly wound palate offers espresso, clove and grilled herb flavors, while close-grained tannins leave a bracing finish.
title: Poggio alla Sala 2012 Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Here's a luminous red that opens with red berry, sun-baked soil and Mediterranean herb aromas. It's medium-bodied and approachable, delivering wild cherry, star anise and clove flavors, supported by polished tannins.
title: Molino di Sant'Antimo 2015  Rosso di Montalcino

description: Underbrush, stewed plum and a vanilla aromas lead the nose. The medium-bodied palate offers dried Morello cherry, orange zest, sage and star anise flavors, framed by firm tannins.
title: Lunadoro 2015 Prugnanello  (Rosso di Montepulciano)

description: The nose is shy at first, gradually revealing black-skinned fruit, scorched earth and nutmeg aromas. The juicy, straightforward palate delivers ripe black cherry, mocha and clove flavors through a frame of evolved tannins. Drink through 2020.
title: La Togata 2012  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Subtle oak, underbrush and leather aromas come together in this tart, astringent red. The palate offers sour cherry, orange zest, toast and sage flavors, framed by raspy tannins.
title: Tenute del Cerro 2012 Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Subtle oak, underbrush and leather aromas come together in this tart, astringent red. The palate offers sour cherry, orange zest, toast and sage flavors, framed by raspy tannins.
title: Tenute del Cerro 2012 Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Ripe dark-skinned berry, French oak, espresso and coconut aromas emerge in the glass. Youthful and taut, the palate doles out Marasca cherry, crushed raspberry, truffle and vanilla flavors, set against a frame of tightly knit, refined tannins.
title: Talosa 2015  Rosso di Montepulciano

description: This has subdued toast, coconut, incense aromas, while the palate shows grilled herb, licorice and dried cherry flavors. Assertive, close-grained tannins leave an astringent finish.
title: Salcheto 2011 Salco  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Subdued aromas of pressed blossom, fennel and orchard fruit come together on this. The lean, rather diluted palate offers hints of green pear, citrus rind and a mineral note alongside tangy acidity.
title: Marco Porello 2014 Camestri  (Roero)

description: Subdued aromas of pressed blossom, fennel and orchard fruit come together on this. The lean, rather diluted palate offers hints of green pear, citrus rind and a mineral note alongside tangy acidity.
title: Marco Porello 2014 Camestri  (Roero)

description: This simple, refreshing white has a subdued nose while the palate offers delicate flavors suggesting peach, green apple and a hint of citrus. Bright acidity leads to a clean finish.
title: La Scolca 2015 White Label  (Gavi)

description: The nose is inexpressive while the lean, rather diluted palate offers dried herb, citrus zest and a note of bitter almond. Brisk acidity completes the picture.
region: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore
title: Frati Bianchi 2014 Il Priore  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore)

description: The nose is initially inexpressive but eventually reveals a hint of exotic spice. The palate also doesn't give away much, but orange peel and licorice notes eventually emerge alongside fleeting tannins. It finishes abruptly.
title: Cantine del Borgo Reale 2010  Barolo

description: This expression of Freisa from the Asti area of northern Italy opens with sharp berry and underbrush aromas with earthy, rubber-like tones in the background. Notice the commemorative bottle for Italy's 150th Unification anniversary.
title: Il Vino dei Padri 2010 150 Anniversario Freisa (Asti)

description: This Riserva Roero is a low-key wine with subtle fruit and spice characteristics wrapped around a thin, streamlined mouthfeel. The best thing to do with a wine like this is pair it with a sweetish, fatty food such as oil roasted tomatoes stuffed with herbs and breadcrumbs.
title: Fratelli Casetta 2007 Riserva  (Roero)

description: This modern interpretation of Dolcetto opens with plush, meaty tones of black cherry and blueberry backed by power and concentration. The finish is short, clean and tight.
title: Clavesana 2010 You d'Oh Something to Me Dolcetto (Piedmont)

description: Aromas of underbrush, pressed violet, blackberry, baked earth and new leather lead the nose of this classic wine. The structured, elegant palate offers succulent black cherry, crushed raspberry, cinnamon, clove and a hint of anise alongside tightly knit but polished tannins that need to unwind. It's already tempting but give this time to develop even more omplexity. Drink 2017–2030.
title: Contucci 2010 Mulinvecchio  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: This gorgeous wine boasts alluring scents of fragrant blue flower, wild berry, sun-baked earth, leather and a balsamic note. The linear, structured palate shows depth and finesse, delivering juicy red cherry, crushed raspberry, strawberry, clove, white pepper and tobacco. This is one of the best and freshest showings from the torrid 2011 vintage. Drink 2016–2026.
title: Monteraponi 2011 Baron' Ugo Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: This gorgeous wine boasts alluring scents of fragrant blue flower, wild berry, sun-baked earth, leather and a balsamic note. The linear, structured palate shows depth and finesse, delivering juicy red cherry, crushed raspberry, strawberry, clove, white pepper and tobacco. This is one of the best and freshest showings from the torrid 2011 vintage. Drink 2016–2026.
title: Monteraponi 2011 Baron' Ugo Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Aromas of leather, tilled soil, black-skinned fruit, spice and a balsamic note slowly take shape on this classically crafted, full-bodied red. The smooth, delicious palate doles out ripe wild cherry, crushed raspberry, cinnamon, licorice and clove alongside firm but ripe tannins. Hold for complexity. Drink 2016–2025.
title: Cafaggio 2010 Basilica Solatìo Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: A fantastic combination of power and finesse, this opens with aromas of under brush, ripe plum, truffle, leather, smoke and a balsamic note. The firm, delicious palate delivers fleshy black cherry, crushed raspberry, cinnamon and mocha. Velvety tannins support the juicy flavors.
title: San Felice 2011 Il Grigio Gran Selezione  (Chianti Classico)

description: This intriguing blend of Falanghina, Biancolella and Pepella (three relatively unknown indigenous grapes) has a candy- or soda-like quality that recalls butterscotch and caramel. However, those notes are balanced by an elegant mineral tone and the wine has good dimension on the close.
title: Tenuta San Francesco 2007 Tramonti White (Campania)

description: This maintains good harmony between aromas of ripe fruit and elegant spice. It's an easy-drinking, approachable wine that would wash down well with simple roasted meats. Imported by Racke USA.
title: Vitae 2005 Sangiovese (Puglia)

description: This a pretty and neutral smelling Negroamaro rosé from Puglia with a slightly amber hue to its color and aromas of mineral and mature peach. It has a fresh and vibrant feel with lively berry flavors and a crisp close.
title: Valle dell'Asso 2007 Rosato Negroamaro (Galatina)

description: There's an added layer of yellow fruit on the nose that recalls ripe peach and Golden Delicious apple. This inviting Falanghina is creamy and smooth with persistent sweet peach flavors. A Marc de Grazia selection, various American importers.
title: Cantina del Taburno 2007 Falanghina (Campania)

description: There's an added layer of yellow fruit on the nose that recalls ripe peach and Golden Delicious apple. This inviting Falanghina is creamy and smooth with persistent sweet peach flavors. A Marc de Grazia selection, various American importers.
title: Cantina del Taburno 2007 Falanghina (Campania)

description: Pretty mineral tones color the background of this fruit-forward Falanghina from Molise (a tiny region in Southern Italy). The wine offers stone fruit, green melon and warm honey: It's creamy but not too thick and ends on a fresh, citrusy note.
title: Borgo di Colloredo 2007 Falanghina (Molise)

description: Benito Ferrara delivers a very nice Fiano di Avellino that lives up to the excellent reputation of the wine thanks to its precise mineral tones and background notes of stone fruit and honeysuckle. A Marc de Grazia selection, various American importers.
title: Benito Ferrara 2007  Fiano di Avellino

description: A luminous, golden color sets the stage of this Coda di Volpe-based wine from Campania, with its subdued tones of pear, Golden Delicious apple and white stone. There's a playful touch of sweetness in the mouth backed by fresh citrus and white minerals.
title: Mastroberardino 2006 Coda di Volpe (Lacryma Christi del Vesuvio)

description: A luminous, golden color sets the stage of this Coda di Volpe-based wine from Campania, with its subdued tones of pear, Golden Delicious apple and white stone. There's a playful touch of sweetness in the mouth backed by fresh citrus and white minerals.
title: Mastroberardino 2006 Coda di Volpe (Lacryma Christi del Vesuvio)

description: This is good example of the potential of Calabria's Greco Bianco grape. The wine is crisp and fresh and bursting with enticing notes of fruit, honey and mineral. You'll get citrus tones followed by cleansing flavors of lime and grapefruit.
title: Statti 2007 Greco Bianco (Calabria)

description: The wine lacks huge intensity but it does deliver subdued aromas of peach, pear, mineral and candied fruit. It is light and lean in structure but has powerful and pleasantly fruity flavors.
title: Ocone 2006 Greco (Taburno)

description: Campo Morar is a sophisticated and rich Valpolicella that sees 18 months of oak aging for extra intensity and density. The wood tones add softness and lingering aromas of vanilla and spice but don't completely eliminate a sour note on the close.
title: Viviani 2005 Campo Morar  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore)

description: Figari is a simple and tight Valpolicella that opens with bright berry nuances and a touch of bitter almond. There's also an herbal, medicine like note at the back.
title: Villa Spinosa 2007 Figari  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore)

description: Here's a simple, relatively complex Valpolicella that opens with berry tones, spice and a touch of bitter almond. The wine is crisp and compact in the mouth, making it a good companion to fried finger foods.
title: Pietro Zardini 2008  Valpolicella

description: This Valpolicella shows a nice level of heft and density with ripe cherry and blueberry aromas. There's a slight tannic touch here and enough natural acidity to pair with cream cheese and chives on crackers.
title: Pietro Clementi 2005  Valpolicella Classico Superiore

description: Valpolicella is an informal but friendly wine that pairs with a long list of easy foods like pasta and pizza. This expression opens with bright cherry, blueberry and almond aromas.
title: Villa Erbice 2006 Monte Tombole  (Valpolicella Superiore)

description: This is an absolutely beautiful white wine (made from a bland of Ansonica and Chardonnay) that delivers rich and opulent tones of stone fruit, mon blossom. The wine excels in the mouth thanks to its richness and smooth creaminess.
title: Donnafugata 2007 Chiarandà  (Contessa Entellina)

description: Dark fruit and plum cake open the bouquet and set the stage for the overall aromatic richness and intensity to come. But then, that crisp acidity pops up in the mouth and pulls the wine towards a lighter, leaner side where small berry fruit and blue violets make an appearance.
title: Tenuta Friggiali 2008 Agricola Centolani  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: This is a masculine and powerful expression of Brunello with tight tannins, dark concentration and savory aromas of dark fruit, prune, leather, pipe tobacco and bitter chocolate. That characteristic acidity kicks in at the end and gives the wine a burst of levity.
title: San Lorenzo 2008 Bramante  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: This is a masculine and powerful expression of Brunello with tight tannins, dark concentration and savory aromas of dark fruit, prune, leather, pipe tobacco and bitter chocolate. That characteristic acidity kicks in at the end and gives the wine a burst of levity.
title: San Lorenzo 2008 Bramante  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Here's a very good deal for a Brunello “annate” representing the 2008 vintage. The wine offers dark concentration and steady aromas of red fruit, vanilla oak, lead pencil and drying brimstone. Touches of white pepper and cola appear on the silky finish.
title: Il Poggiolo E. Cosimi 2008 Bramante  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: You'll find ripe plum, forest floor, exotic spice, menthol and espresso aromas in this structured red. The palate is bright and linear with youthful tension, delivering red cherry, strawberry, white pepper and anise notes set against compact, fine-grained tannins. Drink 2020–2030.
title: Pietroso 2012  Brunello di Montalcino

description: This polished 100% Pinot Nero wine opens with enticing red cherry, baking spice, blue flower and balsamic notes. The elegant palate delivers red raspberry and wild strawberry fruit laced with cinnamon. It's nicely balanced, with fine-grained tannins and fresh acidity. Enjoy through 2020.
title: Marchesi de' Frescobaldi 2013 Pinot Nero (Pomino)

description: Made of 60% Merlot, 20% Cabernet Franc, 10% Cabernet Sauvignon and 10% Syrah, this offers heady black currant, plum and clove aromas. The smooth, juicy palate delivers ripe black cherry, tobacco and licorice flavors, with smooth, silky tannins. Enjoy through 2020.
title: Le Macchiole 2015  Bolgheri

description: This 100% Syrah wine opens with ripe black-skinned fruit, roasted coffee, leather and cedar aromas. The full-bodied, concentrated palate offers dried blackberry, espresso, white pepper and star anise flavors, bolstered by ample, polished tannins. Enjoy through 2021.
title: Le Macchiole 2013 Scrio Syrah (Toscana)

description: Made of 60% Trebbiano and 40% Malvasia, this opens with acacia honey, ripe Annurca apple and hazelnut aromas that carry over to the vanilla-inflected palate. Don't dip your cookies in this one; it's more of a vino da meditazione.
title: Volpaia 2011  Vin Santo del Chianti Classico

description: This all- Cabernet Franc bottling opens with cassis, mocha, graphite and bell pepper aromas. The concentrated palate delivers black currant, raspberry jam, clove and oak-derived spice flavors, with assertive but polished tannins. Drink through 2023.
title: Le Macchiole 2013 Paleo Rosso Cabernet Franc (Toscana)

description: This all- Cabernet Franc bottling opens with cassis, mocha, graphite and bell pepper aromas. The concentrated palate delivers black currant, raspberry jam, clove and oak-derived spice flavors, with assertive but polished tannins. Drink through 2023.
title: Le Macchiole 2013 Paleo Rosso Cabernet Franc (Toscana)

description: Made entirely from Sangiovese, this elegant red boasts classic varietal aromas such as violet, red berry and new leather. On the bright, sleek palate, cinnamon and Mediterranean herb accent a juicy core of Morello cherry and crushed raspberry fruit. It's nicely balanced, with polished tannins and fresh acidity. Drink through 2025.
title: Istine 2012 Levigne Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: This blend of 60% Malvasia and 40% Trebbiano boasts caramel, candied ginger and pine nut aromas. The concentrated, polished palate doles out candied apricot, maple syrup and toasted almond flavors, with a touch of carob.
title: Castello di Selvole 1996  Vin Santo del Chianti Classico

description: Vigne di Proprietà is an estate-grown wine with dark concentration and distinctive aromas of black cherry and mature fruit (likely explained by the hot vintage). The wine offers chewy fullness and opulence backed by sweet spice flavors and velvety tannins. It has power too and the alcohol definitely shows as the wine warms in the glass.
title: Marchesi di Barolo 2003 Vigne di Proprietà  (Barolo)

description: Vigna Cerretta shapes a smoky wine with notes of black fruit, road tar, licorice and spice. The wine presents an upfront layer of aromas but doesn't offer as much depth after that. Give it time to find harmony and loosen its tight tannins. Drink after 2015.
title: Ca'Romè 2005 Vigna Cerretta  (Barolo)

description: Vigna Cerretta shapes a smoky wine with notes of black fruit, road tar, licorice and spice. The wine presents an upfront layer of aromas but doesn't offer as much depth after that. Give it time to find harmony and loosen its tight tannins. Drink after 2015.
title: Ca'Romè 2005 Vigna Cerretta  (Barolo)

description: This delicate Barbaresco moves over the palate lightly and softly, imparting notes of wild berry, cedar, white truffle and licorice. The intensity builds in the mouth, where the wine gains momentum thanks to its tight, compact structure and its lingering tones of smoke and ash.
title: Tenuta Carretta 2005 Garassino  (Barbaresco)

description: Elegant and streamlined in the mouth, this expression from the Vigna del Gris vineyard shows many little aromas of wild berry, bramble, plum, licorice and leather that together form a comprehensive and intense whole. There's a touch of mature strawberry as well and the wine shows the astringent tannins of a wine that will age. Drink after 2018.
title: Conterno Fantino 2005 Vigna del Gris  (Barolo)

description: Fontanafredda is a landmark estate for the entire winemaking area and this vintage of its lovely base Barolo is particularly delicious. The aromas are broad and intense and combine hickory notes with coffee, black fruit and spice. It's a modern, succulent wine executed in a bold and food- friendly style. Drink after 2015.
title: Fontanafredda 2004 Serralunga d'Alba  (Barolo)

description: Surprising density and smoothness characterizes this structured Pinot Grigio. The wine is redolent of peach, melon and mature grapefruit with a touch of nutty almond on the close.
title: Marco Felluga 2009 Mongris Pinot Grigio (Collio)

description: Livio Felluga's Pinot Grigio is distinguished by a thick, creamy mouthfeel and abundant aromas of peach, wild flower and vanilla cream. The wine is clean and pristine, yet structured and smooth at the same time. Very nice.
title: Livio Felluga 2009 Pinot Grigio (Colli Orientali del Friuli)

description: Livio Felluga's Pinot Grigio is distinguished by a thick, creamy mouthfeel and abundant aromas of peach, wild flower and vanilla cream. The wine is clean and pristine, yet structured and smooth at the same time. Very nice.
title: Livio Felluga 2009 Pinot Grigio (Colli Orientali del Friuli)

description: Here's a very successful and aromatic Pinot Grigio from cool-climate Trentino in northern Italy. A small percentage of the grapes undergo air-drying (appassimento) for extra heft and richness on the finish. Aromas include apricot, tropical fruit and a touch of white almond.
title: Maso Canali 2009 Pinot Grigio (Trentino)

description: This is a lovely Pinot Grigio “ramato” (with a copperish color) that shows strong aromas of white cherry, cranberry and pink rose. It's smooth and creamy in the mouth and although the alcohol is high, it is well integrated.
title: Valter Scarbolo 2008 XL Pinot Grigio (Friuli Grave)

description: This luminous, golden Pinot Grigio offers loads of intensity in the form of peach, apricot, honeydew melon and white almond. The mouthfeel is smooth and thick, making this wine particularly well suited to sophisticated pasta dishes such as pumpkin-filled ravioli with crushed walnuts.
title: Valter Scarbolo 2008 Pinot Grigio (Friuli Grave)

description: This is infused with engaging scents of red berry, crushed violet, rose and a balsamic whiff of eucalyptus. The linear palate is tightly wound, offering dried wild cherry and a note of light baking spice accompanied by rather austere tannins. Drink after 2018.
title: Malabaila 2012 Bric Volta  (Roero)

description: This shows rustic aromas of barnyard and wet fur combined with espresso and toast. Despite a dense core of black fruit, this is bitter and astringent, with an abrupt finish.
title: Negretti 2010 Superiore  (Barbera d'Alba)

description: Dark berry, baking spice, tilled soil and a hint of new leather aromas unfold on this polished, earthy red. The juicy palate tastes of black cherry, cinnamon, orange zest, and aromatic herb while its mineral vein is noticeable alongside smooth tannins and fresh acidity. Enjoy through 2023.
title: COS 2013  Cerasuolo di Vittoria Classico

description: Dark berry, baking spice, tilled soil and a hint of new leather aromas unfold on this polished, earthy red. The juicy palate tastes of black cherry, cinnamon, orange zest, and aromatic herb while its mineral vein is noticeable alongside smooth tannins and fresh acidity. Enjoy through 2023.
title: COS 2013  Cerasuolo di Vittoria Classico

description: Aromas of yellow flower, citrus and dried herb float out of the glass. The palate is a bit on the lean side, offering lime, grilled sage and bitter almond alongside zesty acidity.
title: Principe di Corleone 2015 Bianca di Corte Grillo (Sicilia)

description: This opens with aromas suggesting pressed yellow flower, orchard fruit and an unusual whiff that recalls brimstone. The brisk palate offers yellow apple, citrus and a bitter medicinal note.
title: Terredora 2015 Corte di Giso Falanghina (Irpinia)

description: This is a bit ripe and raw with notes of blueberry, some strawberry, black ink and background shadings of graphite or charcoal. It has a simple, easy feel in the mouth with sharp cherry tones and a slightly abbreviated finish.
title: Tenimenti Angelini 2003 TreRose Simposio  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Raw, extremely redolent of blueberries and strawberries with a tiny lactic note, this wine tastes much younger than it really is. It's also on the ripe side with some jelly and jam-like nuances and a solid core of in-your-face fruit. It has rich, dense extraction and simple, fruit-driven flavors. This Riserva has always performed very well in past vintages.
title: Carpineto 2004 Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: This wine has structure and concentration, but is less generous in terms of its aromas. There are evident notes of ripe cherry, leather, vanilla and some tobacco, but they never come into full bloom. The tannins are gritty and still a bit raw and the wine offers sour cherry flavors in the mouth.
title: Bindella 2005  Vino Nobile di Montepulciano

description: This offers aromas of toast, espresso, scorched earth, red berry, clove and a whiff of leather. The lean, tense palate offers dried cherry, grilled herb, anise, coffee and tobacco but not much fruit richness. Tightly wound, bracing tannins and nervous acidity provide the framework.
title: Poderi Luigi Einaudi 2011 Cannubi  (Barolo)

description: The nose is initially rather closed but eventually reveals dark berry, blue flower and brown baking spice. The ripe palate offers mature black cherry, coffee, cocoa, star anise and chopped sage alongside tightly packed tannins. Give this another two or three years to let the tannins unfurl, then enjoy.
title: Mauro Veglio 2011 Arborina  (Barolo)

description: Aromas of baked plum are joined by earthy whiffs of truffle, leather, game and cured meat. The aromas carry over to the ripe, dense palate along with fleshy black cherry, anise, mocha and mint. Velvety tannins provide the framework while a confectionary note backs up the finish. Drink 2017–2022.
title: Manzone Fratelli 2011 Fraschin  (Barolo)

description: Raspberry, rose petal, baking spice, tilled soil and new leather aromas unfold on this structured red. The chewy, full-bodied palate doles out juicy wild cherry, menthol and dark cooking spice while assertive tannins and fresh acidity lend balance. Drink 2019–2029.
title: Gianpiero Marrone 2011 Pichemej  (Barolo)

description: Red berry, dried rose, truffle and a hint of scorched earth aromas come together on this solid, no-frills Barolo. The straightforward palate delivers wild cherry, ripe strawberry and a hint of cake spice alongside firm, ripe tannins and fresh acidity. Drink 2016–2021.
title: Villadoria 2011  Barolo

description: This opens with aromas of woodland berry, crushed herb and a whiff of well-integrated oak. The firm palate delivers dried Morello cherry, baking spice and mocha alongside firm, fine-grained tannin. It closes on a note of star anise. Drink 2016–2021 to capture the fruit richness.
title: Cascina Ballarin 2011 Bricco Rocca  (Barolo)

description: This opens with aromas of woodland berry, crushed herb and a whiff of well-integrated oak. The firm palate delivers dried Morello cherry, baking spice and mocha alongside firm, fine-grained tannin. It closes on a note of star anise. Drink 2016–2021 to capture the fruit richness.
title: Cascina Ballarin 2011 Bricco Rocca  (Barolo)

description: Crushed rose, pressed violet, perfumed berry, sage and a balsamic note are just some of the aromas you'll find on this full-bodied red. The firm palate offers dried black cherry, black pepper and licorice alongside tightly knit tannins and the subtle warmth of alcohol. Give it a few more years to come together. Drink 2018–2016.
title: Cantina del Pino 2011  Barbaresco

description: Mature black fruit, toast and spice aromas lead the nose. The firm palate is still tightly wound, offering baked black cherry, licorice and espresso balanced by youthfully assertive, taut tannins. Drink after 2019.
title: Cantina del Nebbiolo 2011 del Comune di Serralunga d'Alba  (Barolo)

description: Classic Nebbiolo aromas of red berry, underbrush, tilled soil, aromatic herb and spice lead the nose. The bracing palate offers dried black cherry, anisette, mocha, toast and grilled herb alongside extremely assertive tannins and brisk acidity. Drink 2019–2031.
title: Ca' Viola 2011 Sottocastello di Novello  (Barolo)

description: Here's an Amarone with raw notes of cherry and root beer backed by mesquite smoke, spice, leather and cigar box. It's a very sweet, succulent wine with soft tannins and a long, chewy finish.
title: Le Guaite 2003 Le Guaite di Giulietta  (Amarone della Valpolicella)

description: Here's an Amarone with raw notes of cherry and root beer backed by mesquite smoke, spice, leather and cigar box. It's a very sweet, succulent wine with soft tannins and a long, chewy finish.
title: Le Guaite 2003 Le Guaite di Giulietta  (Amarone della Valpolicella)

description: If you aren't familiar with Ripasso (a hybrid wine that borrows elements from austere Amarone and informal Valpolicella), this selection from Bolla is an excellent introductory wine. It opens with a deep-ruby color and bright aromas of red cherry, cola, spice and leather. It ends with both sweet and spicy nuances.
title: Bolla 2007 Le Poiane  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso)

description: Intense aromas of white peach, green apple and pear carry over to the palate along with lemon zest, almond paste and a note of candied ginger. Crisp acidity brightens up the creamy fruit palate.
title: Ancilla 2012 Ella  (Lugana)

description: Intense aromas of white peach, green apple and pear carry over to the palate along with lemon zest, almond paste and a note of candied ginger. Crisp acidity brightens up the creamy fruit palate.
title: Ancilla 2012 Ella  (Lugana)

description: Made from the Turbiana grape, this conveys aromas of jasmine, honeysuckle and citrus with a whiff of walnut. The palate offers juicy nectarine, kiwi and lemon zest accented by a hint of almond.
title: Ancilla 2012 1909  (Lugana)

description: Aromas of lemon blossom, pear and citrus lead the nose, with a whiff of bread dough. The dry palate delivers mature yellow apple, lemon zest and toasted almond alongside bright acidity and a lively perlage.
title: Altemasi 2007 Pas Dosé Sparkling (Trento)

description: Aromas of lemon blossom, pear and citrus lead the nose, with a whiff of bread dough. The dry palate delivers mature yellow apple, lemon zest and toasted almond alongside bright acidity and a lively perlage.
title: Altemasi 2007 Pas Dosé Sparkling (Trento)

description: Dense and delicious, this deeply colored wine opens with aromas of blue flower, plum, raspberry and graphite. The lively, savory palate delivers concentrated black cherry, cassis, white pepper and mineral before reaching a dry finish. Thanks to broad but fine tannins, it has a surprisingly solid structure for such an easy-drinking, enjoyable wine.
title: Villa di Corlo 2013 Corleto  (Lambrusco Grasparossa di Castelvetro)

description: Dense and delicious, this deeply colored wine opens with aromas of blue flower, plum, raspberry and graphite. The lively, savory palate delivers concentrated black cherry, cassis, white pepper and mineral before reaching a dry finish. Thanks to broad but fine tannins, it has a surprisingly solid structure for such an easy-drinking, enjoyable wine.
title: Villa di Corlo 2013 Corleto  (Lambrusco Grasparossa di Castelvetro)

description: This opens with aromas of ripe berry, pipe tobacco, leather and espresso. The palate offers mature black cherry, coffee, vanilla and mocha alongside firm, drying tannins. It finishes on a licorice note.
title: Tenuta Rocca 2010  Barolo

description: This opens with aromas of oak, espresso, mocha and plum. The firm palate offers oak extract, chocolate, licorice and black cherry alongside drying wood tannins.
title: Cascina Bongiovanni 2010 Pernanno  (Barolo)

description: Fruity, fresh and bone dry, this offers aromas of bright red berries and a hint of violets. The refreshing palate delivers intense strawberry and wild cherry accented with a hint of white pepper. Serve chilled and sip on the deck in summertime or pair with cold cuts.
title: Paltrinieri 2013 L'Eclisse  (Lambrusco di Sorbara)

description: Aromas include ripe plum, blackberry, vanilla, coffee and a hint of toasted oak. On the palate, notes of mocha and chocolate back up candied cherry and black raspberry. Firm tannins support the juicy flavors. Drink through 2021.
title: Marchesi di Barolo 2011 Serragrilli  (Barbaresco)

description: This opens with scents of orchard fruit, beeswax and a whiff of white flower. The light, linear palate shows Bartlett pear and citrus peel alongside zesty acidity that lends verve.
title: Montesole 2014  Greco di Tufo

description: This opens with scents of orchard fruit, beeswax and a whiff of white flower. The light, linear palate shows Bartlett pear and citrus peel alongside zesty acidity that lends verve.
title: Montesole 2014  Greco di Tufo

description: Smoky mineral, Mediterranean herb, stone fruit and flint aromas lead the nose on this polished, vibrant wine. The linear palate doles out white peach, mint, sage, lemon zest and energizing mineral alongside firm acidity.
title: Villa Raiano 2013  Fiano di Avellino

description: This structured, copper-colored wine—the natural color of Pinot Grigio after skin contact—delivers dried red berry, nut, lightly toasted oak, butterscotch, vanilla and mineral sensations. It's an unusual but attractive interpretation of Pinot Grigio.
title: Vie di Romans 2012 Dessimis Pinot Grigio (Friuli Isonzo)

description: High-toned aromas include nail varnish, resin, spicy plum and nutmeg. The concentrated palate delivers ripe blackberry, blueberry extract, clove and a chocolate note alongside smooth tannins. A licorice note signals the close.
title: Le Ragose 2006 Marta Galli  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Subtle but pretty aromas of pressed flower, mature pear and honey mingle in the glass. The round, full-bodied palate offers dried apricot, Golden Delicious apple, lemon drop and nuance of cake spice brightened by fresh acidity.
title: Cà Lojera 2012  Lugana Superiore

description: Crisp and linear, this delicious Soave delivers sensations of honeysuckle, tart green apple, creamy white peach and juicy nectarine. It's vibrant and balanced, with bright acidity.
title: Gini 2013  Soave Classico

description: Crisp and linear, this delicious Soave delivers sensations of honeysuckle, tart green apple, creamy white peach and juicy nectarine. It's vibrant and balanced, with bright acidity.
title: Gini 2013  Soave Classico

description: Made from the estate's oldest vines, this silky blend of 95% Schiava and 5% Lagrein opens with a fragrance of wild berry and alpine herb. The vibrant palate doles out layers of sour red cherry, juicy raspberry, mandarin orange and a light almond note alongside fine-grained tannins and bright acidity. Enjoy soon to capture the delicious fresh fruit flavors.
title: Franz Gojer-Glögglhof 2013 Rondell St. Magdalener Red (Alto Adige)

description: Made from the estate's oldest vines, this silky blend of 95% Schiava and 5% Lagrein opens with a fragrance of wild berry and alpine herb. The vibrant palate doles out layers of sour red cherry, juicy raspberry, mandarin orange and a light almond note alongside fine-grained tannins and bright acidity. Enjoy soon to capture the delicious fresh fruit flavors.
title: Franz Gojer-Glögglhof 2013 Rondell St. Magdalener Red (Alto Adige)

description: You'll detect aromas reminiscent of wood shop on this wine. Both the nose and the palate reveal heavy-handed oak sensations along with espresso, vanilla and a hint of burned rubber.
title: Tinazzi 2011 Rivertondo Tenuta Valleselle  (Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso)

description: This vino naturale (the wine is not filtered and has no added sulfites) opens with intense aromas of butterscotch, candied fruit, apricot and honey. The blend is Chardonnay, Sauvignon and Malvasia, and it tastes slightly oxidized overall.
title: Paraschos 2009 Ponka White (Venezia Giulia)

description: Fresh, clean and pristine, this is an up-and-coming indigenous grape from central Italy. It shows a light, lean mouthfeel with citrus highlights that would pair with barbecued shrimp or calamari.
title: Farnese 2011 Casale Vecchio Passerina (Colli Aprutini)

description: Fresh, clean and pristine, this is an up-and-coming indigenous grape from central Italy. It shows a light, lean mouthfeel with citrus highlights that would pair with barbecued shrimp or calamari.
title: Farnese 2011 Casale Vecchio Passerina (Colli Aprutini)

description: Made from a blend of Ribolla Gialla and Malvasia Istriana, this rich but finessed wine conveys delicate aromas of hawthorne, stone fruit and slate. The succulent palate delivers apricot, tangerine and lime accented with mineral and bitter almond. An unusual, compelling wine.
title: Scubla 2012 Speziale Bianco White (Colli Orientali del Friuli)

description: A structured but polished Sauvignon made from organically farmed grapes. The delicious palate delivers white peach, grapefruit and honeydew melon accented with mineral and a ginger note. Fermentation in large casks gives complexity.
title: Manincor 2012 Tannenberg Sauvignon (Alto Adige Terlano)

description: Citrus blossom and orchard fruit aromas lead the way. On the round, medium-bodied palate, tangy acidity supports ripe yellow apple and pear flavors. A hint of citrus zest marks the close.
title: Castello di Spessa 2015 Pinot Grigio (Collio)

description: This wine's delicate nose offers white spring flower, Mediterranean herb and wet stone aromas. They carry over to the fresh palate, along with fruity green apple and pineapple notes while a savory mineral note backs up the finish.
title: La Sibilla 2015 Falanghina (Campi Flegrei)

description: Taut and tense, this opens with aromas of red berry, crushed herb, clove and whiff of menthol. The firm, tightly wound palate offers bright cherry, licorice and ground black pepper alongside assertive tannins and nervous acidity. Give this time to unwind and fully develop. Drink 2019–2031.
title: Poderi Luigi Einaudi 2011 Terlo Vigna Costa Grimaldi  (Barolo)

description: Aromas of perfumed berry, mint, baking spice and a whiff of oak emerge on this structured wine. The firm palate offers wild red cherry, crushed raspberry, mint, grilled sage and a touch of oak-driven spice alongside bracing tannins and nervous acidity. Give it time to soften and fully develop. Drink 2019–2031.
title: Oddero 2011 Brunate  (Barolo)

description: Aromas of perfumed berry, mint, baking spice and a whiff of oak emerge on this structured wine. The firm palate offers wild red cherry, crushed raspberry, mint, grilled sage and a touch of oak-driven spice alongside bracing tannins and nervous acidity. Give it time to soften and fully develop. Drink 2019–2031.
title: Oddero 2011 Brunate  (Barolo)

description: Made with dried Nebbiolo grapes, this offers aromas of pressed rose, mature dark berry, leather, baking spice and a balsamic note. The concentrated, forward palate doles out mature black cherry, carob, date, clove and tobacco alongside firm, fine-grained tannins.
title: Travaglini 2010 Il Sogno  (Gattinara)

description: Crushed violet, woodland berry, eucalyptus and cake spice aromas meld in the glass. The structured palate doles out dried black cherry, licorice, espresso and white pepper alongside tight, fine-grained tannins. It closes on a note of chopped sage. Drink 2017–2022.
title: Nada Fiorenzo 2011 Manzola  (Barbaresco)

description: Pretty aromas of blue flower, rose, wild berry and graphite lead the way. The firm palate delivers mature black cherry, raspberry, star anise, black pepper and chopped sage alongside bright acidity and tightly knit tannins that need to unwind. Drink 2018–2026.
title: Marchesi di Barolo 2011 Coste di Rose  (Barolo)

description: Pretty aromas of blue flower, rose, wild berry and graphite lead the way. The firm palate delivers mature black cherry, raspberry, star anise, black pepper and chopped sage alongside bright acidity and tightly knit tannins that need to unwind. Drink 2018–2026.
title: Marchesi di Barolo 2011 Coste di Rose  (Barolo)

description: Aromas of slightly stewed fruit, steeped berry, spice and menthol unfold in the glass. The firm palate delivers juicy cherry, crushed raspberry, licorice, ground pepper and a mint note while bracing tannins and racy acidity provide the backbone. This needs a few more years to calm down and will continue to age well for a decade or more. Drink 2018–2026.
title: Le Strette 2011 Bergera Pezzole  (Barolo)

description: Scents of woodland berry, rose petal, grilled herb, anisette and a balsamic note emerge on this firmly structured wine. On the robust palate, white pepper, licorice, sage and a hint of toast weave through the black cherry core. You'll also detect the warmth of alcohol on the close. Drink 2018–2028.
title: Fratelli Alessandria 2011 Monvigliero  (Barolo)

description: Heady scents of fragrant jasmine, wisteria and white orchard fruit lead the nose, while the frothy, slightly sweet palate offers succulent yellow apple, pear and ripe white peach. Firm acidity and a creamy perlage provide the framework.
title: Case Bianche 2014 Tenuta Col Santago Undici  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Delicate but enticing scents of white spring flowers and orchard fruit float out of the glass. The bright, creamy palate offers white peach, green apple and a hint of pastry cream alongside bright acidity and a frothy mousse.
title: Astoria NV Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Scents of green apple and sage float from the glass and carry over to the frothy palate of white peach. Vibrant acidity offsets the rich fruit flavors while a note of candied citrus backs up the finish.
title: Ruggeri & C. NV Giall'Oro Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Wisteria and hawthorn aromas lead the way alongside a note of chopped herbs. The herbs note follows through to the palate and accents crisp green apple, pear and citrus peel, while vibrant acidity and persistent bubbles provide a zesty backdrop.
title: Case Bianche 2014 Vigna del Cuc  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Aromas of ripe yellow pear, toasted bread crust and a whiff of candied lemon drop slowly emerge on the nose. The rich, deeply colored palate doles out pastry cream, nectarine zest and walnut. Tangy acidity brightens the creamy flavors.
title: Baracchi 2012 Brut Metodo Classico Trebbiano (Vino Spumante)

description: Aromas of ripe yellow pear, toasted bread crust and a whiff of candied lemon drop slowly emerge on the nose. The rich, deeply colored palate doles out pastry cream, nectarine zest and walnut. Tangy acidity brightens the creamy flavors.
title: Baracchi 2012 Brut Metodo Classico Trebbiano (Vino Spumante)

description: This sparkler boasts pretty aromas of white spring flowers, peach and a whiff of Alpine herbs. On the palate, green apple and yellow pear abound while citrus zest and a hint of sage provide back up.
title: Ambo Secco NV Brut  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This sparkler boasts pretty aromas of white spring flowers, peach and a whiff of Alpine herbs. On the palate, green apple and yellow pear abound while citrus zest and a hint of sage provide back up.
title: Ambo Secco NV Brut  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Aromas of wisteria, jasmine, orchard fruit and a whiff of mountain herbs lead the nose. The creamy palate offers yellow apple, white peach, sage and a note of candied lemon drop alongside a soft mousse and bright acidity.
title: Foss Marai 2014 Nadin Millesimato Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Scents of orange blossom, tropical fruit and ripe apple emerge on this lively sparkler. Made with 100% Falanghina, the firm palate delivers nectarine zest, pineapple, green apple and a mineral vein alongside bright acidity and a vibrant, creamy mousse.
title: Feudi di San Gregorio NV Brut Metodo Classico Falanghina (Vino Spumante)

description: This opens with an unusual but intriguing fragrance of candied citrus accented by balsamic notes, aromatic herbs and slate. The bright, linear palate delivers succulent pineapple, nectarine and pink grapefruit energized by mineral notes.
title: Vesevo 2012  Fiano di Avellino

description: This has aromas of toast and exotic fruit that carry over to the palate along with notes of citrus zest, vanilla and roasted coffee bean. A hint of grilled herb marks the close.
title: Attems 2015 Cicinis Sauvignon (Collio)

description: Tomato vine, cut grass, crushed stone and grapefruit aromas almost leap out of the glass. The crisp savory palate delivers juicy citrus, ripe honeydew melon, Alpine herb and a mineral note framed in bright acidity. It has a bright, clean finish.
title: Terlan 2015 Winkl Sauvignon (Alto Adige)

description: Enticing scents of white spring flower, orchard fruit, Alpine herb and an intriguing whiff of smoke lead the way on this stunning wine. The elegantly structured radiant palate delivers juicy nectarine, creamy pear and sage framed in tangy acidity. A racy mineral vein further lifts the lingering finish. Drink through 2020.
title: Abbazia di Novacella 2015 Praepositus Sylvaner (Alto Adige)

description: Linear and mineral driven, this intriguing white opens with aromas of beeswax, acacia, citrus, stone fruit and a yeasty whiff of bread crust. On the expressive palate, a mineral note underscores juicy yellow peach, nectarine and apple. There's a lot going on and a lot to enjoy here.
title: I Stefanini 2015 Monte di Fice  (Soave Classico)

description: Made with dried grapes—67% Malvasia and 33% Trebbiano—this meditation wine opens with intense aromas of maple syrup, carob and crushed raw almond. The concentrated palate doles out dried apricot, chestnut honey and toasted hazelnut while fresh acidity balances the sweet flavors.
title: I Sodi 2009  Vin Santo del Chianti Classico

description: Mature black-skinned fruit, raisin, crushed purple flower and baking spice are some of the aromas you'll find on this bold wine. The chewy full-bodied palate offers dried black cherry, black currant, ground pepper and pipe tobacco alongside firm velvety tannins. An espresso note closes the lingering finish. Drink 2018–2025.
title: Le Salette 2012 Pergole Vece  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Enticing scents of white wild flower, yellow stone fruit and a whiff of honeydew melon lead to a vibrant palate loaded with ripe apricot, cantaloupe and citrus. Baking spice and ginger notes add depth to the lingering finish while fresh acidity lends balance. This will continue to age well and evolve for several years or longer.
title: Jermann 2013 Vintage Tunina White (Venezia Giulia)

description: There's exotic spice here that plays a supporting role to prune, plum and mature blackberry. The wine (a blend of Montepulciano and Nero di Troia) is simple, but generous and intense at the same time. It feels smooth and succulent in the mouth. Pair it with grilled steak and French fries.
title: Rivera 2007 Rupìcolo Red (Castel del Monte)

description: This wine offers drying aromas of dried hay or graham cracker that are very unusual for a dessert wine. In fact, they suggest an obvious pairing with dried biscuits or sponge cake. That said, the wine certainly has personality and offers a smooth, honey-like finish.
title: Volpago NV Lunastorta Passito White (Veneto)

description: There's a distinctive aromatic quality to this wine that comes off more as flowers than it does as fruit. The wine is crisp and satisfying in the mouth and it delivers a touch of piquant spice on the close. This estate was founded more than 400 years ago in 1607.
title: Albino Armani 2007 Corvara Pinot Grigio (Valdadige)

description: Here's a Soave Classico made with fruit selected from Santi's Monteforte vineyard that delivers fresh aromas of stone fruit, honey and lemon zest. There's good balance between acidity and density here and this easygoing wine leaves a cleansing effect on the palate.
title: Santi 2007 Vigneti di Monteforte  (Soave Classico)

description: Aromas recalling hay, yellow flower, dried herb and a light vegetal note carry over to the bright, medium-bodied palate along with lime and green apple. A flinty mineral note underscores the vibrant flavors.
title: Pietradolce 2015 Bianco  (Etna)

description: Aromas of ripe orchard fruit, Mediterranean herb and toasted hazelnut lead the nose while the bright palate offers green pear, peach, unripe apricot and bitter almond. A mineral note signals the close.
title: Mastroberardino 2015 Novaserra  (Greco di Tufo)

description: Made with Nero d'Avola and Perricone, this offers alluring aromas of red berry, spice and a floral note. The bright, immediate palate offers succulent wild cherry, crushed raspberry nectarine zest and a hint of baking spice alongside zesty acidity that leads to a crisp, clean finish.
title: Tenuta Rapitalà 2015 Rosato (Terre Siciliane)

description: Subdued aromas of spring wild flower, hay and orchard fruit float from the glass. The vibrant palate offers lemon zest, sage, dried herb and a hint of saline framed in lively acidity.
title: Tenuta Rapitalà 2015 Grillo (Sicilia)

description: One of Italy's most celebrated whites, this elegant wine opens with alluring scents of white spring flower, white stone fruit and citrus. Radiant and loaded with finesse, the vibrant palate delivers yellow apple, Bartlett pear, nectarine and a hint of ginger alongside bright acidity.
title: Jermann 2014 Vintage Tunina White (Venezia Giulia)

description: Aromas that recall grapefruit, medicinal herb, thyme and adhesive bandages carry over to the lean palate, along with a note of bitter almond.
title: Tenuta di Angoris 2013 Sonoro Sauvignon Blanc (Friuli)

description: Aromas that recall grapefruit, medicinal herb, thyme and adhesive bandages carry over to the lean palate, along with a note of bitter almond.
title: Tenuta di Angoris 2013 Sonoro Sauvignon Blanc (Friuli)
