The concentrated palate delivers blackberry jam, toasted oak, roasted coffee bean and a hint of licorice framed in fine-grained tannins. You'll also notice the heat of evident alcohol. Enjoy through 2021.
title: Fattoria Zerbina 2013 Pietramora Marzeno Riserva Sangiovese (Romagna)

description: Aromas of black-skinned berry, tilled soil and cooking spice lead the nose. The savory juicy palate offers ripe black cherry, leather and black pepper alongside polished tannins. Enjoy through 2020.
title: Enio Ottaviani 2013 Sole Rosso Sangiovese (Romagna)

description: Combining ripe fruit and freshness, this sunny white delivers aromas of yellow flower and yellow stone fruit. Mirroring the aromas, the enveloping palate offers juicy apricot, candied ginger and citrus zest. Bright acidity lifts the rich flavors while a hint of almond closes the finish.
title: Celli 2015 I Croppi Albana (Romagna)

description: A blend of Sangiovese, Cabernet Sauvignon and Canaiolo, this evokes dark-skinned berry and baking spice aromas. The firm savory palate delivers black plum, tobacco and vanilla alongside round tannins. Enjoy through 2019.
title: Brocatelli Galli 2013 Santa Caterina Red (Torgiano Rosso Riserva)

description: Aromas of spring flower, Mediterranean brush, wild herb and tropical fruit lead the nose on this expressive white. The round juicy palate offers pineapple and yellow stone fruit, while a hint of chopped mint closes the finish.
title: Argiolas 2015 Costamolino  (Vermentino di Sardegna)

description: Aromas of spring flower, Mediterranean brush, wild herb and tropical fruit lead the nose on this expressive white. The round juicy palate offers pineapple and yellow stone fruit, while a hint of chopped mint closes the finish.
title: Argiolas 2015 Costamolino  (Vermentino di Sardegna)

description: Black pepper, mature plum and a whiff of damp soil carry over to the dense palate along with chopped herb and black-cherry extract. Assertive close-grained tannins provide the framework and leave a dusty, drying finish.
title: Antico Castello 2010  Taurasi

description: Black pepper, mature plum and a whiff of damp soil carry over to the dense palate along with chopped herb and black-cherry extract. Assertive close-grained tannins provide the framework and leave a dusty, drying finish.
title: Antico Castello 2010  Taurasi

description: Crisp and elegant, this offers alluring scents of white spring flower and yellow stone fruit. The bright linear palate mirrors the nose, offering yellow pear, crunchy apple, white almond and a citrusy note alongside vibrant acidity.
title: Alessandro Tofanari 2013 Astrea  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: Made entirely with Cannonau, this opens with aromas of red berry and Mediterranean brush. The friendly full-bodied palate delivers red cherry, raspberry and white pepper alongside polished tannins. Enjoy through 2020.
title: Vigne Surrau 2014 Sincaru  (Cannonau di Sardegna)

description: Delicate scents of yellow field flower and ripe orchard fruit float from the glass. The savory palate doles out yellow apple, yellow Bartlett pear, tangerine and a hint of stony mineral. Fresh acidity brightens the creamy flavors.
title: San Benedetto 2015  Vernaccia di San Gimignano

description: There's loads of personality here. Verduzzo does beat to its own drum with unique aromas of pine cone, chopped peppermint, candied fruit and loads of floral lavender honey.
title: Bernardis 2006 Ramandolo 750ml Verduzzo (Friuli)

description: Made with organically farmed grapes, this has aromas suggesting acacia honey and toasted nut. The aromas carry over to the palate along with mature yellow apple and a marked note of bitter almond. Zesty acidity lifts the finish.
title: Il Colombaio di Santa Chiara 2014 Campo della Pieve  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: Aromas of toasted oak, smoke and whiff of dried yellow flower take shape in the glass. The rather lean racy palate shows oak, butterscotch, bitter almond and a hint of citrus zest while tangy acidity provides the framework.
title: Falchini 2013 Vigna a Solatio Riserva  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: Delicately scented, this has subtle aromas evoking acacia, orchard fruit and a whiff of honeyed nut. The medium-bodied palate offers yellow apple and Bartlett pear that merge with bitter almond. It closes on a saline note.
title: La Mormoraia 2015  Vernaccia di San Gimignano

description: A selection of the firm's best Vernaccia grapes, this offers delicate alluring scent of hawthorn and white stone fruit. The bright straightforward palate shows yellow apple and pear alongside fresh acidity while a bitter-almond note marks the finish.
title: La Mormoraia 2015 Ostrea  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: Made with 50% Trebbiano, 20% Grechetto, 10% Verdello, 10% Malvasia and 10% Drupeggio, this has aromas of ripe peach and apricot. The aromas carry over to the rather sweet, lively palate together with a hint of almond. Enjoy soon.
title: Bigi 2015 Amabile  (Orvieto Classico)

description: Made entirely with Nero d'Avola, this opens with aromas of red berry and Mediterranean herb. The vibrant straightforward palate delivers red cherry, raspberry and baking spice alongside fresh acidity. Drink soon.
title: Fondo Antico 2014 Aprile Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: Grifalco offers a light and elegant style with loads of spice and black fruit flavors. The wine is easy and approachable overall with fresh fruit notes that chime in on the close.
title: Lucania 2005 Grifalco  (Aglianico del Vulture)

description: Speri's Ripasso has an added layer of spice, vanilla and other oak-generated aromas that distinguish it. There's a juicy core of fruit there too: black cherry, plums and white raisin. Drink this wine with meat-filled ravioli or wild mushrooms.
title: Speri 2005  Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso

description: Riserva Cappellaccio is a pure expression of Aglianico that has embraced the scorching heat of the 2003 vintage to deliver warm tones of jammy fruit, tar, asphalt, resin and natural spice. The wine is broad and chewy in the mouth.
title: Rivera 2003 Riserva Cappellaccio Aglianico (Castel del Monte)

description: Riserva Cappellaccio is a pure expression of Aglianico that has embraced the scorching heat of the 2003 vintage to deliver warm tones of jammy fruit, tar, asphalt, resin and natural spice. The wine is broad and chewy in the mouth.
title: Rivera 2003 Riserva Cappellaccio Aglianico (Castel del Monte)

description: Nero di Serramarrocco is a thick, meaty Sicilian red with aromas of bacon fat, spice and mature blackberry. The mouthfeel is compact and clean and not too thick or syrupy.
title: Tenuta di Serramarrocco 2005 Nero di Serramarrocco Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: This Tuscan Chardonnay is executed in a modern, New World style with ample oak-driven flavors and rich density and texture to match. However, the wine remains focused on complexity and elegance. It would make an ideal match to Indian butter chicken or creamy oven-roasted potatoes.
title: Barone Ricasoli 2006 Torricella Chardonnay (Toscana)

description: This wine's inviting blue flower, dark berry and cake spice aromas emerge in the glass. The vibrant palate delivers juicy Marasca cherry, crushed raspberry, cinnamon and star anise flavors while firm, refined tannins and fresh acidity provide support.
title: Adriano Marco & Vittorio 2014 Sanadaive  (Barbaresco)

description: Showing surprising structure for the vintage, this medium-bodied white offers aromas of honey, nut, pressed flower and peach. The flavors follow through to the vibrant palate, along with mineral and tangy acidity.
title: Vigne Marina Coppi 2014 Marine Favorita (Colli Tortonesi)

description: Enticing scents of fragrant white flower, apricot, pineapple and a whiff of wild herb float out of the glass. On the rich frothy palate, notes of sage and candied lemon drop accent ripe apricot and yellow peach alongside a softly foaming mousse. It finishes bright and clean.
title: Scagliola 2015 Primo Bacio  (Moscato d'Asti)

description: A blend of 80% Nebbiolo, 10% Vespolina and 10% Croatina, this opens with enticing aromas of red woodland berry and a whiff of a vineyard in bloom. The fresh savory palate doles out crunchy sour cherry, pomegranate and a hint of tangerine zest while a mineral vein wraps up the finish.
title: Le Pianelle 2015 Al Posto dei Fiori Rosato (Coste della Sesia)

description: Aromas of pressed rose, red berry, chopped herb and espresso lead the nose. The firm palate offers juicy black cherry, licorice and a hint of mocha alongside a backbone of fine-grained tannins. Drink after 2018.
title: Gianni Gagliardo 2012  Barolo

description: Aromas of pressed rose, red berry, chopped herb and espresso lead the nose. The firm palate offers juicy black cherry, licorice and a hint of mocha alongside a backbone of fine-grained tannins. Drink after 2018.
title: Gianni Gagliardo 2012  Barolo

description: Toasted oak, coffee and vanilla lead the nose and carry over to the palate along with dense cherry extract and espresso. Raspy wood tannins leave an astringent, abrupt finish.
title: Orlando Abrigo 2011 Meruzzano  (Barbaresco)

description: Toasted oak, coffee and vanilla lead the nose and carry over to the palate along with dense cherry extract and espresso. Raspy wood tannins leave an astringent, abrupt finish.
title: Orlando Abrigo 2011 Meruzzano  (Barbaresco)

description: Initially quite closed, the palate eventually reveals sensations of mature black fruit, roasted coffee bean, vanilla and espresso. It lacks fruit richness and is overwhelmed by astringent wood tannins.
title: La Contea 2011 Serragrilli  (Barbaresco)

description: Aromas of toasted oak, espresso, chocolate and mocha echo on the palate, along with notes of chocolate and mocha. But it lacks fruit richness and can't stand up to the astringent wood tannins.
title: Prinsi 2011 Gallina  (Barbaresco)

description: Aromas of toasted oak, espresso, chocolate and mocha echo on the palate, along with notes of chocolate and mocha. But it lacks fruit richness and can't stand up to the astringent wood tannins.
title: Prinsi 2011 Gallina  (Barbaresco)

description: Aromas of butterscotch, toasted oak, roasted coffee and espresso follow through to the palate along with notes of black pepper. There's not enough fruit richness to stand up to the astringent, woody tannins.
title: Prinsi 2011 Gaia Principe  (Barbaresco)

description: This warm expression of Nebbiolo opens with aromas of stewed prunes, resin and raisin. The palate offers plums steeped in spirits and espresso alongside green wood tannins that generate an abrupt finish.
title: Giacosa Fratelli 2011 Basarin Vigna Gianmatè  (Barbaresco)

description: This opens with subdued aromas of menthol, dried herb and spiced plum. The palate is rather evolved, offering dried cherry, coffee, clove and a hint of black tea framed in close-grained tannins that grip the finish. Drink sooner rather than later to capture what fruit remains.
title: Stomennano 2009 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Bright and fresh, this easygoing wine offers aromas of wild berry and fragrant blue flower. The simple, easy-drinking palate delivers red cherry and a hint of white pepper alongside zesty acidity and limber tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: San Leonino 2013 Al Limite  (Chianti Classico)

description: Bright and fresh, this easygoing wine offers aromas of wild berry and fragrant blue flower. The simple, easy-drinking palate delivers red cherry and a hint of white pepper alongside zesty acidity and limber tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: San Leonino 2013 Al Limite  (Chianti Classico)

description: Yellow wild flower and ripe orchard fruit aromas lead the nose while the bright palate evokes tangerine, golden apple and a juicy hint of pineapple. Fresh acidity gives it a tangy finish.
title: Feudo Maccari 2016 Grillo (Terre Siciliane)

description: Aromas of exotic fruit and candied citrus zest take center stage on this deeply colored white. Reflecting the scorching vintage, it's ripe and round, offering dried apricot and nectarine drop. Enjoy soon to capture the fruit and freshness.
title: Fattori 2015 Motto Piane  (Soave)

description: Aromas of exotic fruit and candied citrus zest take center stage on this deeply colored white. Reflecting the scorching vintage, it's ripe and round, offering dried apricot and nectarine drop. Enjoy soon to capture the fruit and freshness.
title: Fattori 2015 Motto Piane  (Soave)

description: Aromas of tropical fruit and banana lead the nose and carry over to the rounded palate along with pineapple and a hint of candied citrus. A note of bitter nut marks the close.
title: Donnachiara 2016  Fiano di Avellino

description: This has subdued scents suggesting grapefruit, citrus and a whiff of sun-warmed hay. Round and ripe, the palate offers yellow apple, lemon zest and a hint of green melon alongside a note of dried sage.
title: Colmello di Grotta 2015 Sauvignon (Collio)

description: This shows slightly volatile aromas of bitter almond, apple skin and apricot.
title: Barberani 2011 Vi No SO2  (Orvieto Classico Superiore)

description: Slightly oxidized at first with aromas of caramel and butterscotch, the wine soon opens to reveal apricot, honey and dried hay. It's an easy, genuine wine to pair with fried onion rings.
title: Fattoria Laila 2010  Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi

description: A wine with a dark, inky appearance, it offers ripe fruit aromas of black cherry, bitter almond and prune. The wine is soft and simple, with a cheerful blast of jammy fruit on the close.
title: Feudi di San Marzano 2009 Red (Salice Salentino)

description: This vintage of Valle d'Oro presents almost exaggerated aromas of violet, dried rose and cinnamon potpourri. Definitely more floral than it is fruity, the wine closes with sweet spice flavors, density and polished tannins.
title: Cantina Tollo 2009 Valle d'Oro  (Montepulciano d'Abruzzo)

description: This vintage of Valle d'Oro presents almost exaggerated aromas of violet, dried rose and cinnamon potpourri. Definitely more floral than it is fruity, the wine closes with sweet spice flavors, density and polished tannins.
title: Cantina Tollo 2009 Valle d'Oro  (Montepulciano d'Abruzzo)

description: On the bouquet, red berry, dried herb, cola and licorice notes emerge at the forefront. The palate shows tight freshness and soft fruit flavors.
title: Monte del Frá 2011 Tenuta Lena di Mezzo  (Valpolicella Classico)

description: This offers simple layers of cherry, spice, cola and toasted almond. The mouthfeel is soft, plush and mild.
title: La Collina dei Ciliegi 2010 Il Valpolicella Superiore  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore)

description: This offers simple layers of cherry, spice, cola and toasted almond. The mouthfeel is soft, plush and mild.
title: La Collina dei Ciliegi 2010 Il Valpolicella Superiore  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore)

description: This combines bright fruit aromas of cherry and raspberry with dried tones of tobacco, earth and crushed stone. It's food friendly and easy going on the finish.
title: Corte Archi 2009 Gli Archi  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso)

description: This vintage of Ripasso Ca' del Laito opens with meaty aromas of bresaola and cured beef followed by mature cherry and blackberry. The wine is soft and chewy, with succulent fruit pulp and a distinct note of sweet spice on the close.
title: Tommaso Bussola 2005 Ca' del Laito  (Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso)

description: Ripasso Pegrandi is a polished and squeaky clean wine with fine aromas of wild fruit, spice, natural rubber and toasted almond. It tastes crisp, tight and would make a great companion to green peppers or zucchini stuffed with rice and ground veal.
title: Vaona 2008 Pegrandi  (Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso)

description: Here's a ripe and jammy expression of Amarone that shows some of the heat of the 2003 vintage. Red cherry and raspberry jam are backed by gritty spice and firm tannins.
title: Tommaso Bussola 2003  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico

description: This is a thickly extracted Amarone with a black, inky appearance and powerful aromas of black fruit, exotic spice, bresaola, mesquite wood and cola. It's almost too much of a good thing and the palate becomes overwhelmed by the wine's muscle, power and overall sweetness.
title: Savoia 2004 Vigneti dei Coali  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Campolieti is a fresh and fruity Ripasso with layers of dried blueberry, rum cake and spice followed by some very light mineral shadings. It boasts a crisp, clean mouthfeel and ends with a hint of vanilla and toasted almond.
title: Luigi Righetti 2008 Campolieti  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso)

description: Campolieti is a fresh and fruity Ripasso with layers of dried blueberry, rum cake and spice followed by some very light mineral shadings. It boasts a crisp, clean mouthfeel and ends with a hint of vanilla and toasted almond.
title: Luigi Righetti 2008 Campolieti  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso)

description: Soft and fruity, this simple, easy-drinking red offers aromas and flavors of ripe blackberry, dark raspberry and hints of wild Mediterranean brush. Round tannins support the juicy flavors.
title: Cantine Ermes 2014 Vento di Mare Bio Nero d'Avola (Terre Siciliane)

description: Here's a great value wine that opens with aromas of ripe plum and blue flower. The simple but well made palate offers juicy black cherry and a hint of vanilla alongside soft, round tannins. Drink now.
title: MandraRossa 2014 Costa Dune Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: Here's a great value wine that opens with aromas of ripe plum and blue flower. The simple but well made palate offers juicy black cherry and a hint of vanilla alongside soft, round tannins. Drink now.
title: MandraRossa 2014 Costa Dune Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: Here's a beautifully aged Amarone from an excellent vintage. Masi's Mazzano is a benchmark wine for Valpolicella thanks to its intriguing complexity of aromas: black cherry, dried fruit, porcini mushroom, dark chocolate, vanilla bean and dark resin like the kind you'd smell in an antique furniture shop. The wine has a slightly brownish hue and remarkable penetration.
title: Masi 2001 Mazzano  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: A blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc, the wine boasts mineral elements that are backed by dried herbs, spice, meaty black fruit and coffee bean. The Cabernet Sauvignon component is obvious, and a bit too green, but not out of balance.
title: Casale del Mare 2006 Fortulla Red (Toscana)

description: Despite the obvious quality of this wine—obvious in its vibrant ruby color and full bouquet of berry and spice aromas—there's a tiny touch of something pungent that recalls kerosene or alcohol. The structure is firm and solid without being bulky and it delivers flavors of small berry fruit.
title: Grattamacco 2001  Bolgheri Superiore

description: This well-priced wine opens with defined mineral nuances and segues quickly into blueberries and violets. The mouthfeel is lean and bright and there's a blast of sour cherry on the finish.
title: Fattoria dei Barbi 2005 Brusco dei Barbi Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: This well-priced wine opens with defined mineral nuances and segues quickly into blueberries and violets. The mouthfeel is lean and bright and there's a blast of sour cherry on the finish.
title: Fattoria dei Barbi 2005 Brusco dei Barbi Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: This blend of Sangiovese and Cabernet Sauvignon is light in color and offers aromas such as old leather, pipe tobacco, prune and chopped herbs with a slightly dirty, earthy quality. Yet it's lively in the mouth, with tight tannins, fresh acidity and bright cherry flavors.
title: Fattoria Corzano e Paterno 2004 Il Corzano Red (Toscana)

description: This blend of Sangiovese and Cabernet Sauvignon is light in color and offers aromas such as old leather, pipe tobacco, prune and chopped herbs with a slightly dirty, earthy quality. Yet it's lively in the mouth, with tight tannins, fresh acidity and bright cherry flavors.
title: Fattoria Corzano e Paterno 2004 Il Corzano Red (Toscana)

description: This Sangiovese seems older than it is because of the hard candy, mineral and brambly notes that offset its aromas of dark chocolate and sweet spice. A tiny hint of apple cider gives the wine piquancy and bite but otherwise it remains a deep, full wine with no overtly sharp edges.
title: Falchini 2004 Paretaio Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: Michele Satta's estate is located in the southernmost part of the denomination. This Sangiovese-based wine offers delicate nuances of blackberry, spice box and dried hay but also has natural rubber or Band-Aid notes that disturb an otherwise pretty picture. Drink now.
title: Michele Satta 2001 Cavaliere Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: Michele Satta's estate is located in the southernmost part of the denomination. This Sangiovese-based wine offers delicate nuances of blackberry, spice box and dried hay but also has natural rubber or Band-Aid notes that disturb an otherwise pretty picture. Drink now.
title: Michele Satta 2001 Cavaliere Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: This Cabernet's penetrating green notes are very much in character with the variety: tomato leaf, leafy greens, medicinal notes, exotic spice and cherry cola. Its meaty consistency is topped by a blast of sour cherry.
title: Marchesi Ginori Lisci 2005 Macchion del Lupo Cabernet Sauvignon (Toscana)

description: This blend of Cabernet, Merlot and Syrah has a lot of heat and power locked within, recognized by slightly cooked or jammy fruit notes. But you'll also get very pleasant, warm tones of soft leather and sweet pipe tobacco.
title: Tenuta Argentiera 2005 Poggio ai Ginepri  (Bolgheri)

description: This 70-30 blend of Cabernet and Sangiovese features aromas of cherry, toast, maple syrup, ink and spice. The wine boast thick, seemingly impenetrable extraction and a dense, chewy mouthfeel.
title: Triacca 2004 Il Mandorlo Red (Toscana)

description: True to the Syrah variety, this plush red wine offers bright fruit tones of blackberry and cherry backed by light spice and clove. It's an easy, soft ensemble that would pair with meat, chicken or pasta.
title: Castello di Poppiano 2007 Syrah (Toscana)

description: Vermentino makes a great companion to sushi, Mediterranean fish dishes, light pasta salad or chicken salad. There's a zesty touch of fresh sage or rosemary on the nose followed by peach, citrus and melon aromas.
title: Viticcio 2010 Greppico Vermentino (Bolgheri)

description: Easy, tight and watery, this informal Prosecco would hit the spot on a hot summer day by the pool. Floral and peach aromas are woven within the sparkler's natural sweetness.
title: De Stefani NV Zero Gran Cuvée Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: Easy, tight and watery, this informal Prosecco would hit the spot on a hot summer day by the pool. Floral and peach aromas are woven within the sparkler's natural sweetness.
title: De Stefani NV Zero Gran Cuvée Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: Creamy and foamy with soft tones of peach and honey, this cheerful Asti would pair with fruit salad, cookies or can be consumed as an early afternoon appetizer wine (thanks to its low 7.5% alcohol) simply on its own.
title: Tosti NV Moscato (Asti)

description: This Rosé sparkler opens with a pretty pink color and intense aromas of mature berry, raspberry candy and zesty grapefruit. A sweet but oddly spicy note characterizes the finish.
title: Zardetto NV Rosé Sparkling (Veneto)

description: This Rosé sparkler opens with a pretty pink color and intense aromas of mature berry, raspberry candy and zesty grapefruit. A sweet but oddly spicy note characterizes the finish.
title: Zardetto NV Rosé Sparkling (Veneto)

description: Fun packaging and a simple, but pristine aromatic profile make this Prosecco a good choice for informal drinking opportunities. Dried grass, hay, citrus and white flower are subtle elements of the bouquet.
title: El Vin NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: Fun packaging and a simple, but pristine aromatic profile make this Prosecco a good choice for informal drinking opportunities. Dried grass, hay, citrus and white flower are subtle elements of the bouquet.
title: El Vin NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: Made with Vernaccia Nera grapes, this pink rosé sparkling wine is redolent of sweet fruit, raspberry, dried sage, honey and lemon soda. Tight, tonic effervescence and fresh acidity keep the palate clean.
title: Colli di Serrapetrona NV Blink Brut Rosé Sparkling (Marche)

description: A creamy, simple and very fresh Italian sparkler, this Frizzante Prosecco offers a soft, foamy feel in the mouth with tones of peach, lemon and apple on the finish.
title: Capo di Vigna NV Frizzante  (Prosecco)

description: Cantaloupe melon and white peach set the stage aromatically. The wine follows through to the palate with fresh crispness and a clean, compact style.
title: Marcato 2010 I Prandi Colli Scaligeri  (Soave)

description: Extra Dry Prosecco offers a delicate touch of sweetness and makes a great companion to spicy finger foods or appetizers. Bellussi's expression easily fits the bill and adds pretty aromas of stone fruit and dried grass along the way.
title: Bellussi NV Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Light and luminous with delicate aromas of spring flower, citrus and stone fruit, this Extra Dry Prosecco would make a great companion to crispy fried shrimp. It boasts a clean mouthfeel with sharp, spicy effervescence.
title: Astoria NV Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Tonic and luminous, this bright Prosecco offers floral aromas, ripe peach, ginger and lemon soda but it also creates a flat and broad impression in the mouth. It delivers piquant effervescence and mature fruit flavors on the close.
title: Collalbrigo NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Conegliano)

description: There's a note of soda-like effervescence or charcoal that disturbs the purity of the nose here. Beyond it is mature peach, chestnut honey and dried flower. The sparkler has firm, sharp bubbles and flavors of ripe melon and mint on the close.
title: Canella NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Conegliano)

description: Here's a dry, mineral-driven rosé sparkler with wooly aromas of cotton flower, talc powder and subtle berry shadings. Thanks to its light, dry style, this wine leaves your palate polished and clean.
title: Vigneti Fantinel NV Rosé Brut Sparkling (Veneto)

description: Here's a dry, mineral-driven rosé sparkler with wooly aromas of cotton flower, talc powder and subtle berry shadings. Thanks to its light, dry style, this wine leaves your palate polished and clean.
title: Vigneti Fantinel NV Rosé Brut Sparkling (Veneto)

description: This is an easy Prosecco with some sweet fruit flavors and lasting aromas of peach and grapefruit. The wine is tonic and compact and would pair well with smoked ham or raw chunks of Parmigiano cheese.
title: Tenuta Santomè NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco del Veneto)

description: Here's a simple Prosecco sparkler with delicate aromas of white flower, chalky stone and sweet lavender honey. There's a flash of crisp acidity on the close but the wine in thin and simple in the mouth.
title: Villa Granda NV Frizzante Prosecco (Colli Trevigiani)

description: Very neutral on the nose, this sparkling blend of Prosecco, Chardonnay and Moscato presents a thin, watery wine with slight, almost invisible shadings of stone fruit and citrus. There's more action in the mouth thanks to its crisp finish and bubbly foam.
title: Zardetto NV Private Cuvée Brut Sparkling (Veneto)

description: This naturally rich Soave Classico opens with floral, soapy aromas of honeysuckle and yellow rose. The texture is dense and heavy, although a fresh acidic component helps keep it balanced.
title: Canoso 2009 Cà del Vento  (Soave Classico)

description: Miraval Prosecco opens with a pungent tone that masks some of the initial freshness of the fruit. But give this luminous sparkling wine a few minutes to aerate and it delivers pretty layers of peach, citrus and honey.
title: Bellenda 2009 Miraval Extra Dry Millesimato  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Tramin's light and silky Pinot Bianco opens with aromas of peach, citrus and honeydew melon. This variety tends to show more structure in the mouth, making this wine a great choice for grilled shrimp or seafood risotto.
title: Tramin 2010 Pinot Bianco (Alto Adige)

description: This certified organic white wine from San Gimignano opens with lively notes of citrus, dried hay, stone fruit and a touch of exotic papaya. The wine is fresh and zesty with a cool, cleansing finish.
title: San Quirico 2010 Vernaccia (San Gimignano)

description: Compared to past vintages, this expression of Moscato d'Asti offers aromas of dried grass and hay backed by peach blossom, lemon and spring flowers. The mouthfeel is soft and creamy rich.
title: Ricossa 2010 Antica Casa  (Moscato d'Asti)

description: Compared to past vintages, this expression of Moscato d'Asti offers aromas of dried grass and hay backed by peach blossom, lemon and spring flowers. The mouthfeel is soft and creamy rich.
title: Ricossa 2010 Antica Casa  (Moscato d'Asti)

description: Moscabianca (“white fly”) is a fresh, easygoing white wine that would pair with sushi or grilled seafood. It's tight and crisp with a touch of citrus sweetness on the finish.
title: Plozner 2010 Moscabianca Friulano (Venezia Giulia)

description: This well-priced Friulano would pair nicely with spicy Indian or Thai food thanks to the creaminess and richness of its mouthfeel. In addition, the wine offers a solid bouquet of peach and melon that would not compete with fragrant ingredients.
title: Petrucco 2010 Friulano (Colli Orientali del Friuli)

description: This is a terrific and youthful white wine for those looking for an easy pairing companion to Chinese take-out or fresh garden salads. It offers a fragrant bouquet of pear, citrus and white flower.
title: La Viarte 2010 Pinot Grigio (Colli Orientali del Friuli)

description: Thin, crisp and short on the palate, this bright expression of Cortese offers a focused bouquet with tones of white flower, crushed stone and citrus. Try it with smoked salmon pâté on toasted bread.
title: La Scolca 2009 Novantesimo Black Label  (Gavi)

description: Thin, crisp and short on the palate, this bright expression of Cortese offers a focused bouquet with tones of white flower, crushed stone and citrus. Try it with smoked salmon pâté on toasted bread.
title: La Scolca 2009 Novantesimo Black Label  (Gavi)

description: La Scolca releases a confusing portfolio of Cortese-based wines commemorating various anniversaries and events. Thankfully, the fundamental winemaking style is the same: fresh, clean and simple with bright citrus and peach flavors over a zesty close.
title: La Scolca 2009 90 Years White Label  (Gavi)

description: This hay-colored Moscato Giallo is redolent of melon, pineapple and honey. The mouthfeel is soft, plush and there's a playful touch of zesty spice on the close.
title: Erste Neue 2009 Barleit Moscato Giallo (Alto Adige)

description: Creamy and naturally dense, this northern Italian white opens with a deep golden color and mature aromas of melon, stone fruit and honey. There's a spicy touch of crushed white pepper on the close.
title: Dogarina 2009 Campodipietra Manzoni (Veneto)

description: Creamy and naturally dense, this northern Italian white opens with a deep golden color and mature aromas of melon, stone fruit and honey. There's a spicy touch of crushed white pepper on the close.
title: Dogarina 2009 Campodipietra Manzoni (Veneto)

description: An attractive element here is the distinct mineral tone that adds a vein of dryness to what is otherwise a sweet sparkler ripe with peach and apricot-like aromas. It has frothy texture and cleansing crispness on the close.
title: Valdo NV Cartizze Cuvée Viviana  (Prosecco Superiore di Cartizze)

description: Here's an organic Prosecco with a wide variety of adjectives that can be attributed to its aromas: peach, lemon blossom, white peppercorn and talc powder. It boasts good personality and freshness on the close.
title: Perlage NV Canan Brut  (Prosecco di Valdobbiadene)

description: Sweet, musky aromas are immediate and generous and come on the heels of mature peach, apricot and exotic fruit. This is an easy, simple wine that goes down beautifully at cocktail hour.
title: Masottina NV Cartizze Dry  (Prosecco Superiore di Cartizze)

description: Here is a very likeable Prosecco with lime flavors and aromas of mint leaf and lemon ice sorbet. It has a remarkably creamy and smooth texture in the mouth—like citrus cream—and a nervous touch of crisp acidity on the close.
title: Le Colture 2006 Pianer Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene)

description: There's a lot going on in the glass starting with lively perlage in the form of small, persistent bubbling. Also very enjoyable are the aromas, which recall white fruit, chopped sweet basil, almond blossom and soapy floral tones. The wine ends on a sweet note with mature pear flavors.
title: La Tordera NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Valdobbiadene)

description: A delicately balanced Prosecco with a touch of white pepper and dried herbs that make a pretty frame to peach cream aromas. The wine has a fine point of sweetness in the mouth and would pair well with Thai curry dishes.
title: La Gioiosa NV Cartizze  (Prosecco Superiore di Cartizze)

description: This is creamier than the norm thanks to its tight, persistent bubbles that feel frothy and soft in the mouth. Lemongrass, fresh field flowers, citrus and white stone characterize its typical Prosecco aromas.
title: Bortolomiol 2006 Banda Rossa Millesimato Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Valdobbiadene)

description: This is a very beautiful and intense sparkler with delicate floral tones that come on the heels of white peach and Golden Delicious apple (10% Chardonnay is blended in). Traces of distinct minerality add elegance and dimension.
title: Le Colture NV Fagher  (Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene)

description: Round and rich, this blend of Sangiovese and 20% Merlot opens with aromas of dark berry and underbrush. The ripe, straightforward palate delivers black plum, crushed black cherry, coffee and a chocolate note while soft tannins make it extremely accessible. Enjoy through 2016.
title: Nottola 2011  Vino Nobile di Montepulciano

description: A blend of Sangiovese and 10% Merlot, this opens with aromas of black plum, tilled soil and a hint of underbrush. The palate offers dark berry, tobacco and a hint of espresso alongside firm tannins.
title: Nottola 2010 Il Fattore  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Attractive aromas of acacia, hawthorne, orchard fruit and delicate, oak-driven spice mingle in the glass. The elegant palate offers apple, passion fruit and a touch of candied lemon. It's brightened by firm acidity, while a hint of white almond backs up the finish.
title: Mormoraia 2013 Ostrea  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: Attractive aromas of acacia, hawthorne, orchard fruit and delicate, oak-driven spice mingle in the glass. The elegant palate offers apple, passion fruit and a touch of candied lemon. It's brightened by firm acidity, while a hint of white almond backs up the finish.
title: Mormoraia 2013 Ostrea  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: This opens with aromas of coconut, chocolate, plum and vanilla. The extracted palate offers dried black cherry, raspberry jam, toast, mocha and roasted coffee bean alongside drying tannins.
title: Monte Maggio 2010 Gran Selezione  (Chianti Classico)

description: This robust wine opens with aromas of forest floor, meat juices and game. The dense palate shows mature black cherry, plum, prune, cake spices and a hint of orange rind. It's extremely accessible so enjoy soon.
title: Trambusti 2012  Rosso di Montalcino

description: Aromas of vanilla, toast, mocha and plum come together in the glass. The palate offers dried black cherry, prune, espresso, toasted oak and oak-driven spices but the fruit flavors are already drying up.
title: Tenute del Cerro 2009 Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Aromas of vanilla, toast, mocha and plum come together in the glass. The palate offers dried black cherry, prune, espresso, toasted oak and oak-driven spices but the fruit flavors are already drying up.
title: Tenute del Cerro 2009 Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Made entirely with Sangiovese, this highlights earthy aromas of leafy underbrush, tilled soil and dark berry. The savory palate offers black cherry, nectarine zest, clove and a hint of Mediterranean herb alongside assertive tannins.
title: Val di Toro 2012 Reviresco  (Morellino di Scansano)

description: A blend of Sangiovese and 10% Cabernet Sauvignon, this structured wine opens with aromas of underbrush, toasted oak, crushed flower and plum. The palate offers dried black cherry, grilled sage, espresso and clove alongside firm tannins.
title: Val delle Rose 2011 Riserva  (Morellino di Scansano)

description: Made from 40-year-old vines, this structured white opens with aromas of pressed chamomile, Spanish broom and a waft of dried apricot. The full-bodied palate offers baked apple, mature peach and dried herb. This shows some of the heat of the vintage, so enjoy soon to capture freshness.
region: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore
title: Umani Ronchi 2012 Vecchie Vigne  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore)

description: Oak, coconut, toast, espresso, menthol and a whiff of cellar floor are some of the aromas you'll find on this robust red. The big, warm palate offers raisin, date, licorice and roasted coffee bean. Teeth-coating tannins leave an astringent finish while the heat of evident alcohol throws it off-balance. While it's tightly tannic, there's not much fruit richness, making this more suited for mid-term drinking.
title: La Poderina 2011  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Garnet colored with a light brick rim, this opens with aromas of leafy underbrush, leather and a whiff of menthol. The palate is straightforward for a Brunello and already surprisingly accessible, offering dried wild cherry, licorice and a hint of baking spice alongside ripe tannins.
title: Kirkland Signature 2010  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Aromas of blackcurrant, spice, menthol, espresso and a whiff of toasted oak lead the nose. The round, chewy palate doles out blackberry jam, licorice, ground black pepper and coffee alongside firm, fine-grained tannins. Showing the heat of the vintage, it's evolving quickly so enjoy sooner rather than later.
title: Lornano 2011 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Aromas of blackcurrant, spice, menthol, espresso and a whiff of toasted oak lead the nose. The round, chewy palate doles out blackberry jam, licorice, ground black pepper and coffee alongside firm, fine-grained tannins. Showing the heat of the vintage, it's evolving quickly so enjoy sooner rather than later.
title: Lornano 2011 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: This opens with aromas of stewed plum, leafy underbrush, scorched earth and leather. The palate offers dried black cherry, white pepper, clove and tobacco set against bracing, tightly knit tannins. Give the tannins another year or two to unwind then drink up to capture the remaining fruit.
title: Il Molino di Grace 2008 Il Margone Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: This luminous wine opens with scents of wisteria, jasmine and white orchard fruit. The vibrant palate doles out tart green apple, white peach and a hint of lemon drop alongside brisk acidity and a foaming mousse.
title: Valdellövo 2014 Anno Zero Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This crisp sparkler opens with aromas of chopped, aromatic herbs and white tree fruit. The racy palate offers yellow apple, pear and a hint of roasted almond alongside bright acidity and a vibrant mousse.
title: Fratelli Bortolin NV Brut  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Made with Pinot Noir, this opens with aromas of toast and roasted walnut. The palate offers ripe apple skin, dried berry, vanilla and pastry accompanied by a creamy perlage.
title: Cà di Frara 2007 Oltre Rosé Riserva Sparkling (Vino Spumante)

description: Aromas of wisteria, Bartlett pear and a whiff of chopped sage lead the nose on this luminous wine. The foaming palate is both linear and rich thanks to crisp green apple, juicy white peach and banana that are offset by racy acidity.
title: Brancher NV B Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Aromas of wisteria, Bartlett pear and a whiff of chopped sage lead the nose on this luminous wine. The foaming palate is both linear and rich thanks to crisp green apple, juicy white peach and banana that are offset by racy acidity.
title: Brancher NV B Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Made with 100% Chardonnay, this opens with aromas of acacia flower, ripe yellow apple skin, citrus peel and a hint of honey. These notes follow through to the palate, which additionally carries a toasted walnut note. Bright acidity and persistent bubbles provide the framework.
title: Altemasi NV Brut Chardonnay (Trento)

description: This Brunello represents the 2005 vintage perfectly. The wine is not dense or over-concentrated and the aromas are bright and polished. Everything comes in moderation. Pair this wine with lean cuts of red meat on the grill.
title: Casanuova delle Cerbaie 2005  Brunello di Montalcino

description: This Brunello Riserva offers wood-driven notes of spice and smoke backed by ripe fruit and blackberry preserves. It is sweet and rich in the mouth with loads of jammy fruit on the close.
title: Collemattoni 2004 Vigna Fontelontano Riserva  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Simple and straightforward aromas of red berry and mineral cap the aromatic nuances expressed in the Brunello Riserva. What the wine lacks is complexity, although it does feel rich, smooth and bright in the mouth. A Marc de Grazia selection; various American importers.
title: Le Potazzine 2004 Riserva  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: This rich expression from the 2005 vintage shows some signs of aging that are evident in its brownish-garnet color and in the wine's aromas of candied fruit, dried currants, mesquite, cola and licorice. It's powerful and pleasantly intense in the mouth with bright acidity and silky tannins. Drink now.
title: Lazzeretti 2005  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Compact and lean in texture, this bright Brunello offers brambly notes of wild berry, cassis, white cherry and licorice. The wine is a bit raw and thorny in places but the fresh acidity and berry flavors pull it forward.
title: Casisano Colombaio 2005  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Compact and lean in texture, this bright Brunello offers brambly notes of wild berry, cassis, white cherry and licorice. The wine is a bit raw and thorny in places but the fresh acidity and berry flavors pull it forward.
title: Casisano Colombaio 2005  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Naturalis Historia is a benchmark wine for Campania—and all of southern Italy—with spectacularly clean mineral tones on the heels of berry fruit, plums, leather and spice. The wine's approach is vertical and immediate but it also evolves slowly in the glass thanks to an ever-changing bouquet.
title: Mastroberardino 2004 Naturalis Historia  (Taurasi)

description: This is one of the best Taurasis of all times. Antonio Caggiano has crafted an elegant wine that is rich in charm and personality. Cherry, freshly milled espresso, natural rubber, white truffle, pecorino cheese and black mineral all play a part in this complex ensemble. It has thick, tight tannins with beautifully etched mineral nuances and should age well for many years in the cellar. A Marc de Grazia selection, various American importers.
title: Antonio Caggiano 2004 Vigna Macchia dei Goti  (Taurasi)

description: This is an extraordinary, golden dessert wine with intense and penetrating notes of honey, marron glacé, dried apricot, marzipan, candied lemon, dried mint and jasmine. It's smooth, rich and long lasting in the mouth. The wine has personality and power and boasts magnetic appeal across the board.
title: Di Majo Norante 2006 Apianae Moscato (Molise)

description: Packaged in a transparent bottle, this wine boasts a surprisingly saturated shade of gold and delivers fragrant aromas of caramel, butterscotch, dried fruit and sun-dried apricots. It makes for a fun bottle to serve with appetizers.
title: Ca' del Bosco NV Cuvée Prestige Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: Packaged in a transparent bottle, this wine boasts a surprisingly saturated shade of gold and delivers fragrant aromas of caramel, butterscotch, dried fruit and sun-dried apricots. It makes for a fun bottle to serve with appetizers.
title: Ca' del Bosco NV Cuvée Prestige Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: Fratelli Bortolin is one of the historic estates of the Valdobbiadene (Prosecco) area and consistently produces a high quality sparkling wine. This Brut expression delivers subtle aromas of white mineral, stone fruit and acacia flower.
title: Bortolin NV Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: A 50-50 blend of Catarratto and Chardonnay, this opens with aromas that recall Spanish broom and ripe orchard fruit. The bright, simple palate offers yellow apple and citrus alongside fresh acidity.
title: Principe di Corleone 2015 Pollara White (Terre Siciliane)

description: Bright and simple, this has delicate aromas of white stone fruit. The easygoing palate offers white peach and fresh apricot alongside fresh acidity.
title: Fazio 2015 Müller-Thurgau (Erice)

description: Bright and simple, this has delicate aromas of white stone fruit. The easygoing palate offers white peach and fresh apricot alongside fresh acidity.
title: Fazio 2015 Müller-Thurgau (Erice)

description: This offers subdued aromas suggesting orchard fruit and pressed yellow flower. The straightforward, rather lean palate offers citrus, saline and a hint of green pear alongside fresh acidity.
title: Duca di Salaparuta 2015 Colomba Palatino White (Terre Siciliane)

description: Aromas of toast, espresso and prune carry over to the lean, tannic palate. It's already extremely evolved and the fruit is drying up quickly. Drink through 2015.
title: Tiberini 2012 Podere Caggiolo  (Rosso di Montepulciano)

description: Aromas of toast, espresso and prune carry over to the lean, tannic palate. It's already extremely evolved and the fruit is drying up quickly. Drink through 2015.
title: Tiberini 2012 Podere Caggiolo  (Rosso di Montepulciano)

description: This high-octane wine offers sensations of toasted oak, sawdust and evident alcohol. It's warm and evolved without much fruit richness.
title: Cà Richeta 2011 Crussi  (Nebbiolo d'Alba)

description: This high-octane wine offers sensations of toasted oak, sawdust and evident alcohol. It's warm and evolved without much fruit richness.
title: Cà Richeta 2011 Crussi  (Nebbiolo d'Alba)

description: Delicate scents of white spring flower and white stone fruit curl out of the glass. This is loaded with finesse, delivering creamy white peach, green apple, pear and citrus. Vibrant acidity lends balance while an elegant perlage gives it an irresistibly silky texture.
title: BiancaVigna 2016 Rive di Soligo Dosaggio Zero  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Delicate scents of white spring flower and white stone fruit curl out of the glass. This is loaded with finesse, delivering creamy white peach, green apple, pear and citrus. Vibrant acidity lends balance while an elegant perlage gives it an irresistibly silky texture.
title: BiancaVigna 2016 Rive di Soligo Dosaggio Zero  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Alluring scents of hawthorn, citrus blossom and ripe orchard fruit come together on this lovely sparkler. On the dry palate, nectarine zest and crushed herbs underscore a core of yellow apple and Bartlett pear. It's well balanced, with vibrant acidity and a creamy mousse that lends finesse.
designation: Cuvée del Fondatore Rive di Col San Martino Brut
title: Graziano Merotto 2016 Cuvée del Fondatore Rive di Col San Martino Brut  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Alluring scents of hawthorn, citrus blossom and ripe orchard fruit come together on this lovely sparkler. On the dry palate, nectarine zest and crushed herbs underscore a core of yellow apple and Bartlett pear. It's well balanced, with vibrant acidity and a creamy mousse that lends finesse.
designation: Cuvée del Fondatore Rive di Col San Martino Brut
title: Graziano Merotto 2016 Cuvée del Fondatore Rive di Col San Martino Brut  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: The nose on this is rather inexpressive, eventually revealing scorched earth and roasted coffee beans. The bitterly astringent palate is almost completely dried up, offering dried black cherry and unripe pomegranate alongside brisk acidity.
title: Canti 2011  Barbera d'Asti Superiore

description: Earthy aromas of scorched soil, leather, prune and white pepper lead the nose. The solid palate shows ripe black cherry, blackberry and ground pepper alongside firm, chewy tannins. Drink through 2018.
title: Niedrist 2011 Berger Gei Lagrein (Alto Adige)

description: Spring flower and yellow stone fruit aromas lift out of the glass. The round, juicy palate doles out creamy peach, nectarine zest, Bosc pear and a hint of hazelnut. Soft acidity brightens the creamy flavors.
title: Cascina del Pozzo 2015 Montemeraviglia  (Roero)

description: Spring flower and yellow stone fruit aromas lift out of the glass. The round, juicy palate doles out creamy peach, nectarine zest, Bosc pear and a hint of hazelnut. Soft acidity brightens the creamy flavors.
title: Cascina del Pozzo 2015 Montemeraviglia  (Roero)

description: Aromas of wild berry, dark spice and leather lead the nose. The solid palate shows ripe black cherry, cassis, clove and coffee beans alongside firm tannins. Drink through 2018.
title: Cantina Produttori Bolzano 2012 Gries Prestige Line Riserva Lagrein (Alto Adige)

description: Toast, violet and plum aromas lead the way and carry over to the inviting palate along with mature blackberry, vanilla and cinnamon. Dusty tannins provide the framework. Drink through 2018.
title: Caldaro 2012 Spigel Lagrein (Alto Adige)

description: Strawberry, rose petal, dark spice and a whiff of oak lead the nose and follow through to the robust palate along with steeped black cherry and a vanilla note. Firm tannins grip the finish. You'll also notice the warmth of alcohol on the close.
title: Aldo Clerico 2011  Barolo

description: La Gerla is one of the finest producers in Montalcino and the estate's less formal Rosso delivers spice and sophistication with loads of oak-related aromas that enhance the wine's natural fruit and consistency. You'll taste the oak spice in the mouth as well so pair this wine with grilled meat or barbecue.
title: La Gerla 2008  Rosso di Montalcino

description: La Gerla is one of the finest producers in Montalcino and the estate's less formal Rosso delivers spice and sophistication with loads of oak-related aromas that enhance the wine's natural fruit and consistency. You'll taste the oak spice in the mouth as well so pair this wine with grilled meat or barbecue.
title: La Gerla 2008  Rosso di Montalcino

description: This fresh Rosso di Montalcino is redolent of pressed violets and rose petals and has more of a floral characteristic than it does a fruity one. The wine is thin but firm in the mouth with a lean but crisp aftertaste.
title: Renieri 2008  Rosso di Montalcino

description: Showing Cannonau's lighter side, this simple red has fruity aromas of wild berry and a hint of dried aromatic herb. The easygoing, informal palate offers red cherry, raspberry and a hint of white pepper alongside soft tannins.
title: Vigneti Zanatta 2013 Salana  (Cannonau di Sardegna)

description: Showing Cannonau's lighter side, this simple red has fruity aromas of wild berry and a hint of dried aromatic herb. The easygoing, informal palate offers red cherry, raspberry and a hint of white pepper alongside soft tannins.
title: Vigneti Zanatta 2013 Salana  (Cannonau di Sardegna)

description: This expression of young Nebbiolo boasts a pretty floral and strawberry fragrance. The palate delivers bright strawberry and raspberry flavors and fresh acidity. It's simple, yet well made, with good balance and a silky texture.
title: Montaribaldi 2011 Gambarin Nebbiolo (Langhe)

description: This has intense forest-floor aromas, a hint of violet along and toasted oak and vanilla notes. The palate shows bright raspberry and espresso flavors, nervous acidity and firm tannins. It needs time, so drink after 2016.
title: Mario Gagliasso 2008 Torriglione  (Barolo)

description: This blend of 55% Frappato and 45% Nero d'Avola opens with red cherry, crushed strawberry, clove and white pepper aromas that carry over to bright, polished palate. It's ready and enjoyable, with silky tannins and fresh acidity.
title: Paolo Calì 2015 Jazz Red (Terre Siciliane)

description: Light touches of dry mineral, white flower and stone fruit form a delicate aromatic embroidery that shapes this wine's feminine personality. The mouthfeel is compact, precise and crisp.
title: Strasserhof 2010 Kerner (Alto Adige)

description: This carefully oak-aged Chardonnay opens with a bright golden color and sophisticated aromas of ripe fruit, apricot, honey, pineapple, toasted almond and vanilla. Rich creaminess drives a long finish.
title: Ricci Curbastro 2007 Vigna Bosco Alto Chardonnay (Curtefranca)

description: This is a rich and smooth white wine with aromas of mature peach, candied fruit, lime, crushed mineral and Asian spice. The wine shows impressive density and consistency that pairs with shellfish or spicy Thai curry.
region: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico
title: Bucci 2007 Villa Bucci Riserva  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico)

description: This is a rich and smooth white wine with aromas of mature peach, candied fruit, lime, crushed mineral and Asian spice. The wine shows impressive density and consistency that pairs with shellfish or spicy Thai curry.
region: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico
title: Bucci 2007 Villa Bucci Riserva  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico)

description: Trebbiano grapes from the beautiful Spoleto area of Umbria (also found in the areas of Montefalco and Trevi) have been carefully selected to produce this rich, golden white wine that would pair with veal or roast turkey. Aromas here include apricot, yellow rose, Golden Delicious apple and candied citrus.
title: Antonelli 2007 Trebium Trebbiano Spoletino Trebbiano (Umbria)

title: Antonelli 2007 Trebium Trebbiano Spoletino Trebbiano (Umbria)

description: Prunar is a deep and sophisticated Pinot Bianco (aged 50-50 in large oak casks and stainless steel) that excels in terms of mouthfeel. It delivers a long, creamy finish accented by tones of apricot, pear and grapefruit.
title: Erste Neue 2010 Prunar Pinot Bianco (Alto Adige)

description: Crushed blue flower, ripe plum and a whiff of exotic spice emerge on this bold wine. On the concentrated palate, ground pepper, cocoa and licorice notes accent ripe black cherry and baked plum. Velvety tannins lend elegance and support.
title: Le Salette 2012 La Marega  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Aromas of steeped cherries, ripe plums, scorched earth and a medley of cooking spices lead the nose on this round, rich wine. The lush palate doles out ripe black cherries, raspberry jam, licorice and a dash of black pepper while velvety tannins lend finesse.
title: Venturini Massimino 2009 Campomasua  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Aromas of steeped cherries, ripe plums, scorched earth and a medley of cooking spices lead the nose on this round, rich wine. The lush palate doles out ripe black cherries, raspberry jam, licorice and a dash of black pepper while velvety tannins lend finesse.
title: Venturini Massimino 2009 Campomasua  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Enticing aromas of violet, baked plum and cake spice lead the way on this bold, elegant wine. The velvety palate offers juicy black cherry, ripe blackberry, licorice and black pepper accompanied by firm, polished tannins that give it a smooth texture.
title: Tommasi 2008 Cà Florian Riserva  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Underbrush, crushed blue flower, fig, charred earth and ripe black cherry aromas come together on this full-bodied red. The brooding, muscular palate delivers blackberry jam, raisin, licorice and tobacco while tightly knit, ripe tannins provide support. Drink after 2017.
title: Bertani 2007  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico

description: Light bodied and ideal for everyday fare, this has flavors of dried cherry, ground black pepper and a hint of clove. It's simple and easygoing, with soft tannins.
title: Dal Cero Tenuta di Corte Giacobbe 2015  Valpolicella
winery: Dal Cero Tenuta di Corte Giacobbe

description: Fruity aromas of pressed grapes and blackberry are repeated on the slightly sweet, informal palate. Zesty acidity keeps it fresh while it closes on a slightly bitter note.
title: Cavicchioli NV Robanera Abboccato  (Lambrusco di Modena)

description: Red bery, chopped herb and ground clove aromas carry over to the light-bodied simple palate. Lightly-knit tannins provide the easygoing framework. Enjoy soon.
title: Tommasi 2015 Rafaèl  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore)

description: Aromas suggest underbrush, scorched soil, stewed black fruit, pressed rose petal and a whiff of game. The warm palate offers steeped prune, fig, grilled herb and a leathery note alongside the heat of evident alcohol. Drink 2016–2021.
title: Val di Suga 2009 Vigna del Lago Riserva  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Aromas suggest underbrush, scorched soil, stewed black fruit, pressed rose petal and a whiff of game. The warm palate offers steeped prune, fig, grilled herb and a leathery note alongside the heat of evident alcohol. Drink 2016–2021.
title: Val di Suga 2009 Vigna del Lago Riserva  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Spiced plum, mocha, leather and Mediterranean herb are some of the aromas that jump from the glass. The one-dimensional palate delivers oak, anisette, stewed plum, vanilla, menthol and a confectionary note alongside drying tannins.
title: Val di Suga 2010  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Spiced plum, mocha, leather and Mediterranean herb are some of the aromas that jump from the glass. The one-dimensional palate delivers oak, anisette, stewed plum, vanilla, menthol and a confectionary note alongside drying tannins.
title: Val di Suga 2010  Brunello di Montalcino

description: A blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc, this opens with aromas of red currant, plum, cedar, bell pepper and toasted oak. The palate offers dried black cherry, grilled herb, espresso and vanilla alongside ripe but rather fleeting tannins.
title: Fornacelle 2011 Guarda Boschi  (Bolgheri Superiore)

description: A blend of Vermentino, Viognier and Petit Manseng, this charming white opens with aromas of Spanish broom, Mediterranean brush, beeswax and apricot. The palate delivers lychee, mature yellow peach and candied nectarine while a ginger note adds a bit of depth.
title: Donna Olimpia 1898 2011 White (Bolgheri)

description: This opens with aromas of toast, vanilla and stewed plum. The rich, monolithic palate offers fleshy black cherry, vanilla, anisette, plum cake and a confectionary note alongside round tannins. Drink 2016–2022.
title: Tenute Silvio Nardi 2010 Poggio Doria  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: This opens with aromas of toast, vanilla and stewed plum. The rich, monolithic palate offers fleshy black cherry, vanilla, anisette, plum cake and a confectionary note alongside round tannins. Drink 2016–2022.
title: Tenute Silvio Nardi 2010 Poggio Doria  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: This polished red opens with aromas of ripe berry, toasted oak and a whiff of blue flower. The vibrant palate delivers juicy red cherry, crushed raspberry and ground black pepper framed between bright acidity and supple tannins.
title: Podere San Cristoforo 2013 Amaranto  (Maremma Toscana)

description: Aromas of toast, espresso and meat juices lead the nose. The palate offers oak, cured meat, grilled herb and dried red fruit alongside firm but fine-grained tannins. Drink 2016–2022.
title: Podere La Vigna 2010  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Aromas of dark berry, blue flower, baking spice and a whiff of forest floor come together in the glass. The vibrant palate starts off with wild cherry, clove and sage but then loses some steam midpalate. Fine-grained but not very persistent tannins offer support. It's already surprisingly accessible. Drink through 2016–2020.
title: Pinino 2010  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Aromas of beeswax, honeysuckle and broom lead the nose on this juicy white. The concentrated palate offers white peach, apricot and nectarine zest alongside bright acidity.
title: Fattoria San Felo 2013 Le Stoppie Vermentino (Maremma Toscana)

description: This opens with aromas of cured meat, sweaty leather and a stalky note of moist hay. The dense palate is more expressive, offering mature black cherry, spiced plum, mocha, vanilla and a confectionary note alongside velvety tannins.
title: Fattoria La Lecciaia 2010 Vigna Manapetra  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Garnet colored with brick tones around the rim, this offers aromas of underbrush, vanilla, leather and dried berry. The palate is still rather closed but displays dried red cherry, white pepper, clove and savory herb alongside austere tannins and fresh acidity. Drink 2017–2022.
title: Fattoria La Lecciaia 2010  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Delicate aromas of white spring flower, pear and Mediterranean herb waft from the glass. The vibrant but restrained palate offers white peach, nectarine and a hint of mint alongside firm acidity. It finishes clean and crisp.
title: Fattoria di Magliano 2013 Pagliatura Vermentino (Maremma Toscana)

description: Quater is a rich red blend that opens with blackberry, rum cake, Indian spice, cola and ground clove. It combines intensity and complexity with a bold, opulent mouthfeel.
title: Firriato 2007 Quater Red (Sicilia)

description: Quater is a rich red blend that opens with blackberry, rum cake, Indian spice, cola and ground clove. It combines intensity and complexity with a bold, opulent mouthfeel.
title: Firriato 2007 Quater Red (Sicilia)

description: Fatagione delivers great intensity of cola, mint, licorice and rosemary-like aromas. The finish is dusty and dry, high lighted by brimstone and crushed mineral.
title: Cottanera 2008 Fatagione Nerello Mascalese (Sicilia)

description: Il Musico is a unique dessert wine that opens with aromas of resin, pine nut, caramel and candied fruit. The viscous mouthfeel is sweet and rich, but there's also a really nice blast of refreshing lemon zest on the close.
title: Benanti 2009 Il Musico Moscato (Sicilia)

description: Lu Patri (named after the “fathers”) is a pure expression of Nero d'Avola with sophisticated oak notes and deep layers of ripe fruit and spice. There's a slightly jammy aroma here, but it works well within the thick, dense personality of this hearty red wine.
title: Baglio del Cristo di Campobello 2009 Lu Patri Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: A blend of Carricante and Catarratto from vineyards plated 600 meters above sea level on the slopes of Mount Etna, Quota 600 is among Sicily's best white wines. Compact, tonic and streamlined, it does a beautiful job of presenting delicate floral and peach fruit aromas against an austere backdrop of crushed stone and talcum powder.
title: Graci 2010 Quota 600  (Etna)

description: Here's a creamy expression of Pinot Grigio with a saturated, golden color and dense aromas of cantaloupe, apricot, almond and yellow rose. The wine is rich and textured in the mouth with a dense, long-lasting finish and a slightly sour aftertaste.
title: Teresa Raiz 2008 Vigneti Le Marsure Pinot Grigio (Venezia Giulia)

description: This is a simple and cheerful Nero d'Avola that would pair well with white meats such as roast chicken or pork. Aromas here include blueberry, forest berry and there's a touch of bitter almond on the close.
title: Tasca d'Almerita 2008 Regaleali Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: Easy, fresh and buoyant, this luminous Pinot Grigio offers pretty aromas of citrus, pear and white mineral. The wine tastes fresh and easygoing and offers a clean, zesty feel on the close. Pair it with tomato and basil bruschetta.
title: Fontana d'Italia 2008 Pinot Grigio (Delle Venezie)

description: Here's a fresh and easygoing Nero d'Avola with light consistency and tonic aromas of berry fruit, cherry and almond paste. You can taste the ripe quality of fruit here and the wine is simple and genuine on the finish.
title: Capo Soprano 2007 Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: Here's a fresh and easygoing Nero d'Avola with light consistency and tonic aromas of berry fruit, cherry and almond paste. You can taste the ripe quality of fruit here and the wine is simple and genuine on the finish.
title: Capo Soprano 2007 Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: This is a pure expression of Syrah that shows rich aromas of ripe fruit, leather, tobacco, crushed black pepper and blackberry. The finish is long and smooth. Pair this with steak in a creamy green-pepper sauce.
title: Renieri 2007 Regina di Renieri Syrah (Toscana)

description: Modus delivers velvety aromas of black cherry, chocolate, leather, exotic spice and pipe tobacco. This super Tuscan blend is comprised of Sangiovese, Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, and it does a very nice job of showing the soft side of those grape varieties, especially on the long finish.
title: Ruffino 2008 Modus Red (Toscana)

description: Cabernets Franc and Sauvignon show a united front with an authentic Italian feel. Umbria's Marciliano is a dense and rich red wine, with savory aromas of blackberry, cured meat, dried sage, leather, tobacco and dark chocolate. The wine's tannins are firm and dense, but not at all sharp or thorny.
title: Falesco 2008 Marciliano Cabernet (Umbria)

description: Bold, thick and chewy, this masculine blend of Montepulciano and Cabernet Franc delivers lasting aromas of pipe tobacco, cinnamon, jammy blackberry and dried herb. The finish is driven by a soft, chocolate-fudge-like aftertaste.
title: Tenuta Vitalonga 2009 Phi Natura Armonia Red (Umbria)

description: Bold, thick and chewy, this masculine blend of Montepulciano and Cabernet Franc delivers lasting aromas of pipe tobacco, cinnamon, jammy blackberry and dried herb. The finish is driven by a soft, chocolate-fudge-like aftertaste.
title: Tenuta Vitalonga 2009 Phi Natura Armonia Red (Umbria)

description: Ser Gioveto is 80% Sangiovese with small additions of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. It has a deeply saturated ruby color and compelling aromas of ripe fruit, strawberry, rum cake and soft spice. There's a jammy accent in the bouquet that gives momentum to its rich, velvety mouthfeel.
title: Rocca delle Macìe 2008 Ser Gioveto Red (Toscana)

description: La Casa dell'Orco offers an interesting interpretation of Fiano that is slightly bigger and fatter than most. This golden wine opens with aromas of mature fruit, melon, apricot and a spicy touch of freshly cut grass at the very end. It moves smoothly over the mouth and shows medium intensity.
title: La Casa Dell'Orco 2009  Fiano di Avellino

description: A meaty note of bresaola or smoked bacon opens the nose of this hearty Aglianico. The wine offers black concentration and rich aromas of sweet spice, blackberry jam, crushed pepper, milky chocolate and sour cherry.
title: Donnachiara 2007 Aglianico (Campania)

description: From vineyards near the dangerous Vesuvius volcano, this crisp white wine is direct, clean, easy-going and food friendly. It opens with citrus, tangerine and stone fruit aromas.
title: Feudi di San Gregorio 2009 White (Lacryma Christi del Vesuvio)

description: Here's a very well priced Falanghina with overt and very mature aromas of apricot, peach and sweet honey. It feels smooth and silky and ends with a blast of yellow fruit flavors.
title: Ocone 2009 Falanghina (Taburno)

description: Vibrant and linear, this opens with aromas of leafy underbrush, moist soil, woodland berry and chopped herb. The luminous, graceful palate is all about freshness and elegance, offering crunchy red cherry, star anise and white pepper alongside bright acidity and firm refined tannins. Drink 2018–2030.
title: Tenute Sella 2010  Lessona

description: Vibrant and linear, this opens with aromas of leafy underbrush, moist soil, woodland berry and chopped herb. The luminous, graceful palate is all about freshness and elegance, offering crunchy red cherry, star anise and white pepper alongside bright acidity and firm refined tannins. Drink 2018–2030.
title: Tenute Sella 2010  Lessona

description: Leather, ripe dark-skinned berry, chopped herb, rose and a balsamic note are some of the aromas you'll find on this. The austere palate offers tart red cherry, sour cranberry, sage and a hint of anise alongside firm tannins. Give it time to fully develop. Drink after 2022.
title: Tiziano Mazzoni 2012 Dei Mazzoni  (Ghemme)

description: It takes only a few moments before you appreciate the enormity, intensity and overall beauty of this landmark wine. Cerretalto is always a high scoring expression of Brunello, but the ideal conditions of the 2007 vintage elevate it to earthly perfection. Dark and fleshy, the wine delivers ever-evolving aromas of dark fruit, chocolate, spice and tobacco. The acidity is carefully balanced against the wine's thickness and rich texture. The finish is long, luscious and elegant. Keep this bottle in your cellar 10 years or more.
title: Casanova di Neri 2007 Cerretalto  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: This blend of 90% Sangiovese and 10% Cabernet Sauvignon opens with aromas of blueberry and black plum accented with vanilla and coffee notes. Still tight, the palate offers up a core of rich black cherry accented with espresso, oak, vanilla and licorice alongside astringent, drying tannins. Give this a few years to unwind and fully develop.
title: Fattoria San Felo 2010 Dicioccatore  (Morellino di Scansano)

description: This blend of 90% Sangiovese and 10% Cabernet Sauvignon opens with aromas of blueberry and black plum accented with vanilla and coffee notes. Still tight, the palate offers up a core of rich black cherry accented with espresso, oak, vanilla and licorice alongside astringent, drying tannins. Give this a few years to unwind and fully develop.
title: Fattoria San Felo 2010 Dicioccatore  (Morellino di Scansano)

description: This quintessential young Chianti Classico is composed of 90% Sangiovese, 10% Pugnitello and 10% Colorino. The juicy palate bursts with ripe black cherry, raspberry, black pepper and cinnamon-spice. Smooth and delicious, it's ready to be enjoyed soon.
title: San Felice 2011  Chianti Classico

description: Intense red cherry and violet aromas follow through to the firmly structured palate in this wine, along with pomegranate, licorice and chopped herb notes. Taut, fine-grained tannins and bright acidity provide the framework. Drink 2023–2033.
title: Mauro Veglio 2013  Barolo

description: Ripe and succulent, this opens with aromas of mature black fruit, leather, graphite and Mediterranean herb. The full-bodied palate delivers juicy black cherry, mocha and baking spice alongside chewy, mature tannins. Drink through 2019.
title: Felsina 2009 Colonia Gran Selezione  (Chianti Classico)

description: Aromas of Mediterranean herb, balsam, eucalyptus and dark berry lead the nose. The firm, elegant palate delivers juicy black cherry, dried blackberry, black pepper, clove, thyme, orange peel and anisette alongside youthfully austere but fine-grained tannins. Let this wine develop. Drink 2017–2022.
title: Castello La Leccia 2010 Bruciagna Gran Selezione  (Chianti Classico)

description: Aromas of Mediterranean herb, balsam, eucalyptus and dark berry lead the nose. The firm, elegant palate delivers juicy black cherry, dried blackberry, black pepper, clove, thyme, orange peel and anisette alongside youthfully austere but fine-grained tannins. Let this wine develop. Drink 2017–2022.
title: Castello La Leccia 2010 Bruciagna Gran Selezione  (Chianti Classico)

description: Juicy and powerfully structured, this vibrant red boasts aromas of underbrush, game and mature plum. The palate offers cherry marinated in spirits, juicy raspberry, white pepper, clove, tobacco and licorice alongside firm, velvety tannins. Drink through 2019.
title: Castello di Cacchiano 2009 Millenio Gran Selezione  (Chianti Classico)

description: This opens with earthy aromas of tilled soil, leather, game, dark berry and graphite. The firm palate offers up juicy blackberry, dried black cherry, notes of grilled porcini, peppercorn, thyme and tobacco alongside velvety tannins. It closes on a licorice note. Hold for complexity. Drink 2016–2022.
title: Castelli del Grevepesa 2010 Panzano Gran Selezione  (Chianti Classico)

description: This opens with aromas of blue flower, ripe woodland berry and a whiff of pressed powder. The robust palate doles out juicy black cherry, mature plum, licorice and savory herb alongside firm, velvety tannins. It's concentrated and already accessible but will offer drinking pleasure for the next several years. Drink through 2021.
title: Poliziano 2011 Asinone  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: This opens with aromas of black plum and baking spice that carry over to the straightforward palate together with a touch of pepper. Round tannins provide easygoing support. Drink soon.
title: Trerè 2015 Lona Bona Sangiovese (Romagna)

description: A blend of 45% Cannonau, 45% Muristellu and 10% Cabernet Sauvignon, this laid-back red has delicate aromas suggesting ripe black cherry and Mediterranean underbrush. The straightforward accessible palate offers black plum, nutmeg and a bitter almond note alongside smooth tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Tenute Olbios 2012 Nessuno Red (Colli del Limbara)

description: A blend of 45% Cannonau, 45% Muristellu and 10% Cabernet Sauvignon, this laid-back red has delicate aromas suggesting ripe black cherry and Mediterranean underbrush. The straightforward accessible palate offers black plum, nutmeg and a bitter almond note alongside smooth tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Tenute Olbios 2012 Nessuno Red (Colli del Limbara)

description: Aromas of espresso, black-skinned fruit and a whiff of toasted oak take center stage on this. The firm palate delivers black plum, clove and mocha while assertive tannins leave a somewhat drying finish. Drink through 2019.
title: Tenuta La Viola 2013 P. Honorii Bertinoro Riserva Sangiovese (Romagna)

description: This no-fuss red opens with aromas of red berry and underbrush. The cheerful palate offers strawberry, cinnamon and a hint of orange peel accompanied by smooth tannins. It's made to be enjoyed young so drink soon.
title: Noelia Ricci 2015 Il Sangiovese Sangiovese (Romagna)

description: This easygoing red opens with aromas of black-skinned berry, baking spice and a whiff of violet. The bright shows black plum, cinnamon and a touch of white pepper alongside smooth tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Morini 2015 Morale Sangiovese (Romagna)

description: Made with 90% Nero d'Avola and 10% Nocera, this opens with earthy aromas of black plum, Mediterranean herb and a whiff of game. The straightforward palate displays black plum and carob alongside smooth tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Cantine Russo 2013 di Milazzo Red (Mamertino)

description: Made with 90% Nero d'Avola and 10% Nocera, this opens with earthy aromas of black plum, Mediterranean herb and a whiff of game. The straightforward palate displays black plum and carob alongside smooth tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Cantine Russo 2013 di Milazzo Red (Mamertino)

description: Ripe blackberry, spiced plum, purple flower and vanilla aromas jump out of the glass. The palate is more restrained, showing dried cherry, clove and a hint of clove set against close-grained tannins. Drink sooner rather than later to capture the remaining fruit.
title: Vesevo 2012 Aglianico (Beneventano)

description: Ripe blackberry, spiced plum, purple flower and vanilla aromas jump out of the glass. The palate is more restrained, showing dried cherry, clove and a hint of clove set against close-grained tannins. Drink sooner rather than later to capture the remaining fruit.
title: Vesevo 2012 Aglianico (Beneventano)

description: Aromas of white spring flower, yellow pear and apple follow the straightforward palate along with a hint of citrus. A light touch of almond signals the close.
title: Toscolo 2015  Vernaccia di San Gimignano

description: Delicate aromas of toast, hazelnut, yellow wild flower and candied citrus zest lead the nose. The subdued, rather lean palate shows yellow apple skin, toast, butterscotch and raw almond alongside bright acidity. A coffee note marks the close. It doesn't have much fruit richness so enjoy soon.
title: Tollena 2013 Signorina Vittoria Riserva  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: Delicately scented, this offers whiffs of white stone fruit and white spring flower. On the linear, rather lean palate, a note of bitter almond underscores green apple and citrus alongside racy acidity.
title: Tenuta Le Calcinaie 2014  Vernaccia di San Gimignano

description: Made with 95% Sangiovese and 5% Merlot, this opens with delicate aromas of red currant and baking spice. The straightforward palate offers raspberry jam, clove and white pepper alongside rounded tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Tenuta Casali 2015 Palazzina Red (Romagna)

description: Made with 95% Sangiovese and 5% Merlot, this opens with delicate aromas of red currant and baking spice. The straightforward palate offers raspberry jam, clove and white pepper alongside rounded tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Tenuta Casali 2015 Palazzina Red (Romagna)

description: Delicate aromas of white spring flower and a whiff of beeswax carry over to the fresh palate along with yellow apple and pear. A lightly bitter-almond note marks the finish.
title: Sensi 2016 Collegiata  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: Delicate scents suggesting aromatic herb, citrus blossom and a whiff of orchard fruit come together on this. The palate is round but rather shy, offering notes of mature yellow apple, honey and bitter almond.
title: San Quirico 2015  Vernaccia di San Gimignano

description: Garnet-ruby hue with slightly browning rim. Savory aromas of cured meat, cola, dried fruit and rum cake upfront, while warm earthy, tobacco and leather tones fill in the rear. Sophisticated and rich, reminiscent of a storied, nostalgic Brunello tradition. Generous, but with a firm, drying feel on the finish.
title: Baccinetti 2007 Saporoia  (Brunello di Montalcino)
