description: This full-bodied and savory blend of Chardonnay, Ribolla Gialla and Sauvignon opens with lovely aromas of hawthorne, apple and stone fruit. The vibrant palate delivers yellow peach, nectarine, Golden Delicious apple and candied citrus alongside bright acidity.
title: Gradis'ciutta 2011 Bratinis White (Collio)

description: Bold and savory, it has intriguing aromas of grass, dried hay, stone fruit and dill. The rich, warm palate delivers yellow peach, candied ginger and grapefruit accented with sage and a vanilla note.
title: La Tunella 2012 Col Matiss Sauvignon (Colli Orientali del Friuli)

description: Bold and savory, it has intriguing aromas of grass, dried hay, stone fruit and dill. The rich, warm palate delivers yellow peach, candied ginger and grapefruit accented with sage and a vanilla note.
title: La Tunella 2012 Col Matiss Sauvignon (Colli Orientali del Friuli)

description: It delivers classic varietal aromas of tomato leaf, cut grass, hay and citrus. The crisp palate delivers juicy grapefruit, cantaloupe, exotic fruit and mineral alongside lively acidity that leaves a pristine finish.
title: Comelli 2012 Sauvignon (Colli Orientali del Friuli)

description: This would pair with cold cuts, oven-roasted pizza or bruschetta with wild mushrooms. It is simple, clean and redolent of wild berries and tart cherry.
title: Stefano Accordini 2011  Valpolicella Classico

description: This would pair with cold cuts, oven-roasted pizza or bruschetta with wild mushrooms. It is simple, clean and redolent of wild berries and tart cherry.
title: Stefano Accordini 2011  Valpolicella Classico

description: A refreshing rosé sparkler that would pair with smoked salmon or fried calamari rings, this is tonic and bright, offering crisp acidity and tonic effervescence.
title: Lamberti NV Rosé Sparkling (Veneto)

description: A refreshing rosé sparkler that would pair with smoked salmon or fried calamari rings, this is tonic and bright, offering crisp acidity and tonic effervescence.
title: Lamberti NV Rosé Sparkling (Veneto)

description: The traditional grapes of Valpolicella (Corvina, Rondinella and Molinara) are blended with 10% Barbera, giving this an added touch of crisp acidity. The simple nose shows notes of wild berry, toasted almond and cola.
title: Musella 2010  Valpolicella Superiore

description: This has a touch of austerity, with savory spice, cured meat and teriyaki aromas. The palate bursts with bright red fruit and smooth tannins.
title: Pietro Zardini 2008 Austero  (Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso)

description: This has a touch of austerity, with savory spice, cured meat and teriyaki aromas. The palate bursts with bright red fruit and smooth tannins.
title: Pietro Zardini 2008 Austero  (Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso)

description: Lean and streamlined, this has bright aromas of dried rosemary, currant, cassis and spice. There's isn't too much pulpy fruit or extraction, but the acidity is refreshening and bright.
title: Vaona 2009 Paverno  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Lean and streamlined, this has bright aromas of dried rosemary, currant, cassis and spice. There's isn't too much pulpy fruit or extraction, but the acidity is refreshening and bright.
title: Vaona 2009 Paverno  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: This offers hearty fruit layers of black cherry, prune and plum, followed by notes of spice, leather and cola. It shows power and determination on the finish, with soft, velvety tannins.
title: Tinazzi 2009 Tenuta Valleselle Rovertondo  (Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso)

description: This offers hearty fruit layers of black cherry, prune and plum, followed by notes of spice, leather and cola. It shows power and determination on the finish, with soft, velvety tannins.
title: Tinazzi 2009 Tenuta Valleselle Rovertondo  (Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso)

description: This opens with bright fruit notes of blueberry and wild cherry, followed by savory touches of exotic spice and green tea. It offers heft and endurance without the chewy thickness found in some Amarone.
title: Ca' Rugate 2010 Campo Lavei  (Valpolicella Superiore)

description: This has zest, personality and depth, with layers of red fruit, spice, leather, pipe tobacco and dried rosemary emerge that emerge on the bouquet.
title: Bolla 2010 Le Poiane  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso)

description: This has zest, personality and depth, with layers of red fruit, spice, leather, pipe tobacco and dried rosemary emerge that emerge on the bouquet.
title: Bolla 2010 Le Poiane  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso)

description: To add a touch of much-needed freshness and acidity, a small percentage of Barbera is added to this traditional blend of Corvina, Rondinella and Molinara. The quality of fruit is very nice and resembles cherry, cassis and prune.
title: Musella 2009  Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso

description: A blend of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, this has bright cherry fruit, with light touches of spice and toasted almond. The simple, but velvety mouthfeel will work with curry chicken or spicy beef.
title: Maculan 2010 Brentino Red (Veneto)

description: This is layered and complex, with tones of black cherry, dried apple skin, clove, white pepper and grated ginger. Like most wines from Valpolicella, it offers heat and power but mellow tannins.
title: La Dama 2009  Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso

description: This is not complex or elaborate, nor is it meant to be. In fact, simplicity sums it up. It's fresh and clean, and it will drink nicely with meatloaf or pork chops.
title: Tedeschi 2011 Lucchine  (Valpolicella Classico)

description: Tight and aromatically intense, this delivers layers of ripe fruit, prune, black pepper, blackberry jelly and cinnamon. Those beautiful tones are followed by soft, velvety tannins.
title: Santi 2010 Solane  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso)

description: Pietracalda (which translates into “hot rock”) seems indeed to release aromas of sunbaked granite or river stone over lush background tones of peach, pear and yellow lemon zest. There's a drying, polished feel in the mouth with a touch of bitter almond on the close.
title: Feudi di San Gregorio 2009 Pietracalda  (Fiano di Avellino)

description: Here's a new producer from southern Italy who presents a very interesting blend of Pallagrello (70%), Aglianico and Casavecchia. The wine opens with warm aromas of leather, smoked meat and black fruit and delivers a unique mouthfeel that is firm but rich at the same time.
title: Nanni Copé 2008 Sabbie di Sopra il Bosco Red (Terre del Volturno)

description: This firm and austere Taurasi opens with dark aromas of plum cake, chocolate, dried currant, cola and smoky barbecue sauce. The tannins are firm and dense and the wine needs a few more years of cellar aging before it softens.
title: Donnachiara 2006  Taurasi

description: This firm and austere Taurasi opens with dark aromas of plum cake, chocolate, dried currant, cola and smoky barbecue sauce. The tannins are firm and dense and the wine needs a few more years of cellar aging before it softens.
title: Donnachiara 2006  Taurasi

description: Here's a fresh, crisp and tonic Moscato d'Asti (packaged in an elegant, little bottle) that shows nice floral intensity and background aromas of peach and almond skin. It tastes sweet and smooth and those perky bubbles help refresh the palate.
title: Michele Chiarlo 2009 Nivole 375ml  (Moscato d'Asti)

description: Recioto is a dark red dessert wine that pairs with chocolate fudge or spongy spice cake. This expression shows loads of dark sweetness and firm fleshiness backed by aromas of cinnamon, clove, cherry candy and blackberry jam.
title: Antolini 2007 500ml  (Recioto della Valpolicella Classico)

description: This dry interpretation of the Cartizze cru shows chalky mineral notes with background tones of peach, honey, wild flower and lemon zest. The soft sweetness feels great next to the naturally foamy quality of the mouthfeel.
title: Andreola 2009 Cartizze Dry  (Valdobbiadene Superiore di Cartizze)

description: This expression shows lightness, freshness and clear luminosity; Delivers creamy, foamy bubbles with bright aromas of peach, honey and citrus.
title: Villa Sandi NV Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This expression shows lightness, freshness and clear luminosity; Delivers creamy, foamy bubbles with bright aromas of peach, honey and citrus.
title: Villa Sandi NV Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This opens with Pecorino's classic floral fragrance of acacia and hawthorne, accented by whiffs of stone fruit. On the palate, it delivers ripe peach and apple flavors, with notes of ginger, almond and a drop of honey. Energizing minerality marks the finish.
title: Ciù Ciù 2012 Merlettaie  (Offida Pecorino)

description: This opens with Pecorino's classic floral fragrance of acacia and hawthorne, accented by whiffs of stone fruit. On the palate, it delivers ripe peach and apple flavors, with notes of ginger, almond and a drop of honey. Energizing minerality marks the finish.
title: Ciù Ciù 2012 Merlettaie  (Offida Pecorino)

description: This lovely Verdicchio opens with an alluring fragrance of white spring flowers, Spanish broom and a whiff of sea breeze. The creamy palate delivers white peach, tropical fruit and lemon notes, all brightened by crisp acidity and mineral accents.
region: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore
title: Tenuta di Tavignano 2012 Misco  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore)

description: Attractive floral scents of yellow flowers and Alpine herbs meld with juicy flavors of creamy peach, apple and lemon, all accented by hints of thyme and sage. Aging 25% of the wine in wood lends a touch of complexity to the savory flavors.
title: Poderi San Lazzaro 2012 Pistillo  (Offida Pecorino)

description: Attractive floral scents of yellow flowers and Alpine herbs meld with juicy flavors of creamy peach, apple and lemon, all accented by hints of thyme and sage. Aging 25% of the wine in wood lends a touch of complexity to the savory flavors.
title: Poderi San Lazzaro 2012 Pistillo  (Offida Pecorino)

description: This opens with lovely floral aromas accompanied by pure fruit sensations. The palate offers ripe yellow peach, lemon-lime and almond notes. This can be enjoyed now or held for a few years to develop more complexity.
region: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore
title: Garofoli 2011 Podium  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore)

description: Grassy aromas of field flower and dandelions are backed by discreet tones of citrus and passionfruit. This is a very good and easygoing cocktail wine. It's thin, simple and fresh on the close.
title: Zimòr 2008 Friulano (Friuli Grave)

description: This is a sweet sparkling wine made with very fragrant Moscato grapes that can be paired with fruit desserts or easy appetizers. The wine imparts aromas of peach, honey and jasmine.
title: Castello del Poggio NV Dolce Moscato (Asti)

description: Here's a luminous and bright sweet sparkling wine (made from generously fragrant Moscato grapes) with lingering, but simple, aromas of honey, rose, peach blossom and pink grapefruit. The wine is tonic and firm and imparts sweet honey flavors on the close.
title: Mionetto NV Moscato Dolce Moscato (Veneto)

description: You absolutely can't go wrong with a wine like this. Valpolicella Torre d'Orti is an easy, fresh wine that would pair with anything from lasagna to cheeseburgers. It's crisp and thin with a nice quality of cherry, raspberry and cassis fruit.
title: Cavalchina 2007 Torre d'Orti  (Valpolicella Superiore)

description: You absolutely can't go wrong with a wine like this. Valpolicella Torre d'Orti is an easy, fresh wine that would pair with anything from lasagna to cheeseburgers. It's crisp and thin with a nice quality of cherry, raspberry and cassis fruit.
title: Cavalchina 2007 Torre d'Orti  (Valpolicella Superiore)

description: This easy-going Valpolicella offers medium heft and density with fresh notes of cherry, blueberry, white almond and cola. Pair this wine with bruschetta topped with wild mushrooms and olive oil.
title: Zenato 2008  Valpolicella Superiore

description: Here's a bold and jammy Valpolicella with loads of power and alcohol that would pair with stewy meat dishes or game meat. You'll feel the heat on the nose followed by determined aromas of exotic spice, cherry maraschino and amaretto liqueur.
title: Tommaso Bussola 2005  Valpolicella Classico Superiore

description: This bright and crisp Valpolicella Classico delivers clean aromas of cherry, blackberry and plum. The wine sees no oak and for that reason, its fruity characteristics really shine on the finish.
title: Marchesi Fumanelli 2007  Valpolicella Classico

description: This bright and crisp Valpolicella Classico delivers clean aromas of cherry, blackberry and plum. The wine sees no oak and for that reason, its fruity characteristics really shine on the finish.
title: Marchesi Fumanelli 2007  Valpolicella Classico

description: Cherry candy and cola aromas emerge from the nose of this simple, but very bright Ripasso. There's a tiny hint of dried apple skin or citrus at the back and the wine is smooth and lively on the close.
title: Manzini 2004  Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso

description: Cherry candy and cola aromas emerge from the nose of this simple, but very bright Ripasso. There's a tiny hint of dried apple skin or citrus at the back and the wine is smooth and lively on the close.
title: Manzini 2004  Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso

description: La Corte del Pozzo is an easy-going Ripasso with bright berry nuances and loads of natural freshness and crispness. The wine would pair with easy, fatty foods like pizza or lasagna with melted mozzarella.
title: Gino Fasoli 2006 La Corte del Pozzo  (Valpolicella Ripasso)

description: Made with organically-farmed grapes, this Valpolicella blend offers meaty aromas of ripe cherry, moist pipe tobacco and light shadings of dark spice. It delivers medium length and intensity with a very crisp, almost bitter fade.
title: Corte Sant' Alda 2009 Ca' Fiui  (Valpolicella)

description: Made predominantly from Pinot Nero and with no added dosage, this sparkling wine delivers aromas of acacia flower, toasted almond and honey that carry over to the palate. It has a fine perlage and a bone-dry finish.
title: Villa Crespia 2006 Francesco Iacono Dosaggio Zero Riserva Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: Full-bodied but accessible, this delivers ripe dark cherry, plum, black pepper and clove flavors. Fresh and balanced with polished tannins, it's already drinking well. Drink through 2019.
title: Campo della Maestà 2009  Montefalco Sagrantino

description: Violet, rose, mature black fruit, leather and baking spice aromas open this smooth, structured wine. The palate offers prune, dried cherry, nutmeg and mocha alongside assertive, drying tannins. Drink 2016–2023.
title: Villa Mora 2008 Riserva  (Montefalco Rosso)

description: Blackberry, underbrush, mocha and baking spice aromas lead the nose on this hearty wine. The dense palate offers mature black plum, dill, clove and hints of black pepper alongside bracing tannins.
title: Albino Armani 2009  Amarone della Valpolicella

description: Made with organically cultivated grapes, this savory white offers alluring aromas of yellow stone fruit, pear and white spring flower. Juicy and delicious, the creamy palate doles out succulent yellow peach, golden apple, nectarine and a savory saline note. Tangy acidity lifts the creamy flavors while a hint of white almond graces the finish.
title: Il Colombaio di Santa Chiara 2015 Selvabianca  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: Made with organically cultivated grapes, this savory white offers alluring aromas of yellow stone fruit, pear and white spring flower. Juicy and delicious, the creamy palate doles out succulent yellow peach, golden apple, nectarine and a savory saline note. Tangy acidity lifts the creamy flavors while a hint of white almond graces the finish.
title: Il Colombaio di Santa Chiara 2015 Selvabianca  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: This impressive white from Sardinia opens with aromas of ripe orchard fruit, Mediterranean brush and a whiff of exotic fruit while the juicy palate doles out apricot, pineapple and candied citrus zest. An energizing mineral note brightens the creamy flavors.
title: Vigne Surrau 2015 Sciala Superiore  (Vermentino di Gallura)

description: This soft, round wine opens with aromas of oak, vanilla and black fruit. It has big, ripe flavors of blackberry, plum, espresso and chocolate alongside smooth tannins. While it's not complex, it's delicious and ready to enjoy now.
title: Falesco 2012 Merlot (Umbria)

description: Here's an updated expression of Umbria's most famous white that adds 40% Vermentino to 50% Grechetto and 10% Trebbiano. It delivers an enticing fragrance of pineapple and stone fruit that carries through to the palate, along with apple and citrus flavors. It has a rich texture and crisp finish.
title: Decugnano dei Barbi 2011 Decugnano Bianco  (Orvieto Classico Superiore)

description: This opens with earthy aromas of scorched earth, overripe plum and a whiff of game. The straightforward palate offers juicy wild cherry, raspberry jam, coffee and vanilla alongside zesty acidity and fine-grained tannins. Drink through 2017.
title: Icardi 2012 Suri di Mu  (Barbera d'Alba)

description: Dark and dense, this opens with aromas of ripe plum, vanilla and exotic spice. The round, chewy palate offers ripe black cherry, blackberry, roasted coffee bean, licorice and clove alongside close-grained tannins.
title: Matteo Correggia 2012 Marun  (Barbera d'Alba Superiore)

description: Dark and dense, this opens with aromas of ripe plum, vanilla and exotic spice. The round, chewy palate offers ripe black cherry, blackberry, roasted coffee bean, licorice and clove alongside close-grained tannins.
title: Matteo Correggia 2012 Marun  (Barbera d'Alba Superiore)

description: Forest floor, woodland berry and spice aromas emerge in the glass. The tight palate offers sour cherry, white pepper, grilled herb and a whiff of tobacco alongside close-grained tannins and racy acidity. An anisette note closes the finish.
title: Vite Colte 2011 del Comune di Barolo Essenze  (Barolo)

description: This opens with aromas of espresso, leather, prune, toasted hazelnut and a whiff of dark spice. The palate is evolved, showing roasted coffee bean, raisin and licorice alongside somewhat astringent tannins. You'll also note a green sensation of powdered sage on the close.
title: Collina San Ponzio 2010 Riserva  (Barolo)

description: Fun and refreshing, this lightly sparkling dessert wine offers aromas and flavors of ripe yellow peach, candied tangerine zest and a hint of aromatic herb. Modest acidity stops it from being cloying.
title: Villa San Giovanni 2015  Moscato d'Asti

description: Here is a sophisticated, opulent expression of Vernaccia that opens with a deep golden color and offers toasty notes of almonds and hazelnut followed by honey, pineapple and dried apricot. The wine has a dense, slightly sour taste and ends with big fruit intensity.
title: San Quirico 2003 Riserva  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: Here is a sophisticated, opulent expression of Vernaccia that opens with a deep golden color and offers toasty notes of almonds and hazelnut followed by honey, pineapple and dried apricot. The wine has a dense, slightly sour taste and ends with big fruit intensity.
title: San Quirico 2003 Riserva  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: Cherries, blueberries and sweet Christmas spice characterize this Riserva and help fill out its dense, dark extraction. The wine has a very smooth, almost sweet-tasting element and offers chewy, juicy tannins with lingering berry flavors. Made with small percentages of Merlot and Cabernet to lift the Sangiovese.
title: Rocca delle Macìe 2004 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: There's a hint of initial ripeness or stewiness on the nose in the form of blackberry preserves and strawberry but it's not enough to be a problem. In fact, the wine comes in line with just a few swirls of the glass to reveal more delicate and ethereal notes of spice and vanilla.
title: Castello di Verrazzano 2005 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Here is 100% Sangiovese that reaches unbelievable extraction and thickness. The results are meaty and chewy with thick aromatic layers of plump cherries, chocolate, tobacco, moist earth and oaky spice. The mouthfeel is lively and vibrant with lingering tones of barbecue on the finish.
title: Barone Ricasoli 2006 Brolio  (Chianti Classico)

description: This is a succulent, full-bodied Riserva with loads of aromatic intensity in the form of black cherry, ripe blueberry, leather, resin, tobacco and black spice. It's a pretty, vibrant wine both in terms of color and flavor and has solid, ripe tones of black fruit and mature berry.
title: Tenuta di Arceno 2005 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: This is a succulent, full-bodied Riserva with loads of aromatic intensity in the form of black cherry, ripe blueberry, leather, resin, tobacco and black spice. It's a pretty, vibrant wine both in terms of color and flavor and has solid, ripe tones of black fruit and mature berry.
title: Tenuta di Arceno 2005 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: A unique and distinctive style of Vernaccia: The wine offers a thick golden color and opulent notes of almonds, stone fruit, ripe melon and honey. There's style and elegance here and the wine leaves a clean, fresh sensation in the mouth.
title: Poderi del Paradiso 2006 Biscondola  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: Ramandolo is a traditional dessert wine with roots in northeast Italy that opens with sweet aromas of candied fruit, pickled ginger and crème brûlée. A spicy touch of peppermint or dried herb keeps the mouthfeel focused and sharp.
title: Dario Coos 2008  Ramandolo

description: Here's a ripe red wine with mature aromas of black fruit, prunes and dried figs. The wine is smooth and soft in the mouth and ends with some fresh, but slightly sour fruit flavors.
title: San Osvaldo 2007 Refosco (Lison-Pramaggiore)

description: Baked plum, grilled mushroom and a potpourri of spicy aromas emerge on this firmly structured red. The concentrated, full-bodied palate delivers ripe black cherry, tobacco, fig, ground pepper and a licorice note. Firm, ripe tannins provide support.
title: Mastroberardino 2009 Radici  (Taurasi)

description: Baked plum, grilled mushroom and a potpourri of spicy aromas emerge on this firmly structured red. The concentrated, full-bodied palate delivers ripe black cherry, tobacco, fig, ground pepper and a licorice note. Firm, ripe tannins provide support.
title: Mastroberardino 2009 Radici  (Taurasi)

description: Aromas of French oak, mature black-skinned fruit, espresso and a hint of blue flower lead the nose on this structured red. The generous palate doles out juicy black cherry, blackberry, ground pepper and licorice while velvety tannins provide smooth, seamless support. Drink through 2021.
title: Donnafugata 2011 Mille e Una Notte  (Contessa Entellina)

description: Here's a beautiful Riserva Pinot Bianco that delivers intense aromas of stone fruit, honey, melon and toasted almond. The wine rests on the lees for eight months for extra heft and density on its naturally rich texture. Pair it with shellfish or white meat.
title: Russiz Superiore 2006 Riserva Pinot Bianco (Collio)

description: This feminine, delicate rosé sparkling wine from northern Italy opens with a beautiful peachy-pink color and lively aromas of stone fruit, cranberry, pink rose, dried grass and crushed mineral. Pair this wine with caviar or smoked salmon.
title: Bellavista 2005 Gran Cuvée Rosé Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: This beautiful sparkler rested on its lees for 70 months, giving it extra smoothness and rich denseness. The bouquet is redolent of apricot, ripe fruit, melon and lightly toasted baguette. The mouthfeel is long, elegant and driven by fine perlage.
designation: Casa delle Colonne Zero Riserva Millesimato
title: Fratelli Berlucchi 2005 Casa delle Colonne Zero Riserva Millesimato Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: Oozing richness and opulence, the bouquet delivers a steady stream of honey, flower and apricot aromas. On the palate, this is silky and creamy, save for a tingling touch of acidity that keeps the palate refreshed.
title: Di Majo Norante 2010 Apianae Moscato (Molise)

description: Gorgeous and elegant, this demonstrates Tuscany's sweetest side. Trebbiano, Sangiovese and Malvasia undergo long aging to obtain impressive thickness and intensity of flavor. The lengthy finish is driven by notes of candied fruit, honey and brown sugar.
title: Castello di Bossi 2003 Vin San Laurentino White (Toscana)

description: Air-dried Moscato Giallo grapes are pushed to the extremes in terms of their intensity and staying power. This opulent selection offers thick layers of candied fruit, apricot, honey, caramel and marzipan. The flavors are delicious and long-lasting.
title: Kellerei Kaltern Caldaro 2008 Serenade Passito Moscato Giallo (Alto Adige)

description: This Italian Malbec shows bright fruit flavors backed by drying mineral tones and bright cherry tones. The wine has grace and charm thanks to its streamlined build and its natural ability to pair with Mediterranean foods. Aged 12 months in oak, this is the estate's top wine.
title: Paladin 2005 Malbech Gli Aceri Malbec (Delle Venezie)

description: This Italian Malbec shows bright fruit flavors backed by drying mineral tones and bright cherry tones. The wine has grace and charm thanks to its streamlined build and its natural ability to pair with Mediterranean foods. Aged 12 months in oak, this is the estate's top wine.
title: Paladin 2005 Malbech Gli Aceri Malbec (Delle Venezie)

description: Opening with subtle aromas that recall white flower and citrus, this straightforward white offers flavors of Granny Smith apple and lime alongside bright acidity. It's extremely simple but also clean and refreshing.
title: Gran Passione 2015  Gavi

description: Aromas of tropical fruit, yellow flower and a hint of nut lead the nose. On the informal palate, brisk acidity brightens banana, white peach and pear.
title: Italo Cescon 2014 Pinot Grigio (Veneto)

description: Aromas of rose and baked apple lead the way on this vibrant sparkler. The lively palate delivers strawberry, nectarine zest and a note of bread crust alongside a firm, persistent pelage. An almond note closes the sharp finish.
title: Castello Bonomi NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: Aromas of rose and baked apple lead the way on this vibrant sparkler. The lively palate delivers strawberry, nectarine zest and a note of bread crust alongside a firm, persistent pelage. An almond note closes the sharp finish.
title: Castello Bonomi NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: Refermenting in the bottle adds nice depth to the Bartlett pear, Granny Smith apple and nectarine zest flavors. A soft mousse adds elegance while crisp acidity gives it a clean, refreshing finish.
title: Bellenda NV Sei Uno  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This offers aromas of almond, citrus zest and orchard fruit. The firm, rich palate delivers lemon drop, white peach and yellow apple while bright acidity and small, persistent bubbles provide the framework. It ends crisp and refreshing.
title: Andreola 2014 Dry  (Valdobbiadene Superiore di Cartizze)

description: Scents of Spanish broom, acacia flower, beeswax and orchard fruit lead the nose on this slightly sweet sparkler. The bright, creamy palate doles out juicy white peach, yellow apple and ripe pear while firm acidity and a vibrant mousse offer support. A hint of almond closes the finish.
title: Adami NV  Valdobbiadene Superiore di Cartizze

description: Enticing aromas of white spring flowers, Spanish broom and orchard fruit lead the way. The refreshing palate doles out white peach, green apple and pear alongside firm acidity and a racy perlage. A mineral note backs up the finish.
title: La Farra NV Selezione Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: A blend of 50% Nebbiolo, 30% Pinot Nero and 20% Chardonnay, this offers aromas of chamomile, lemon blossom, orchard fruit and lemon zest. The firm palate offers nectarine zest, ripe apple, toasted hazelnut and a note of bread crust alongside a vibrant perlage.
title: Rivetti Massimo 2010 Duemiladieci Bianco Metodo Classico Sparkling (Vino Spumante)

description: A blend of 50% Nebbiolo, 30% Pinot Nero and 20% Chardonnay, this offers aromas of chamomile, lemon blossom, orchard fruit and lemon zest. The firm palate offers nectarine zest, ripe apple, toasted hazelnut and a note of bread crust alongside a vibrant perlage.
title: Rivetti Massimo 2010 Duemiladieci Bianco Metodo Classico Sparkling (Vino Spumante)

description: Made entirely with Pinot Nero, this salmon-colored sparkler has delicate aromas of McIntosh apple, citrus zest and a whiff of honey. The bright palate offers strawberry, bread crust and a note of toasted hazelnut alongside an elegant mousse.
title: Cascina Bretta Rossa 2011 Cuvéè Leonora Rosé Pinot Nero (Alta Langa)

description: Truffle, game and grilled sage aromas take center stage along with a floral note of red rose. The solid palate shows red berry, clove and white pepper while somewhat grainy tannins provide an assertive framework and a mouth-drying finish. Drink 2020–2028.
title: Boasso 2013 Margheria  (Barolo)

description: Truffle, game and grilled sage aromas take center stage along with a floral note of red rose. The solid palate shows red berry, clove and white pepper while somewhat grainy tannins provide an assertive framework and a mouth-drying finish. Drink 2020–2028.
title: Boasso 2013 Margheria  (Barolo)

description: Violet, rose and woodland berry aromas fuse with a whiff a new leather on this bright red. On the luminous no-frills palate, accents of clove and orange peel add interest to unripe strawberry and sour cherry. Fresh acidity and firm tannins provide solid support.
title: Sordo 2013  Barolo

description: Ripe fruit, strawberry marmalade, spice and BBQ sauce characterize this mature expression of Amarone by Domenico Fraccaroli. The wine is sweet and creamy in the mouth but that overripe note of jammy fruit appears once more in the mouth.
title: Grotta del Ninfeo 2004  Amarone della Valpolicella

description: Ripe fruit, strawberry marmalade, spice and BBQ sauce characterize this mature expression of Amarone by Domenico Fraccaroli. The wine is sweet and creamy in the mouth but that overripe note of jammy fruit appears once more in the mouth.
title: Grotta del Ninfeo 2004  Amarone della Valpolicella

description: Campo Leòn has herbal or green aromas that are unusual in Amarone. Those leafy elements are backed by ripe fruit, spice and toasted almond. It's round and full on the close with lingering berry flavors.
title: Latium di Morini 2003 Campo Leòn  (Amarone della Valpolicella)

description: The nose of this Aglianico Riserva from Southern Italy is redolent of Indian spice, sandalwood, church incense and potpourri. You'll also get perfumed fruit tones of cherry liqueur and candied fruit over a thick, chewy mouthfeel with a touch of sour cherry on the close.
title: Rivera 2004 Riserva Cappellaccio Aglianico (Castel del Monte)

description: This expression of Magliocco and Gaglioppo (two native grapes of Calabria) is less opulent and rich than SerraMonte but shows more elegance and harmony overall. You still get mature fruit aromas of raisins and prunes but the mouthfeel is bright, thick and delicious. From Giampaolo Venica and his Calabrian venure, Balbia is an ancient name given to this part of the world by the Romans.
title: Terre di Balbia 2006 Balbium Red (Calabria)

description: Dark concentration and an inky, midnight color describe this Amarone's rich appearance. On the nose, however, it offers vibrant and lively tones of cola, mineral, cherry and dried flowers. There's even a soapy, or perfumed incense-like tone hidden at the back.
title: Marco Cottini 2003  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico

description: A straight-shooting blend of Sangiovese and Syrah for picnics or weekends away with friends. The wine goes down easy, and offers fresh cherry and blueberry flavors along the way.
title: Badia a Coltibuono 2009 Cancelli Red (Toscana)

description: A straight-shooting blend of Sangiovese and Syrah for picnics or weekends away with friends. The wine goes down easy, and offers fresh cherry and blueberry flavors along the way.
title: Badia a Coltibuono 2009 Cancelli Red (Toscana)

description: This fresh and food-friendly Pinot Grigio opens with delicate floral notes of white rose and almond blossom followed by exotic fruit and citrus. The balanced acidity would pair with chicken salad and mayonnaise.
title: Josef Brigl 2010 Sielo Blu Pinot Grigio (Alto Adige)

description: Forget Pinot Grigio and try this wonderful white wine from central Italy. Passerina, a little-known native grape, offers crisp sassiness and bright aromas of kiwi, citrus and passion fruit. There's loads of fresh personality here.
title: Il Conte 2009 Villa Prandone Cavaceppo Passerina (Marche)

description: Forget Pinot Grigio and try this wonderful white wine from central Italy. Passerina, a little-known native grape, offers crisp sassiness and bright aromas of kiwi, citrus and passion fruit. There's loads of fresh personality here.
title: Il Conte 2009 Villa Prandone Cavaceppo Passerina (Marche)

description: A food-friendly blend of Schiava and Lagrein (two native grapes of northern Italy) this ruby-colored wine opens with a lean consistency and medium build. It shows cool-climate aromas of small forest fruit and blue flowers with a touch of white almond on the close.
title: Andriano 2009 Santa Maddalena Red (Alto Adige)

description: You could get lost in the enticing fragrance of this wine thanks to wild berry, blue flower, baking spice, chopped herb and saddle leather aromas. The smooth, elegantly structured palate is just as inviting, doling out juicy black cherry, raspberry, cinnamon and white pepper flavors. Polished tannins and fresh acidity lend balance and support. An impressive effort from this winery—one of Montalcino's little known gems.
title: Armilla 2012  Brunello di Montalcino

description: You could get lost in the enticing fragrance of this wine thanks to wild berry, blue flower, baking spice, chopped herb and saddle leather aromas. The smooth, elegantly structured palate is just as inviting, doling out juicy black cherry, raspberry, cinnamon and white pepper flavors. Polished tannins and fresh acidity lend balance and support. An impressive effort from this winery—one of Montalcino's little known gems.
title: Armilla 2012  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Forest floor, wild berry, new leather and balsam are some of the aromas you'll find in this bright, linear red. On the palate, firm, polished tannins support ripe red cherry, white pepper, andcrushed mint notes with a hint of black tea. It's still young and tightly wound but already boasts stunning elegance. Drink 2020–2032.
title: Il Marroneto 2012  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Here's a delicious red that opens with appealing ripe plum, blue flower, tobacco and baking spice aromas. Velvety tannins and fresh acidity provide structure and balance, while while juicy black cherry, raspberry compote and licorice flavors envelope the palate. Drink 2019–2032.
title: Abbadia Ardenga 2012 Vigna Piaggia  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Here's a delicious red that opens with appealing ripe plum, blue flower, tobacco and baking spice aromas. Velvety tannins and fresh acidity provide structure and balance, while while juicy black cherry, raspberry compote and licorice flavors envelope the palate. Drink 2019–2032.
title: Abbadia Ardenga 2012 Vigna Piaggia  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Le Passule is a gorgeous passito dessert wine that offers sweet tones of honey, candied apricot and almond paste backed by a zesty touch of exotic spice. There's enough heft and determination here to pair with aged cheese.
title: Librandi 2007 Le Passule 500ml White (Val di Neto)

description: What sets this Taurasi apart is a distinct floral note of blue flower or pressed rose that sits over a much broader and bolder base of dark spice, black fruit, prune, resin and cola. The little floral accent adds a feminine touch to what is without a doubt one of Italy's most masculine wines.
title: Villa Matilde 2005 Tenuta di Altavilla  (Taurasi)

description: From the extraordinary Punggl vineyard cru south of the town of Magrè at an altitude of 790 feet above sea level, this rich, luscious and refined Merlot is simply gorgeous. The mouthfeel is soft, silky and rich and the high altitude has helped to shape aromatic brightness and overall intensity. Beautiful.
title: Alois Lageder 2004 MMIV Merlot (Alto Adige)

description: A 50-50 blend of Bombino Bianco and Chardonnay, this oak-aged white blend from southern Italy delivers bright acidity from the first grape variety and smooth vanilla, butterscotch and peach from the second.
title: Torrevento 2009 Bacca Rara White (Puglia)

description: Albana di Romagna is a little-known white wine from central Italy that offers much of the same fresh appeal of more popular and commercial Italian whites like Pinot Grigio. This expression is bright and crisp with pear and stone fruit.
title: Tenuta Valli 2009 Vinchi  (Albana di Romagna)

description: Crisp and clean with medium aromatic intensity and an easy finish, this Pinot Grigio would wash down with chicken or tuna salad. Citrus and stone fruit appear as zesty endnotes.
title: Forchir 2010 Villa del Borgo Pinot Grigio (Friuli Grave)

description: Crisp and clean with medium aromatic intensity and an easy finish, this Pinot Grigio would wash down with chicken or tuna salad. Citrus and stone fruit appear as zesty endnotes.
title: Forchir 2010 Villa del Borgo Pinot Grigio (Friuli Grave)

description: Black Label Gavi from the historic La Scolca winery offers zesty freshness backed by crisp aromas of grapefruit and crushed white mineral. The boasts beautiful, clean simplicity.
title: La Scolca 2010 Black Label  (Gavi)

description: Valcolomba is a pure expression of Vermentino from Maremma in southern Italy with ripe aromas of melon, peach and passion fruit. The mouthfeel is smooth, easy and creamy soft.
title: Carpineto 2010 Valcolomba Vermentino (Maremma)

description: Valcolomba is a pure expression of Vermentino from Maremma in southern Italy with ripe aromas of melon, peach and passion fruit. The mouthfeel is smooth, easy and creamy soft.
title: Carpineto 2010 Valcolomba Vermentino (Maremma)

description: A blend of equal parts Vermentino, Fiano and Chardonnay, Le Zere offers thick aromas of honey, yellow fruit and butterscotch. A sour, spicy flavor moves the wine forward over the palate.
title: Pieve Vecchia 2009 Le Zere White (Maremma)

description: You can't beat this price for a Pinot Grigio with natural freshness and pristine aromas of stone fruit and citrus. The nice thing is that it tastes Italian made, and not like many of the commercial, generic Grigios on the market today.
title: Kirkland Signature 2010 Pinot Grigio (Friuli Grave)

description: You can't beat this price for a Pinot Grigio with natural freshness and pristine aromas of stone fruit and citrus. The nice thing is that it tastes Italian made, and not like many of the commercial, generic Grigios on the market today.
title: Kirkland Signature 2010 Pinot Grigio (Friuli Grave)

description: Earthy, almost funky, aromas of tilled soil, leather, toast and game take shape in the glass. The palate offers dried black cherry, powdered sage, tobacco and an anisette note alongside assertive tannins. Drink after 2018.
title: Renieri 2010  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Aromas of toasted oak, vanilla, spiced plum, leather and a whiff of game lead the nose. The rich palate offers baked black fruit, sage, tobacco and anisette alongside a backbone of assertive tannins.
title: Cava d'Onice 2010  Brunello di Montalcino

description: A blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Syrah, this vibrant wine conveys aromas of black currant, red berry and cooking spice. The savory palate offers black cherry and ground pepper alongside relaxed tannins. Drink through 2016.
title: Giorgio Meletti Cavallari 2013 Borgeri  (Bolgheri)

description: The light garnet color, brick rim and tertiary aromas indicate this is evolving quickly. The palate is more vibrant, displaying menthol, steeped cherry, plum cake, vanilla and licorice alongside bracing tannins. Drink after 2017.
title: Fattoria dei Barbi 2010  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Crushed herb, red berry, dark spice, eucalyptus and a hint of celery mingle together in the glass. On the austere, tightly wound palate, assertive, fine-grained tannins support sour cherry and pomegranate fruit that's juxtaposed with hints of espresso and anise.
title: Batasiolo 2014  Barbaresco

description: Crushed herb, red berry, dark spice, eucalyptus and a hint of celery mingle together in the glass. On the austere, tightly wound palate, assertive, fine-grained tannins support sour cherry and pomegranate fruit that's juxtaposed with hints of espresso and anise.
title: Batasiolo 2014  Barbaresco

description: Made from 100% Nero d'Avola, this has ripe blackberry, tilled earth and clove aromas. The juicy palate offers blueberry jam, vanilla and leather touches alongside velvety tannins. Drink through 2020.
title: Valle dell'Acate 2013 Il Moro Nero d'Avola (Vittoria)

description: Made from 100% Nero d'Avola, this has ripe blackberry, tilled earth and clove aromas. The juicy palate offers blueberry jam, vanilla and leather touches alongside velvety tannins. Drink through 2020.
title: Valle dell'Acate 2013 Il Moro Nero d'Avola (Vittoria)

description: This wine opens with mature black plum, blue flower and cooking spice aromas. The juicy, easy-drinking palate delivers ripe blackberry and blueberry jam flavors, with a hint of pink peppercorn. Velvety tannins provide smooth support. Enjoy through 2020.
title: Morgante 2014 Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: Enticing aromas of white and yellow spring flowers, peach and a hint of pastry cream lead the nose. The palate offers creamed green apple, nectarine zest, ripe pear and a hint of mineral alongside vibrant acidity and an elegant, persistent perlage.
title: Terre di San Venanzio Fortunato NV Dry  (Valdobbiadene Superiore di Cartizze)

description: Made with 70% Nebbiolo and 30% Pinot Nero, this savory sparker offers aromas and flavors of wild cherry, juicy strawberry, orange zest and a hint of cake spice. Fresh acidity and a vibrant but refined perlage provide the backdrop.
title: Rivetti Massimo 2009 Duemilanove Rosé Metodo Classico Sparkling (Vino Spumante)

description: Made with 70% Nebbiolo and 30% Pinot Nero, this savory sparker offers aromas and flavors of wild cherry, juicy strawberry, orange zest and a hint of cake spice. Fresh acidity and a vibrant but refined perlage provide the backdrop.
title: Rivetti Massimo 2009 Duemilanove Rosé Metodo Classico Sparkling (Vino Spumante)

description: This bright Refosco Riserva offers bitter notes of white cherry and cranberry followed by light spice and toasted nut. It's a lively, fresh red wine with a citrusy, crisp close. Pair it with chicken in creamy mushroom sauce and wild rice.
title: Bosco del Merlo 2005 Roggio dei Roveri Riserva Refosco (Lison-Pramaggiore)

description: Le Prunée is a simple expression of Merlot with layers of cherry, blackberry, spice, earth and old leather. You could easily pair this wine with roast chicken or pork thanks to the smooth nature of the mouthfeel.
title: Tommasi 2008 Le Prunée Merlot (Delle Venezie)

description: A pure expression of the Raboso grape (a native variety of northern Italy), Rabià is a dark wine with meaty, thick aromas of mature blackberry and sour cherry. The wine delivers soft tannins, good density and a touch of bitter fruit on the close.
title: Cescon Italo Storia e Vini 2005 Rabià Raboso (Piave)

description: Il Groto is an easy blend of red grapes that are native to the Verona area in northern Italy. This is the kind of wine you'll want to pair with informal, home-cooked meat dishes like stew or roast beef. Aromas here include cherry, almond and a touch of sweet vanilla.
title: Aldegheri 2007 Il Groto Red (Rosso del Veronese)

description: Aromas of baked plum, underbrush, grilled herb and mocha lead the nose on this dense, soft wine. The concentrated palate delivers blackberry, black cherry, vanilla, clove and black pepper notes alongside velvety tannins.
title: Santa Sofia 2007 Gioè  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Made entirely from Nebbiolo, this boasts finesse and structure. Aromas of rose and red berry carry over to the palate alongside bright cherry and yeasty notes of baked bread. Crisp acidity generates freshness, while the elegant perlage gives a silky texture. It finishes bone-dry. Oliver McCrum, Volio Vino.
title: Germano Ettore 2012 Rosanna Metodo Classico Brut Rosé Nebbiolo (Vino Spumante)

description: With its fragrance of wild flowers and red berries, this wine is as attractive as its unique, square-based bottle that allows for more contact between the yeasts and wine during secondary fermentation. Made with Pinot Noir, the crisp, savory palate boasts crushed raspberries, mineral and baking spices alongside a silky mousse. Extremely elegant.
title: Ferghettina 2010 Brut Rosé Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: Aromas of blue flower, blueberry, blackberry and exotic spice almost explode from the glass. The rich palate offers black plum, prune marinated in spirits, black pepper and nutmeg alongside velvety tannins. You'll also detect the warmth of alcohol, but it's supported by the fruit richness. Drink through 2021.
title: Valentina Cubi 2006 Riserva Morar  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Displaying a ripe, multifaceted nose with violets, cumin, licorice, tar and chocolate elements, this wine shows class and grace with classic dry cherry flavors.  Possessing lovely weight and balance, it is full without being heavy, and finishes with dusty rose and even tannins.
title: Marchesi di Barolo 1996  Barolo

description: Alluring aromas of white spring flower, hay, stone fruit and almond come together in the glass. The firm, savory palate delivers creamy peach, juicy nectarine, mature apple, Mediterranean herb and mineral alongside bright acidity. Enjoy now through 2018.
title: Selva Capuzza 2011 Menasasso Riserva  (Lugana)

description: Structured and elegant, this offers aromas of strawberry, mint, forest floor and an earthy note of leather. The savory palate delivers juicy wild cherry, mineral and baking spice alongside firm, polished tannins.
title: Manincor 2012 Mason Pinot Nero (Alto Adige)

description: Herbal aromas of cut grass, bell pepper and tomato vine mingle with suggestions of ripe pineapple and stone fruit. A 50-50 blend of Chardonnay and Sauvignon, the rich palate delivers baked Golden Delicious apple, mature apricot, tangerine zest and candied lemon drop. A mineral note closes the lingering finish.
title: Vie di Romans 2012 Dut'Un White (Venezia Giulia)

description: Herbal aromas of cut grass, bell pepper and tomato vine mingle with suggestions of ripe pineapple and stone fruit. A 50-50 blend of Chardonnay and Sauvignon, the rich palate delivers baked Golden Delicious apple, mature apricot, tangerine zest and candied lemon drop. A mineral note closes the lingering finish.
title: Vie di Romans 2012 Dut'Un White (Venezia Giulia)

description: This polished, structured white opens with intense aromas of yellow peach, passion fruit, dried hay and crushed tomato vine. The linear, vibrant palate delivers juicy nectarine, creamy white peach and green melon. It's balanced, with refreshing acidity.
title: Lis Neris 2013 Picol Sauvignon (Friuli Isonzo)

description: Deep, golden yellow, this elegant but structured white offers aromas of fragrant white flower, alpine herb, mature pear and exotic fruit. The vibrant, spicy palate doles out crisp green apple, white peach, nectarine, lemon zest, white pepper and a ginger note. It's balanced and fresh, with bright acidity and a long, mineral finish.
title: Abbazia di Novacella 2012 Praepositus Veltliner (Alto Adige Valle Isarco)

description: Aromas suggest exotic fruit, yellow flower and a whiff of Mediterranean herb. The linear palate doles out yellow apple, ginger, thyme and a hint of mineral alongside bright acidity.
title: Marilena Barbera 2013 Dietro Le Case Inzolia (Menfi)

description: Aromas suggest exotic fruit, yellow flower and a whiff of Mediterranean herb. The linear palate doles out yellow apple, ginger, thyme and a hint of mineral alongside bright acidity.
title: Marilena Barbera 2013 Dietro Le Case Inzolia (Menfi)

description: This easy-drinking red delivers aromas and flavors of ripe blackberry, black cherry and a hint of clove. Round tannins provide soft support. Drink through 2016.
title: Manenti 2013  Cerasuolo di Vittoria

description: Subdued aromas of red berry, dried meat and a touch of oak lead the nose. The palate discloses raw red cherry, thyme, anise and clove alongside biting, astringent tannins that dry out the mouth. Drink after 2017.
title: Le Vigne di Eli 2012 Moganazzi Volta Sciara Rosso  (Etna)

description: Here's an earthy wine that opens with aromas of leafy underbrush, porcini mushroom, game, mature black plum and dark berry. The palate delivers juicy dark berry, toast and allspice alongside assertive, drying tannins and a hint of licorice.
title: I Custodi 2013 Pistus Rosso  (Etna)

description: Aromas of toast, coconut and oak-driven spice lead the nose and carry over to the palate along with licorice and a confectionary note. This lacks fruit richness while raspy tannins leave an astringent finish.
title: Pelissero 2012 Nubiola  (Barbaresco)

description: Mauro Sebaste is an up-and-coming winery to watch with a full range of Piedmont wines. This pretty Barbera from Alba shows big oak tones that need more time to integrate within the folds of the dark berry and sweet spice tones that are typical of this deeply beloved native grape.
title: Mauro Sebaste 2008 Santa Rosalia  (Barbera d'Alba)

description: Mauro Sebaste is an up-and-coming winery to watch with a full range of Piedmont wines. This pretty Barbera from Alba shows big oak tones that need more time to integrate within the folds of the dark berry and sweet spice tones that are typical of this deeply beloved native grape.
title: Mauro Sebaste 2008 Santa Rosalia  (Barbera d'Alba)

description: Lush concentration and deep aromas of dark fruit and black cherry make an excellent first impression. This Dolcetto shows a dark, deep color and a chewy, almost inky texture.
title: Marziano Abbona 2008 Papà Celso  (Dolcetto di Dogliani)

description: You'll find bright berry notes followed by white licorice, forest floor and a distant touch of chopped herbs in this fresh, well-integrated Barbera from Monferrato. The mouthfeel is not too concentrated and the wine is naturally acidic (try it with cheese- or butter-based pasta dishes).
title: Marco Canato 2007 La Baldea  (Barbera del Monferrato Superiore)

description: You'll find bright berry notes followed by white licorice, forest floor and a distant touch of chopped herbs in this fresh, well-integrated Barbera from Monferrato. The mouthfeel is not too concentrated and the wine is naturally acidic (try it with cheese- or butter-based pasta dishes).
title: Marco Canato 2007 La Baldea  (Barbera del Monferrato Superiore)

description: This is a very pleasant Barbera from the Monferrato zone with good concentration and bright aromas of blueberry, wild fruit, wet earth and hazelnut. There's good dimension here as well as a smooth texture that is accented by the wine's natural acidity.
title: Castello di Uviglie 2008 Le Cave  (Barbera del Monferrato Superiore)

description: This Barbera represents a return to Asti tradition thanks to its clean, simple aromas of fresh fruit, mild spice and wet earth. The wine is sharp, tangy and crisp in the mouth and would pair perfectly with cheesy or buttery dishes.
title: Cascina La Ghersa 2007 Vignassa  (Barbera d'Asti Superiore)

description: This Barbera represents a return to Asti tradition thanks to its clean, simple aromas of fresh fruit, mild spice and wet earth. The wine is sharp, tangy and crisp in the mouth and would pair perfectly with cheesy or buttery dishes.
title: Cascina La Ghersa 2007 Vignassa  (Barbera d'Asti Superiore)

description: Apparent notes of coffee and freshly ground espresso appear at first and are followed by chocolate, cherry and raspberry. This is a modern, plump Barbera that will appeal to those who like a softer, more supple style.
title: Bersano 2007 Ca d'Galdin  (Barbera d'Asti)

description: Apparent notes of coffee and freshly ground espresso appear at first and are followed by chocolate, cherry and raspberry. This is a modern, plump Barbera that will appeal to those who like a softer, more supple style.
title: Bersano 2007 Ca d'Galdin  (Barbera d'Asti)

description: Here's a heavily oak-influenced Barbera with distinctive tones of spice, tobacco, wood, bramble and forest floor. There are red fruit notes in there, mostly masked by the wood. Give this wine two or three more years of bottle aging to find harmony.
title: Bersano 2007  Barbera d'Asti Superiore Nizza

description: Coffee, tobacco and finely ground espresso come to light at the back of blackberry, cranberry and pomegranate. This is a fresh and vibrant interpretation that makes good use of the natural acidity present in Barbera d'Asti.
title: Antonia Gazzi 2007 Praiot  (Barbera d'Asti)

description: Thick oak-driven aromas of vanilla, spice and tobacco roll out in front of cassis and black cherry. This is a well-worked wine (the oak element is very strong) in which the winemakers have dulled some of the sharpness of Barbera's natural acidity.
title: Angelo Negro & Figli 2007 Bertu  (Barbera d'Alba)

description: Thick oak-driven aromas of vanilla, spice and tobacco roll out in front of cassis and black cherry. This is a well-worked wine (the oak element is very strong) in which the winemakers have dulled some of the sharpness of Barbera's natural acidity.
title: Angelo Negro & Figli 2007 Bertu  (Barbera d'Alba)

description: From the celebrated 2004 vintage, this expression of Barbera offers solid and correct aromas of ripe fruit, raspberries, wet earth and leather. The wine is bright and incredibly generous in terms of intensity and purity of the fruit flavors.
title: Agricola Sulin 2004 Ornella  (Barbera del Monferrato Superiore)

description: Easy and informal, this is exactly the style of wine you'll want to pour with family and friends at, say, an outdoor picnic or barbecue. Packaged in a screwcap bottle, the wine offers aromas of melon, citrus and pear.
title: Esperto 2009 Pinot Grigio (Delle Venezie)

description: Easy and informal, this is exactly the style of wine you'll want to pour with family and friends at, say, an outdoor picnic or barbecue. Packaged in a screwcap bottle, the wine offers aromas of melon, citrus and pear.
title: Esperto 2009 Pinot Grigio (Delle Venezie)

description: The equivalent of four bottles of wine, this well-priced boxed white blend of Garganega and Pinot Grigio opens with fragrant aromas of white flowers, stone fruit and honeysuckle. The wine is fresh, easy and crisp on the close.
designation: Garganega and Pinot Grigio 3 liter BIB
title: Duca del Frassino 2010 Garganega and Pinot Grigio 3 liter BIB White (Venezie)

description: The equivalent of four bottles of wine, this well-priced boxed white blend of Garganega and Pinot Grigio opens with fragrant aromas of white flowers, stone fruit and honeysuckle. The wine is fresh, easy and crisp on the close.
designation: Garganega and Pinot Grigio 3 liter BIB
title: Duca del Frassino 2010 Garganega and Pinot Grigio 3 liter BIB White (Venezie)

description: A luminous blend of Garganega (80%) and Pinot Grigio, this easy-drinking Italian white would pair with tuna salad or sushi. Floral fragrances are enhanced by a steady, but compact mouthfeel.
title: Antica Corte 2010 White (Delle Venezie)

description: From the tiny Faro denomination overlooking the Strait of Messina, this cult red opens with earthy aromas of tilled soil, leather, dried berry, smoke, savory herb and a hint of game. Displaying compelling earthy elegance, the palate offers black cherry, raspberry, tobacco, truffle, tobacco, soil, graphite and licorice. It's still young but impeccably balanced, with firm but fine-grained tannins and bright acidity. Hold for even more complexity. Drink 2018–2025.
title: Palari 2010  Faro

description: Made with Corvina, Corvinone, Rondinella and Molinara, this offers aromas of violet, red-skinned berry and nutmeg. The bright, straightforward palate offers red cherry, raspberry and clove alongside silky tannins and refreshing acidity. Enjoy soon.
title: Le Salette 2016  Valpolicella Classico

description: A blend of Corvina, Rondinella and Merlot, this has aromas reminiscent of black-skinned berry, wild cherry and white pepper. The supple, vibrant palate delivers black currant, clove and a touch of pomegranate alongside smooth tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Guerrieri Rizzardi 2016 Tacchetto  (Bardolino)

description: A blend of Corvina, Rondinella and Merlot, this has aromas reminiscent of black-skinned berry, wild cherry and white pepper. The supple, vibrant palate delivers black currant, clove and a touch of pomegranate alongside smooth tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Guerrieri Rizzardi 2016 Tacchetto  (Bardolino)

description: This bright, easy-drinking red offers aromas and flavors of wild cherry, crushed raspberry and freshly ground pepper. It's fresh and enjoyable, with soft tannins. Drink soon.
title: Corte Giara 2016  Valpolicella

description: This luminous Gavi offers mineral notes of graphite and talc powder backed by fruity tones of peach and citrus. The wine is smooth and silky on the close and would pair with seafood or tuna salad.
title: Michele Chiarlo 2009 Le Marne  (Gavi)

description: This luminous wine, presented in attractively clean packaging, opens with inviting aromas of citrus, peach and Golden Delicious. It's an informal, easy-drinking wine that washes down the palate in a very refreshing manner.
title: Damilano 2009 Arneis (Langhe)

description: Light in density, this fresh Roero exhibits aromas of orange zest and tangerine skin on top of pressed blue flowers and wild berries. The wine is sharp, tannic and firm on the palate.
title: Negro Angelo e Figli 2007 Prachiosso  (Roero)

description: Light in density, this fresh Roero exhibits aromas of orange zest and tangerine skin on top of pressed blue flowers and wild berries. The wine is sharp, tannic and firm on the palate.
title: Negro Angelo e Figli 2007 Prachiosso  (Roero)

description: Here's a ruby-colored sparkling dessert wine that would pair with chocolate-covered strawberries, panna cotta or apricot tart. Fruity and cheerful, aromas here include raspberry, white cherry and cranberry. Creamy foaming is capped by bright crispness to keep the mouth refreshed.
title: Giacomo Vico 2008 Birbet Brachetto (Piedmont)

description: Here's a ruby-colored sparkling dessert wine that would pair with chocolate-covered strawberries, panna cotta or apricot tart. Fruity and cheerful, aromas here include raspberry, white cherry and cranberry. Creamy foaming is capped by bright crispness to keep the mouth refreshed.
title: Giacomo Vico 2008 Birbet Brachetto (Piedmont)

description: Donna Anita is a fresh Arneis from northern Italy that boasts a pretty mineral characteristic backed by light fruit touches of citrus and peach.
title: Donna Anita 2008 Arneis (Langhe)

description: Light graphite notes of pencil shaving and slate roof come on the heels of wild berries, orange zest and powdered licorice. Shadings of ash and smoke liven the mouth but the finish is exceedingly tannic and dry.
title: Cantina del Nebbiolo 2007  Roero

description: Leafy underbrush, moist soil, asphalt and sweet plum take center stage on this dense wine. The palate delivers espresso, toasted oak, vanilla and dried black cherry alongside drying wood tannins.
title: Trabucchi d'Illasi 2006 Cent'Anni Riserva  (Amarone della Valpolicella)

description: Subdued aromas suggest leather, dried tobacco leaf, prune and fennel. The hearty palate offers stewed prune, dried black cherry, licorice and a black pepper note alongside assertive tannins.
title: Villa Canestrari 2008 A  (Amarone della Valpolicella)

description: Subdued aromas suggest leather, dried tobacco leaf, prune and fennel. The hearty palate offers stewed prune, dried black cherry, licorice and a black pepper note alongside assertive tannins.
title: Villa Canestrari 2008 A  (Amarone della Valpolicella)

description: Aromas include blackberry compote, game, overripe plum and allspice. The dense palate offers cassis, blueberry extract, black pepper and licorice alongside astringent tannins. The heat of alcohol shows on the midpalate.
title: Tabarrini 2010 Colle alle Macchie  (Montefalco Sagrantino)

description: Aromas of leafy underbrush, steeped prune and a whiff of dark kitchen spice lead the nose. The dense palate offers dried black cherry, raisin and licorice alongside tightly packed, drying tannins.
title: Cantine di Ora 2012  Amarone della Valpolicella

description: Aromas of leafy underbrush, steeped prune and a whiff of dark kitchen spice lead the nose. The dense palate offers dried black cherry, raisin and licorice alongside tightly packed, drying tannins.
title: Cantine di Ora 2012  Amarone della Valpolicella

description: Creamy and fresh, this opens with scents of white spring flower and pear. The vibrant palate offers green apple and white peach offset by a soft mousse.
title: Ballancin 2014  Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore

description: Lithe and silky, this easygoing wine opens with aromas of woodland berry and cake spice. The bright palate offers wild cherry, raspberry, white pepper and clove. It's easy drinking and well balanced, with supple tannins and fresh acidity. Drink through 2016.
title: Cembra 2012 Vigna di Saosent Pinot Nero (Trentino)

description: From vineyards ranging from 700 to 900 meters above sea level, Tasca's blend of Catarratto and Chardonnay offers fluid aromas of white flower, brimstone and stone fruit. It's an easy and refreshing wine that would pair perfectly with fried calamari.
title: Tasca d'Almerita 2008 Leone d'Almerita White (Sicilia)

description: This is a polished and intense wine with super thick concentration, a black inky appearance, and almost too much black fruit, mineral and spice. It is the Great Wall of Southern Italian wines with impenetrable density, sweet flavors and a chewy, solid-state texture.
title: Vinosia 2004  Taurasi

description: Here's a jammy, syrupy and dense expression of Primitivo with chewy layers of black cherry, leather, spice and tobacco. There's a sweet, overripe note in there as well that recalls strawberry comfiture and the wine is dense and chewy on the close.
title: L'Astore Masseria 2007 Jèma Primitivo (Salento)

description: Here's a jammy, syrupy and dense expression of Primitivo with chewy layers of black cherry, leather, spice and tobacco. There's a sweet, overripe note in there as well that recalls strawberry comfiture and the wine is dense and chewy on the close.
title: L'Astore Masseria 2007 Jèma Primitivo (Salento)

description: This plush Tuscan Merlot (from one of Montalcino's best producers of Brunello) opens with soft and round tones of cherry, milk chocolate spice and cassis. There's an elegant richness here that would help pair this wine with game hen or risotto with wild mushrooms. Drink now.
title: Tenute Silvio Nardi 2007 Merlot (Sant'Antimo)

description: Raddese is 100% Sangiovese executed in a bold, dark style. It opens with ripe fruit, black cherry and rum cake followed by dark spice and leather. Varietal crispness shows up on the close, where there's a subtle sour note as well.
title: Vignavecchia 2007 Raddese Sangiovese (Colli della Toscana Centrale)

description: Serrata di Belguardo (an 80-20 blend of Sangiovese and Alicante) opens with chewy berry tones of raspberry and blackberry backed by leather, moist earth and pressed blue flowers. It shows lip-smacking crispness that makes it perfect for pasta with cream sauce or cheese.
title: Mazzei 2009 Serrata di Belguardo  (Maremma)

description: Serrata di Belguardo (an 80-20 blend of Sangiovese and Alicante) opens with chewy berry tones of raspberry and blackberry backed by leather, moist earth and pressed blue flowers. It shows lip-smacking crispness that makes it perfect for pasta with cream sauce or cheese.
title: Mazzei 2009 Serrata di Belguardo  (Maremma)

description: This blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot from coastal Tuscany opens with some sharp or thorny aromas of bramble or forest fruit. It delivers firm, etched tannins with a dry, polished close.
title: Cipriana 2009  Bolgheri

description: Aromas of Granny Smith apple, pear and a hint of citrus lead the nose and carry over to the palate. This wine is simple, straightforward and refreshing.
title: Il Cavaliere 2013 Pinot Grigio (Friuli Grave)

description: Aromas of Granny Smith apple, pear and a hint of citrus lead the nose and carry over to the palate. This wine is simple, straightforward and refreshing.
title: Il Cavaliere 2013 Pinot Grigio (Friuli Grave)

description: Pretty aromas of Bartlett pear and a floral note lead the nose on this easy-drinking wine. The simple, refreshing palate offers lemon zest and apple alongside tangy acidity.
title: Bolla 2013 Retro  (Soave Classico)

description: Made with 100% Sangiovese, fermented and aged in terra-cotta amphora, this elegant red opens with alluring aromas of sunbaked earth, leather, blue flower and a balsamic note. Bright and polished, the palate delivers juicy red cherry, a sprinkling of baking spice and an energizing mineral vein. Lithe tannins and fresh acidity provide the framework.
title: Fattoria Montecchio 2013 Priscus Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: Aromas of chopped mint, underbrush, spiced berry, toast and a whiff of iris take shape on this savory, approachable wine. Made entirely with Sangiovese, the ripe round palate offers dried cherry, raspberry, truffle and licorice framed in supple tannins. It finishes on a savory, almost salty note. Drink through 2020.
title: Castello di Bossi 2012 Berardo Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Aromas of underbrush, scorched earth, French oak and a whiff of new leather lift out of the glass. The powerfully structured palate offers dried black cherry, toast, espresso and dark spice alongside firm fine-grained tannins. It's still a bit austere so give it a few more years to fully develop. Drink 2020–2025.
title: Pieve Santa Restituta 2011 Sugarille  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: The grapes are Carignan and Merlot. Raim translates as “grape” in the Catalan dialect spoken in some parts of Sardinia. The aromas are light cherry plus some Brettanomyces. On the palate, you experience a full-bodied, well-balanced structure with some rough tannins. The finish is long, showing cherry and earth components. An interesting wine with grilled meats.
title: Sella & Mosca 1996 Raím Red (Isola dei Nuraghi)

description: Quite tight at the present time, but there are distinct game and leather aromas and flavors. The structure is fine for a young Amarone but the short finish shows only earth tones and not much fruit. The acidity seems a bit high. Try it again in a few years.
title: Bolla 1996  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico

description: Believed to be a clone of Grenache, Cannonau is Sardinia’s workhorse grape, accounting for 20% of the island’s total production. This version is a pleasant everyday wine; the light ruby color belies the inviting cherry-and-earth flavor package and the 13.5% alcohol.
title: Sella & Mosca 1997 Riserva  (Cannonau di Sardegna)

description: Believed to be a clone of Grenache, Cannonau is Sardinia’s workhorse grape, accounting for 20% of the island’s total production. This version is a pleasant everyday wine; the light ruby color belies the inviting cherry-and-earth flavor package and the 13.5% alcohol.
title: Sella & Mosca 1997 Riserva  (Cannonau di Sardegna)

description: This perennial favorite sparkles with tangerine peel, honeysuckle, vanilla, creamery butter and honeyed notes. Very clean and zesty. It drinks as sweet as it smells. Fortunately, the acidity is high and refreshing, the wine exceptionally clean and well-made. Fans of this style will absolutely love it, and there's a lot to like.
title: Martini & Rossi NV Asti Spumante  (Moscato d'Asti)

description: This perennial favorite sparkles with tangerine peel, honeysuckle, vanilla, creamery butter and honeyed notes. Very clean and zesty. It drinks as sweet as it smells. Fortunately, the acidity is high and refreshing, the wine exceptionally clean and well-made. Fans of this style will absolutely love it, and there's a lot to like.
title: Martini & Rossi NV Asti Spumante  (Moscato d'Asti)

description: This is the type of wine they love in Emilia-Romagna. A rich berry nose begins things. In the mouth, there's wonderful texture, balance, and a persistent berry finish. Not a complex wine, but a good one--and what a great wine with a pasta dish such as tortellini alla Bolognese. Very drinkable now.
title: Dalfiume 1999 Rubicone Sangiovese (Emilia-Romagna)

description: Very fragrant green floral and apple aromas on the nose yield to a round, soft, full palate bearing light strawberry and apple flavors. It’s a bit on the sweet side for a brut, but the aromatics keep it quite interesting and pleasing.
title: Bellavista NV Cuvée Brut  (Franciacorta)

description: The new and old in the form of cherry, herbs, spices and dried fruits characterize this Amarone. A supple mouthfeel, full body and long finish are its other attributes. Yes, the tannins are rough, but the price certainly isn’t.
title: Luigi Righetti 1995 Capitel de' Roari  (Amarone della Valpolicella)

description: A slam-dunk to have with tonight’s lasagna. It’s loaded with black fruit and spices, both on the nose and on the palate. Medium-bodied and well balanced, the finish is delightfully long.
title: Terredora 1999  Aglianico d'Irpinia

description: A creamy, slightly sweet bubbly that begins with shaved chocolate, coconut, lime and pound-cake aromas, which are rather inviting. The flavors are fruity, ripe, supple and honeyed. The bubbles are a bit scouring and rough, but other than that, it's a very pretty wine.
title: Col de' Salici NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Valdobbiadene)

description: A creamy, slightly sweet bubbly that begins with shaved chocolate, coconut, lime and pound-cake aromas, which are rather inviting. The flavors are fruity, ripe, supple and honeyed. The bubbles are a bit scouring and rough, but other than that, it's a very pretty wine.
title: Col de' Salici NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Valdobbiadene)

description: A Sauvignon Blanc from Sardinia, and it’s a good one. One worries after the slightly reticent nose, but after that it’s all uphill. Well balanced, with crisp acidity and an expansive mouthfeel. Its predominantly melon finish goes on and on.
title: Sella & Mosca 1999 Le Arenarie Sauvignon Blanc (Sardinia)

description: Tanca Farra is the name of the soil; the grapes are Cabernet Sauvignon (50%) and the Sardinian workhorse, Cannonau (50%). They work well together in this wine, which opens nicely to reveal black-fruit notes. The palate experience is ripe tannins, adequate acidity and a good mouthfeel. The finish is long, with cherry and plum notes.
title: Sella & Mosca 1995 Tanca Farra Red (Sardinia)

description: A Pinot Grigio that hits the mark on all counts. The aroma and flavors are apple and pear. The palate has a silky mouthfeel and good structure, with just the right amount of acidity, and a long finish. This is what more Pinot Grigios should taste like.
title: Tolloy 1999 Pinot Grigio (Alto Adige)

description: This vintage of La Froscà Soave Classico ushers forth a bold and sophisticated style followed by thick, almost fatty tones of mature melon and peach. Pair with food that has an acidic bite to offset the wine's creamy density. Chinese chicken salad with tangerine wedges should do.
title: Gini 2008 La Froscà  (Soave Classico)

description: This aged expression of Motto Piane Soave drinks with such intensity, thickness and golden brilliance, you'd almost mistake it for a dessert wine. Aromas include candied fruit and sweet pineapple.
title: Fattori 2008 Motto Piane  (Soave)

description: Run by an exciting all-female team, Soave Classico Le Rive opens with a rich, opulent style that has obviously benefitted from careful oak aging. There are deep layers here of candied fruit, honeysuckle and dried sage.
title: Suavia 2007 Le Rive  (Soave Classico)

description: Aromas of medicinal herb carry over to the slightly sweet, rather simple palate along with ripe peach, green apple, candied orange peel and a confectionary note. Fresh acidity lifts the finish.
title: Baldi NV Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Aromas of yellow wild flower, pear and grapefruit follow over to the simple off-dry palate along with apple and a candied lemon note. Racy acidity refreshes the rich flavors.
title: Ornella Molon NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco Treviso)

description: Citrus and orchard-fruit aromas lead the way. Reflecting the nose, the simple off-dry palate offers ripe pear and nectarine drop alongside bright acidity.
title: Ruggeri & C. NV Giall'oro Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This easygoing sparkler has aromas of honeysuckle and apple that carry on to the off-dry palate along with mature yellow peach and candied lemon drop. It's simple but well made.
title: Biasotto NV  Prosecco

description: Citrus, spring blossom and apple aromas follow over to the straightforward easygoing palate along with peach and a candied note. Lively acidity provides the backdrop.
title: Avissi NV  Prosecco

description: Opening with aromas of ripe orchard fruit, this delightful, informal sparkler offers yellow apple, Bartlett pear and just a hint of beeswax. It's fun and fresh, with brisk acidity and a lively perlage.
title: Adami NV Garbèl Brut  (Prosecco Treviso)

description: This intriguing Amarone already shows complexity and depth. It has aromas of raisin, black fruit, graphite and spice, with a hint of leather. The palate delivers ripe but restrained plum and black cherry flavor, with soft white pepper and nutmeg notes, all supported by fresh acidity. Drink after 2015.
title: Viviani 2008 Casa dei Bepi  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: This dense and concentrated Amarone offers an intense bouquet of marinated cherry, blackberry and tobacco. The palate delivers rich flavors of blackberry, prune, licorice and a touch of carob, along with round tannins and soft acidity. It has layers of flavor and nice depth. Drink through 2017.
title: Accordini Igino 2007 Le Bessole  (Amarone della Valpolicella)

description: This dense and concentrated Amarone offers an intense bouquet of marinated cherry, blackberry and tobacco. The palate delivers rich flavors of blackberry, prune, licorice and a touch of carob, along with round tannins and soft acidity. It has layers of flavor and nice depth. Drink through 2017.
title: Accordini Igino 2007 Le Bessole  (Amarone della Valpolicella)

description: This delicious Amarone is loaded with ripe plum and black cherry flavors, layered with black pepper and clove. It's structured but elegant, with firm tannins and enough acidity to age well and develop complexity. Drink after 2016.
title: Tenuta Chiccheri 2008 Vigneto di Campo delle Strie  (Amarone della Valpolicella)

description: This delicious Amarone is loaded with ripe plum and black cherry flavors, layered with black pepper and clove. It's structured but elegant, with firm tannins and enough acidity to age well and develop complexity. Drink after 2016.
title: Tenuta Chiccheri 2008 Vigneto di Campo delle Strie  (Amarone della Valpolicella)

description: This delicious Amarone offers intense flavors of black cherry, raisin, white pepper, cinnamon and clove. It has a great structure, with big yet smooth tannins supported by just enough fresh acidity.
title: Pieropan 2009 Vigna Garzon  (Amarone della Valpolicella)

description: This is a delicious Amarone boasting black-cherry and plum-cake flavors layered with cinnamon, nutmeg and notes of vanilla and well-integrated oak. With its chewy tannins and freshness, this will develop complexity over the next few years. Drink after 2016.
title: Montecariano 2008  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico

description: Here's a delicious Amarone, with aromas of spirit-soaked black cherry and spice. The palate is rich but refined, with succulent black cherry, raspberry and plum flavors all layered with nutmeg and white pepper accents.
title: Monte del Frà 2009 Tenuta Lena di Mezzo  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: This Amarone has forward aromas of ripe black fruit and spice. The palate delivers rich black cherry flavors layered with chocolate, black pepper and hints of espresso. It's robust, with great depth and a velvety texture.
title: Tommasi 2007 Ca' Florian  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: This compelling Amarone has an earthy fragrance of moist earth, dark fruits, leather and meat juices. The palate delivers ripe black cherry flavor, with velvety, brooding tannins and hints of raisin dusted with white pepper and cinnamon. This already has great depth but drink after 2016 for more complexity.
title: Monteci 2008 Costa delle Corone  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: This is a gorgeous, compelling wine of power and finesse. It has a captivating fragrance of earth, leather, black fruit and incense accented with whiffs of exotic spice. The palate is rich but refined, delivering ripe black cherry, blue berry, tobacco and baking spices along with enveloping, velvety tannins. Drink 2016–2036.
title: Mastroberardino 2006 Radici Riserva  (Taurasi)

description: This is a gorgeous, compelling wine of power and finesse. It has a captivating fragrance of earth, leather, black fruit and incense accented with whiffs of exotic spice. The palate is rich but refined, delivering ripe black cherry, blue berry, tobacco and baking spices along with enveloping, velvety tannins. Drink 2016–2036.
title: Mastroberardino 2006 Radici Riserva  (Taurasi)

description: Fresh and youthful, this opens with cherry and blackberry scents. It shows firm tannins and good structure on the finish. The blend is 60% Merlot and 40% Cabernet Sauvignon.
title: Fornacelle 2011 Zizzolo  (Bolgheri)
