description: This is a thick and brawny Brunello that shows a lot more heft and personality than some of the weaker expression from the 2005 vintage. Fattoria Scopone presents a rich and textured wine with ripe notes of cherry liqueur and blackberry followed by firm, gritty tannins.
title: Fattoria Scopone 2005  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Here's a lush and modern Rosso di Montalcino with bright aromas of spice and vanilla that play background roles to fresh cherry and raspberry. The wine boasts a smooth, supple texture and sweet fruit on the finish.
title: Tenute Silvio Nardi 2008  Rosso di Montalcino

description: This Brunello opens with a bright ruby color and delivers aromas of cherry cola, Spanish cedar, cigar box, wild berries and spice. It's a streamlined wine that puts more emphasis on elegance than brawn or power. A Marc de Grazia selection; various American importers.
title: Le Potazzine 2005 Gorelli  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: This special selection Brunello shows ripe notes of strawberry and raspberry backed by spice and mature cherry. It's smooth and bright with a touch of sour fruit on the close.
title: Il Marroneto 2005 Selezione Madonna delle Grazie  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: This is a lovely wine made from the Montepulciano grape that opens with inky dark concentration and bold notes of black fruit, prune and exotic spice. In the mouth, it shows a rich, soft texture with chocolate fudge on the finish.
title: Torre Raone 2007 Terre dei Vestini San Zopito  (Montepulciano d'Abruzzo)

description: This Riserva Montepulciano may be an acquired taste to some but it definitely opens a fascinating window onto the potential of wine from Italy's Adriatic Coast. It offers big, round consistency with bold black fruit, spice and black chewing tobacco.
title: Umani Ronchi 2009 Cúmaro Riserva  (Conero)

description: This Riserva Montepulciano may be an acquired taste to some but it definitely opens a fascinating window onto the potential of wine from Italy's Adriatic Coast. It offers big, round consistency with bold black fruit, spice and black chewing tobacco.
title: Umani Ronchi 2009 Cúmaro Riserva  (Conero)

description: Made with Bordò (a biotype of Grenache) in limited case production, Kupra is a special wine that is clearly designed to showcase the potential of winemaking in the Marche, Central Italy. The wine is crisp, clean and elegant with a long assembly of aromas that span from cherry and cinnamon to crushed white stone and white pepper. The close is smooth and elegant.
title: Oasi degli Angeli 2008 Kupra Grenache (Marche)

description: Gold shows unexpected sophistication for the otherwise overtly bold and gregarious Sagrantino grape. Those prickly tannins you recognize from the variety are wrapped by layers of spice, cured meat and dried berry fruit.
title: Còlpetrone 2006 Gold  (Montefalco Sagrantino)

description: Call it a “superMarche” wine. The blend is 50% Cabernet Sauvignon with 40% Montepulciano and 10% Merlot. It offers deep intensity with floral, almost potpourri-like tones of dried rose backed by cherry, spice and touches of chocolate fudge. It's plush and velvety with medium intensity on the mid-palate.
title: Umani Ronchi 2009 Pelago Red (Marche)

description: Pinot Grigio doesn't get better than this. Fresh and fragrant, this lovely wine offers beautiful intensity and a soft, smooth consistency. Peach nectar, tangerine, lemon curd and white almond all appear in perfect doses.
title: Tramin 2011 Unterebner Pinot Grigio (Alto Adige)

description: Made entirely with Merlot, the shy nose eventually reveals notes of black-skinned fruit and clove. The dense palate delivers cedar, espresso and leather alongside gripping tannins.
title: Conte Ferdinando Guicciardini 2013 La Historia di Italia Merlot (Toscana)

description: A blend of 50% Sangiovese, 30% Cabernet Sauvignon and 20% Merlot, this has a shy nose that slowly unleashes aromas of black-skinned fruit and cedar. The smooth accessible palate offers black cherry and cinnamon alongside round tannins.
title: Castello di Poppiano 2013 Tricorno Red (Toscana)

description: In this blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot and Petit Verdot, you'll find delicate aromas of cassis and allspice together with an herbaceous note. The smooth palate delivers mature black-skinned fruit alongside rounded tannins.
title: Campo alla Sughera 2013 Arnione  (Bolgheri Superiore)

description: In this blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot and Petit Verdot, you'll find delicate aromas of cassis and allspice together with an herbaceous note. The smooth palate delivers mature black-skinned fruit alongside rounded tannins.
title: Campo alla Sughera 2013 Arnione  (Bolgheri Superiore)

description: Forest floor, dark-skinned berry, clove and sage aromas emerge in the glass. The juicy straightforward palate offers wild cherry extract, anise and a hint of pipe tobacco alongside chewy tannins. Drink 2018–2023.
title: Uggiano 2010  Brunello di Montalcino

description: A blend of 85% Sangiovese and 15% Cabernet Sauvignon, this has subdued aromas suggesting scorched earth, coffee bean and a whiff of dark spice. The round palate offers dried black cherry, espresso and a hint of cake spice framed in pliant tannins. Drink soon to capture the remaining freshness.
title: Triacca 2012 La Palaia  (Chianti Classico)

description: A blend of Cabernet, Petit Verdot, Merlot and Syrah, this has aromas of French oak, vanilla and espresso. The palate is rather austere, delivering black currant and clove alongside bracing, close-grained tannins.
title: Argiano 2014 Solengo Red (Toscana)

description: A blend of 90% Sangiovese, 5% Cabernet Sauvignon and 5% Merlot, this opens with earthy aromas of truffle, scorched earth, violet and a touch of dark spice. The palate offers dried black cherry and ground pepper alongside fine-grained tannins. It also shows the heat of the vintage, so drink soon.
title: La Castellina 2011 Squarcialupi Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: This has aromas of dark-skinned berry, blue flower, cooking spice and oak. The bright palate offers dried cherry, licorice and coffee framed in rounded tannins and firm acidity.
title: Rocca delle Macìe 2014 Tenuta Sant'Alfonso  (Chianti Classico)

description: This has aromas of dark-skinned berry, blue flower, cooking spice and oak. The bright palate offers dried cherry, licorice and coffee framed in rounded tannins and firm acidity.
title: Rocca delle Macìe 2014 Tenuta Sant'Alfonso  (Chianti Classico)

description: Raspberry jam, prune and cake spice aromas unfold on this blend of 90% Sangiovese and 10% Merlot. The accessible palate offers dried black cherry, fig, star anise and toast alongside fine-grained tannins.
title: Poggio Mandorlo 2011 La Querce  (Montecucco)

description: Scorched soil, toasted oak, dried sage and roasted coffee bean aromas lead the nose. The approachable full-bodied palate offers dried cherry, espresso and a hint of clove alongside fine-grained tannins. Drink sooner rather than later to capture the remaining fruit.
title: Mocali 2011  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Made with 60% Corvina, 20% Rondinella, 10% Corvinone and 10% Negrara, this opens with subtle aromas of black-skinned fruit and underbrush. The savory easy-drinking palate doles out black currant, clove and a hint of tobacco alongside round tannins. Enjoy through 2021.
title: Pasqua 2015  Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso

description: Aromas of cooking spice, black-skinned berry and a whiff of tobacco lead the nose. The firm palate delivers blackberry jam, clove and licorice alongside closed-grained tannins. Drink through 2020.
title: Guido Berta 2013  Barbera d'Asti Superiore Nizza

description: Fruity and fresh, this enjoyable red has aromas of red berry and dark spice. Mirroring the nose, the soft, bright palate doles out ripe red cherry and white pepper alongside smooth, supple tannins. Drink soon.
title: Gorgo 2016  Bardolino

description: This easy Sangiovese should pair with a pizza or a grilled ham and cheese sandwich. There are mild fruit flavors here, followed by sun-drenched aromas of leather and spice.
title: Spinelli 2009 Sangiovese (Terre di Chieti)

description: Made entirely with Raboso, this opens with subdued aromas of ripe plum, vanilla and a whiff of licorice that carry over to the dense one-dimensional palate. Round tannins provide the framework. It's already accessible so drink soon.
title: De Stefani 2012 Malanotte Raboso (Veneto)

description: This robust red opens with aromas suggesting forest floor, truffle, pressed violet and used leather. The hefty palate shows scorching alcohol, licorice and a hint of raisin but not much fruit richness. Clenching tannins leave an extremely astringent finish.
title: Citille di Sopra 2012 Vigna Poggio Ronconi  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: This opens with aromas of toasted oak, yellow apple skin and a confectionery note. The aromas carry over to the firm palate along with butterscotch and a mineral note but it doesn't have quite enough fruit richness to stand up to the dominant oak sensations.
title: Cantina Produttori San Michele Appiano 2014 Sanct Valentin Pinot Grigio (Alto Adige)

description: White spring flower, mature pear and yellow peach aromas lead the nose on this enjoyable white. The ripe round palate offers exotic fruit and a hint of white almond.
title: Zambon 2015  Soave

description: Alluring aromas of white spring flower, orchard fruit and a hint of aromatic herb lead the nose. The fresh palate offers ripe pear and citrus zest while an uplifting hint of thyme signals the close.
title: Tenuta Santa Maria 2015 Lepia  (Soave)

description: Alluring aromas of white spring flower, orchard fruit and a hint of aromatic herb lead the nose. The fresh palate offers ripe pear and citrus zest while an uplifting hint of thyme signals the close.
title: Tenuta Santa Maria 2015 Lepia  (Soave)

description: Acacia, beeswax and orchard fruit aromas lead the way on this. The aromas carry over to the ripe round palate along with suggestions of apple and pear.
title: Sandro de Bruno 2015 Terre di Terrossa  (Soave)

description: A stellar performer year after year, Uccelliera's confident delivery is characterized by intensity, purity and personality. This Montalcino favorite also delivers plush softness with thick texture and a focused point of bright acidity.
title: Uccelliera 2006  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Here's a modern, plush and extracted expression of Sangiovese Grosso that has been enhanced by elegant oak aging. Still young, it exhibits notes of vanilla, toasted coconut, smoke and resin along with a solid base of cassis and dried berry fruit. The texture here is polished and smooth with zesty spice on the close.
title: Poggio Antico 2006 Altero  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Here's a modern, plush and extracted expression of Sangiovese Grosso that has been enhanced by elegant oak aging. Still young, it exhibits notes of vanilla, toasted coconut, smoke and resin along with a solid base of cassis and dried berry fruit. The texture here is polished and smooth with zesty spice on the close.
title: Poggio Antico 2006 Altero  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: La Serena offers an amazing wine with rich smoothness and loads of chocolate and cherry intensity. In the mouth, the wine tastes round and soft with bright almond and cinnamon notes on the close. Pair it with saltimbocca, or veal steaks wrapped in ham and sage leaf.
title: La Serena 2006  Brunello di Montalcino

description: La Rasina offers a beautifully dark and austere expression of Brunello with almost exaggerated intensity. The wine is dense, extracted and velvety with smooth cherry and vanilla backed by a firm tannic backbone. Drink after 2015.
title: La Rasina 2006  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Earthy overtones of wild mushroom and moist soil add pretty dimension to this classy Brunello. At the core of I Poggiarelli, however, are black fruit, sweet spice, toasted nut and long-lasting black cherry flavors.
title: La Mannella 2006 I Poggiarelli  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: La Gerla offers a spectacular Brunello that hits all the right marks in terms of intensity, beauty and staying power. This is an opulent and rich wine with plump blueberry flavors followed by chocolate fudge and sweet exotic spice. You can either cellar it or enjoy it within the next few years.
title: La Gerla 2006  Brunello di Montalcino

description: San Polo has shown very impressive work lately and this velvety rich Brunello pushes its ambitions even further. The bouquet offers a long succession of beautiful aromas including black cherry, vanilla, carob, cola, cinnamon spice and black licorice. There's also a drying mineral note that adds a dusty touch of elegance and sophistication.
title: San Polo 2006  Brunello di Montalcino

description: The celebrated Poggio alle Mura Brunello delivers hearty masculine richness and deep layers of sassy spice that are offset by plush blackberry and cherry nuances. The wine shows solid structure that will soften with careful cellar aging.
title: Castello Banfi 2006 Poggio alle Mura  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: This beautiful Riserva Brunello opens with dark richness and loads of mature berry flavors such as blackberry, maraschino cherry and cassis syrup. A cheerful spice element comes through on the mouth thanks to overtones of crushed clove and black pepper.
title: Castelgiocondo 2005 Ripe al Convento Riserva  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Toasted hazelnut, golden apple and citrus scents lift out of the glass. The linear, elegant palate delivers ripe pear, lemon zest, bread crust and mineral alongside a refined perlage. It finishes crisp and dry.
title: Fratelli Berlucchi 2009 Casa delle Colonne Zero Riserva Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: This opens with earthy, almost funky aromas that recall new leather, tilled soil, truffle and a whiff of game. The palate is still youthfully austere, offering dried black cherry, baking spice and chopped herb alongside fine-grained tannins. Drink 2020–2028.
title: Grimaldi Bruna 2010 Badarina Riserva  (Barolo)

description: Enticing scents of ripe orchard fruit, aromatic herb and fragrant white spring flower take center stage on this elegant sparkler. The generous palate doles out juicy white peach, ripe Granny Smith apple and tangerine zest. Fresh acidity brightens the creamy flavors while an elegant mousse imparts finesse.
designation: Vigneto della Riva di San Floriano Brut
title: Nino Franco 2015 Vigneto della Riva di San Floriano Brut  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Polished and balanced, this elegant red opens with scents of rose, red berry, tilled earth and truffle. The firmly structured palate delivers juicy raspberry, crunchy red cherry, licorice and a hint of nutmeg alongside bright acidity and taut, refined tannins. Drink 2018–2030.
title: Nervi 2010  Gattinara

description: Polished and balanced, this elegant red opens with scents of rose, red berry, tilled earth and truffle. The firmly structured palate delivers juicy raspberry, crunchy red cherry, licorice and a hint of nutmeg alongside bright acidity and taut, refined tannins. Drink 2018–2030.
title: Nervi 2010  Gattinara

description: Scents of small woodland berry, orchard fruit and Alpine herb waft out of the glass. On the creamy palate, notes of baking spice and energizing mineral accent fresh strawberry, crushed raspberry and tangerine zest. It's fresh and balanced, with lively acidity and an elegant perlage.
title: Moser 2012 Rosé Extra Brut Pinot Nero (Trento)

description: Elegant and fresh, this opens with enticing scents of orchard fruit, citrus and a yeasty whiff of bread crust. The vibrant, linear palate delivers pear, apple, hazelnut and nectarine zest alongside lively acidity and an elegant perlage.
title: Rizzi 2010 Pas Dosé Metodo Classico Sparkling (Vino Spumante)

description: Made entirely from late harvested Petit Manseng, this sweet, round dessert wine opens with ripe apricot and baked pear aromas. The straightforward palate delivers lemon honey, mature melon and vanilla flavors. Enjoy it soon.
title: Caiarossa 2011 Oro di Caiarossa Petit Manseng (Toscana)

description: This opens with funky aromas of barnyard, overripe black fruit, resin and varnish. The palate is on the rustic side, showing steeped prune, nutmeg, clove and vanilla alongside evolved, raspy tannins that leave a mouth-drying finish.
title: La Contea 2012 Serragrilli  (Barbaresco)

description: This opens with aromas of toast, oak and cherry. The tense palate offers raw red berry, roasted coffee bean, oak-driven spice and powdered sage, yet lacks fruit richness. Abrasive tannins give it a bracing finish.
title: Giacosa Fratelli 2012 Basarin Vigna Gianmatè  (Barbaresco)

description: Made with dried Grillo grapes, this opens with subdued aromas of citrus peel and a whiff of yellow peach. The palate is more expressive, offering dried apricot, fig and a hint of candied lemon zest.
title: Feudo Disisa 2008 Krysos Grillo (Sicilia)

description: Yellow apple and yellow pear aromas follow through to the round, juicy palate, along with citrus and Alpine herb notes. Fresh acidity lifts the rich flavors while a flinty mineral note backs up the lingering finish.
title: Abbazia di Novacella 2015 Sylvaner (Alto Adige Valle Isarco)

description: Structured and alluring, this opens with yellow stone fruit, tomato vine and chopped herb aromas. The enveloping palate doles out juicy yellow peach, grapefruit and savory thyme notes while tangy acidity lends balance.
title: Russiz Superiore 2012 Riserva Sauvignon (Collio)

description: A blend of Nero d'Avola and Nerello Cappuccio, this delivers a tangy, spicy feel, plus polished aromas of blackberry, almond and cured meat. Pair this easygoing selection with pepperoni pizza.
title: Viticultori Associati Canicatti 2010 Calìo Red (Sicilia)

description: A fine wine to enjoy while watching a football game or a good movie, this Merlot washes down easily, offering bright cherry, plum and mild spice flavors.
title: Feudo Arancio 2011 Merlot (Sicilia)

description: This blend of Grecanico and Viognier offers a generous bouquet with exotic fruit, pineapple, white flower and dusty talc powder. The wine also shows creamy thickness in the mouth.
title: Settesoli 2011 Seligo White (Sicilia)

description: From one of Sicily's most powerful wine co-ops, this blend of Syrah and Nero d'Avola offers pretty fruit intensity, with layers of red cherry and blackberry. Subtle tones of spice, leather and bitter almond fill in the back.
title: Settesoli 2011 Seligo Red (Sicilia)

description: In its iconic amphora-shaped bottle, this opens with pretty aromas of white and yellow roses. The palate offers up a forward lemon flavor, with a hint of almond and refreshing acidity. Perfect to wash down shellfish.
region: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico
title: Fazi Battaglia 2012 Titulus  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico)

description: Made from 100% Montepulciano, this opens with unusual aromas of tire rubber. Dense black fruit flavors are accented with hints of white pepper alongside astringent tannins. Already approachable, the palate is straightforward and one dimensional. Drink soon.
title: Fattoria Le Terrazze 2011  Rosso Conero

description: Made from 100% Montepulciano, this opens with aromas of rubber, coffee and espresso. The palate offers black fruit sensations, alongside slightly bitter tannins. This is simply structured and already accessible, so drink soon.
title: Piantate Lunghe 2011  Rosso Conero

description: Made from 100% Montepulciano, this opens with aromas of rubber, coffee and espresso. The palate offers black fruit sensations, alongside slightly bitter tannins. This is simply structured and already accessible, so drink soon.
title: Piantate Lunghe 2011  Rosso Conero

description: This perky wine offers tropical fruit, citrus and apple sensations alongside the grape's hallmark of bright acidity. It closes on a delicate note of steely mineral. Simple, but well constructed.
title: Santa Barbara 2012 Passerina (Marche)

description: Here's a direct Chianti Classico with attractive plum and vanilla aromas. The palate shows ripe—nearly overripe—black cherry and raspberry flavors that finish rather abruptly on the dry, tannic finish.
title: Castello Il Palagio 2010  Chianti Classico

description: This straightforward selection offers plum and cherry sensations with hints of espresso and chocolate. The simple style will work well with pasta dishes and cheeses.
title: Melini 2010 Terrarossa  (Chianti Classico)

description: This has iris and cherry aromas layered with evident oak and burnt rubber sensations. The palate opens much better thanks ripe berry, spice and licorice flavors along with oak, coffee bean and espresso notes.
title: Il Colombaio di Cencio 2010 I Massi  (Chianti Classico)

description: This soft, plummy expression of Chianti Classico shows ripe black fruit and roasted coffee bean aromas that carry over to the palate. Thanks to its tame acidity and round tannins, this is perfect to drink young.
title: Villa Calcinaia 2010 Piegaia  (Chianti Classico)

description: This soft, plummy expression of Chianti Classico shows ripe black fruit and roasted coffee bean aromas that carry over to the palate. Thanks to its tame acidity and round tannins, this is perfect to drink young.
title: Villa Calcinaia 2010 Piegaia  (Chianti Classico)

description: This young Chianti Classico is still a bit closed, but it reveals cherry and raspberry sensations along with black- and white-pepper notes. It's still tightly knit but it should should open up well after one or two more years bottle aging.
title: Tenuta di Lilliano 2011  Chianti Classico

description: Aged partly in concrete vats and partly in oak, this shows concentrated sensations of ripe plum, sour cherry and raspberry layered with espresso notes. Pair this with grilled vegetables or spicy cheeses.
title: Principe Corsini Fattoria Le Corti 2010  Chianti Classico

description: This rosso has a pretty bouquet of fruit and floral aromas, with an underpinning of spice. The palate is soft, with ripe plum, cinnamon and chocolate flavors, and while well made, it doesn't have a lot of personality. This is ripe and ready, so enjoy soon.
title: Poliziano 2011  Rosso di Montepulciano

description: This rosso has a pretty bouquet of fruit and floral aromas, with an underpinning of spice. The palate is soft, with ripe plum, cinnamon and chocolate flavors, and while well made, it doesn't have a lot of personality. This is ripe and ready, so enjoy soon.
title: Poliziano 2011  Rosso di Montepulciano

description: Made with 60% Friulano, 30% Sauvignon and 10% Malvasia, this opens with aromas of ripe Golden Delicious apple, vanilla and hay. The straightforward palate offers pink grapefruit and toasted almond alongside fresh acidity.
title: Tenuta di Angoris 2014 Giulio Locatelli Riserva White (Collio)

description: Honeysuckle, honeydew melon and white-peach aromas follow through to the somewhat sweet palate along with a note of glazed orange zest. Fresh acidity lifts the rich candied flavors.
title: Sorelle Bronca NV Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This straightforward white opens with aromas of chamomile flower and mature orchard fruit that carry over to the ripe simple palate along with yellow apple. A hint of dried herb marks the close.
title: Monte del Frà 2015  Soave Classico

description: Delicate scents of spring flower and white peach follow through to the soft foaming palate along with green apple and a hint of candied nectarine drop. Bright acidity gives it a fresh finish.
title: Val d'Oca 2016 Millesimato Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: Aromas of fragrant spring flower and a whiff of pear emerge on this lively sparkler. The invigorating palate shows Rennet apple and citrus alongside crisp acidity and bracing bubbles.
title: Soligo NV Col de Mez Brut  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Floral notes of honeysuckle and acacia lead the nose. On the racy palate, brisk acidity and vigorous bubbles offset ripe white peach, candied citrus and green apple.
title: Drusian NV Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Floral notes of honeysuckle and acacia lead the nose. On the racy palate, brisk acidity and vigorous bubbles offset ripe white peach, candied citrus and green apple.
title: Drusian NV Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Honeysuckle, almond and orchard-fruit aromas take center stage. On the off-dry palate, fresh acidity brightens green apple, white peach and a citrusy note backed by a soft perlage.
title: De Stefani 2016 Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: Honeysuckle, almond and orchard-fruit aromas take center stage. On the off-dry palate, fresh acidity brightens green apple, white peach and a citrusy note backed by a soft perlage.
title: De Stefani 2016 Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: Soft and slightly sweet, this straightforward sparkler offers green apple, white peach and candied-citrus-peel flavors. It's bright, with tangy acidity.
title: Canevel 2016 Dry  (Valdobbiadene Superiore di Cartizze)

description: Made entirely from Nerello Mascalese, this vibrant wine opens with blue flower, red-skinned berry and thyme aromas. The fresh, juicy palate delivers red cherry, strawberry, cinnamon and licorice flavors framed by fine-grained tannins. Enjoy through 2023.
title: Tascante 2014 Ghiaia Nera Nerello Mascalese (Sicilia)

description: This opens with aromas of red berry, espresso and a whiff of sawdust. On the palate, raw red cherry is backed up by licorice, toast and roasted coffee bean but it lacks the fruit richness needed to stand up to the oak and the youthfully raspy tannins which leave an astringent finish.
title: Bruno Rocca 2012 Coparossa  (Barbaresco)

description: Aromas of dried Mediterranean brush, chopped mint, vanilla, mocha and ripe plum lead the nose. The meaty palate doles out prune, ripe black cherry, fig, cinnamon and nutmeg alongside the heat of alcohol and solid, chewy tannins.
title: Giuseppe Sedilesu 2010 Ballu Tondu Riserva  (Cannonau di Sardegna)

description: Earthy aromas of tilled soil, underbrush, wild berry and a floral note lead the nose. The straightforward palate offers bright red cherry, blackberry, black pepper and grilled herb alongside polished tannins.
title: Giuseppe Gabbas 2013 Lillovè  (Cannonau di Sardegna)

description: Earthy aromas of tilled soil, underbrush, wild berry and a floral note lead the nose. The straightforward palate offers bright red cherry, blackberry, black pepper and grilled herb alongside polished tannins.
title: Giuseppe Gabbas 2013 Lillovè  (Cannonau di Sardegna)

description: Here's a smooth, savory Nebbiolo that's loaded with red berry and dried black-cherry flavors. Polished tannins and modest acidity make it already accessible, while a vein of mineral adds a kick of energy to the finish.
title: Vallana 2011 Spanna Nebbiolo (Colline Novaresi)

description: Made with botrytized Grillo grapes, this dessert wine opens with aromas that recall dried peach and citrus zest. The rich, sweet palate offers lemon honey, candied tangerine slices and toasted almond.
title: Tenuta Gorghi Tondi 2011 Grillo d'Oro Passito Grillo (Sicilia)

description: Made with botrytized Grillo grapes, this dessert wine opens with aromas that recall dried peach and citrus zest. The rich, sweet palate offers lemon honey, candied tangerine slices and toasted almond.
title: Tenuta Gorghi Tondi 2011 Grillo d'Oro Passito Grillo (Sicilia)

description: This opens with aromas of red berry, rose petal, roasted coffee bean and brown cooking spice. On the palate, notes of anise, sage and white pepper accent raw red cherry alongside bracing tannins. Drink 2018–2024.
title: Rattalino 2012 Quarantadue42  (Barbaresco)

description: This easy-drinking Chianti opens with subtle red-skinned fruit and leather aromas. The tannins are rather evolved for such a young, simple wine, so drink soon to capture the red cherry and raspberry fruit.
title: Giulio Straccali 2015  Chianti

description: Subdued violet, plum and brown spice scents lead this 70% Sangiovese, 20% Ciliegiolo and 10% Canaiolo Chianti. Those aromas carry over to the palate, which is simple and mildly tanninic. Drink soon.
title: Burchino 2014 L'Antico  (Chianti)

description: Made entirely from Sangiovese, this opens with delicate red-skinned berry and Mediterranean herb aromas. The simple palate delivers red cherry and underbrush notes, with a mildly tanninic texture. Drink soon.
title: Palagetto 2014  Chianti Colli Senesi

description: This 90% Sangiovese, 10% Merlot and 10% Canaiolo Chianti opens with subtle blackberry and moist earth aromas. Morello cherry fruit dominates the palate, accented by baking spice notes and round tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Poggio Salvi 2014  Chianti Colli Senesi

description: This opens with blue flower, herb and dark-skinned berry aromas. The palate is lean, offering sour cherry fruit and a hint of star anise, set against tightly wound, austere tannins that leave a drying finish.
title: Vecchia Cantina di Montepulciano 2013  Vino Nobile di Montepulciano

description: Lean and evolved, this offers raisin, espresso, orange zest and grilled sage notes. Bracing tannins leave an abrasive finish.
title: Vecchia Cantina di Montepulciano 2011 Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Lean and evolved, this offers raisin, espresso, orange zest and grilled sage notes. Bracing tannins leave an abrasive finish.
title: Vecchia Cantina di Montepulciano 2011 Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Black plum and cut grass aromas lead the nose of this simple, easy-drinking red. The palate offers red cherry fruit, a touch of nutmeg and relaxed tannins.
title: Scaranto 2015  Chianti Colli Senesi

description: Oak, vanilla, underbrush and spiced plum scents float out of the glass. The palate is lean and linear, offering sour cherry and star anise flavors, pulled taut by firm acidity and refined tannins.
title: Villa S. Anna 2013  Rosso di Montepulciano

description: Made of 90% Sangiovese and 10% Canaiolo, this offers black tea and mature plum aromas, while the palate evokes dried cherry, clove and star anise flavors. Firm, close-grained tannins generate an austere finish. Give it another few years to soften, then enjoy.
title: Vecchia Cantina di Montepulciano 2011 Redi Briareo Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Made of 90% Sangiovese and 10% Canaiolo, this offers black tea and mature plum aromas, while the palate evokes dried cherry, clove and star anise flavors. Firm, close-grained tannins generate an austere finish. Give it another few years to soften, then enjoy.
title: Vecchia Cantina di Montepulciano 2011 Redi Briareo Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: This red combines Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon to create black currant and Mediterranean herb aromas. The easygoing, approachable palate shows black cherry and dark spice flavors, framed by polished tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Tringali Casanuova 2014 Casa al Piano  (Bolgheri)

description: Dark-skinned berry, French oak, aromatic herb and a whiff of dark spice come together on the nose of this firm red. On the palate, roasted coffee bean and star anise notes accent wild cherry fruit, while close-grained tannins provide the framework.
title: Lunadoro 2012 Quercione Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Dark-skinned berry, French oak, aromatic herb and a whiff of dark spice come together on the nose of this firm red. On the palate, roasted coffee bean and star anise notes accent wild cherry fruit, while close-grained tannins provide the framework.
title: Lunadoro 2012 Quercione Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: This opens with toast, ground pepper, grilled herb and sawdust aromas. The palate is firm with grippy tannins but expressive, evoking sour cherry, roasted coffee bean, oak and star anise.
title: La Calonica 2012 San Venerio Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: This opens with toast, ground pepper, grilled herb and sawdust aromas. The palate is firm with grippy tannins but expressive, evoking sour cherry, roasted coffee bean, oak and star anise.
title: La Calonica 2012 San Venerio Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: This blend of 80% Sangiovese, 12% Ciliegiolo, 6% Canaiolo and 2% Colorino displays spice-laced blackberry and leather aromas. On the palate, firm, grainy tannins frame mature plum, espresso, tobacco and clove flavors. Drink through 2019.
title: Quercia al Poggio 2012  Chianti Classico

description: This straightforward, robust red displays subtle black-skinned fruit, leather and forest floor aromas. The rounded, already approachable palate delivers red plum, baking spice and tobacco flavors held firm with tannins.
title: Poggio dell'Aquila 2012  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Subtle plum, blue flower and toast aromas come together in this red. The tightly wound, firmly tannic palate offers fleshy black cherry, star anise and clove flavors.
title: Poggio alla Sala 2015  Rosso di Montepulciano

description: Subtle plum, blue flower and toast aromas come together in this red. The tightly wound, firmly tannic palate offers fleshy black cherry, star anise and clove flavors.
title: Poggio alla Sala 2015  Rosso di Montepulciano

description: This blend of 70% Sangiovese with Canaiolo, Colorino, Ciliegiolo and Malvasia shows fruity berry and violet aromas. On the palate, juicy black plum fruit is laced with baking spice and structured by smooth tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Pietro Beconcini 2015 Antiche Vie  (Chianti)

description: Made of 70% Sangiovese, 20% Cabernet Sauvignon and 10% Merlot, this opens with black currant, leather and underbrush aromas. Black cherry, clove and white pepper flavors come forward on the palate, with a polished edge to the tannins. Enjoy through 2018.
title: Piaggia 2014 Il Sasso  (Carmignano)

description: Made predominantly of Sangiovese grapes, this easygoing wine offers inviting violet and red berry aromas. The straightforward palate delivers raspberry and spiced cranberry notes, with a polished tannic structure. Drink soon.
title: Michele Satta 2014 Diambra Red (Toscana)

description: Made predominantly of Sangiovese grapes, this easygoing wine offers inviting violet and red berry aromas. The straightforward palate delivers raspberry and spiced cranberry notes, with a polished tannic structure. Drink soon.
title: Michele Satta 2014 Diambra Red (Toscana)

description: Made predominantly from Chardonnay and Pinot Bianco, this opens with delicate white flower and orchard fruit aromas. The bright palate offers yellow apple, lemon and rosemary flavors, set against fresh acidity.
title: Marchesi de' Frescobaldi 2015 Bianco White (Pomino)

description: Made predominantly from Chardonnay and Pinot Bianco, this opens with delicate white flower and orchard fruit aromas. The bright palate offers yellow apple, lemon and rosemary flavors, set against fresh acidity.
title: Marchesi de' Frescobaldi 2015 Bianco White (Pomino)

description: Underbrush, red berry and clove aromas carry over to the linear palate, which is steeped in espresso flavor. While it's already accessible, fine-grained tannins give it a firm structure. Drink through 2020.
title: Il Poggione 2015  Rosso di Montalcino

description: This luminous, ruby-colored Rosso delivers aromas of cherry, ripe berry fruit and sweet vanilla. There's a soft, modern touch here that has been shaped by oak aging and you'll taste background flavors of smoke and spice.
title: Villa I Cipressi 2007  Rosso di Montalcino

description: Cecchi, the historic estate in Chianti Classico, is doing beautiful work at their second property in Maremma, southern Tuscany. Litorale Vermentino really does conjure up images of sea, sand and heaping servings of seafood. The wine is light, fresh and very tasty.
title: Cecchi 2008 Litorale Vermentino (Maremma)

description: Made entirely from Cabernet Sauvignon, this has aromas of black-skinned berry, leather and cedar. The dense palate delivers black currant, espresso and clove alongside bracing tannins that leave a somewhat astringent finish.
title: Castellare 2012 Coniale Cabernet Sauvignon (Toscana)

description: Made entirely from Cabernet Sauvignon, this has aromas of black-skinned berry, leather and cedar. The dense palate delivers black currant, espresso and clove alongside bracing tannins that leave a somewhat astringent finish.
title: Castellare 2012 Coniale Cabernet Sauvignon (Toscana)

description: This opens with aromas of rose petal, lychee and pear. The intense slightly sweet palate delivers apricot jam, yellow peach and mango. It has nice length and finishes on an energizing mineral note.
title: Cantina Produttori San Michele Appiano 2015 Sanct Valentin Gewürztraminer (Alto Adige)

description: This is a little less fragrant than usual but still offers aromas of tropical fruit, cut grass and white spring flower. The palate is more exuberant than the nose, doling out juicy pineapple, white grapefruit and sage alongside fresh acidity.
title: Cantina Produttori San Michele Appiano 2015 Lahn Sauvignon (Alto Adige)

description: Made with 85% Merlot and 15% Cabernet Sauvignon, this opens with aromas of black currant, anise and leather. The firm palate delivers blackberry jam, cedar and toast alongside assertive tannins while a hint of vanilla marks the firm finish. Enjoy through 2020.
title: Uggiano 2010 Petraia Red (Toscana)

description: Made entirely with Pinot Nero, this opens with aromas of raspberry, Alpine herb and a balsamic note. The juicy palate doles out ripe strawberry, mineral and a hint of baking spice alongside supple tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Andriano 2015 Pinot Nero (Alto Adige)

description: Made entirely with Pinot Nero, this opens with aromas of raspberry, Alpine herb and a balsamic note. The juicy palate doles out ripe strawberry, mineral and a hint of baking spice alongside supple tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Andriano 2015 Pinot Nero (Alto Adige)

description: This 100% Lagrein opens with aromas of black-skinned berries, baking spices and licorice. The medium-bodied concentrated palate delivers black plums, mocha and clove alongside firm tannins and fresh acidity. Drink through 2019.
title: Tiefenbrunner 2014 Linticlarus Riserva Lagrein (Alto Adige)

description: Made entirely with Nosiola, this opens with aromas of dried apricot, crème caramel and a whiff of orange jam. The rounded palate delivers orange blossom honey, fig and a hint of toasted almond.
title: Pisoni 2002 Vino Santo Nosiola (Trentino)

description: A blend of 87% Sangiovese, 10% Foglia Tonda and Merlot, this delicious red offers aromas of blue flower, wild berry, new leather and forest floor. The round enveloping palate doles out raspberry jam, fleshy black cherry, chopped herb and star anise alongside velvety tannins. It closes on a zesty, orange-peel note. Drink through 2019.
title: Roberto Mascelloni 2013 Arcere Red (Orcia)

description: Purchased by the Gaja family in 1967, the Costa Russi vineyard produces elegant expressions of Nebbiolo with beautifully saturated, sun-drenched flavors. Indeed, this vintage shows wild berry with beautiful background renderings of smoke and graphite. Five percent Barbera is added and the wine shows amazing harmony and sophistication with bright acidity and firm tannins. It will only become more beautiful in time.
title: Gaja 2006 Costa Russi Nebbiolo (Langhe)

description: Conteisa is a Barolo-inspired wine from Angelo Gaja (with 8% Barbera) that opens with very attractive and approachable aromas of red fruit, tobacco, leather, moist earth and black licorice. There's a youthful element to the personality (that hints at a long aging future ahead) backed by silky, but firm tannins and beautifully crisp acidity. The wine will be at its best after 2018.
title: Gaja 2006 Conteisa Nebbiolo (Langhe)

description: Conteisa is a Barolo-inspired wine from Angelo Gaja (with 8% Barbera) that opens with very attractive and approachable aromas of red fruit, tobacco, leather, moist earth and black licorice. There's a youthful element to the personality (that hints at a long aging future ahead) backed by silky, but firm tannins and beautifully crisp acidity. The wine will be at its best after 2018.
title: Gaja 2006 Conteisa Nebbiolo (Langhe)

description: A bright, lively wine made from Sangiovese, it has classic varietal aromas of blue flower, red berries, spice and just a whiff of leather. The palate delivers ripe red cherry accented with hints of white pepper, clove and cinnamon alongside firm but fine tannins and fresh acidity.
title: Il Molino di Grace 2010  Chianti Classico

description: This wine begins with aromas that recall red peppers, black berries and spice with a whiff of grilled sage. The palate offers ripe black cherry and plum accented with white pepper and cinnamon-spice and thyme. It still has youthful, aggressive tannins that need a few more years to soften. Drink 2016–2021.
title: Carpineto 2009 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Made entirely from Sangiovese, this leads with aromas of blue flower, bright red berries and plum accented with a balsamic note. The palate delivers black cherry, plum, mocha and white pepper alongside bracing tannins. Drink 2015–2019.
title: Borgo Scopeto 2009 Vigna Misciano Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Made entirely from Sangiovese, this starts with aromas of underbrush, iris, red berries, mint and toasted notes. The wine then discloses a core of black cherry accented with menthol, white pepper, cinnamon-spice and hints of espresso. This is already approachable so enjoy soon.
title: Melini 2008 La Selvanella Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Here's a polished wine made from a blend of 90% Sangiovese and 10% Cabernet Sauvignon. It offers aromas of red berry, blue flower and cedar with a hint of toasted oak. The concentrated flavors include black cherry, exotic spice and a hint of chocolate. Soft with smoothed tannins, this is already approachable.
title: Marchesi Antinori 2009 Marchese Antinori Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: For sun-drenched Bolgheri this wine demonstrates excellent elegance and finesse with aromas of red cherry, exotic spice, nutmeg and milk chocolate. It has a vibrant and vertical delivery thanks to the wine's natural acidity and its wild berry flavors. The blend is Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot and Sangiovese.
title: Grattamacco 2007  Bolgheri

description: For sun-drenched Bolgheri this wine demonstrates excellent elegance and finesse with aromas of red cherry, exotic spice, nutmeg and milk chocolate. It has a vibrant and vertical delivery thanks to the wine's natural acidity and its wild berry flavors. The blend is Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot and Sangiovese.
title: Grattamacco 2007  Bolgheri

description: Earthy aromas of game, scorched soil and underbrush lead the way. The ripe palate offers black cherry, white pepper, anise, truffle and a hint of vanilla alongside grilled herb while bracing tannins give it a tight, firm finish.
title: Socré 2012  Barbaresco

description: Bright and savory, this opens with an alluring fragrance of white flower, exotic fruit, ripe peach, Mediterranean scrub and a whiff of sea breeze. The creamy palate doles out ripe apricot, green apple, mineral and a slightly salty finish alongside refreshing acidity.
title: Sella & Mosca 2014 La Cala  (Vermentino di Sardegna)

description: This opens with aromas of steeped prune, chopped herb and a whiff of baking spice. The palate offers crunchy red cherry, mint, sage and ground aniseed alongside rugged tannins that leave a mouth-puckering finish.
title: Punset 2010 S. Cristoforo Campo Quadro Riserva  (Barbaresco)

description: This is initially quite closed but it eventually opens up in the glass to reveal wild berry, cooking spice and a whiff of cellar floor. The palate offers unripe sour cherry, white pepper, cinnamon and grilled herb alongside youthfully assertive tannins. Drink 2017–2022.
title: Prinsi 2012 Gaia Principe  (Barbaresco)

description: This is initially quite closed but it eventually opens up in the glass to reveal wild berry, cooking spice and a whiff of cellar floor. The palate offers unripe sour cherry, white pepper, cinnamon and grilled herb alongside youthfully assertive tannins. Drink 2017–2022.
title: Prinsi 2012 Gaia Principe  (Barbaresco)

description: Aromas of ripe berry, toast, chopped herb and coffee lead the way. On the palate, assertive, fine-grained tannins support raw red cherry, fresh raspberry, vanilla and aniseed.
title: Cascina Morassino 2012 Morassino  (Barbaresco)

description: Aromas of ripe berry, toast, chopped herb and coffee lead the way. On the palate, assertive, fine-grained tannins support raw red cherry, fresh raspberry, vanilla and aniseed.
title: Cascina Morassino 2012 Morassino  (Barbaresco)

description: This opens with aromas of prune, perfumed berry, baking spice, leather, a whiff of coconut and a balsamic note. The fresh palate offers wild cherry, crushed raspberry, lightly toasted oak, anise and espresso. It's still tightly tannic and astringent, but it should improve with a few more years in the bottle. Drink 2018–2028.
title: Cascina Luisin 2012 Rabajà  (Barbaresco)

description: Dark berry, sawdust, oak-driven spice and tobacco aromas emerge in the glass. It's still tense, with tightly packed tannins and fresh acidity that backup flavors of oak, toast, espresso, licorice and cherry steeped in spirits. It's shy on fruit richness, making the alcohol noticeable.
title: Ca'Romè 2012 Rio Sordo  (Barbaresco)

description: This juicy blend of Sangiovese, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah opens with aromas of violet and red currant. Accents of ground white pepper and clove wrap around a core of black cherry while supple tannins give it a soft, easy-drinking texture.
title: Tortarossa 2011 Red (Toscana)

description: This juicy blend of Sangiovese, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah opens with aromas of violet and red currant. Accents of ground white pepper and clove wrap around a core of black cherry while supple tannins give it a soft, easy-drinking texture.
title: Tortarossa 2011 Red (Toscana)

description: Aromas of roasted coffee bean, mature, black-skinned fruit and scorched earth lead the nose. The one-dimensional palate offers ripe black cherry, plum, espresso, vanilla and a confectionary note alongside round tannins.
title: Vignaioli del Morellino di Scansano 2010 Sicomoro Riserva  (Morellino di Scansano)

description: Aromas of dark berry, scorched earth and leather take shape in the glass. The forward palate offers ripe sour cherry and grilled herb alongside round but not very persistent tannins. Drink through 2016.
title: Vecchia Cantina di Montepulciano 2011  Vino Nobile di Montepulciano

description: Aromas of tropical fruit and pressed white flower take center on this medium-bodied white. On the palate, bright acidity balances out dried yellow fruit, citrus zest and toasted oak. Enjoy now to capture the remaining fruit.
title: Talamonti 2011 Aternum  (Trebbiano d'Abruzzo)

description: This straightforward red conveys aromas of red berry, underbrush and a lightly toasted note. The palate offers juicy morello cherry, toasted almond and a hint of white pepper plus lithe tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Rocca delle Macìe 2013 Campomaccione  (Morellino di Scansano)

description: This straightforward red conveys aromas of red berry, underbrush and a lightly toasted note. The palate offers juicy morello cherry, toasted almond and a hint of white pepper plus lithe tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Rocca delle Macìe 2013 Campomaccione  (Morellino di Scansano)

description: Made entirely with native grape Trebbiano Spoletino, this conveys aromas of chamomile, candied fruit and a hint of acacia. The round palate offers dried fruit and a honey accent alongside soft acidity.
title: Perticaia 2013 Trebbiano Spoletino (Umbria)

description: Crisp and polished, this opens with heady aromas of hawthorne and stone fruit. The vibrant palate offers white peach, passion fruit and citrus alongside bright acidity and a light mineral note.
title: Castello Montauto 2014  Vernaccia di San Gimignano

description: Aromas of red berry and crushed blue flower open this easy-drinking red. The bright, vertical palate offers sour cherry and a hint of cooking spice alongside vibrant acidity and sleek tannins.
title: Castello Montauto 2013  Chianti

description: Aromas of toast, walnut and dried orchard fruit lead the nose on this blend of 40% Vermentino, 40% Sauvignon and 20% Chardonnay. The palate offers yellow apple skin, oak extract, butterscotch and toasted almond but it's shy on fruit richness.
title: Campo alla Sughera 2013 Achenio White (Bolgheri)

description: This vibrant white unfolds with fragrances of white spring flower, hay, earth, green apple and tropical fruit that all carry over to the palate. Crisp acidity brightens the juicy fruit flavors.
title: Argillae 2013  Orvieto

description: A blend of Trebbiano, Sangiovese and Malvasia, this holds aromas of maple syrup, walnut and dried stone fruit. The syrupy, low-acid palate doles out acacia honey and pastry crust.
title: Renieri 2003 Principe di Renieri Red (Toscana)

description: Here is a linear and feminine 90-10 blend of Sangiovese and Cabernet Sauvignon with aromas of pressed red rose, fresh blueberry, cherry cola and chalky white mineral. The wine tastes clean and polished in the mouth and ends with very elegant shadings of berry fruit.
title: Tenuta di Ceppaiano 2004 Violetta Red (Toscana)

description: Fresh berry nuances come on the heels of spice, chocolate and smoke. The wild berry presence is nicely defined and gives this Vino Nobile a fresh and youthful disposition. In the mouth, however, it shows the natural sophistication and complexity of this celebrated category of Tuscan wine.
title: Canneto 2005 Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Here's an elegant expression of Cabernet Sauvignon with smooth aromas of wild berries and cherry that are seamlessly integrated with light shadings of spice and toast. The wine is crisp and generous on the palate and delivers a smooth, but determined texture.
title: Camigliano 2006 Campo ai Mori Cabernet Sauvignon (Sant'Antimo)

description: Here's an elegant expression of Cabernet Sauvignon with smooth aromas of wild berries and cherry that are seamlessly integrated with light shadings of spice and toast. The wine is crisp and generous on the palate and delivers a smooth, but determined texture.
title: Camigliano 2006 Campo ai Mori Cabernet Sauvignon (Sant'Antimo)

description: Here's a mature red wine from Maremma, Tuscany with ripe notes of cherry, chocolate, prune and black plum followed by exotic spice and spicy mesquite flavors. The wine is sweet, round and slightly jammy in the mouth but washes over the palate with generosity and intensity.
title: Rocca di Frassinello 2007  Maremma

description: Made entirely with Aglianico, this salmon-colored wine has delicate aromas of red berry and a whiff of wild rose. The lean, racy, palate offers hints of strawberry and red cherry alongside sharp acidity.
title: San Martino 2014 Neverosa Rosato (Basilicata)

description: This vibrant, informal wine offers fruity aromas of crushed cherry, strawberry and woodland berry. The fruity aromas carry over to the palate along with a hint of tangerine zest and bracing acidity.
title: Caparra & Siciliani 2014 Le Formelle Rosato (Cirò)

description: Red berry, pressed flower and a whiff of damp earth lead the nose. The diluted palate shows raw cherry, clove and gamy note alongside brisk acidity. It's rather rustic and lean, with a short, bitter finish.
title: Caparra & Siciliani 2013 Solagi Rosso  (Cirò Classico)

description: Made with equal parts of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Alicante, this has earthy aromas of black-skinned fruit and game. The dense palate delivers prune, toast and tobacco alongside gripping, rather drying tannins.
title: Poggio Verrano 2010 3 Red (Toscana)

description: Made with equal parts of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Alicante, this has earthy aromas of black-skinned fruit and game. The dense palate delivers prune, toast and tobacco alongside gripping, rather drying tannins.
title: Poggio Verrano 2010 3 Red (Toscana)

description: Made entirely with Sangiovese, this opens with delicate aromas of black cherry and clove that continue to the no-frills palate together with a hint of white pepper. Firm tannins provide support.
title: Agrisole 2013 Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: Made entirely with Malvasia Nera, this opens with aromas of black cherry, ground pepper and cocoa that carry over to the straightforward palate. Close-grained tannins grip the finish.
title: Agrisole 2013 Malvasia Nera (Toscana)

description: Made with equal parts Sangiovese and organically grown Cabernet Sauvignon, this opens with fruity aromas of red cherry and raspberry. The aromas carry over to the easygoing palate alongside tangy acidity and smooth tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Volpaia 2014 Citto Red (Toscana)

description: This straightforward informal red offers aromas of dark berry and moist soil. The soft palate displays raspberry jam and a hint of dark spice. It's easy drinking, with supple tannins.
title: Triacca 2014 Bello Stento  (Chianti Classico)

description: Blue flower, iris, used leather and woodland berry aromas float out of the glass. The easygoing palate offers red cherry, white pepper and a hint of anise accompanied by soft relaxed tannins. Drink through 2017.
title: Bonacchi 2013 Casalino Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: A blend of 60% Sangiovese and 40% Cabernet Sauvignon, this has aromas of sunbaked earth, dried herb, dark berry and a whiff of underbrush. The soft straightforward palate offers juicy black cherry and a hint of spice framed in easygoing tannins. Drink soon.
title: Poggio al Tufo 2015 Rompicollo Red (Toscana)

description: A blend of 60% Sangiovese and 40% Cabernet Sauvignon, this has aromas of sunbaked earth, dried herb, dark berry and a whiff of underbrush. The soft straightforward palate offers juicy black cherry and a hint of spice framed in easygoing tannins. Drink soon.
title: Poggio al Tufo 2015 Rompicollo Red (Toscana)

description: Light bodied and refreshing, this simple enjoyable red delivers sour cherry, red currant, chopped Mediterranean herb and a hint of white pepper. It finishes clean and crisp. It's made to be drunk young, so enjoy now.
title: Pietro Beconcini 2015 Fresco di Nero Tempranillo (Toscana)

description: You'll find subtle aromas of red cherry, scorched earth and clove on this solid red. The full-bodied palate delivers dried black cherry, tobacco and walnut. Fine-grained tannins leave a firm finish.
title: Peteglia 2012  Montecucco

description: Made entirely with Sangiovese, this opens with aromas of scorched soil, used leather and game. The aromas follow over to the funky palate along with mature plum and black pepper. It's already accessible, with evolved tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Guicciardini Strozzi 2011 Sòdole Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: Made with 70% Sangiovese, 20% Cabernet Sauvignon and 10% Merlot, this has aromas of red plum and a whiff of cinnamon. The rather lean palate offers strawberry and vanilla along with a smoky finish. Enjoy soon.
title: Fattoria Montellori 2013 Moro Red (Toscana)

description: A blend of white grapes Vermentino and Colombana, this opens with aromas yellow flower, stone fruit, and a whiff of citrus. The fresh palate offers yellow peach and tangerine that lead to a clean finish.
title: Fattoria Fibbiano 2015 Fonte delle Donne White (Toscana)

description: Made entirely with Syrah, this has subdued aromas of blackberry and a suggestion of sandalwood. The dense palate offers dried black cherry, black pepper and oak alongside round tannins. Drink sooner rather than later to capture the remaining fruit.
title: Conti di Sn Bonifacio 2012 Sustinet Syrah (Toscana)

description: This easygoing Sangiovese opens with fruity aromas of red and black berries. The straightforward, enjoyable palate delivers black cherries and baking spices alongside smooth tannins and fresh acidity.
title: Casa Catelli 2015 Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: This opens with floral aromas of violet, iris and a whiff of sunbaked earth. The straightforward palate offers wild black cherry and a hint of dark spice alongside polished tannins. Enjoy through 2018.
title: Carpineto 2015  Chianti Classico

description: Made with late-ripened grapes (85% Vermentino and 15% Viognier), this has aromas suggesting beeswax, pressed yellow flower and a whiff of honey. The aromas carry over to the round palate along with suggestions of apricot and nectarine.
title: Vignaioli del Morellino di Scansano 2015 Vigna Fiorini Vendemmia Tardiva White (Toscana)

description: Made with 70% Cabernet Sauvignon and 30% Sangiovese, this supple, easy-drinking red offers pretty scents of fragrant purple flower and red berry. The round easygoing palate offers wild cherry and a hint of a red currant alongside bright acidity and soft tannins. Drink now.
title: Tenuta San Guido 2014 Le Difese Red (Toscana)

description: Made with 70% Cabernet Sauvignon and 30% Sangiovese, this supple, easy-drinking red offers pretty scents of fragrant purple flower and red berry. The round easygoing palate offers wild cherry and a hint of a red currant alongside bright acidity and soft tannins. Drink now.
title: Tenuta San Guido 2014 Le Difese Red (Toscana)

description: Made with 40% Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Merlot, 20% Cabernet Franc and 15% Syrah, this has subtle aromas of red berry and bell pepper that carry on to the dense palate, along with a note of mature plum. Soft tannins provide the round, easygoing framework. Enjoy soon.
title: Tenuta Poggio Rosso 2015 Fufluna Red (Toscana)

description: Made entirely with rare native grape Uvalino, this opens with aromas that recall ripe black plum and vanilla. The dense robust palate delivers prune, clove and a dusting of cocoa alongside assertive tannins. Enjoy through 2018.
title: Cascina Castlet 2011 Uceline Uvalino (Monferrato)

description: This is a bold and thickly structured Sagrantino that has all its cards in place hold for a slightly disjointed note on the bouquet. The aromas are raw and intense and those bright cherry and spice elements seem to compete strongly against each other. Campo alla Cerqua is aged three years in large oak casks.
title: Tabarrini 2008 Campo alla Cerqua  (Montefalco Sagrantino)

description: This inky-colored wine is showing some age. It offers flavors of prune, bell pepper, toast and ground black pepper alongside astringent tannins. The fruit is all dried up.
title: Avide 2007 Barocco  (Cerasuolo di Vittoria Classico)

description: This has fragrances of dark cherry, moist soil and spice. The palate offers ripe black-fruit flavors, along with white pepper and baking spice accents. Pair this with salami or pot roast.
title: Zenato 2010 Ripassa  (Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso)

description: This boasts aromas of plum cake and vanilla, with whiffs of toast and oak. It has a ripe-cherry flavored palate, with espresso, coffee and oak sensations.
title: Tenuta Sant'Antonio 2010 Selezione Antonio Castagnedi  (Amarone della Valpolicella)

description: This has earthy aromas of mushroom and tobacco leaf, along with notes of raisin, ripe blackberry and plum. The palate delivers succulent black cherry, nutmeg and mint flavors accented by chocolate and bitter almond. This is well structured, with fresh acidity.
title: Tedeschi 2011 Capitel San Rocco  (Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso)

description: This has earthy aromas of mushroom and tobacco leaf, along with notes of raisin, ripe blackberry and plum. The palate delivers succulent black cherry, nutmeg and mint flavors accented by chocolate and bitter almond. This is well structured, with fresh acidity.
title: Tedeschi 2011 Capitel San Rocco  (Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso)

description: This earthy selection offers aromas of black cherry, bitter almond, graphite and freshly tilled soil. On the palate, this presents mouthwatering blackberry and raspberry flavors layered with cinnamon-spice. The bold character is supported by ample freshness and structure.
title: Nicolis 2010 Seccal  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso)

description: This is a structured but elegant wine, with attractive aromas of baked plum, black cherry and cinnamon. The palate is both concentrated and smooth, with lush blackberry, white pepper and cinnamon flavors, as well as fresh acidity. This is delicious and ready to enjoy now.
title: Monte del Frà 2011 Tenuta Lena di Mezzo  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso)

description: This is loaded with succulent black cherry, almond, tobacco and black pepper flavors. The dense fruit and round structure are balanced by vibrant acidity, making this perfect to pair with everything from cured meats to risotto.
title: Corteforte 2010 Podere Bertarole  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso)

description: This is loaded with succulent black cherry, almond, tobacco and black pepper flavors. The dense fruit and round structure are balanced by vibrant acidity, making this perfect to pair with everything from cured meats to risotto.
title: Corteforte 2010 Podere Bertarole  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso)

description: This has intense fragrances of moist earth, blackberry, raisin and almond. The rich palate offers concentrated black cherry, plum, cinnamon and black pepper flavors. It shows the warmth of the vintage and while it doesn't seem to have enough fresh acidity for long-term aging, it's velvety-smooth and delicious now.
title: Accordini Igino 2009  Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso

description: This linear white presents varietal aromas of tropical fruit, cut grass and crushed tomato vine. The bright, juicy palate offers green melon and white peach alongside zesty acidity that gives it a clean finish.
title: Pighin 2013 Sauvignon (Friuli Grave)

description: This linear white presents varietal aromas of tropical fruit, cut grass and crushed tomato vine. The bright, juicy palate offers green melon and white peach alongside zesty acidity that gives it a clean finish.
title: Pighin 2013 Sauvignon (Friuli Grave)

description: Aromas of violet, wild strawberry and red raspberry carry through to the palate alongside hints of tea and rosemary. It's balanced and approachable with silky tannins and fresh acidity.
title: Erste Neue 2013 Pinot Nero (Alto Adige)

description: Aromas of hawthorn, acacia flower and stone fruit take shape in the glass. The linear palate offers crisp apple, juicy pear and bitter almond alongside tangy acidity.
title: Cantina di Soave 2013 Rocca Sveva Castelcerino  (Soave Classico)

description: Aromas of hawthorn, acacia flower and stone fruit take shape in the glass. The linear palate offers crisp apple, juicy pear and bitter almond alongside tangy acidity.
title: Cantina di Soave 2013 Rocca Sveva Castelcerino  (Soave Classico)

description: Attractive aromas of red berry and blue flower lead the nose on this bright wine. On the palate, notes of beet and mint accent a core of wild strawberry and crunchy red cherry. It's savory and easy drinking thanks to fresh acidity and sleek tannins.
title: Cantina Produttori San Michele Appiano 2013 Pinot Nero (Alto Adige)

description: Pretty varietal aromas include raspberry and rose petal. The sleek, easy-drinking palate offers crushed strawberry, green tomato and a hint of mineral alongside polished tannins.
title: Cantina Produttori Cortaccia 2013 Pinot Nero (Alto Adige)

description: Pretty varietal aromas include raspberry and rose petal. The sleek, easy-drinking palate offers crushed strawberry, green tomato and a hint of mineral alongside polished tannins.
title: Cantina Produttori Cortaccia 2013 Pinot Nero (Alto Adige)

description: Aromas of violet and red currant waft from the glass. The fresh, juicy palate delivers wild cherry, strawberry and an herbal note alongside bright acidity and soft tannins. It finishes with an almond accent.
title: Caldaro 2013 Campaner Schiava (Alto Adige)

description: Aromas of violet and red currant waft from the glass. The fresh, juicy palate delivers wild cherry, strawberry and an herbal note alongside bright acidity and soft tannins. It finishes with an almond accent.
title: Caldaro 2013 Campaner Schiava (Alto Adige)

description: Aromas of spring blossom and yellow stone fruit delicately lead the way on this refreshing white. The vibrant palate offers raw peach, lime and a hint of almond alongside racy acidity. A saline note closes the tangy finish.
title: Olivetta 2014 Cortese (Piemonte)

description: Aromas of spring blossom and yellow stone fruit delicately lead the way on this refreshing white. The vibrant palate offers raw peach, lime and a hint of almond alongside racy acidity. A saline note closes the tangy finish.
title: Olivetta 2014 Cortese (Piemonte)

description: Balsamic herb, toast, oak, exotic spice and berry aromas emerge in the glass. The palate is still rather closed and austere showing oak, licorice and tart cherry alongside bracing tannins that leave an astringent finish. Give the tannins a few years to soften than drink before to capture the remaining fruit.
title: Oddero 2012  Barolo

description: This opens with delicate scents of field flower and white stone fruit. On the creamy off-dry palate, a soft mousse backs up sweet white peach, green apple and a candied citrus note while bright acidity lends freshness.
title: Andreola 2016 Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Enticing aromas of wisteria and white spring flower rise from the glass on this fragrant sparkler. The crisp dry palate is more restrained, offering yellow apple and lemon zest alongside racy acidity and a vibrant perlage.
title: Foss Marai 2016 Guia Brut  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Enticing aromas of wisteria and white spring flower rise from the glass on this fragrant sparkler. The crisp dry palate is more restrained, offering yellow apple and lemon zest alongside racy acidity and a vibrant perlage.
title: Foss Marai 2016 Guia Brut  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Citrus blossom, wisteria and orchard fruit aromas lift out of the glass. Fresh and creamy, the palate offers white peach, candied nectarine slice and ripe Bartlett pear. Fresh acidity brightens the rich flavors while a silky mousse lends finesse.
title: Foss Marai NV Strada di Guia 109 Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Citrus blossom, wisteria and orchard fruit aromas lift out of the glass. Fresh and creamy, the palate offers white peach, candied nectarine slice and ripe Bartlett pear. Fresh acidity brightens the rich flavors while a silky mousse lends finesse.
title: Foss Marai NV Strada di Guia 109 Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This is a fabulous take on Verdicchio from 30-year-old vines that boasts a golden color and generous tones of sweet honey, passion fruit, perfumed white flower and mature peach. Feminine and silky in texture, it also has a viscous, creamy side that aids in establishing a broader, richer mouthfeel.
region: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore
title: Umani Ronchi 2004 Casal di Serra Vecchie Vigne  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore)

description: This is a fabulous take on Verdicchio from 30-year-old vines that boasts a golden color and generous tones of sweet honey, passion fruit, perfumed white flower and mature peach. Feminine and silky in texture, it also has a viscous, creamy side that aids in establishing a broader, richer mouthfeel.
region: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore
title: Umani Ronchi 2004 Casal di Serra Vecchie Vigne  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore)

description: From a little-known producer outside the Classico zone, here is a pretty wine with notes of cherry, chocolate, spice and subtle shadings of vanilla. In the mouth, it delivers soft tannins and good persistency of spice and fruit flavors.
title: Provolo 2001  Amarone della Valpolicella

description: This wine from northern Italy offers bell pepper and red currant aromas that carry over to the palate along with notes of black pepper. The bright, straightforward and easy-drinking style is ideal to pair with everyday fare.
title: Piera Martellozzo 2012 Terre Magre Cabernet Franc (Friuli Grave)

description: This wine from southern Italy is made with native grape Greco di Tufo. It has aromas of oak and mineral with hints of candied fruit. The restrained palate shows wood and hints of lemon peel, but it lacks fruit richness.
title: Donnachiara 2011 Ostinato Greco (Campania)

description: This wine from southern Italy is made with native grape Greco di Tufo. It has aromas of oak and mineral with hints of candied fruit. The restrained palate shows wood and hints of lemon peel, but it lacks fruit richness.
title: Donnachiara 2011 Ostinato Greco (Campania)

description: This blend of white native grapes from Lazio has delicate, fruity aromas of pear and apple that carry over to the palate along with an almond note. Fresh and crisp, this makes a perfect apéritif, or pair it with lightly-seasoned dishes.
title: Tenuta di Pietra Porzia 2012 Regillo  (Frascati Superiore)

description: This is a recommended wine for those who love classic expressions of Amarone. The wine's intensity is fueled by aromas of cherry, apple, spice and chocolate and it really comes alive in the mouth thanks to a long, fresh trail of cola and dried herbs.
title: Manara 2004  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico

description: This broad, generous expression of Amarone has black fruit aromas that are fleshed out by pretty mineral tones of slate roof or schoolroom chalkboard. Although the fruit tastes very ripe, the wine's firm tannins create a drying effect in the mouth.
title: Zeni 2004 Vigne Alte  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Pegrandi exhibits a sincere and succulent personality with loads of blackberry, dried currants, oak, mineral notes and Indian spice (it is aged 25 months in wood). The wine's mouthfeel is gritty and somewhat raw with firm tannins and a sweet cherry aftertaste.
title: Vaona 2004 Pegrandi  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Pegrandi exhibits a sincere and succulent personality with loads of blackberry, dried currants, oak, mineral notes and Indian spice (it is aged 25 months in wood). The wine's mouthfeel is gritty and somewhat raw with firm tannins and a sweet cherry aftertaste.
title: Vaona 2004 Pegrandi  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Little changes at Biondi-Santi. The tannins on this huge 1997 are dense, almost impenetrable. The flavors are of cherry, tobacco, old wood and solid, black fruits. The aftertaste is all tannin at this stage. Despite this rigorous adherence to tradition, the 1997 seems a touch less overwhelming than previous vintages of this classic wine. Nevertheless, age for at least 15 years before drinking.
title: Biondi Santi 1997 Il Greppo  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: The land from which this wine comes was once owned by the Biondi-Santi family. It forms part of an 18-acre estate belonging to Sergio Rossi. It is a stunning wine, with a sense of fine poise combined with solid tannins and firm, ripe fruit. At the back of the palate is a lingering flavor ofviolets and sweet herbs. Drink from 2005; the wine should age well.
title: La Gerla 1997  Brunello di Montalcino

description: The label reads Chianti, but this is more about deep, driving black fruit than typically racy Sangiovese. It kicks off with the purest scent of smashed berries, and then offers up a supercharged black-cherry-laden palate with far more hedonistic weight than starching acids. The wine finishes with power and warmth.
title: Borgo Scopeto 1998 Misciano - Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: This nuovo mondo Super Tuscan represents the first vintage of Borgo Scopeto under the management of Tenuta Caparzo, and it has a tremendous jammy, extracted quality to it, from the smooth, deep plum and blackberry nose to the soft, rich palate that exudes tons of black cherry fruit along with coffee and licorice. It's a mix of 60% Sangiovese, 20% Cabernet Sauvignon and 20% Syrah, and everything is working in unison.
title: Borgo Scopeto 1998 Borgonero Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: This nuovo mondo Super Tuscan represents the first vintage of Borgo Scopeto under the management of Tenuta Caparzo, and it has a tremendous jammy, extracted quality to it, from the smooth, deep plum and blackberry nose to the soft, rich palate that exudes tons of black cherry fruit along with coffee and licorice. It's a mix of 60% Sangiovese, 20% Cabernet Sauvignon and 20% Syrah, and everything is working in unison.
title: Borgo Scopeto 1998 Borgonero Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: A Type-A wine if ever there was one. It's high-voltage Cabernet, with just a touch of Merlot, and it's layered with cassis, buttery oak, and some toast. The mouthfeel is full but elegant, with mint and clove nuances poking through to impact the bold currant-laden palate. A smooth, well-oaked, persistent finish is the encore. Can easily be aged for a decade.
title: Castello del Terriccio 1998 Lupicaia Cabernet Sauvignon (Toscana)

description: A Type-A wine if ever there was one. It's high-voltage Cabernet, with just a touch of Merlot, and it's layered with cassis, buttery oak, and some toast. The mouthfeel is full but elegant, with mint and clove nuances poking through to impact the bold currant-laden palate. A smooth, well-oaked, persistent finish is the encore. Can easily be aged for a decade.
title: Castello del Terriccio 1998 Lupicaia Cabernet Sauvignon (Toscana)

description: Sesta is one of the wines coming out of Montalcino that manages to combine the old-world power and tannin of Brunello with top-quality fruit flavors. It is firm and concentrated, showing dry tannins that go right through the palate. At the same time, there is delicious ripe, violet-flavored fruit and balancing acidity. Drink after 10 years.
title: Tenuta di Sesta 1997  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Sesta is one of the wines coming out of Montalcino that manages to combine the old-world power and tannin of Brunello with top-quality fruit flavors. It is firm and concentrated, showing dry tannins that go right through the palate. At the same time, there is delicious ripe, violet-flavored fruit and balancing acidity. Drink after 10 years.
title: Tenuta di Sesta 1997  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Riccardo Talenti, grandson of Pierluigi Talenti, the grand old man of Montalcino, currently makes one of the finest Brunellos with the help of consultant Carlo Ferrini. They are now using new wood for aging, and the extra layer of richness this brings is apparent in the comparative accessibility of this wine. Yet it is also huge, with classic tannins and intense, concentrated flavors of sweet blackberry jelly.
title: Talenti 1997  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Fast becoming one of the world's top luxury cuvées, this blend of 60% Cabernet Sauvignon, 30% Merlot and 10% Syrah is a complex amalgam of dry, classy fruit, herbal notes, smoked meat, black pepper and baking spices. Its calling card is its perfect body weight. It isn't heavy or jammy, but it manages to offer tons of stuffing and a graceful finish loaded with the essences of cola, coffee and chocolate. If possible, it should be cellared for several more years.
title: Antinori 1999 Guado Al Tasso  (Bolgheri)

description: Hailing from the town of Suvereto in the southern Maremma, this sophomore Cabernet-Merlot blend from the same owner as Bellavista and Contadi Castaldi in Franciacorta is flat-out awesome. One whiff of the bouquet says it all: earth, currant, blackberry and coffee. The palate is equally sensational—a magic carpet ride of plum fruit, pure oak and solid but forgiving tannins. Drink and enjoy any time through 2006.
title: Petra 1998 Riserva Cabernet Sauvignon-Merlot (Toscana)

description: Spicy and full of cassis, tobacco and coffee aromas. Texture and mouthfeel are what this wine is all about; it is plush like velvet carpet. Deep, satisfying flavors of plum, black currant and vanilla lead into an ultrasmooth finish that is clean as a hospital emergency room.
title: Tenuta dell'Ornellaia 1999 Ornellaia  (Bolgheri)

description: Round and juicy, this opens with aromas of stone fruit, dried herb and a whiff of pear. The ripe, enveloping palate doles out white peach, mature apple, juicy nectarine and a hint of bitter almond. A mineral note closes the lingering finish.
title: Gradis'ciutta 2015 Pinot Grigio (Collio)

description: Round and juicy, this opens with aromas of stone fruit, dried herb and a whiff of pear. The ripe, enveloping palate doles out white peach, mature apple, juicy nectarine and a hint of bitter almond. A mineral note closes the lingering finish.
title: Gradis'ciutta 2015 Pinot Grigio (Collio)

description: Aromas of yellow flower, candied orange zest and a balsamic note emerge in the glass. On the enveloping palate, a ginger note accents baked Gala apple and eucalyptus honey. Fresh acidity brightens the rich flavors.
title: Gigante 2008 Picolit (Friuli Colli Orientali)

description: Alluring aromas of acacia flower, beeswax, citrus and a whiff of honey float out of the glass. The elegant, linear palate offers green pear, grapefruit, lemon zest, almond and mineral framed in racy acidity. Give this time to fully develop. Drink through 2021.
region: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore
title: Garofoli 2013 Podium  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore)

description: Enticing scents of wild blackberry, violet and a hint of menthol unfold on this savory red. The juicy palate doles out succulent raspberry, white pepper, clove and cocoa while lively acidity and firm, refined tannins provide balance.
title: Franz Haas 2012 Lagrein (Alto Adige)

description: With a little time in the glass, this eventually reveals subtle aromas of toasted almond, pressed yellow flower, beeswax and a whiff of honey. The honeyed note follows over to the enveloping palate, along with candied citrus peel, marzipan and mineral. Fresh acidity brightens the rich flavors and provides balance. It's already enjoyable but hold for more complexity. Drink through 2023.
title: La Monacesca 2013 Mirum Riserva  (Verdicchio di Matelica)

description: With a little time in the glass, this eventually reveals subtle aromas of toasted almond, pressed yellow flower, beeswax and a whiff of honey. The honeyed note follows over to the enveloping palate, along with candied citrus peel, marzipan and mineral. Fresh acidity brightens the rich flavors and provides balance. It's already enjoyable but hold for more complexity. Drink through 2023.
title: La Monacesca 2013 Mirum Riserva  (Verdicchio di Matelica)

description: This fragrant, elegant white opens with scents of orange blossom and white wild flower. The savory palate has a lovely depth of flavors, including yellow peach, Bosc pear, juicy lime and mineral alongside fresh acidity. A hazelnut note backs up the finish.
