description: Poggio Teo offers excellent quality of fruit with berry, cherry and cassis overtones. This is a bright, crisp wine that flows nicely over the palate with rich intensity and integrated acidity.
title: Valiano 2006 Poggio Teo  (Chianti Classico)

description: Here's an inky, garnet-colored Brunello that opens with lavish aromas of mature berry, moist earth, dried rose and cured meat. In fact, that distinctive note of bresaola or smoked ham is one of its most interesting qualities. The mouthfeel is thick and penetrating and the tannins are dense but smooth.
title: Tenuta Oliveto 2006  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Still young and nervous, this wine needs a few more years of cellar aging. There's great potential here thanks to the wine's natural aromas of cassis, dried fruit, cherry and toasted nut. In the mouth, it is tart, crisp and long-lasting.
title: Tenimenti Angelini 2006 Val di Suga  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: This bright Brunello is accented by a few sharp points of acidity that will soften with more years of bottle aging. On the nose, the wine shows layers of wild berry, bramble, white mushroom, moist earth and pressed violets.
title: San Filippo 2006  Brunello di Montalcino

description: This bright Brunello is accented by a few sharp points of acidity that will soften with more years of bottle aging. On the nose, the wine shows layers of wild berry, bramble, white mushroom, moist earth and pressed violets.
title: San Filippo 2006  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Here's a bright, buoyant style of Brunello that drinks easily but also delivers the sophistication and complexity you should expect of Montalcino. It opens with crisp, tonic aromas of cassis and wild berry with very subtle aromas of vanilla and toasted nut at the back.
title: Pietroso 2006  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Ser Lapo is a celebration of Tuscan Sangiovese with refined berry aromas and cherry undertones followed by blue flower, cola and spice. The color, consistency and fruit flavors are all excellent.
title: Mazzei 2006 Ser Lapo Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Here's an interesting Brunello that recalls moist notes of forest floor and white mushroom, backed by cherry and wild berry. The wine opens with dense concentration and a dark ruby color. It ends with a long, polished feel.
title: Le Chiuse 2006  Brunello di Montalcino

description: This elegant Brunello opens with a ruby-garnet color and offers enticing aromas of mature berry fruit, cedar, and a touch of cola or tar. There's a smoky, mineral note in the mouth and although the texture it not too dense, it delivers a soft, sophisticated edge.
title: La Velona 2006  Brunello di Montalcino

description: This elegant Brunello opens with a ruby-garnet color and offers enticing aromas of mature berry fruit, cedar, and a touch of cola or tar. There's a smoky, mineral note in the mouth and although the texture it not too dense, it delivers a soft, sophisticated edge.
title: La Velona 2006  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Tight and compact, this delivers tangy, spicy intensity that's packed around a solid core of red fruit. The midpalate is driven by sensations of cherry, cassis and blackberry, and the finish shows signs of smoky barbecue and roasted chestnut.
title: Venturini Massimino 2007 Campomasua  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: This boasts tiny portions of Teroldego, Merlot and Croatina that give the wine a soft, lush disposition. Some 42 months of oak aging also add to the palate's overall silkiness. Flavors of chocolate, cherry, plum, tar, resin and licorice are all recognizable.
title: Eleva 2005 Piovesole  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: This boasts tiny portions of Teroldego, Merlot and Croatina that give the wine a soft, lush disposition. Some 42 months of oak aging also add to the palate's overall silkiness. Flavors of chocolate, cherry, plum, tar, resin and licorice are all recognizable.
title: Eleva 2005 Piovesole  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: This is a landmark Amarone that has often acted as the category's biggest ambassador abroad. It bursts open with aromas of dark berry, spice, leather and tobacco, and it is both generous and long-lasting on the palate.
title: Masi 2008 Costasera  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Dark and brooding, this has inky concentration, power and determination. The nose is alive with tones of blackberry, maraschino, leather, tobacco and rusty soil. The mouthfeel is thick and penetrating.
title: Le Salette 2008 La Marega  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Dark and savory, this opens with cured meat, smoked bacon, teriyaki, cherry and cola aromas. The palate is lush and velvety, with accents of candied fruit, leather and black pepper.
title: Antolini 2008 Morópio  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Dark and savory, this opens with cured meat, smoked bacon, teriyaki, cherry and cola aromas. The palate is lush and velvety, with accents of candied fruit, leather and black pepper.
title: Antolini 2008 Morópio  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: On the dark and savory side, this opens with blackberry, prune, chocolate and moist tobacco aromas. It offers ethereal notes of dried herb, cola and licorice that give the wine a lighter, more buoyant personality.
title: Recchia 2005 Ca' Bertoldi  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: This producer does a fantastic job of presenting quality air-dried fruit without the jamminess and heaviness that is sometimes encountered. Aged for 30 months in large oak casks, this is tight, structured and elegant.
title: Nicolis 2006  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico

description: Here's an easy, fresh Valpolicella that opens with cherry, raspberry, dried herbs and a touch of sweet dill. The mouthfeel is clean and lean: You could envisage a successful pairing with chicken, pasta or veal.
title: Ca' Rugate 2008 Campo Lavei  (Valpolicella Superiore)

description: Monte Tombole Valpolicella opens with easy cherry and blueberry aromas backed by light nuances of spice and sweet vanilla. The wine is fresh, lean and crisp on the close.
title: Villa Erbice 2007 Monte Tombole  (Valpolicella Superiore)

description: This friendly Ripasso opens with sweet and slightly overripe aromas of strawberry, spice, honey-roasted nut, cassis syrup, new leather and cola. It's simple and straightforward in the mouth however with a raw, sharp feel.
title: La Giaretta 2007  Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso

description: Bright and correct with clean berry flavors, this is a perfect red wine to pair with meat appetizers or pâtè. It delivers a thin, watery feel with loads of crisp berry freshness in the mouth.
title: Speri 2008 La Roverina  (Valpolicella)

description: This cheerful, screw cap Valpolicella offers crisp raspberry and cherry flavors over a lean, compact body. It's a lightweight, easy-going wine that would pair with soups or sandwiches.
title: Speri 2007 La Roverina  (Valpolicella)

description: La Fortuna's Rosso offers contrasting aromas of spice, red apple, wild berry, bramble and cherry liqueur. It boasts a deep ruby color and in the mouth, it feels pointed and edgy.
title: La Fortuna 2008  Rosso di Montalcino

description: Aromas of crushed herb, red berry, roasted coffee bean, coconut and clove come together on this. The tight tannic palate offers dried Marasca cherry and tobacco alongside close-grained tannins that grip the finish. Drink 2023–2033.
title: Arnaldo Rivera 2013 Vigna Rionda  (Barolo)

description: Aromas of crushed herb, red berry, roasted coffee bean, coconut and clove come together on this. The tight tannic palate offers dried Marasca cherry and tobacco alongside close-grained tannins that grip the finish. Drink 2023–2033.
title: Arnaldo Rivera 2013 Vigna Rionda  (Barolo)

description: Here's a fun delightful sparkler that gives you yellow apple, Bartlett pear and nectarine zest flavors alongside steely, vivacious bubbles. Firm acidity gives it a crisp finish.
title: Tenuta Stella NV Brut Ribolla Gialla (Vino Spumante)

description: Made entirely with native grape Nascetta, this opens with aromas of white spring flower and a whiff of hay. The straightforward, rather lean palate offers tropical fruit, lemon zest and a hint of toasted hazelnut alongside refreshing acidity.
title: Serra dei Fiori 2015 La Regina Nascetta (Langhe)

description: Delicately sweet and redolent of honey, acacia and exotic fruit, this would go down easily in casual settings or during the holidays. It has a creamy mouthfeel with peach and pear flavors.
title: Mionetto NV Cartizze  (Prosecco Superiore di Cartizze)

description: This is a beautiful sparkler with outstanding purity of aromas: Peach blossom, kiwi, exotic fruit, floral tones and caramel candy form a delicate embroidery. It boasts perky sweetness in the mouth with refreshing crispness on the close.
title: Bortolomiol 2006 Cartizze  (Prosecco Superiore di Cartizze)

description: This structured white opens with aromas of orange zest, Mediterranean brush and a whiff of oak-driven spice. The aromas carry through to the round palate along with ripe apricot, toast and candied lemon drop. Moderate acidity brightens the rich flavors.
title: Tenute Soletta 2013 Kyanos Bianco White (Isola dei Nuraghi)

description: A blend of 90% Carignano and 10% Syrah, this vibrant, spicy rosato delivers juicy strawberry, wild cherry, orange zest, anise and white pepper. Crisp acidity gives it a clean, quenching finish.
title: Capichera 2014 Tambè Rosato (Isola dei Nuraghi)

description: A blend of 90% Carignano and 10% Syrah, this vibrant, spicy rosato delivers juicy strawberry, wild cherry, orange zest, anise and white pepper. Crisp acidity gives it a clean, quenching finish.
title: Capichera 2014 Tambè Rosato (Isola dei Nuraghi)

description: Aromas of forest floor, woodland berry, pressed flower and a hint of chopped herb lead the nose. The taut palate delivers tart red cherry, grilled sage and anise alongside assertive tannins.
title: Ca' del Baio 2012 Vallegrande  (Barbaresco)

description: Toast, mint, red berry and leather aromas come together on this firm red. The palate offers up ripe wild cherry, grilled herb, clove and anise while assertive tannins provide the framework and leave an astringent finish.
title: Ricossa 2011  Barbaresco

description: Aromas of jasmine, baked apple and a whiff of apricot come together in the glass. The aromas carry over to the round, ripe palate energized by a mineral vein. Bright acidity supports the juicy fruit flavors.
title: Mesa 2013 Opale  (Vermentino di Sardegna)

description: Aromas of jasmine, baked apple and a whiff of apricot come together in the glass. The aromas carry over to the round, ripe palate energized by a mineral vein. Bright acidity supports the juicy fruit flavors.
title: Mesa 2013 Opale  (Vermentino di Sardegna)

description: This refreshing white opens with aromas that recall honeysuckle, citrus and ripe orchard fruit. On the palate, rich flavors of white peach, yellow apple and pear are balanced with fresh acidity. A note of bitter almond closes the finish.
title: Piero Mancini 2014 Cucaione Superiore  (Vermentino di Gallura)

description: This exuberant white opens with aromas of Spanish broom, tropical fruit, ripe Bartlett pear and wild herb that carry through to the round, full-bodied palate. Fresh acidity brightens the rich flavors while a mineral note closes the finish.
title: Pala 2014 I Fiori  (Vermentino di Sardegna)

description: This exuberant white opens with aromas of Spanish broom, tropical fruit, ripe Bartlett pear and wild herb that carry through to the round, full-bodied palate. Fresh acidity brightens the rich flavors while a mineral note closes the finish.
title: Pala 2014 I Fiori  (Vermentino di Sardegna)

description: Easy drinking and loaded with finesse, this delivers juicy black cherry, crushed raspberry, ground black pepper and grilled sage sensations. Firm, polished tannins support the primary flavors while a licorice note signals the close.
title: Mesa 2013 Primo Rosso  (Carignano del Sulcis)

description: Comedìa is a blend of Sangiovese (50%), Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot that delivers immediate aromas of spice, toasted almond and cherry fruit. It shows crisp, fresh acidity and an easy mouthfeel that would pair well with aged pecorino cheese.
title: Bellini 2009 Comedìa Red (Rosso di Toscana)

description: Here's a youthful and fresh Bolgheri blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah and Cabernet Franc that opens with vinous or foxy notes of crushed grapes, blueberry and dark cherry. The wine offers a dark ruby color and rich concentration followed by a soft, plush mouthfeel.
title: Batzella 2010 Digià  (Bolgheri)

description: Ser Amerigo (a blend of Sangiovese, Merlot and Colorino) is a bright and straightforward wine with aromas of cherry, forest berry and bitter almond. The mouthfeel is tight and polished, and there's a touch of crisp acidity as well.
title: Marchesi Gondi 2006 Ser Amerigo Red (Colli della Toscana Centrale)

description: Ser Amerigo (a blend of Sangiovese, Merlot and Colorino) is a bright and straightforward wine with aromas of cherry, forest berry and bitter almond. The mouthfeel is tight and polished, and there's a touch of crisp acidity as well.
title: Marchesi Gondi 2006 Ser Amerigo Red (Colli della Toscana Centrale)

description: A blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Sangiovese and Merlot (with small percentages of other varieties mixed in), this extracted wine delivers mature fruit, dried rose petal and dark chocolate. The wine is fresh but gritty and thickly textured as well.
title: Michele Satta 2009  Bolgheri

description: This blend of Cabernet Sauvignon (80%), Cabernet Franc, Merlot and -Syrah opens with unique aromas of candied fruit or sweet cherry. The wine's appearance is of dense, dark garnet, and it finishes with soft, yielding tannins.
title: I Luoghi 2008 Podere Ritorti  (Bolgheri Superiore)

description: Here's a watery and thinly extracted Pinot Grigio that delivers measured aromas of citrus, honey and passion fruit. This is the kind of easygoing wine you'll want to share at park picnics.
title: Don Giovanni 2008 Pinot Grigio (Delle Venezie)

description: Here's an easy-drinking (and well-priced) Pinot Grigio with little extraction and simple aromas of citrus and white peach. The wine is watery and thin in the mouth but it does offer that trademark touch of acidity on the close.
title: Mariana 2008 Pinot Grigio (Delle Venezie)

description: Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot are aged in large oak casks to produce a balanced relationship between the wine's fruit and spice-driven components. It's an informal and easy-drinking wine that would pair with roast beef or honey-glazed ham.
title: Leopoldo I di Toscana 2007 D'Echo Red (Toscana)

description: This cheerful 60-40 blend of Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc offers pristine aromas of white flower, honeysuckle, peach blossom and a touch of crushed white pepper. The wine is smooth and silky on the close and shows a sunny Tuscan personality.
title: Badia a Coltibuono 2009 Trappoline White (Toscana)

description: This is a brilliant and well-executed Trebbiano d'Abruzzo with pretty tones of peach, pear and fresh grapefruit. The wine exhibits a smooth, silky texture and ends on a crisp note that adds a touch of spice on the finish.
title: Talamonti 2006 Aternum  (Trebbiano d'Abruzzo)

description: This Brunello has a smoky, spicy element that recalls crushed white pepper, vanilla and dried herbs. Succulent fruit is delivered in the form of chewy blackberry and blueberry preserves. It's a nice wine with good structure and medium length.
title: San Lorenzo 2003  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Here's a 2004 Chianti Classico (with a 15% component of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon for extra structure and smoothness) that delivers aromas of wet earth, white mushroom, blackberry, tobacco and leather. Drink it with stewed meats or game dishes.
title: Castello di Monastero 2004  Chianti Classico

description: Here's a 2004 Chianti Classico (with a 15% component of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon for extra structure and smoothness) that delivers aromas of wet earth, white mushroom, blackberry, tobacco and leather. Drink it with stewed meats or game dishes.
title: Castello di Monastero 2004  Chianti Classico

description: Casanuova delle Cerbaie presents a mature Brunello that shows signs of the hot 2003 vintage. The wine is ripe with aromas of black cherry and blackberry preserves with warm tones of leather and spice.
title: Casanuova delle Cerbaie 2003  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Casanuova delle Cerbaie presents a mature Brunello that shows signs of the hot 2003 vintage. The wine is ripe with aromas of black cherry and blackberry preserves with warm tones of leather and spice.
title: Casanuova delle Cerbaie 2003  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Mantele is a bright and luminous Sauvignon with immediate aromas of mango, kiwi and pineapple. The winemaking approach here puts an emphasis on purity, elegance and straightforwardness.
title: Cantina Nalles Magre 2007 Mantele Sauvignon (Alto Adige)

description: Mantele is a bright and luminous Sauvignon with immediate aromas of mango, kiwi and pineapple. The winemaking approach here puts an emphasis on purity, elegance and straightforwardness.
title: Cantina Nalles Magre 2007 Mantele Sauvignon (Alto Adige)

description: Franco Pacenti's brooding Brunello offers coffee, prune, ripe fruit and a thick, brownish color that all point to a ripe vintage. You'll get a distinctly sweet aroma of vanilla or maple syrup and the wine offers medium length on the finish.
title: Canalicchio 2003  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Franco Pacenti's brooding Brunello offers coffee, prune, ripe fruit and a thick, brownish color that all point to a ripe vintage. You'll get a distinctly sweet aroma of vanilla or maple syrup and the wine offers medium length on the finish.
title: Canalicchio 2003  Brunello di Montalcino

description: This cheerful Prosecco delivers pretty floral tones and delicate peach intensity. The texture is lean and compact and the wine offers bright acidity on the close: Pair it with appetizers and finger foods to enjoy on a sunny afternoon.
title: Villa Sandi NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Valdobbiadene)

description: Luscious Granny Smith apple is backed by creamy peach and mature pear. In fact, the pear notes become the dominant aromatic force after a few minutes in the glass (maybe because 10% Pinot Bianco is added to the blend). This bright sparkler offers creamy froth and a crisp, clean close.
title: Bortolotti NV Brut  (Prosecco di Valdobbiadene)

description: Stone fruit, sweet grapefruit and green apple flavors; demonstrates excellent balance between effervescence, sweetness and acidity.
title: Andreola Orsola NV Vigneto Dirupo Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Valdobbiadene)

description: Stone fruit, sweet grapefruit and green apple flavors; demonstrates excellent balance between effervescence, sweetness and acidity.
title: Andreola Orsola NV Vigneto Dirupo Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Valdobbiadene)

description: Makers of textbook Prosecco, Mionetto's extra-dry sparkler is lush and pulpy with aromas of lemon blossom, melon, beeswax, pear and oats. Count on good freshness in the mouth. reinforced by lemon candy flavors.
title: Mionetto NV Sergio Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene)

description: Makers of textbook Prosecco, Mionetto's extra-dry sparkler is lush and pulpy with aromas of lemon blossom, melon, beeswax, pear and oats. Count on good freshness in the mouth. reinforced by lemon candy flavors.
title: Mionetto NV Sergio Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene)

description: This opens with tonic aromas of citrus and crushed stone, with light touches of peach and pear at the back. The wine is bright and clean, with a sharp, firm quality of effervescence.
title: Conselve NV Tramontana Brut  (Prosecco)

description: This opens with tonic aromas of citrus and crushed stone, with light touches of peach and pear at the back. The wine is bright and clean, with a sharp, firm quality of effervescence.
title: Conselve NV Tramontana Brut  (Prosecco)

description: Touches of sweet peach and honey open the bouquet of this easygoing, well-priced sparkler. Pair this with barbecued shrimp or tempura vegetable appetizers.
title: Bellussi NV Enrico Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: In its unmistakable squat bottle, this Moscato-based dessert wine offers pretty floral tones and flavors of peach and citrus. Its easy mouthfeel make it a natural pairing with almond cookies.
title: Gaierhof 2011 Moscato Giallo (Trentino)

description: This offers aromas of candied cherry, cake spice, charred earth, cured meat and a whiff of underbrush. On the rich palate, notes of vanilla and black pepper accent chocolate covered cherry, raspberry and raisin accompanied by velvety tannins.
designation: Alfio Moricone Selection Capitel della Crosara
title: Montresor 2009 Alfio Moricone Selection Capitel della Crosara  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: From the gravel soils of northeast Italy, this pure expression of Chardonnay offers bright aromas of papaya, banana, exotic fruit and white peach. There's a touch of spice and almond on the close.
title: Meroi 2010 Chardonnay (Colli Orientali del Friuli)

description: This delivers a delicate bouquet of wild berry, white cherry, peppercorn, dried mint and forest floor. The aromatic intensity of this ruby-colored wine is intense and pure.
title: Manincor 2009 Mason Pinot Nero (Alto Adige)

description: A highly drinkable wine that's very well put together, this is redolent of citrus, stone fruit and crushed mineral.
title: Livio Felluga 2011 Pinot Grigio (Collio)

description: Toast, oak, coffee, underbrush and baked plum aromas unfold on this extremely ripe, full-bodied wine. The densely concentrated palate delivers blackberry jam, licorice, oak roasted coffee bean, coconut and a vanilla note alongside astringent tannins. Give the tannins another few years to soften then drink sooner rather than later.
title: La Magia 2010 Riserva  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Vibrant and savory, this blend of 70% Sangiovese, 15% Sagrantino and 15% Merlot delivers succulent black cherry, crushed plum, black pepper, grilled herb and mocha flavors alongside firm but velvety tannins. It's well balanced with surprisingly fresh acidity for the hot vintage. It's already drinking well but will be even better after 2016.
title: Antonelli 2011  Montefalco Rosso

description: Vibrant and savory, this blend of 70% Sangiovese, 15% Sagrantino and 15% Colorino boasts juicy black cherry, blackberry and raspberry flavors, while notes of white pepper and cinnamon add depth. It's balanced and delicious with fine-grained tannins. Enjoy through 2016.
title: Perticaia 2011  Montefalco Rosso

description: This iconic bottling, a blend of 80% Sangiovese and 20% Canaiolo, features aromas of ripe black fruit, violet, grilled herb, toast and espresso. The palate delivers juicy black cherry, crushed raspberry, vanilla and mocha alongside firm but refined tannins. It closes on a licorice note. Drink 2015–2023.
title: Lungarotti 2008 Vigna Monticchio Red (Torgiano Rosso Riserva)

description: Falesco's Riccardo Cotarella makes some of Italy's best Merlot. His talents are evident in this easygoing expression from Umbria, which is rich and succulent, bearing dark tones of blackberry, leather and sweet chocolate.
title: Falesco 2010 Merlot (Umbria)

description: Castello Banfi in Tuscany does a great job with Chardonnay, as evidenced by this wine. It's rich and soft, with bright aromas of peach, citrus, vanilla and savory herb. A pinch of acidity on the finish works beautifully as well.
title: Castello Banfi 2011 Fontanelle Chardonnay (Toscana)

description: Castello Banfi in Tuscany does a great job with Chardonnay, as evidenced by this wine. It's rich and soft, with bright aromas of peach, citrus, vanilla and savory herb. A pinch of acidity on the finish works beautifully as well.
title: Castello Banfi 2011 Fontanelle Chardonnay (Toscana)

description: Light in color and lean in consistency, this offers subtle aromas of citrus, honey and grapefruit. The wine is refreshing and crisp overall.
title: Straccali 2011 Pinot Grigio (Provincia di Pavia)

description: This is vinified in cement vats to retain the purity of fruit and easy crispness. You will also notice slight dusty tones of crushed mineral and vitamin on the finish.
title: Piazzano 2011  Chianti

description: This is a gorgeous, creamy wine. A blend of Pinot Grigio, Chardonnay and Sauvignon, Lis offers everything you look for in a quality Italian white. It's crisp and fruit-driven and delivers good staying power and freshness.
title: Lis Neris 2006 Lis White (Venezia Giulia)

description: Plum cake, resin, leather, raisin and exotic spice aromas come together in the glass. On the dense palate, licorice, chopped sage and tobacco notes accent prune and blackberry while firm, fine-grained tannins offers support.
title: Corte Moschina 2011  Amarone della Valpolicella

description: Crushed violet, baking spice, scorched earth, ripe black-skinned fruit and a whiff of leather meld together on this velvety red. The round, ripe palate doles out raspberry jam, dried black cherry, raisin, ground pepper and licorice accompanied by firm, polished tannins. Drink 2016–2021.
title: Tenuta Santa Maria alla Pieve 2009  Amarone della Valpolicella

description: Crushed violet, baking spice, scorched earth, ripe black-skinned fruit and a whiff of leather meld together on this velvety red. The round, ripe palate doles out raspberry jam, dried black cherry, raisin, ground pepper and licorice accompanied by firm, polished tannins. Drink 2016–2021.
title: Tenuta Santa Maria alla Pieve 2009  Amarone della Valpolicella

description: Simple, clean and easygoing, this fresh Chianti delivers some mature tones of strawberry and cherry backed by chewy succulence and medium structure.
title: Pio Wines 2007  Chianti

description: Simple, clean and easygoing, this fresh Chianti delivers some mature tones of strawberry and cherry backed by chewy succulence and medium structure.
title: Pio Wines 2007  Chianti

description: Cypresses is a direct and charming expression of Sangiovese from Tuscany that seems designed for informal dinners with family and friends. Simple aromas of berry and forest fruit are followed by fresh crispness.
title: Villa Pillo 2008 Cypresses Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: Cypresses is a direct and charming expression of Sangiovese from Tuscany that seems designed for informal dinners with family and friends. Simple aromas of berry and forest fruit are followed by fresh crispness.
title: Villa Pillo 2008 Cypresses Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: From the Cortona area of eastern Tuscany, here is a simple, bright and crisp expression of Sangiovese that would pair with grilled meat or sausage.
title: La Calonica 2009 Calcinaio Sangiovese (Cortona)

description: The perfect pizza or easy pasta wine, this simple Chianti offers loads of sweet fruit and crisp freshness. It feels silky but simple on the close.
title: Fattoria di Casalbosco 2009 Casalbosco  (Chianti)

description: A bit muddled aromatically at first, give this wine a few minutes in the glass to find its voice. Once it does, it delivers an easy, straightforward rendition of cherry, blueberry and toasted almond.
title: Podere San Cristoforo 2008 Carandelle  (Maremma)

description: Cetamura is a consistently excellent value wine from Tuscany that shows bright berry and forest fruit nuances backed by a crisp but thin mouthfeel. Those qualities make it an ideal choice for cheesy pasta.
title: Badia a Coltibuono 2008 Cetamura  (Chianti)

description: From the hot 2003 vintage, this vineyard-designate Riserva Chianti (Sangiovese with small components of Canaiolo and Cabernet Sauvignon) is thin and marked by tertiary aromas of dried fruit and butterscotch. Drink now.
title: Fattoria di Petrognano 2003 Vigna Santa Riserva  (Chianti)

description: A flashy, modern-style wine, Modus takes traditional Tuscan flavors of leather and tobacco, dresses them up with cassis, vanilla and toast and wraps all that in a cocoon of lush, supple tannins. An immediately approachable blend of 50% Sangiovese, 25% Cabernet Sauvignon and 25% Merlot.
title: Ruffino 2003 Modus Red (Toscana)

description: A lush fruit nose, with plenty of blackberry jam, woodsmoke and anise. Quite chunky on the palate, but amaiable and easy going, although not a particularly long finish. A pleasant food friendly wine for a weekday night after a hard day at work.
title: Ca' Viola 2005 Barturot  (Dolcetto d'Alba)

description: This stylish Barbera has a bright, fresh nose of sweet strawberry, roses and licorice. On the palate, the freshness of the fruit comes through. beautifully. Full flavored without being full bodied. Slightly old fashioned and delicious.
title: Pio Cesare 2005  Barbera d'Alba

description: This stylish Barbera has a bright, fresh nose of sweet strawberry, roses and licorice. On the palate, the freshness of the fruit comes through. beautifully. Full flavored without being full bodied. Slightly old fashioned and delicious.
title: Pio Cesare 2005  Barbera d'Alba

description: Giacosa Fratelli (to be distinguished from the venerable house of Bruno Giacosa) tends to make good, solid wines but never anything really earth shattering. This proved to be one of his best, a lovely nose of dark fruit, chocolate, soy and smoked meat. Quite soft on the palate, but rich and layered,and although it showed a touch of mid palate hollowness, the finish was good if somewhat chunky. Needs 3-5 years to really come round.
title: Giacosa Fratelli 2003 Bussia  (Barolo)

title: Giacosa Fratelli 2003 Bussia  (Barolo)

description: A fat rich wine with an exuberant personality. Plenty of  hefty, ripe  fruit, a big chunky palate and a good, long luscious finish. While it is not as complex as some other 2003 Barolos, it is friendly and solid and will work beautifully with food.
title: Poderi Colla 2003 Dardi Le Rose Bussia  (Barolo)

description: A fat rich wine with an exuberant personality. Plenty of  hefty, ripe  fruit, a big chunky palate and a good, long luscious finish. While it is not as complex as some other 2003 Barolos, it is friendly and solid and will work beautifully with food.
title: Poderi Colla 2003 Dardi Le Rose Bussia  (Barolo)

description: Many 2000 Barolos are showing signs of retreating into their shells, none more so than this. This was initially very dumb, and only after a good deal of swirling and plenty of time in the glass did it begin to show anything. At last, dark fruit,  earth, rose petal and road tar began to emerge. On the palate it was tannic and again took its time to open, but again it showed some complexity, with a medium finish. A wine that needs a decade in the cellar.
title: Beni di Batasiolo 2000 Vigneto Boscareto  (Barolo)

description: Lovely, complex nose of dark fruit, licorice, rose and woodmeal. Delivered the same but in a muted form in the mouth. It seemed to be running out of steam in mid-palate, it came back to post a pleasant and nicely layered finish.
title: Marcarini 2003 La Serra  (Barolo)

description: Lovely, complex nose of dark fruit, licorice, rose and woodmeal. Delivered the same but in a muted form in the mouth. It seemed to be running out of steam in mid-palate, it came back to post a pleasant and nicely layered finish.
title: Marcarini 2003 La Serra  (Barolo)

description: Toast, underbrush, leather, truffle, mature black-skinned berry and game are some of the aromas you'll find on this. The round, juicy palate offers ripe Morello cherry, a hint of stewed berry, grilled herb, hazelnut and clove while firm, fine-grained tannins offer seamless support. Drink 2018–2025.
title: Castello di Verduno 2013 Rabajà  (Barbaresco)

description: Toast, underbrush, leather, truffle, mature black-skinned berry and game are some of the aromas you'll find on this. The round, juicy palate offers ripe Morello cherry, a hint of stewed berry, grilled herb, hazelnut and clove while firm, fine-grained tannins offer seamless support. Drink 2018–2025.
title: Castello di Verduno 2013 Rabajà  (Barbaresco)

description: Balsamic aromas, leather, truffle, soil and ripe berry scents take center stage. The chewy, structured palate offers succulent Morello cherry, fleshy raspberry and cake spice alongside firm, fine-grained tannins. A star anise note closes the finish. Drink 2018–2025.
title: Cascina Morassino 2013 Morassino  (Barbaresco)

description: Blue flower, woodland berry, cake spice, menthol and a whisper of vineyard dust come together on the nose while the smooth, juicy, palate doles out ripe red cherry, crushed strawberry, star anise and cinnamon. It's a lovely wine, with polished, enveloping tannins and fresh acidity that provide an elegant, accessible structure.
title: Carlo Giacosa 2013 Narin  (Barbaresco)

description: Intense, enticing aromas of violet, rose and leather lead the nose along with an earthy whiff of game. The palate is still young and primary, but already offers red berry, licorice, white pepper and cinnamon. Tightly wound, assertive tannins and bright acidity provide balance. Drink after 2020.
title: Attilio Ghisolfi 2012 Bussia  (Barolo)

description: Fig, stewed prune, sun baked soil, camphor and exotic spice aromas lead the nose. On the palate, close-grained tannins support dried black cherry, orange zest, grilled herb and clove that leave to a rather austere finish. Drink 2018–2023.
title: Ada Nada 2012 Rombone Elisa  (Barbaresco)

description: This full-bodied red opens with aromas of underbrush, raspberry compote and dark baking spice. The brooding palate offers mature black cherry, white pepper, cinnamon, grilled herb and licorice alongside a backbone of assertive tannins. Drink 2020–2028.
title: Aldo Conterno 2012 Bussia Romirasco  (Barolo)

description: A tribute to the late Angelo Rocca, this delicious wine opens with aromas suggesting leather, truffle, mature black-skinned berry, fragrant blue flower and a whiff of menthol. The smooth, full-bodied palate offers mouthfuls of red cherry, juicy raspberry, and a note of cake spice while fine-grained tannins provide polished support.
title: Albino Rocca 2013 Angelo  (Barbaresco)

description: This nicely balanced Pinot Bianco is fresh and crisp, blending peach, apple and grapefruit aromas and flavors together into a cohesive whole. Plump on the midpalate, yet steely and food-friendly on the finish.
title: Jermann 2001 Pinot Bianco (Venezia Giulia)

description: From a single vineyard, this exemplary Soave has great intensity and concentration, with flavors of peppers and ripe, green fruits. The wine's long fermentation wine gives it structure and great extraction of flavor.
title: Gini 2001 La Froscà  (Soave Classico)

description: This wine is the white partner to Masi's familiar Campfiorin. In this case, it is the 25% of Verduzzo grapes in the blend that have gone through the drying process known as passito. The 75% of Pinot Grigio adds spice, while the Verduzzo gives great richness and ripeness.
title: Masi 2002 Masianco White (Delle Venezie)

description: This wine is the white partner to Masi's familiar Campfiorin. In this case, it is the 25% of Verduzzo grapes in the blend that have gone through the drying process known as passito. The 75% of Pinot Grigio adds spice, while the Verduzzo gives great richness and ripeness.
title: Masi 2002 Masianco White (Delle Venezie)

description: This is still a closed, young wine, but the potential of the spicy, ripe, but still light and elegant fruit is going to be great. Intense concentration seems to be the hallmark of the wines made by Gianni Menotti at this great estate.
title: Villa Russiz 2002 Tocai (Collio)

description: There's a slight coppery tinge to this wine's color, which sets it apart from the vast majority of other Grigios on the market. And maybe it's just the suggestion of the hue, but it seems to taste "pink" as well, showcasing ripe berries and appples backed by tangy acids and great length. Classy stuff.
title: Livio Felluga 2001 Pinot Grigio (Friuli Venezia Giulia)

description: There's a slight coppery tinge to this wine's color, which sets it apart from the vast majority of other Grigios on the market. And maybe it's just the suggestion of the hue, but it seems to taste "pink" as well, showcasing ripe berries and appples backed by tangy acids and great length. Classy stuff.
title: Livio Felluga 2001 Pinot Grigio (Friuli Venezia Giulia)

description: Elena Walch's fantasy wine is a blend of Chardonnay and four other varieties that she does not reveal. Eighteen months in oak give the wine a fine, toasty character and creamy fruit, but still leaves the hallmark Alto Adige crispness and freshness.
title: Elena Walch 2001 Beyond the Clouds White (Alto Adige)

description: Elena Walch's fantasy wine is a blend of Chardonnay and four other varieties that she does not reveal. Eighteen months in oak give the wine a fine, toasty character and creamy fruit, but still leaves the hallmark Alto Adige crispness and freshness.
title: Elena Walch 2001 Beyond the Clouds White (Alto Adige)

description: This is a rare example of a successful wood-aged Sauvignon Blanc. The fruit comes from the Lafoa vineyard in Cornaiano. Half the wine has new oak barrel fermentation, the other was kept in stainless steel, cutting the wood flavors to an elegant balance with the floral and mineral flavors.
title: Produttori Colterenzio 2001 Lafoa Sauvignon Blanc (Alto Adige)

description: Pungent and smoky, filled with minerals and grapefruit, this is top-flight Sauvignon Blanc. The mouthfeel is smooth, silky and slightly creamy; the finish, long and delicate.
title: Cantina Terlano 2001 Quarz Sauvignon Blanc (Alto Adige)

description: There's smoke, pink grapefruit, graphite and just a hint of asparagus on the nose, but virtually nothing to indicate this wine is over 10 years old. Honeyed grapefruit flavors feature a liberal dusting of minerals on the long finish.
title: Cantina Terlano 1992 Riserva Sauvignon Blanc (Alto Adige)

description: This relatively full-bodied Pinot Grigio leans toward warm, baked-apple scents and flavors, blending ripe fruit with dried cinnamon and folding in hints of peach on the long finish. Has a lovely, caressing mouthfeel that underscores its comforting flavors.
title: Jermann 2001 Pinot Grigio (Venezia Giulia)

description: This relatively full-bodied Pinot Grigio leans toward warm, baked-apple scents and flavors, blending ripe fruit with dried cinnamon and folding in hints of peach on the long finish. Has a lovely, caressing mouthfeel that underscores its comforting flavors.
title: Jermann 2001 Pinot Grigio (Venezia Giulia)

description: Mario Schiopetto and his sons, Carlo and Giorgio, draw astonishingly intense flavors from the lees contact this wine has until bottling.It is powerful with rich, spicy fruit and flavors of pepper, vanilla and apricot.
title: Mario Schiopetto 2001 Pinot Bianco (Collio)

description: Shows a rich blend of citrus and stone fruits on the nose and on the palate, easily combining grapefruit, passion fruit and nectarines into a cohesive package. Finishes long, with tangy, lip-smacking acids that beg you to give this wine some time in the cellar. It's tasty now, but should be better in 2005.
title: Jermann 2001 Vintage Tunina White (Venezia Giulia)

description: Shows a rich blend of citrus and stone fruits on the nose and on the palate, easily combining grapefruit, passion fruit and nectarines into a cohesive package. Finishes long, with tangy, lip-smacking acids that beg you to give this wine some time in the cellar. It's tasty now, but should be better in 2005.
title: Jermann 2001 Vintage Tunina White (Venezia Giulia)

description: Pinot Grigio grape berries aren't actually gray; instead they are tinged with pink or purple. Maybe it is just the power of suggestion, but this wine even seems to taste pink, showcasing ripe berries and apples that are backed by tangy acids and great length. Classy stuff.
title: Livio Felluga 2002 Pinot Grigio (Friuli Venezia Giulia)

description: Piccini's top wine is this super Tuscan that puts 60% Sangiovese with Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Merlot in a successful blend of tobacco, earth and dark fruit flavors. The '99 is firmer in structure than the '97, a reflection of the vintage.
title: Valiano 1999 Vino in Musica Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: Aromas of ripe pears and peaches jump out of the glass, and the flavors follow suit, bouncing across the palate in a display of stone fruits. It's relatively full bodied, but a garnish of grapefruit zest on the finish keeps it balanced and lively. Best Buy.
title: Pieropan 2001  Soave Classico Superiore

description: Underbrush, chopped aromatic herb, wild berry and a hint of new leather are the main scent notes. The bright, structured palate is full of layers of juicy red cherry, crushed raspberry, cinnamon, mint and tobacco set against a backbone of chewy tannins. It's already accessible, and while not loaded with complexity, it is delicious. Drink through 2020.
title: Marchesato degli Aleramici 2011  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Tilled earth, mature black-skinned fruit, leather, eucalyptus and truffle aromas come together on this concentrated wine. The firm palate offers dried black cherry, blackberry jam, coffee and licorice aromas alongside brooding tannins. Drink 2016–2021.
title: Tenuta di Lilliano 2011 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Made with 80% Sangiovese, 10% Pugnitello and 10% Colorino, this savory, firmly structured wine offers aromas that recall baked plum, prune, resin, blue flower, leather and a balsamic note. The chewy, concentrated palate delivers juicy black cherry, mature blackberry, vanilla, cinnamon and mocha. Dusty tannins provide support. Drink through 2021.
title: San Felice 2011 Poggio Rosso Gran Selezione  (Chianti Classico)

description: Firm and fragrant, this opens with scents of violet, iris, ripe plum and sweet baking spice. The chewy palate delivers dried plum, ripe black cherry, white pepper, anise and clove while fine-grained, polished tannins provide support.
title: Panzanello 2011 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Big and bold, this opens on aromas of ripe wild berry, forest floor, sunbaked earth, leather and grilled herb. The concentrated palate offers fleshy Morello cherry, raspberry jam, licorice, clove and dried herb while firm, velvety tannins provide the framework. You'll also notice the warmth of alcohol on the close but the fruit richness keeps it in check. Drink 2018–2025.
title: Franci 2011  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Aromas recalling underbrush, truffle, leather, toast, red berry and a whiff of blue flower emerge on this bold Brunello. The full-bodied palate shows wild cherry, cinnamon, anise and dried herb alongside youthfully assertive tannins. It's still tight so give it several more years to unwind and develop complexity. Drink 2020–2026.
title: Sesti 2011  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Aromas recalling underbrush, truffle, leather, toast, red berry and a whiff of blue flower emerge on this bold Brunello. The full-bodied palate shows wild cherry, cinnamon, anise and dried herb alongside youthfully assertive tannins. It's still tight so give it several more years to unwind and develop complexity. Drink 2020–2026.
title: Sesti 2011  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Sweet Zibibbo grapes are dried under the sun for concentration and power. Abraxas makes one of the most traditional interpretations with a dark amber color and pure aromas of raisin, dried apricot and chestnut honey.
title: Abraxas 2007  Passito di Pantelleria

description: Here's a lightly oak-aged Recioto di Soave that opens with an intensely golden color and beautiful aromas of raw honey, roasted almond and chestnut, backed by candied fruit and apricot.
title: Sandro de Bruno 2007 Monte Calvarina  (Recioto di Soave)

description: Truffle, black plum, game and leather aromas come together in the glass. On the savory palate, notes of mint, dried sage and white pepper accent a core of juicy black cherry while polished tannins provide the framework. It's already accessible and delicious. Drink through 2016.
title: Falchini 2012 Titolato Colombaia  (Chianti Colli Senesi)

description: This pretty expression of Sangiovese and 5% Canaiolo opens with aromas of wild berry, plum, violet, wet earth and a whiff of Mediterranean herb. The lively, easy-drinking palate delivers sour cherry, black raspberry, black pepper and espresso alongside sleek tannins and bright acidity.
title: Castellare di Castellina 2013  Chianti Classico

description: This pretty expression of Sangiovese and 5% Canaiolo opens with aromas of wild berry, plum, violet, wet earth and a whiff of Mediterranean herb. The lively, easy-drinking palate delivers sour cherry, black raspberry, black pepper and espresso alongside sleek tannins and bright acidity.
title: Castellare di Castellina 2013  Chianti Classico

description: Aromas of plum, dark berry, iris, tobacco and a whiff of menthol emerge in the glass. The palate is a bit more subdued than the nose, offering dried black cherry, mint, dark spice and a hint of coffee. Soft, smooth tannins give it polish and an easy-drinking vibe.
title: Castellani 2012 Campomaggio  (Chianti Classico)

description: Aromas of dried black-skinned fruit, cedar, charred earth and ground pepper lead the nose. The palate offers dried black cherry, ripe blackberry, clove, allspice and tobacco alongside fine-grained tannins. Drink through 2018.
title: Carpineto 2010 Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Aromas of underbrush, blackcurrant, oak and cake spice lead the nose of this blend of Sangiovese and 15% Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon. The palate offers dried blackberry accented with oak-driven spices of coconut, vanilla, mocha and cedar alongside assertive tannins. Drink through 2016–2022.
title: Carpineto 2007 Sant'Ercolano  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Aromas of underbrush, blackcurrant, oak and cake spice lead the nose of this blend of Sangiovese and 15% Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon. The palate offers dried blackberry accented with oak-driven spices of coconut, vanilla, mocha and cedar alongside assertive tannins. Drink through 2016–2022.
title: Carpineto 2007 Sant'Ercolano  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Aromas of toast, mocha and baked plum lead the nose of this blend of Sangiovese and 10% Colorino. The taut palate offers dried wild cherry, raspberry, mint and ground pepper alongside fine-grained tannins. Drink 2016–2021.
title: Villa Cerna 2011 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Bright and savory, this offers aromas of wild berry, lilac, baking spice and a whiff of menthol. On the palate, notes of grilled herb, coffee and aniseed accent the wild cherry core while chewy tannins offer support.
title: Villa Calcinaia 2012 Piegaia  (Chianti Classico)

description: Aromas of underbrush, baked earth, cedar and a whiff of game lead the nose. The palate offers dried black cherry, anise, black pepper and grilled sage alongside brooding tannins. It's a bit rustic but has an earthy appeal. Drink through 2019.
title: Travignoli 2010 Tegolaia Riserva  (Chianti Rufina)

description: A blend of Sangiovese, 10% Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, this offers aromas that recall ripe plum, sun-baked earth and black pepper. The round, ripe palate doles out fleshy black cherry, cinnamon, mocha and a confectionary note alongside lithe tannins.
title: San Felice 2012 Villa La Pagliaia  (Chianti Classico)

description: Aromas of blackberry, blue flower and a whiff of aniseed lead the nose. The medium-bodied palate offers ripe black cherry, vanilla, clove, white pepper and grilled herb alongside assertive, tightly knit tannins that leave a rather astringent finish. Drink 2016–2021.
title: Rocca di Castagnoli 2011 Stielle Gran Selezione  (Chianti Classico)

description: Aromas of ripe plum, oak-driven spice and a whiff of pressed violet waft out of the glass. The sturdy, straightforward palate delivers dried black cherry, peppercorn and licorice alongside solid tannins. Drink 2017–2022.
title: Poggio alla Sala 2012  Vino Nobile di Montepulciano

description: A skillful blending of 50% Barbera and 50% Nebbiolo, the Cogno has lovely wild strawberry aromas, cranberry and a touch of licorice. Light bodied but with fairly intense flavors, it was pleasant and interesting, its only fault lay in the slightly high acidity.
title: Elvio Cogno 2004 Montegrilli Red (Langhe)

description: Stunning and sophisticated, it leads with intense aromas of elder flowers, tropical fruit, spice and hay. The structured but elegant palate delivers creamy peach, melon, and exotic fruit accented with notes of spice and energizing mineral purity alongside vibrant acidity. Throughout, it shows impeccable balance and depth.
title: Cantina Produttori San Michele Appiano 2012 Sanct Valentin Sauvignon (Alto Adige)

description: Here's an informal off-dry sparkler offering suggestions of apple and pear. It's fresh and simple, with crisp acidity.
title: Bolla NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: Fun and informal, this extremely simple sparkler offers flavors of white peach, citrus and confectionery note. It's bright and foamy, with fresh acidity.
title: Alberto Nani NV Organic Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: Stone fruit and honeysuckle aromas lead the nose while the simple off-dry palate doles out green apple, peach and candied citrus peel. It's fresh and informal, with bright acidity.
title: Acinum NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: Aromas of mature apple and acacia carry through to the simple palate along with a hint of pineapple. It's fresh and informal, with bright acidity.
title: Piera Martellozzo NV Giade Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: This light simple sparkler offers aromas and flavors of apple, pear and candied citrus zest. Bright acidity refreshes the finish.
title: Piera Martellozzo NV Blu Giovello Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: This offers aromas of yellow stone fruit and pressed acacia flower. On the lean palate, racy acidity frames suggestions of yellow apple skin, lime and salty mineral while a bitter almond note marks the close.
title: Pagani 2014  Soave Classico

description: Refreshing and fun, this simple informal sparkler has aromas and flavors suggesting green apple, Anjou pear and a hint of lemon zest. It's brisk and bright, with invigorating bubbles.
title: Candoni NV Brut  (Prosecco)

description: The only wine of its kind in existence, Massifitti is a pure expression of the Trebbiano di Soave grape packaged in a heavy bottle and sealed with red wax. This white wine opens with aromas of candied fruit, lemon drop, pineapple, bee's wax, peach and smokey mineral.
title: Suavia 2008 Massifitti Trebbiano (Veronese)

description: Aromas of apple, cherry and liqueur open. The racy airy palate offers mature red-apple skin and toasted nut alongside big, vigorous bubbles.
title: Vite Colte 2015 La Gatta  (Moscato d'Asti)

description: White spring flower and orchard fruit aromas float out of the glass. The bright breezy palate shows crisp green apple, peach and a hint of tangerine zest alongside a soft mousse and vibrant acidity.
title: Valdo 2014 Numero 10 Metodo Classico  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Rossojbleo opens with distinct aromas of oatmeal cookie, Graham cracker and bright red fruit. It's a unique expression, with just enough acidity to keep the plate refreshed.
title: Gulfi 2009 Rossojbleo Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: This pretty expression of Riesling Renano offers fruity aromas of pear and peach backed by natural rubber and fragrant floral tones. The wine is soft, smooth and thick on the close.
title: Fondazione Edmund Mach 2010 Istituto Agrario San Michele all'Adige Riesling (Trentino)

description: Missoni is an oak-aged Cabernet Sauvignon that opens with soft, chewy fruit and aromas of cherry liqueur, rum cake, espresso and exotic spice. The mouthfeel is plush, round and driven by plump blackberry flavors.
title: Feudi del Pisciotto 2009 Missoni Cabernet Sauvignon (Sicilia)

description: Versace is a smooth but easy Sicilian Nero d'Avola with ripe fruit and loads of dark, sun-ripened concentration. The mouthfeel is soft, round and chewy.
title: Feudi del Pisciotto 2008 Versace Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: Named after fashion designer Alberta Ferretti, this oak-aged Chardonnay delivers layers of soft, ripe mango and pineapple. The mouthfeel is thick and creamy.
title: Feudi del Pisciotto 2008 Alberta Ferretti Chardonnay (Sicilia)

description: From the Erice area of Sicily in the southwest corner of the island, this bright Insolia offers crisp aromas of citrus, cut grass and white almond. It's a simple, genuine wine that is put together nicely.
title: Fazio 2010 Levàntio Insolia (Erice)

description: This estate dominates one of the most beautiful wine valleys in the southern half of Sicily. Rolling hills and chalky white soils help shape a bright but polished Syrah with sharp berry tones and lingering notes of crushed stone and talcum powder.
title: Feudo Principi di Butera 2008 Syrah (Sicilia)

description: This aged wine shows tertiary aromas of dried fruit, cured meat, bresaola and toasted almond. The wine is garnet in color with browning hues. Drink immediately.
title: Tenuta Barone Nicolò La Lumia 2002 Torreforte Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: Leone d'Almerita is a blend of Catarratto, Chardonnay, Sauvignon and Traminer that opens with a fragrant floral bouquet and pretty notes of honey, peach blossom and marzipan.
title: Tasca d'Almerita 2010 Leone d'Almerita White (Sicilia)

description: Terre di Giumara is a fresh and tight white wine with bright yellow fruit, peach and honey-roasted almond. The wine is full and ripe, with a touch of piquant spice on the close.
title: Caruso & Minini 2010 Terre di Giumara Inzolia (Sicilia)

description: Terre di Giumara is a fresh and tight white wine with bright yellow fruit, peach and honey-roasted almond. The wine is full and ripe, with a touch of piquant spice on the close.
title: Caruso & Minini 2010 Terre di Giumara Inzolia (Sicilia)

description: Dietro le Case (“behind the houses”) is a pure expression of Inzolia that opens with a pale hay color and fragrant aromas of melon, apricot and dried flowers. It's a simple, fresh wine with accents of citrus and honey.
title: Cantine Barbera 2010 Dietro le Case Inzolia (Menfi)

description: From the beautiful Menfi area of southern Sicily comes this clean and genuine expression of Nero d'Avola featuring bright berry aromas and silky tannins. Pair this wine with roast pork.
title: Cantine Barbera 2009 Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: From the beautiful Menfi area of southern Sicily comes this clean and genuine expression of Nero d'Avola featuring bright berry aromas and silky tannins. Pair this wine with roast pork.
title: Cantine Barbera 2009 Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: Lunario offers bright sensations of cola, wild berry, red rose and drying talc powder. The wine boasts a thick, textured mouthfeel, and finishes with toasted notes of almond and pistachio.
title: Brugnano 2008 Lunario Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: Chardonnay (75%) and Grillo are blended to produce an intense wine with pungent notes of ripe fruit, pineapple, candied lemon and yellow rose. There is alcoholic heat on the close but it is softened by the general density and thickness of the wine's texture.
title: Baglio del Cristo di Campobello 2010 Adènzia White (Sicilia)

description: Chardonnay (75%) and Grillo are blended to produce an intense wine with pungent notes of ripe fruit, pineapple, candied lemon and yellow rose. There is alcoholic heat on the close but it is softened by the general density and thickness of the wine's texture.
title: Baglio del Cristo di Campobello 2010 Adènzia White (Sicilia)

description: Delicio is a Sicilian expression of Fiano with a creamy mouthfeel and easy aromas of dried hay, pear and Golden Delicious apple. Pair this wine with Caesar salad.
title: Viticultori Associati Canicatti 2009 Delicio Fiano (Sicilia)

description: Made with organically cultivated Sangiovese, this full-bodied dessert wine boasts aromas of maple syrup, apricot, candied ginger and dried clove. The palate doles out candied nectarine, maple syrup, white almond and glazed brown sugar.
title: Badia a Coltibuono 2004 Occhio di Pernice  (Vin Santo del Chianti Classico)

description: Aromas of black plum, cake spice and hints of leather and tilled earth lead the nose. The spicy palate combines elegance and structure, offering black cherry, vanilla, mocha and white pepper alongside firm but fine-grained tannins. Drink 2016–2022.
title: Salcheto 2010 Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Aromas of tilled soil, blue flower, spicy plum cake and a balsamic note waft out of the glass. The structured but refined palate delivers mature blackberry, prune, menthol and allspice alongside bracing but fine-grained tannins. The lingering finish closes on a licorice note. Drink 2016–2024.
title: Goretti 2009  Montefalco Sagrantino

description: Aromas of tilled soil, blue flower, spicy plum cake and a balsamic note waft out of the glass. The structured but refined palate delivers mature blackberry, prune, menthol and allspice alongside bracing but fine-grained tannins. The lingering finish closes on a licorice note. Drink 2016–2024.
title: Goretti 2009  Montefalco Sagrantino

description: Here's a strange Sauvignon with aromas of caper and dill weed that are backed by pungent aromas of bitter almond and mature peach. The wine has a tonic, soda-like quality in the mouth and a bitter close.
title: Principi di Porcìa 2008 Ca' Bembo Sauvignon (Friuli Grave)

description: Here's a strange Sauvignon with aromas of caper and dill weed that are backed by pungent aromas of bitter almond and mature peach. The wine has a tonic, soda-like quality in the mouth and a bitter close.
title: Principi di Porcìa 2008 Ca' Bembo Sauvignon (Friuli Grave)

description: Underbrush, tobacco, new leather, crushed herb and a whiff of mature plum lead the way. The juicy full-bodied palate is still young and taut, evoking ripe black cherry, crushed raspberry, licorice, clove and a hint of coffee. A backbone of youthfully austere fine-grained tannins and bright acidity gives it an age-worthy structure and balance. Drink 2020–2032.
title: Ruffino 2012 Greppone Mazzi  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Initially reserved, this ethereal red took some time to open but it was worth the wait, revealing enticing scents of violet, wild berry, rosemary and Mediterranean brush. The palate is all about extreme elegance, offering wild cherry, crushed strawberry, grilled herb and star anise alongside firm, refined tannins. Best 2018–2023.
title: Poggio di Sotto 2011 Riserva  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Initially reserved, this ethereal red took some time to open but it was worth the wait, revealing enticing scents of violet, wild berry, rosemary and Mediterranean brush. The palate is all about extreme elegance, offering wild cherry, crushed strawberry, grilled herb and star anise alongside firm, refined tannins. Best 2018–2023.
title: Poggio di Sotto 2011 Riserva  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Aged on its lees for over 10 years, this stunning wine shows the extraordinary aging potential of Pinot Bianco in Alto Adige. It boasts enticing scents of ripe orchard fruit, vanilla, graphite and a whiff of oak that carry over to the radiant palate along with ripe apple, candied lemon drop and nectarine zest. Bright acidity lends balance while a flinty mineral note backs up the lingering finish. Loaded with finesse and complexity, it's simply gorgeous.
title: Terlan 2004 Rarità 2004 Pinot Bianco (Alto Adige)

description: Enticing Sangiovese aromas of truffle, ripe dark-skinned berry, pressed violet and new leather lead the way on this delicious red. The smooth succulent palate doles out juicy Marasca cherry, crushed raspberry, baking spice and wild herb framed in velvety tannins that envelope the palate while a licorice note wraps around the finish. Drink 2018–2026.
title: Collosorbo 2011 Riserva  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Enticing Sangiovese aromas of truffle, ripe dark-skinned berry, pressed violet and new leather lead the way on this delicious red. The smooth succulent palate doles out juicy Marasca cherry, crushed raspberry, baking spice and wild herb framed in velvety tannins that envelope the palate while a licorice note wraps around the finish. Drink 2018–2026.
title: Collosorbo 2011 Riserva  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Enticing intense aromas including exotic fruit, fragrant white wild flower, cut grass and Alpine herb offer an intriguing introduction to this stunning wine. One of Italy's most iconic bottlings, it has an inviting full-bodied palate, delivering layers of ripe pineapple, juicy white grapefruit and energizing mineral notes. Mouthwatering acidity closes the long lingering finish.
title: Cantina Produttori San Michele Appiano 2015 Sanct Valentin Sauvignon (Alto Adige)
