One of Italy's most iconic bottlings, it has an inviting full-bodied palate, delivering layers of ripe pineapple, juicy white grapefruit and energizing mineral notes. Mouthwatering acidity closes the long lingering finish.
title: Cantina Produttori San Michele Appiano 2015 Sanct Valentin Sauvignon (Alto Adige)

description: This is dominated by oak, toasted coffee beans and a hint of meat juices. The palate is short and finishes on a green note, with bitter wood tannins.
title: Mauro Molino 2009 Vigna Gancia  (Barolo)

description: This is dominated by oak, toasted coffee beans and a hint of meat juices. The palate is short and finishes on a green note, with bitter wood tannins.
title: Mauro Molino 2009 Vigna Gancia  (Barolo)

description: From the Conca vineyard in La Morra, this Barolo shows the uneven ripening that plagued much of this village in 2009. It shows predominantly wood aromas of chocolate and toast, and the palate is also dominated by oak sensations. The fruit appears to have dried up, leaving only aggressive, astringent tannins.
title: Mauro Molino 2009 Vigna Conca  (Barolo)

description: Subdued aromas of French oak, espresso, game and a hint of exotic spice come together in the glass. The palate delivers toast, licorice, roasted coffee bean, fleshy black cherry and oak-driven spice accompanied by fine-grained tannins. It's already rather evolved so drink sooner rather than later.
title: Poggio Borgoni 2011 Borromeo Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: This opens with aromas suggesting spearmint, blackcurrant jam, toasted oak and roasted coffee bean. The aromas follow through to the evolved palate along with raisin and anise while raspy tannins clench the finish.
title: Paradiso di Frassina 2010 Flauto Magico Riserva  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: This wine shows dark spice, ripe fruit, teriyaki sauce and savory notes of black pepper and leather. It's a dark, penetrating Sangiovese-based wine that will pair with grilled meat or sausage.
title: Terre di Talamo 2007 Tempo Riserva  (Morellino di Scansano)

description: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Syrah are combined to produce a rich, creamy red wine with milk chocolate, blueberry and exotic spice. Emilio Primo is rich, plush and soft in the mouth.
title: Terre del Marchesato 2009 Emilio Primo Red (Toscana)

description: This delightful Chianti Classico shows Sangiovese charisma with bright fruit aromas, cherry, white almond and pressed violets. It's smooth and silky, with a touch of sourness on the close.
title: Querceto di Castellina 2008 L'Aura  (Chianti Classico)

description: Attractive on any table thanks to its vintage-automobile label artwork, this bright Chianti Classico shows ripe fruit aromas of cherry liqueur and plum cake backed by soft, savory exotic spice. It's crisp but velvety smooth on the close.
title: Querceto di Castellina 2007 Belvedere Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Attractive on any table thanks to its vintage-automobile label artwork, this bright Chianti Classico shows ripe fruit aromas of cherry liqueur and plum cake backed by soft, savory exotic spice. It's crisp but velvety smooth on the close.
title: Querceto di Castellina 2007 Belvedere Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: A blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Merlot farmed at super high density for extra concentration and power, Carmione is a rich and supple wine packed tight with black fruit, cured meat, black pepper and tobacco. It ends with a playful touch of bitterness.
title: Pratesi 2008 Carmione Red (Toscana)

description: Toast, dried sage, menthol and a whiff of coconut lead the nose. The raw, extracted palate offers roasted coffee bean, espresso, anise, coconut and hints of dried berry but it lacks fruit richness. Burly, astringent tannins give it a bitter, mouth-puckering finish.
title: Sarotto Roberto 2011 Audace  (Barolo)

description: Toast, dried sage, menthol and a whiff of coconut lead the nose. The raw, extracted palate offers roasted coffee bean, espresso, anise, coconut and hints of dried berry but it lacks fruit richness. Burly, astringent tannins give it a bitter, mouth-puckering finish.
title: Sarotto Roberto 2011 Audace  (Barolo)

description: Fresh and fruity, this simple, easy-drinking red doles out black cherry, blackberry, white pepper and clove. Racy acidity brightens the juicy fruit flavors.
title: Collina San Ponzio 2014  Barbera d'Alba

description: Baked plum, baking spice coconut and vanilla aromas lead the nose. The evolved, fleeting palate offers raisin, nut and a hint of clove. Drink now.
title: Dacapo 2011 Vigna da Capo  (Barbera d'Asti Superiore Nizza)

description: Baked plum, baking spice coconut and vanilla aromas lead the nose. The evolved, fleeting palate offers raisin, nut and a hint of clove. Drink now.
title: Dacapo 2011 Vigna da Capo  (Barbera d'Asti Superiore Nizza)

description: Blue flower, mature plum, licorice, clove, mocha and menthol aromas all come together on this brawny red. The warm, bold palate delivers juicy black cherry, espresso, ground pepper and anisette alongside a backbone of fine-grained tannins. Showing the heat of the vintage, it won't need years to come around. Drink 2018–2028.
title: Tenuta Duecorti 2011 Castelletto  (Barolo)

description: Wild berry, grilled herb, aniseed and a hint of vanilla are some of the aromas you'll find on this attractive red. The linear, elegantly structured palate offers ripe black cherry, raspberry, licorice and grilled sage while a tobacco note closes the firm finish.
title: Deltetto 2011 Braja Riserva  (Roero)

description: Leafy underbrush, truffle, woodland berry and toast aromas lead the nose. The chewy, solid palate offers ripe black cherry, crushed raspberry, grilled sage and ground aniseed alongside bracing tannins and assertive acidity. Drink 2018–2028.
title: Cantina del Nebbiolo 2011 Cannubi Boschis  (Barolo)

description: Leafy underbrush, truffle, woodland berry and toast aromas lead the nose. The chewy, solid palate offers ripe black cherry, crushed raspberry, grilled sage and ground aniseed alongside bracing tannins and assertive acidity. Drink 2018–2028.
title: Cantina del Nebbiolo 2011 Cannubi Boschis  (Barolo)

description: Woodland berry, pressed violet, dark cooking spice, truffle and new leather aromas unfold on this brawny wine. The full-bodied palate doles out ripe black cherry, ground pepper, licorice and tobacco accompanied by velvety tannins. It closes on notes of menthol and the warmth of alcohol. Drink 2018–2028.
title: Giacomo Grimaldi 2011 Sotto Castello di Novello  (Barolo)

description: Woodland berry, pressed violet, dark cooking spice, truffle and new leather aromas unfold on this brawny wine. The full-bodied palate doles out ripe black cherry, ground pepper, licorice and tobacco accompanied by velvety tannins. It closes on notes of menthol and the warmth of alcohol. Drink 2018–2028.
title: Giacomo Grimaldi 2011 Sotto Castello di Novello  (Barolo)

description: Aromas of mature dark-skinned fruit, scorched earth, exotic spice and a whiff of blue flower lead the way. The vibrant, savory palate doles out juicy black cherry, plum, ground pepper and anise set in a framework of racy acidity and softly polished tannins. Enjoy through 2018.
title: Elvio Cogno 2013 Bricco dei Merli  (Barbera d'Alba)

description: Aromas of mature berry, espresso, exotic spice and a whiff of menthol emerge on this full-bodied red. The palate shows dried black cherry, coconut, licorice and roasted coffee bean alongside fine-grained tannins. This isn't a classic Nebbiolo but it's polished, balanced and will appeal to those who enjoy oak-driven sensations.
title: Elio Grasso 2008 Runcot Riserva  (Barolo)

description: This young Barbaresco is somewhat closed, but offers floral Nebbiolo fragrance and toasted oak. The palate shows cherry, spice and coffee notes, but also green, unripe sensations. Finishes short, with drying wood tannins.
title: Montaribaldi 2010  Barbaresco

description: A simple but well made Dolcetto, with aromas of black cherry and stewed prunes followed by plum, licorice and graphite on the palate. It closes with a bitter almond note. This would work well with lasagna.
title: Mario Gagliasso 2011 Vigna Ciabot Russ  (Dolcetto d'Alba)

description: This Barolo is tightly wound, with aggressive tannins and nervous acidity. It lacks complexity and richness despite its core of black cherry fruit. It also shows evident alcoholic warmth and finishes on a green, astringent note.
title: Stroppiana 2008 Leonardo  (Barolo)

description: This Barolo is tightly wound, with aggressive tannins and nervous acidity. It lacks complexity and richness despite its core of black cherry fruit. It also shows evident alcoholic warmth and finishes on a green, astringent note.
title: Stroppiana 2008 Leonardo  (Barolo)

description: Made from 65% Sangiovese and 35% Cabernet Sauvignon—organically farmed—this polished red opens with aromas of black-skinned fruit, violet and Mediterranean herb. On the full-bodied palate, tobacco and aniseed accent a core of ripe black cherry, while firm tannins provide support.
title: Volpaia 2012 Balifico Red (Toscana)

description: This unfiltered, cloudy wine offers aromas of lime and yeast. A blend of Chardonnay (80%) and Viognier (20%), it's grown according to the principles of biodynamic viticulture. The juicy palate doles out white peach, vanilla and lemon, closing on a toasted hazelnut note.
title: Fattoria La Vialla 2015 Barricato Bianco White (Toscana)

description: A blend of Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot, Sangiovese, Alicante and Syrah, this juicy wine opens with aromas of ripe plum, baking spice and a balsamic note. The concentrated palate doles out ripe black cherry, clove and licorice alongside fine-grained tannins.
title: Caiarossa 2012 Aria di Caiarossa Red (Toscana)

description: Aromas of underbrush, cut grass, Mediterranean scrub, red currant and spice take center stage along with a hint of menthol. The soft approachable palate offers blackberry, black currant, star anise, vanilla and white pepper alongside bright acidity and supple tannins.
title: Ca' Marcanda 2014 Promis  (Bolgheri)

description: Spicy, and medium bodied, this has a smoky, spicy nose that recalls charred earth, graphite, black currant and cedar. The smoky quality carries to the palate, along with mature blackberry, allspice, licorice and clove. Firm but fine-grained tannins and fresh acidity provide an uplifting framework.
title: Alberto Longo 2013 Primitivo (Puglia)

description: Made with 70% Nero di Troia plus other varieties, this features aromas of ripe dark berry, bell pepper, game and tobacco. All of these carry over to the palate along with clove and ground black pepper. Assertive but drying tannins provide support. Drink through 2019.
title: Rivera 2009 Il Falcone Riserva Red (Castel del Monte)

description: An elegant expression of this grape, this smooth, full-bodied wine delivers layers of spicy plum, juicy blackberry, graphite, clove and licorice. Firm but velvety tannins provide ample texture and support.
title: Ognissole 2013  Primitivo di Manduria

description: Aromas of blue flower, ripe berry and allspice jump out of the glass of this full-bodied but elegant red. The fresh, juicy palate offers blueberry, blackberry, graphite and a hint of mocha. Firm, fine-grained tannins offer support and give it a smooth texture.
title: Masseria Altemura 2012 Altemura  (Primitivo di Manduria)

description: Made entirely from Cabernet Franc, this offers blueberry, cedar and bell pepper aromas. The palate is juicy, full of red currant, vanilla and Mediterranean herb flavors, held firm with polished tannins and a tart finish. Drink through 2022.
title: Tenuta Sette Cieli 2013 Scipio Red (Toscana)

description: Made entirely from Cabernet Franc, this offers blueberry, cedar and bell pepper aromas. The palate is juicy, full of red currant, vanilla and Mediterranean herb flavors, held firm with polished tannins and a tart finish. Drink through 2022.
title: Tenuta Sette Cieli 2013 Scipio Red (Toscana)

description: Woodland berry, tobacco and cooking spice aromas emerge in the glass. The medium-bodied, already approachable palate doles out juicy black cherry, star anise and white pepper notes, with a frame of ripe, tightly knit tannins. Enjoy 2018–2022.
title: Tenuta Friggiali 2012  Brunello di Montalcino

description: This all-Viognier wine opens with apricot, butterscotch, toast and vanilla notes. On the creamy, full-bodied palate, lime and hazelnut flavors accent a core of juicy yellow peach. Enjoy through 2019.
title: Michele Satta 2014 Giovin Re Viognier (Toscana)

description: Grilled herb, dark spice, forest floor, toast and oak aromas lead the nose. The palate is dense, its mature black cherry, espresso, licorice and tobacco flavors drawn tight with close-grained tannins that leave a compact finish. Drink 2022–2027.
title: Fattoi 2012  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Grilled herb, dark spice, forest floor, toast and oak aromas lead the nose. The palate is dense, its mature black cherry, espresso, licorice and tobacco flavors drawn tight with close-grained tannins that leave a compact finish. Drink 2022–2027.
title: Fattoi 2012  Brunello di Montalcino

description: This blend of Chardonnay and Sauvignon delivers pretty floral and white-fruit aromas, while the long and linear palate shows restrained fruit flavors punctuated by pear and a hint of mineral.
title: Pico Maccario 2012 Estrosa  (Monferrato Bianco)

description: This Barbera has a subtle fragrance of plum and spice. The palate offers restrained black cherry flavors, along with hints of white pepper and nutmeg. Simple, but well made, this would pair perfectly with pasta Bolognese or mushroom dishes.
title: Mauro Molino 2012  Barbera d'Alba

description: It opens with aromas of stone fruit, pineapple and a hint of mineral. Rich flavors of pear, peach and mango accompany an intriguing smoked note. The palate finishes crisp and dry.
title: Terredora 2012 Terre Dora  (Fiano di Avellino)

description: It opens with aromas of stone fruit, pineapple and a hint of mineral. Rich flavors of pear, peach and mango accompany an intriguing smoked note. The palate finishes crisp and dry.
title: Terredora 2012 Terre Dora  (Fiano di Avellino)

description: This blend of 60% Malvasia delle Lipari, 30% Carricante and 10% other native grapes features aromas of subtle oak, coconut and hints of exotic fruit. The round palate delivers sweet nectarine, peach and juicy tropical fruit accented with Mediterranean herbs.
title: Tenuta di Castellaro 2011 Pomice White (Sicilia)

description: This blend of native grapes (80% Caprettone and 20% Catalanesca) conveys delicate fragrances of Spanish broom and white fragrant flowers. The vibrant palate offers apple, citrus and peach accented with notes of Mediterranean herbs. Vinity Wine, Panebianco.
title: Cantine Olivella 2012 Lacrimabianco White (Lacryma Christi del Vesuvio)

description: There's plenty of tropical fruit, white peach, green apple and mineral sensations in this savory wine. The round, juicy palate is supported by fresh acidity that gives it a clean, quenching finish.
title: Cantine Farro 2012 Le Cigliate Falanghina (Campi Flegrei)

description: Made with Carricante from the slopes of Mount Etna, this opens with a floral fragrance of Spanish broom and ripe pear. The linear palate offers Granny Smith apple, citrus and Bartlett pear alongside fresh acidity. It has a bitter, nutty finish.
title: Benanti 2012 Biancodicaselle  (Etna)

description: Rich and full-bodied, it starts with aromas of stone fruit, citrus and slate. The palate is loaded with ripe white peach, mineral and almond. Lively acidity brightens up the creamy texture.
title: Antonio Caggiano 2012 Devon  (Greco di Tufo)

description: This presents aromas of toasted oak, espresso and a whiff of burned tire rubber. The lean palate displays raw, red cherry, coffee and oak extract alongside astringent tannins that leave an abrupt, bitter finish.
title: Vignaioli del Morellino di Scansano 2013 Vignabenefizio  (Morellino di Scansano)

description: Aromas of blackcurrant, grilled pepper and oak lead the nose. The dense, extracted palate offers dried black cherry, mature blackberry, licorice, espresso and vanilla alongside firm tannins.
title: Feudo Disisa 2010 Vuaria Nero d'Avola (Monreale)

description: Pretty aromas suggest ripe berry, spiced plum and a bit of eucalyptus. The polished palate offers mature blackberry and cinnamon alongside smooth but rather fleeting tannins.
title: Fazio 2012 Torre dei Venti Nero d'Avola (Erice)

description: Aromas of cedar, allspice and black-skinned fruit take shape in the glass. On the easygoing palate, notes of ground pepper and star anise add some depth to the juicy blackberry core, while chewy tannins give it texture. Drink through 2016.
title: Barone Montalto 2013 Nero d'Avola-Cabernet Sauvignon Red (Terre Siciliane)

description: Aromas of toasted oak, espresso, vanilla and ripe berry lead the nose. The palate offers oak extract, roasted coffee bean, mocha and dark cherry. It's full-bodied, with drying and rather fleeting tannins.
title: Baglio del Cristo di Campobello 2012 Lu Patri Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: Slightly funky aromas of game, leather, tilled earth and a whiff of barnyard carry over to the palate, along with mature black cherry and clove. Mature tannins offer support.
title: Murgo 2011 Tenuta S. Michele Rosso  (Etna)

description: Subdued aromas suggest underbrush, scorched earth and dark berry. The supple palate offers dried cherry, wild strawberry, graphite and a hint of white pepper alongside polished—almost delicate—tannins.
title: Murgo 2011 Tenuta S. Michele Pinot Nero (Sicilia)

description: Aromas of ripe orchard fruit and citrus zest carry on to the lively palate along with a hint of ginger. Crisp acidity and small continuous bubbles provide a fresh elegant backdrop.
title: Adami NV Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Made entirely with Ribolla Gialla, this has aromas of Abate Fetel pear and white spring flower. The fresh savory palate offers yellow peach, lemon zest and a pleasant note of bitter almond alongside bright acidity.
title: Ferruccio Sgubin 2015 Ribolla Gialla (Collio)

description: Made entirely with Ribolla Gialla, this has aromas of Abate Fetel pear and white spring flower. The fresh savory palate offers yellow peach, lemon zest and a pleasant note of bitter almond alongside bright acidity.
title: Ferruccio Sgubin 2015 Ribolla Gialla (Collio)

description: Made with dried Garganega grapes, this has delicate aromas suggesting dried white flowers, ripe fig and a whiff of cake spice. The rounded palate offers mature apricot, acacia honey and light touch of cinnamon.
title: Ca' Rugate 2014 La Perlara  (Recioto di Soave)

description: Made with dried Garganega grapes, this has delicate aromas suggesting dried white flowers, ripe fig and a whiff of cake spice. The rounded palate offers mature apricot, acacia honey and light touch of cinnamon.
title: Ca' Rugate 2014 La Perlara  (Recioto di Soave)

description: Honeysuckle, lily of the valley and a whiff of exotic fruit aromas take center stage. The silky palate offers sweet white peach, candied nectarine slice and banana alongside a soft mousse.
title: Terre di San Venanzio Fortunato NV Brut Demi Long  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Heady aromas of citrus and orchard fruit almost jump out of the glass. The savory, medium-bodied palate tastes of ripe pear, mature apple and creamy peach interspersed with energizing mineral notes. Fresh acidity brightens the creamy flavors.
title: Feudi di San Gregorio 2015  Greco di Tufo

description: Heady aromas of citrus and orchard fruit almost jump out of the glass. The savory, medium-bodied palate tastes of ripe pear, mature apple and creamy peach interspersed with energizing mineral notes. Fresh acidity brightens the creamy flavors.
title: Feudi di San Gregorio 2015  Greco di Tufo

description: Aromas of pear, Spanish broom, flint and Mediterranean herb emerge in the glass. The juicy, medium-bodied palate offers ripe apple, peach and lime alongside fresh acidity and a mineral vein. A hazelnut note marks the close.
title: Feudi di San Gregorio 2015  Fiano di Avellino

description: Scents of Spanish broom, pineapple, orchard fruit and a saline note meld together in the glass. The focused palate offers mature apple, peach, botanical herb and mineral alongside firm acidity.
title: Biondi 2014 Chianta Bianco  (Etna)

description: Enticing scents of spring flower, beeswax and orchard fruit come together in the glass. The elegant, linear palate shows juicy lemon, nectarine, hazelnut and a saline note framed in firm acidity. It closes crisp and clean.
title: Baglio del Cristo di Campobello 2015 Adenzia White (Sicilia)

description: Bright and savory, this opens with enticing aromas of wild berry, fragrant blue flower, rose and a whiff of exotic spice. The silky, easy-drinking palate offers succulent Marasca cherry, black raspberry, white pepper and a hint of clove alongside lithe tannins and fresh acidity.
title: Valle dell'Acate 2015 Il Frappato Frappato (Vittoria)

description: An iconic wine of Italy and deservedly so, Biondi-Santi captures the spirit of the 2007 vintage with his clear fruit interpretations of red cherry, blackberry and cassis. The wine shows power, structure and fresh acidity that drives the long finish.
title: Biondi Santi 2007  Brunello di Montalcino

description: An iconic wine of Italy and deservedly so, Biondi-Santi captures the spirit of the 2007 vintage with his clear fruit interpretations of red cherry, blackberry and cassis. The wine shows power, structure and fresh acidity that drives the long finish.
title: Biondi Santi 2007  Brunello di Montalcino

description: From Marchese Lodovico Antinori's beautiful wine estate in Bibbona, this boasts the heritage of the great super Tuscan family to which it belongs. The blend is Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Petit Verdot, and the overall effect is simply gorgeous. Richness, generosity and persistence characterize the mouthfeel, and the bouquet is driven by aromas of red cherry, chocolate and spice. Drink after 2015.
title: Tenuta di Biserno 2007 Il Pino di Biserno Red (Toscana)

description: Compared to its basic Brunello, Querceta ups the ante with this Riserva in terms of intensity and overall power. Bold notes of cherry, spice and leather make an appearance in this fresh and firmly structured offering.
title: Querceta 2006 Riserva  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Riserva La Volta exhibits smoky tones of charcoal, black slate, licorice and dried black currant backed by toasted peanut or roasted chestnut. The toasted element, which seems to have become more prominent with time, is a bit overwhelming and definitely the wine's defining characteristic.
title: Viberti 2001 Riserva La Volta  (Barolo)

description: Made with Teroldego from three different vineyards, this offers aromas of truffle, leather, scorched soil, black plum and a whiff of game. Aged and fermented in wood, the savory palate offers ripe blackberry, spiced blueberry, earthy notes of Mediterranean herbs and dark cooking spice. Firm but fine-grained tannins provide support. Drink 2016–2026.
title: Foradori 2011 Granato Teroldego (Vigneti delle Dolomiti)

description: Made with Teroldego from three different vineyards, this offers aromas of truffle, leather, scorched soil, black plum and a whiff of game. Aged and fermented in wood, the savory palate offers ripe blackberry, spiced blueberry, earthy notes of Mediterranean herbs and dark cooking spice. Firm but fine-grained tannins provide support. Drink 2016–2026.
title: Foradori 2011 Granato Teroldego (Vigneti delle Dolomiti)

description: Fragrances recall honeysuckle, jasmine and citrus zest. The juicy palate offers creamy green apple, Bartlett pear and nectarine alongside zesty acidity. A note of white almond signals the close.
title: Pieropan 2013  Soave Classico

description: Fragrances recall honeysuckle, jasmine and citrus zest. The juicy palate offers creamy green apple, Bartlett pear and nectarine alongside zesty acidity. A note of white almond signals the close.
title: Pieropan 2013  Soave Classico

description: Delicate aromas suggest stone fruit, flint and Mediterranean herb. The luminous palate delivers white peach, Bartlett pear, crisp apple, almond and an energizing mineral vein.
title: Suavia 2013 Monte Carbonare  (Soave Classico)

description: Made entirely with Trebbiano di Soave, this vibrant white offers enticing aromas of white flower and citrus blossom. The linear palate delivers juicy yellow peach, pear, kiwi and mineral alongside firm acidity.
title: Suavia 2012 Massifitti Trebbiano (Veronese)

description: Delicate aromas of pressed white flower, tree fruit, citrus and slate lead the nose on this elegant, structured white. The vibrant palate offers juicy yellow peach, Granny Smith apple, nectarine skin and bitter almond alongside crisp acidity. The lingering finish has a mineral accent.
title: Selva Capuzza 2013 Selva  (Lugana)

description: Delicate aromas of pressed white flower, tree fruit, citrus and slate lead the nose on this elegant, structured white. The vibrant palate offers juicy yellow peach, Granny Smith apple, nectarine skin and bitter almond alongside crisp acidity. The lingering finish has a mineral accent.
title: Selva Capuzza 2013 Selva  (Lugana)

description: This is an extremely distinctive and site-specific expression of Barbaresco from the celebrated Roncaglie cru. The wine is characterized by feminine, delicate tones of subtle Indian spice, pressed rose petal, violets and light vanilla or white chocolate. It boasts well-integrated freshness and finely polished tannins.
title: Poderi Colla 2007 Roncaglie  (Barbaresco)

description: This Barolo from the Gattera vineyard of La Morra opens with bold personality and chiseled aromas of cola, spice, black fruit, root beer, licorice, dried tobacco and herbs. The wine holds the banner high as far as Nebbiolo tradition goes and offers a long, spice- filled finish. Drink after 2015.
title: Gianfranco Bovio 2006 Vigne Gattera  (Barolo)

description: This Barolo from the Gattera vineyard of La Morra opens with bold personality and chiseled aromas of cola, spice, black fruit, root beer, licorice, dried tobacco and herbs. The wine holds the banner high as far as Nebbiolo tradition goes and offers a long, spice- filled finish. Drink after 2015.
title: Gianfranco Bovio 2006 Vigne Gattera  (Barolo)

description: There's a very interesting and unique Asian quality here that reveals itself on the nose as saffron, soya, clove and Chinese barbecue sauce. The wine is lean and compact in the mouth with a long, silky finish: Hold five to 10 years in your cellar.
title: Giacomo Ascheri 2006 Sorano Coste & Bricco  (Barolo)

description: This is a straightforward and genuine Barolo with deep layers of bright fruit, spice and mineral packaged seamlessly together as a whole. In the mouth, the wine is clean and elegant with dry, finely textured tannins.
title: Germano Ettore 2006 Cerretta  (Barolo)

description: The Brunate cru, with denser soils, is known for meatier, more structured wines. This Barolo offers elegance, power and complexity with lingering aromas of exotic spice, black fruit and root beer. It's also exceptionally bright and lively in the mouth and would pair with a hearty wintery dish such as beef Bourguignon.
title: Francesco Rinaldi 2006 Le Brunate  (Barolo)

description: The celebrated Cerequio cru is known for its elegant and refined wines. However, in this hot vintage, you can taste the maturity of the fruit thanks to the wine's aromas of plum, prune and spice cake. Clay soils help shape the wine's natural density and structure.
title: Contratto 2003 Cerequio  (Barolo)

description: This is a big Barbaresco executed in a bold, modern style that can either be consumed immediately, or can be put aside to age in your cellar. Soft layers of spice, nutmeg and vanilla are enhanced by bursting flavors of cherry and blueberry. The wine is rich, dense and opulent overall.
title: Cascina Luisin 2007 Sori Paolin  (Barbaresco)

description: Boroli is a dynamic winery worth keeping a close eye on. Barolo Villero takes a traditional approach that speaks highly of the beautifully hilly area that shaped the wine. Delicate aromas include wild berries, dried orange zest, apple skin, licorice, tar and cigar box. In the mouth, the wine is streamlined and tight.
title: Boroli 2006 Villero  (Barolo)

description: Elegance and finesse characterize this wine and suggest that it may already be suitable to drink within the next five years or so. Aromas include dark chocolate, tar, espresso grinds and smoked beef. Those aged tertiary fragrances are emerging now and the wine is thick, firm and luscious on the close.
title: Mario Gagliasso 2004 Riserva  (Barolo)

description: Barolo Vigna Merenda opens with a bright bouquet composed of cherry, spice, floral and balsam elements. This is also an extremely mineral-driven wine that exposes a vein of graphite or crushed stone at its core. Thanks to the wine's natural structure and long persistency, it would make a perfect pairing partner to any dish with black truffles.
title: Scarzello 2006 Vigna Merenda  (Barolo)

description: Sleek and savory, this blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc opens with aromas of mocha, spicy plum, scorched earth and leather. The juicy palate offers black currant, cassis, black pepper, savory herb and licorice alongside polished tannins.
title: Fattoria di Magliano 2011 Poggio Bestiale  (Maremma Toscana)

description: This blend of 70% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Petit Verdot and 10% Merlot opens with aromas of blackberry, cedar and exotic spice. The bold, concentrated palate delivers ripe black cherry, blackberry, graphite, anise and clove alongside assertive tannins.
title: Donna Olimpia 1898 2011 Millepassi  (Bolgheri)

description: Made with organically farmed grapes, this opens with pretty aromas of crushed rose, violet, perfumed berry, leather, truffle and a balsamic note. The warm palate doles out fleshy wild cherry, stewed plum, cake spice, anisette and savory herb alongside velvety tannins. It closes on a licorice note and the heat of evident alcohol. Drink 2018–2025.
title: Corte Pavone 2010  Brunello di Montalcino

description: A blend of 70% Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Cabernet Franc and a splash of Petit Verdot, this offers bright red berry, menthol, cedar, espresso and savory herb aromas. On the palate, polished tannins support juicy dark cherry, blackberry, licorice, coffee and toasted notes. Enjoy through 2017.
title: Grattamacco 2010 L'Alberello  (Bolgheri Superiore)

description: A blend of 70% Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Cabernet Franc and a splash of Petit Verdot, this offers bright red berry, menthol, cedar, espresso and savory herb aromas. On the palate, polished tannins support juicy dark cherry, blackberry, licorice, coffee and toasted notes. Enjoy through 2017.
title: Grattamacco 2010 L'Alberello  (Bolgheri Superiore)

description: Hearty and soulful, this offers aromas of tilled soil, leather, game and woodland berry. The meaty palate is still very tightly wound, delivering black cherry, plum, grilled sage, licorice and tobacco alongside bold tannins. Hold until 2018 then enjoy.
title: Uccelliera 2010  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Firmly structured and elegant, this offers aromas of pressed rose, violet, menthol, savory herb and woodland berry. The palate is still closed but reveals crunchy red cherry, oak, mint and sage alongside youthfully austere tannins that need time to unfold. Drink 2017–2025.
title: Il Palazzone 2010  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Made from 65% Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Merlot and 10% Cabernet Franc, this opens with savory aromas of fennel, dark berry, bell pepper and cedar. The firm palate offers black currant, black cherry, clove and Mediterranean herbs. Assertive but fine-grained tannins add elegance.
title: Poggio al Tesoro 2011 Sondraia  (Bolgheri Superiore)

description: Made from 65% Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Merlot and 10% Cabernet Franc, this opens with savory aromas of fennel, dark berry, bell pepper and cedar. The firm palate offers black currant, black cherry, clove and Mediterranean herbs. Assertive but fine-grained tannins add elegance.
title: Poggio al Tesoro 2011 Sondraia  (Bolgheri Superiore)

description: Vintner Giovannella Fugazza has crafted a soft and plush white wine with ripe peach and candied fruit aromas. The fragrant grape used is Malvasia and the wine is sweet and chewy on the close.
title: Castello di Luzzano 2011 Tasto di Seta Malvasia (Colli Piacentini)

description: Here's a fresh and clean value wine (made with 100% Trebbiano) that opens with cut green-grass aromas, citrus and honeydew melon. Pair this wine with fried finger foods.
title: Caldora Vini 2011  Trebbiano d'Abruzzo

description: There's a ripe and spicy side to this thick Chardonnay from Central Italy that is followed by tones of orange skin and apricot. The finish is thick and chewy.
title: Bosco dei Cirmioli 2011 Chardonnay (Delle Venezie)

description: It's a little hard to get past the cooked fruit nuances that hit the nose in a powerful and determined manner. Dark, inky concentration is followed by jammy cherry, sweet jam with a touch of smoked bacon.
title: Oasi degli Angeli 2009 Kurni Montepulciano (Marche)

description: Barriano is a rosemary green and slightly vegetal blend of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon that is balanced out by a good dose of plump red cherry in the mouth.
title: Villa Gianna 2009 Barriano Red (Lazio)

description: Made with Pinot Nero, this conveys subtle aromas of red berry and a whiff of bread dough. The palate offers dried cherry, raspberry and a note of bitter almond husk alongside vigorous bubbles and sharp acidity.
title: La Travaglina 2009 Julillae Cruasé Brut Pinot Nero (Oltrepò Pavese)

description: Hailing from Puglia, this is made from native grapes Bombino (60%) and Aglianico (40%). Aromas of green apple, vanilla and peach carry over to the palate along with bread crust and a confectionary note. It has brisk acidity and sharp, vivacious bubbles.
title: Teanum 2011 Tiati Metodo Classico Brut Sparkling (Puglia)

description: There's a soft, creamy element to the nose of this Extra Dry Prosecco that is surrounded by pretty aromas of peach, melon and passion fruit. The mouthfeel is rich, foamy and smooth.
title: Sorelle Bronca NV Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Sorelle Bronca is a boutique producer that makes some of the finest Prosecco available today. This sparkling Brut expression shows finesse and focus with lively aromas of white flower and smooth peach.
title: Sorelle Bronca NV Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This Brut, Chardonnay-based sparkling wine is fantastically fresh and light with lively aromas of green apple, citrus, talc powder and drying mineral. It shows steely perlage and a foamy texture.
title: Fratelli Muratori NV Villa Crespia Novalia Brut Chardonnay (Franciacorta)

description: The 2006 Millesimato sparkling wine delivers aromas of honey and sourdough bread and loads of almond and stone fruit flavors. It closes with a fresh, citrusy blast.
title: Camossi 2006 Millesimato Extra Brut Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: Cartizze is the most celebrated vineyard cru in the Prosecco area and this expression lives up to its reputation very nicely. It offers delicate floral and mineral tones that create a smooth, feminine personality.
title: Bortolin NV Cartizze Dry  (Valdobbiadene Superiore di Cartizze)

description: Made with air-dried Tocai Friulano grapes (now simply called Friulano), this golden wine opens with apricot tones, peach, candied fruit and honey. It's a simple, clean sweet wine with a crisp touch of acidity on the finish.
title: Beccarello 2008 Oro Cason Brusà Vino Passito Friulano (Lison-Pramaggiore)

description: Prosecco Superiore Dei Casel is a soft, foamy wine with apple mousse, lemon zest and soft layers of peach cobbler. The wine is delicate, elegant and fine.
title: Adami NV Dei Casel Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Great for informal occasions or as an apéritif before a delicious fish dinner, this tight and focused Brut Prosecco Superiore offers aromas of talc powder, white flower and a distant touch of honey.
title: Adami NV Bosco di Gica Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: We can now enjoy a lively little group of Sicilian producers who also make metodo classico sparkling wine. This expression from the Carricante grape shows dry fruit and mineral notes with background tones of fresh baked bread and dried hay.
title: Planeta NV Brut Carricante (Sicilia)

description: This a beautiful Prosecco Superiore with bright aromas of white flower, stone fruit and dried grass. The mouthfeel is thin and crisp, but it leaves ample room for the creamy foam that inevitably spreads thickly over the palate.
designation: Cuvée del Fondatore Graziano Merotto Millesimato Brut
title: Merotto 2012 Cuvée del Fondatore Graziano Merotto Millesimato Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This a beautiful Prosecco Superiore with bright aromas of white flower, stone fruit and dried grass. The mouthfeel is thin and crisp, but it leaves ample room for the creamy foam that inevitably spreads thickly over the palate.
designation: Cuvée del Fondatore Graziano Merotto Millesimato Brut
title: Merotto 2012 Cuvée del Fondatore Graziano Merotto Millesimato Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Serbato is a thick and savory red wine from central Italy that offers toasted notes of spice and tobacco backed by a plush and velvety mouthfeel. The wine seems to rev up quickly in the mouth but ultimately feels short on the mid palate.
title: Lamoretti 2007 Serbato Red (Emilia-Romagna)

description: This thick and creamy expression of the Garganega grape (the main component of all Soave whites) delivers melon, peach, tangerine skin and white almond. The wine is soft and round on the close. Pair it with white meat or shellfish.
title: Corte Adami 2010 Vigna della Corte  (Soave)

description: Coppo's beautiful La Rocca Gavi is precisely the kind of wine you'll want to serve with smoked salmon, grilled tuna or fresh vegetables. There's a crisp, flinty quality that gives the wine a bright and lively feel followed by tones of citrus and honeydew melon.
title: Coppo 2011 La Rocca  (Gavi)

description: Packaged in a beautifully unique glass bottle, this collector's wine from southern Italy offers balance, intensity and cleanly etched aromas of black fruit, resin, cola, rum cake, dried violets and tobacco. The finish is elegant, polished and lingers long on the palate thanks to the drying tannins.
title: Mastroberardino 2005 Naturalis Historia  (Taurasi)

description: This is a gorgeous interpretation of Aglianico in which the tannic grape is softened and rounded out thanks to quality winemaking. Aromas of chocolate fudge, exotic spice, rum cake and loads of black fruit appear on the bouquet. You will, however, feel that characteristic tightness on the long, drying finish.
title: Feudi di San Gregorio 2006  Taurasi

description: Pago dei Fusi is a distinctive wine that excels in terms of intensity and clarity. Elegant tones of tar, black fruit, tobacco, dark spice and rum cake appear immediately and slowly change form as the wine spends more time in the glass. Drying tannins make for a dramatic close.
title: Terredora Di Paolo 2004 Pago dei Fusi  (Taurasi)

description: From limestone and clay soils, this elegant Aglianico opens with a smooth and silky feel backed by power. Aromas of dark fruit, licorice and spice would match leg of lamb or pork roast.
title: Ocone 2006 Anastasi  (Aglianico del Taburno)

description: This 60-30-10 Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Aglianico blend from southern Italy delivers beautiful purity and intensity. Aromas here include blackberry, tobacco, leather, rum cake and polished black stone. It tastes firm and full on the palate and could use a few more years of cellar aging.
title: Montevetrano 2008 Red (Campania)

description: Serpico is a beautiful but also modern expression of Aglianico (the grapes come from ancient vines in the Taurasi area) that opens with dark notes of blackberry, crushed stone, chocolate, rum cake, licorice and cola. The mouthfeel is smooth, firm and very rich.
title: Feudi di San Gregorio 2007 Serpico Aglianico (Irpinia)

description: From the local Italian word for “to work the soil,” Runcaris represents an easy, fresh expression of Soave Classico with lingering aromas of citrus, yellow rose, honey, jasmine and dried herbs.
title: Fattori 2010 Runcaris  (Soave Classico)

description: This vintage-dated Prosecco beautifully captures ambient light within its luminous appearance. Persistent perlage and cheerful aromas of white flower, pear and peach seal the deal.
title: Toffoli 2009 Millesimato Brut Rive di Refrontolo  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Suavia's base Soave Classico opens with an initial hint of sulphur but then finds purity in the form of peach, honey and herbal aromas. In fact, the wine shows very nice fruit characteristics on the close.
title: Suavia 2010  Soave Classico

description: Aromas of leather, underbrush, ripe red berry and eucalyptus lead the nose on this structured wine. The delicious palate delivers juicy black cherry, crushed raspberry, baking spice and savory herb alongside big, chewy tannins. It ends on a succulent note. Drink 2016–2024.
title: Tenimenti Famiglia Cavallero 2009 Bussia  (Barolo)

description: This elegant, medium-bodied Nebbiolo starts off with aromas of berry, herb, leather and violet. The savory, polished palate delivers wild raspberry, mint, cake spice and a balsamic note alongside velvety tannins. Drink through 2018.
title: Principiano Ferdinando 2012 Montagliato  (Nebbiolo d'Alba)

description: Dried peach, nectarine zest, flint and Mediterranean herb aromas characterize this stunning dessert wine from Campania. On the palate, fresh acidity brightens layers of candied ginger and lemon rind as well as honey and dried herb.
title: Feudi di San Gregorio 2011 Privilegio Fiano (Irpinia)

description: Dried peach, nectarine zest, flint and Mediterranean herb aromas characterize this stunning dessert wine from Campania. On the palate, fresh acidity brightens layers of candied ginger and lemon rind as well as honey and dried herb.
title: Feudi di San Gregorio 2011 Privilegio Fiano (Irpinia)

description: Aromas of underbrush, scorched earth and dark baking spice lead the way on this firmly structured wine. The tense, full-bodied palate delivers dried black cherry, licorice, leather and tobacco supported by bracing, fine-grained tannins. Drink 2019–2029.
title: Pio Cesare 2011 Ornato  (Barolo)

description: Aromas of underbrush, scorched earth, mature dark berry, menthol and dark baking spice lead the nose. The full-bodied palate delivers dried black cherry, licorice, chewing tobacco and clove while ripe, bracing tannins provide structure. Drink 2019–2029.
title: Luigi Oddero & Figli 2009 Vigna Rionda  (Barolo)

description: Aromas of underbrush, scorched earth, mature dark berry, menthol and dark baking spice lead the nose. The full-bodied palate delivers dried black cherry, licorice, chewing tobacco and clove while ripe, bracing tannins provide structure. Drink 2019–2029.
title: Luigi Oddero & Figli 2009 Vigna Rionda  (Barolo)

description: This robust wine opens with aromas of red berry, tilled earth, dark baking spice and a balsamic note. The ripe, hearty palate delivers syrupy black cherry, juicy raspberry, clove and anisette alongside firm tannins. Despite the tannic structure, the dense fruit and warmth of alcohol make it already almost accessible. Drink 2017–2026.
title: Grimaldi Bruna 2011 Camilla  (Barolo)

description: Truffle, underbrush, dark berry, mocha and grilled sage aromas unfold in the glass. The firm palate delivers smoke, raw berry, baking spice, anise and a sprinkling of aromatic herb while bracing tannins provide the backbone.
title: Bel Colle 2011 Monvigliero  (Barolo)

description: Red berry, rose, blue flower, tilled soil and Alpine herb aromas set the pace on this luminous red. The firm palate is still young and closed but already shows ripe red berry, wild cherry, mocha anise, clove and a hint of toast. Youthfully assertive but refined tannins and fresh acidity lend structure and balance. Drink 2019–2029.
title: Fletcher 2011 Alta Pete  (Barolo)

description: Forest floor, mature berry, wild herb, clove, smoke and pressed flower aromas come together on this bright red. The taut palate delivers ripe red cherry, crushed raspberry, star anise and white pepper set against firm, polished tannins.
title: Elvio Cogno 2012 Bordini  (Barbaresco)

description: This edition of Nicolis' Valpolicella blend shows simplicity, but cleanliness and balance as well. It's a straightforward expression with lingering tones of cherry and cola on the close.
title: Nicolis 2008  Valpolicella Classico Superiore

description: This is made with native grape Garganega, the main grape behind Soave. A fruity fragrance of green apple and white peach carries to the palate along with notes of candied lemon peel. Fresh acidity adds brightness.
title: Ca' Rugate NV Fulvio Beo Metodo Classico Brut Garganega (Vino Spumante)

description: Black currant, cedar, prune, spice and just a whiff of barnyard lead the nose on this young Amarone. The dense palate delivers baked plum, stewed prune, nutmeg and clove alongside tightly-knit, bracing tannins. It finishes on an astringent note.
title: Farina 2011  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico

description: Initial aromas include prune, chocolate and toasted oak. Oak takes center stage on the palate along with wood-driven sensations of vanilla and chocolate. There's not enough fruit to support the oak or the bracing tannins.
title: Colle Bereto 2009 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Subdued aromas of strawberry, rose petal and toast come together in the glass. The palate offers bright red berry and a hint of green tea alongside polished tannins.
title: Stroblhof 2011 Riserva Pinot Nero (Alto Adige)

description: Subdued aromas of strawberry, rose petal and toast come together in the glass. The palate offers bright red berry and a hint of green tea alongside polished tannins.
title: Stroblhof 2011 Riserva Pinot Nero (Alto Adige)

description: Delicate but enticing aromas suggest spring blossom, cut grass, orchard fruit and an herbal note. The juicy palate offers crisp apple, pear and citrus together with a light mineral accent. Bright acidity balances it out and gives it a zesty finish.
title: Selva Capuzza 2013 San Vigilio  (Lugana)

description: Delicate but enticing aromas suggest spring blossom, cut grass, orchard fruit and an herbal note. The juicy palate offers crisp apple, pear and citrus together with a light mineral accent. Bright acidity balances it out and gives it a zesty finish.
title: Selva Capuzza 2013 San Vigilio  (Lugana)

description: Delicate aromas of raspberry and almond carry through to the palate along with tangerine and clove. It's balanced by bright acidity and soft, supple tannins. Drink soon.
title: Nals Margreid 2013 Galea Vernatsch Schiava (Alto Adige)

description: Delicate aromas of hawthorn, white wildflower and stone fruit mingle in the glass. The vibrant palate offers tart yellow apple, juicy nectarine and bitter almond alongside zesty acidity. A steely mineral note marks the finish.
title: Monte Tondo 2013  Soave Classico

description: This organic 60-40 blend of Uva di Troia and Montepulciano offers nutty notes of Graham cracker, chestnut podwer and ripe cherry fruit. The aromas are slightly muddled and the wine shows slight effervescence, which contributes to its pungent and piquant flavors. Agrinatura is an organic winemaker who does not use sulfites.
title: Agrinatura 2007 Almagìa Red (Castel del Monte)

description: This organic 60-40 blend of Uva di Troia and Montepulciano offers nutty notes of Graham cracker, chestnut podwer and ripe cherry fruit. The aromas are slightly muddled and the wine shows slight effervescence, which contributes to its pungent and piquant flavors. Agrinatura is an organic winemaker who does not use sulfites.
title: Agrinatura 2007 Almagìa Red (Castel del Monte)

description: Made with organically grown grapes and with no added sulfites, this opens with earthy aromas of black-skinned fruit, ground pepper and a whiff of truffle. The lively, simple palate offers black cherry and clove alongside vibrant acidity.
title: Paolo Marcarino 2014 Zeroincondotta  (Barbera di Piemonte)

description: Floral scents of violet and iris lead the nose on this informal red. The straightforward palate offers raw black cherry, cranberry and white pepper alongside firm, drying tannins that leave a raspy finish.
title: Raineri Gianmatteo 2013 Cornole  (Dogliani)

description: Floral scents of violet and iris lead the nose on this informal red. The straightforward palate offers raw black cherry, cranberry and white pepper alongside firm, drying tannins that leave a raspy finish.
title: Raineri Gianmatteo 2013 Cornole  (Dogliani)

description: Here's a very aromatic dessert wine (made from dried grapes) from the Marche region of central Italy with soapy aromas of scented candle and florists' shop. It has very rich and extremely fragrant flavors that last a long time.
title: Garofoli 2006 Dorato White (Marche)

description: Here's a very aromatic dessert wine (made from dried grapes) from the Marche region of central Italy with soapy aromas of scented candle and florists' shop. It has very rich and extremely fragrant flavors that last a long time.
title: Garofoli 2006 Dorato White (Marche)

description: Orange peel and zesty tangerine follow aromas of honey and butterscotch. Moscato della Torre is a smooth and generous wine with intense flavors and medium acidity. Drink it alone or with aged cheese.
title: Marabino 2007 Moscato della Torre Moscato (Sicilia)

description: Scents of white flower and orchard fruit lift from the glass. The bright, straightforward palate offers yellow apple and citrus alongside crisp acidity.
title: Bortoluzzi 2014 Chardonnay (Collio)

description: This lively white opens with aromas suggesting lemon blossom, orchard fruit, stone and citrus. On the invigorating palate, bracing acidity lifts yellow apple, nectarine and flinty mineral. It finishes on a tangy note.
title: Tramin 2014 Moriz Pinot Bianco (Alto Adige)

description: Aromas of citrus blossom, tropical fruit and a whiff of vanilla lead the nose while the bright palate delivers raw peach, tangerine zest and a dash of nut alongside racy acidity. A light mineral note marks the close.
title: Cormòns 2014 Chardonnay (Collio)

description: This vibrant Pinot Grigio offers delicate scents of white flower, orchard fruit and a whiff of citrus. The crisp palate shows crunchy Granny Smith apple, green pear and tangerine while bracing acidity gives it a clean finish.
title: Collavini 2014 Villa Canlungo Pinot Grigio (Collio)

description: This vibrant Pinot Grigio offers delicate scents of white flower, orchard fruit and a whiff of citrus. The crisp palate shows crunchy Granny Smith apple, green pear and tangerine while bracing acidity gives it a clean finish.
title: Collavini 2014 Villa Canlungo Pinot Grigio (Collio)

description: This lively white offers aromas of fragrant white flower, orchard fruit and crushed stone. The vibrant, linear palate delivers Anjou pear, citrus and an almond note alongside firm acidity.
title: Collavini 2014 Friulano (Collio)

description: This lively white offers aromas of fragrant white flower, orchard fruit and crushed stone. The vibrant, linear palate delivers Anjou pear, citrus and an almond note alongside firm acidity.
title: Collavini 2014 Friulano (Collio)

description: The nose on this one isn't very expressive but eventually gives up whiffs of paraffin and chopped herb. The palate is more open, offering yellow apple skin, mineral and a subtle almond note. It's reserved but refined.
title: Ca'Ronesca 2014 Friulano (Collio)

description: The nose on this one isn't very expressive but eventually gives up whiffs of paraffin and chopped herb. The palate is more open, offering yellow apple skin, mineral and a subtle almond note. It's reserved but refined.
title: Ca'Ronesca 2014 Friulano (Collio)

description: Yellow peach, apricot and tangerine aromas lead to the tangy palate along with notes of ginger and white pepper. Crisp acidity gives it a clean, crisp finish.
title: Cantina Valle Isarco 2014 Kerner (Alto Adige)

description: Partially fermented in barriques (20%), this opens with aromas of oak, toasted nut and a whiff of vanilla. The palate offers yellow apple, bitter almond, peach and a hint of tangerine accompanied by lively acidity.
title: Cantina Cortaccia 2014 Penoner Pinot Grigio (Alto Adige)

description: Partially fermented in barriques (20%), this opens with aromas of oak, toasted nut and a whiff of vanilla. The palate offers yellow apple, bitter almond, peach and a hint of tangerine accompanied by lively acidity.
title: Cantina Cortaccia 2014 Penoner Pinot Grigio (Alto Adige)

description: White spring flower and yellow stone fruit aromas lead the nose. The lively, straightforward palate shows peach and a hint of bitter almond accompanied by brisk acidity.
title: Bortoluzzi 2014 Pinot Grigio (Venezia Giulia)

description: Citrus blossom and peach aromas open while the zesty palate offers rennet apple, lemon drop and almond. Crisp acidity and a mineral note lead to a tangy finish.
title: Ascevi Luwa 2014 Ceròu Pinot Grigio (Collio)

description: This Nero d'Avola opens with mature black cherry, cinnamon and toasted almond aromas while the fresh, structured palate delivers juicy blackberry, raspberry jam and white pepper notes. Fresh acidity and polished tannins lend balance and a smooth texture. Enjoy through 2024.
title: Feudo Principi di Butera 2014 Deliella Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: Made entirely from Nero d'Avola, this delicious wine opens with ripe black plum, carob and Mediterranean brush aromas. The smooth, chewy palate doles out layers of juicy blackberry, ripe Morello cherry, clove and white pepper flavors. A licorice note closes the finish while fine-grained tannins provide the framework. Enjoy through 2022.
title: Curto 2012 Fontanelle Nero d'Avola (Eloro)

description: This wine is based on Sangiovese, with a tiny splash of Cabernet Sauvignon, and it's aged for 12 months in old and new oak barrels. It shows a savory side, with notes of candied fruit, prune, raisin and smoked meat. Drink now.
title: Viticcio 2008 Lucius Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: This wine is based on Sangiovese, with a tiny splash of Cabernet Sauvignon, and it's aged for 12 months in old and new oak barrels. It shows a savory side, with notes of candied fruit, prune, raisin and smoked meat. Drink now.
title: Viticcio 2008 Lucius Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Gherardino offers tight fruit nuances of forest berry, white cherry and cranberry, wrapped within generous tones of almond, wet earth and blue flower. It's an easy-drinking Sangiovese, with bright acids on the finish.
title: Villa Vignamaggio 2010 Gherardino  (Chianti Classico)

description: This offers a base of bright cherry flavor, followed by light tobacco and spice tones. Pair this with grilled lamb chops or roasted pork rolls.
title: Terre di Talamo 2010 Tempo  (Morellino di Scansano)

description: Tones of leather, tobacco and wild mushroom are followed by accents of ripe fruit and blackberry preserves. Notes of rum cake, licorice and Indian spice give complexity to this blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot.
title: Campo al Mare 2010 Campo al Mare  (Bolgheri)

description: Aged in stainless steel, this blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Syrah emits ripe aromas of dark fruit, brown sugar and molasses. Notes of honey and cherry appear on the finish.
title: Batzella 2010 Digià  (Bolgheri)

description: Viognier and Vermentino spend some time in both stainless steel and oak, which gives this blend fresh aromas and a creamy palate. Stone fruit, apricot, honey and white flower notes are accompanied by mildly spicy overtones.
title: Batzella 2007 Mezzodì White (Bolgheri)

description: Viognier and Vermentino spend some time in both stainless steel and oak, which gives this blend fresh aromas and a creamy palate. Stone fruit, apricot, honey and white flower notes are accompanied by mildly spicy overtones.
title: Batzella 2007 Mezzodì White (Bolgheri)

description: This rich and generous expression of Vermentino shows aromas of honey, dried hay, stone fruit and white almond. The dense, creamy palate would stand up to spicy Thai coconut curry.
title: Gualdo del Re 2011 Valentina Vermentino (Toscana)

description: This rich and generous expression of Vermentino shows aromas of honey, dried hay, stone fruit and white almond. The dense, creamy palate would stand up to spicy Thai coconut curry.
title: Gualdo del Re 2011 Valentina Vermentino (Toscana)

description: The fresh bouquet of this blend shows feminine notes of blue flower and light spice. The aromas are a bit raw at this stage, and there's a touch of cherry-like sourness on the close.
title: Donna Olimpia 1898 2011 Tageto Red (Toscana)

description: Forward notes of black fruit and cherry are followed by touches of white almond and rum cake. This oak-aged blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Sangiovese, Merlot, Teroldego and Syrah is tangy and fresh.
title: Michele Satta 2010  Bolgheri

description: This Cabernet Sauvignon shows a dark fruit aroma, with an herbal note at the back. It has a smooth texture and medium intensity, and it would stand up to pork or roast turkey and gravy.
title: Marchesi Ginori Lisci 2009 Macchion del Lupo Cabernet Sauvignon (Montescudaio)

description: Here's a pure expression of the hearty Montepulciano grape with bright berry flavors, thick extraction and a chewy, succulent texture. It's sticky and jammy-sweet in places and thick on the palate.
title: Tenuta Coppadoro 2004 Radicosa Montepulciano (Puglia)

description: Here's a blend of Montepulciano (75%) and Aglianico (25%) with big, ripe intensity and polished tannins. Aromas include sweet cherry, blueberry and spicy cinnamon or vanilla. It feels big and bold in the mouth and would make a statement with lamb or beef.
title: Borgo di Colloredo 2003 Gironia  (Biferno Rosso)

description: Ripe cherry, clove, cinnamon, leather and spice shape a well-balanced wine that exhibits both depth and complexity. Tones of prunes and dried fruit add warm accents and the wine delivers smooth but firm tannins.
title: Ciacci Piccolomini d'Aragona 2003  Brunello di Montalcino

description: This is an organically farmed blend of Sangiovese (80%) and Syrah (20%) with elegant mineral tones at the back of red berry, smoke and campfire. Elegance and harmony stand out here and the flavors are smoky and ashy.
title: Montebelli 2005 Acantòs Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: Aromas of white spring flower, mint and orchard fruit lead the way. Bright and silky, the refined palate delivers yellow apple, peach and Bartlett pear set against crisp acidity and a refined perlage.
title: Ruggeri & C. 2016 Vecchie Viti Brut  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Fermented in clay amphora, this fascinating orange wine opens with alluring aromas of dried yellow stone fruit, baking spice, aromatic herb, pressed yellow flower and a balsamic note. Boasting more fruit and flavor than many other wines in this genre, the savory enveloping palate presents apricot, yellow peach, candied nectarine zest, crystallized ginger and a hint of flinty mineral. Tangy acidity provides balance and lift while a honeyed note closes the lingering finish. Simply gorgeous.
title: Tre Monti 2015 Vitalba in Anfora Albana (Romagna)

description: Pipe tobacco, spiced plum, underbrush, vanilla, new leather and balsamic aromas jump out of the glass while the juicy delicious palate doles out fleshy black cherry, crushed raspberry, licorice and ground pepper. Firm, velvety and enveloping tannins provide smooth polished support. Drink through 2029.
title: Mastroberardino 2009 Radici Riserva  (Taurasi)

description: Made with ungrafted 80-year-old vines, this gorgeous wine opens with an enticing bouquet of perfumed berry, fragrant blue flower, baking spice, leather and a whiff of Mediterranean brush. The concentrated enveloping palate is still young but already offers blackberry extract, raspberry jam, licorice, dried sage and tobacco. Firm fine-grained tannins offer age-worthy support and a velvety texture. Drink 2020–2032.
title: Basilisco 2012 Storico  (Aglianico del Vulture)

description: A simply fantastic expression of Aglianico, this opens with alluring aromas of underbrush, ripe black-skinned fruit, leather, tilled earth and dark spice that carry over to the delicious full-bodied palate. Firm velvety tannins and fresh acidity balance the juicy fruit flavors. It's already extremely tempting but hold for even more complexity. Drink 2020–2031.
title: Fratelli Urciuolo 2011  Taurasi

description: A simply fantastic expression of Aglianico, this opens with alluring aromas of underbrush, ripe black-skinned fruit, leather, tilled earth and dark spice that carry over to the delicious full-bodied palate. Firm velvety tannins and fresh acidity balance the juicy fruit flavors. It's already extremely tempting but hold for even more complexity. Drink 2020–2031.
title: Fratelli Urciuolo 2011  Taurasi

description: Bold, full-bodied and polished, this opens with aromas that recall violets, ripe plums, red berries and cake spices. The smooth, savory palate delivers juicy Morello cherries, black raspberries, cinnamon, mocha, white pepper and a hint of mint. Generous, velvety tannins provide the framework and add finesse.
title: San Rustico 2010  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico

description: Pressed blue flower, ripe black-skinned berry, baking spice, tobacco and leather aromas come together on this round, full-bodied wine. The delicious palate offers juicy wild cherry, raspberry jam, vanilla, cinnamon and licorice while pliant, velvety tannins offer elegant support. It deftly combines power and finesse. Drink through 2024.
title: Fumanelli 2009  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico

description: One of the firm's single-vineyard bottlings, this opens with aromas of truffle, ripe bluish-black fruit, just turned soil and a whiff of purple flower. Fermented and aged in clay vessels, the round, vibrant palate delivers juicy wild cherry, crushed raspberry, white pepper and grilled herb. It's well balanced, with fresh acidity and soft tannins.
title: Foradori 2012 Sgarzon Teroldego (Vigneti delle Dolomiti)

description: Opening with aromas of crushed violet, ripe plum and black pepper, this is one Amarone that seamlessly combines a hefty structure with finesse. The ripe, savory palate doles out juicy black cherry, blackberry jam, licorice, cake spice and tobacco alongside firm, velvety tannins that lend it a polished texture. Drink 2017–2026.
title: Zenato 2011  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico

description: Gaudium is a radically unique expression of Fiano that might not appeal to everyone but that definitely shows careful craftsmanship and execution. The nose is redolent of crushed clove and exotic spice (aromas you'd almost expect to find in a red wine) closely followed by fresh melon, pear and peach.
title: I Capitani 2009 Gaudium  (Fiano di Avellino)

description: Cutizzi's bottle has been restyled with a single yellow polka dot that will really catch your eye. The wine is equally fetching to the senses thanks to its rich aromas of pear, peach and Golden Delicious apple. The soft creaminess to the mouthfeel begs for shrimp or shellfish.
title: Feudi di San Gregorio 2009 Cutizzi  (Greco di Tufo)

description: Cesco di Nece is a dark, inky Aglianico that opens with aromas of dried tobacco, licorice and bitter chocolate. It's a bruiser wine with dark extraction and rock-solid structure.
title: Mustilli 2006 Cesco di Nece Aglianico (Sant' Agata dei Goti)

description: Cesco di Nece is a dark, inky Aglianico that opens with aromas of dried tobacco, licorice and bitter chocolate. It's a bruiser wine with dark extraction and rock-solid structure.
title: Mustilli 2006 Cesco di Nece Aglianico (Sant' Agata dei Goti)

description: Terra di Lavoro (a blend of Aglianico and Piedirosso) is packaged in a handsome bottle and opens with inky, dark richness. The well concentrated wine is redolent of espresso bean, rum cake, chocolate, leather and moist pipe tobacco. The sweet tannins are very astringent still so give this wine time to soften.
title: Galardi 2008 Terra di Lavoro Red (Roccamonfina)

description: Lightly scented, this offers aromas of white spring flowers, citrus peel and a whiff of chopped herbs. The linear palate offers yellow apple, pear and thyme alongside racy acidity and brisk bubbles.
title: Borgoluce NV  Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore

description: This opens with whiffs of yellow apple, pineapple and white spring flowers. The palate delivers tropical fruit and white peach alongside crackling acidity and persistent, vigorous bubbles.
designation: Cuvée Tenuta Val de Brun Extra Dry
title: Astoria 2014 Cuvée Tenuta Val de Brun Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This opens with whiffs of yellow apple, pineapple and white spring flowers. The palate delivers tropical fruit and white peach alongside crackling acidity and persistent, vigorous bubbles.
designation: Cuvée Tenuta Val de Brun Extra Dry
title: Astoria 2014 Cuvée Tenuta Val de Brun Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Aromas of leather, tilled soil, game and an earthy whiff of barnyard follow through to the evolved palate along with raisin, baked plum, anise and a touch of mint. A bitter almond note closes the finish.
title: Marilena Barbera 2010 Coda della Foce Red (Sicilia)

description: This informal red opens with muted aromas of spiced blueberry and mature blackberry. The simple, easy-drinking palate offers mature black cherry, raspberry and a hint of clove alongside soft, fleeting tannins. Drink now.
title: Tenute Orestiadi 2014 Molino a Vento Bio Nero d'Avola (Terre Siciliane)

description: This informal red opens with muted aromas of spiced blueberry and mature blackberry. The simple, easy-drinking palate offers mature black cherry, raspberry and a hint of clove alongside soft, fleeting tannins. Drink now.
title: Tenute Orestiadi 2014 Molino a Vento Bio Nero d'Avola (Terre Siciliane)

description: Aromas of blackberry extract, leather, prune and a whiff of carob lead the nose and follow through to the dense palate along with a note of bitter chocolate. It's simple but well made, with solid, rounded tannins.
title: Villa Pozzi 2014 Nero d'Avola (Terre Siciliane)

description: The subdued nose eventually reveals black cherry, anise and a whiff of chopped herb that carry over to the straightforward, informal palate. Dusty, drying tannins and a note of bitter sage leave an astringent finish.
title: Di Giovanna 2013 Poggionotte Red (Terre Siciliane)

description: This Brunello has an edgy, raw feel that translates into aromas of white cherry, wild raspberries and violets. It's a streamlined and traditional wine with a vibrant, buoyant personality topped by sharp acidity and firm tannins. Pair it with creamy or cheesy dishes.
title: Molino di Sant'Antimo 2005  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Spanish cedar, cola and bright cherry notes open the nose of this beautiful Rosso di Montalcino. Added complexity is evident in the many spice and leather notes you'll encounter here and the mouthfeel is tonic, tight and rich enough to stand up to game and red meats.
title: Mastrojanni 2008  Rosso di Montalcino

description: Here's a beautifully evolved Brunello di Montalcino (from Agricoltori del Geografico) that shows both elegance and harmony within layers of fruit, spice and earth. The wine articulates many of the most pleasurable characteristics associated with Sangiovese Grosso: elegance and liveliness.
title: Geografico Castello Tricerchi 2005  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Here's a beautifully evolved Brunello di Montalcino (from Agricoltori del Geografico) that shows both elegance and harmony within layers of fruit, spice and earth. The wine articulates many of the most pleasurable characteristics associated with Sangiovese Grosso: elegance and liveliness.
title: Geografico Castello Tricerchi 2005  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Although this Brunello is from the newly released 2005 vintage, it has aromas and textures that remind you of a wine that is older still. There are sophisticated undertones here of smoke and licorice that peep up from behind candied fruit and black currants. There are also nicely integrated tones of exotic spice and mesquite wood at the back.
title: Sesti 2005  Brunello di Montalcino

description: This opens with heady aromas of yellow stone fruit, white flower and citrus. The palate is a bit on the lean side, offering lime and a mineral note alongside bright acidity.
title: Caruso & Minini 2015 Corte Ferro Zibibbo (Terre Siciliane)

description: Aromas of honeysuckle and tropical fruit lead the nose while the lively palate doles out pear and juicy nectarine. A touch of bitter almond adds interest.
title: Agricola Bellaria 2015 Falanghina (Irpinia)

description: A blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Petit Verdot, this is plush and round, with bright notes of black fruit, spice, leather and blackberry. There's a touch of spice on the finish, and the texture is soft and rich.
title: Feudo Principi di Butera 2010 Symposio Red (Sicilia)

description: Made from Syrah that was grown on the steep, blackened slopes of Mt. Etna, this is round and plump, with aromas of blackberry and spice backed by black olive, bacon fat and crushed white pepper. It's silky, long and smooth.
title: Cottanera 2009 Sole di Sesta Syrah (Sicilia)

description: Made from Syrah that was grown on the steep, blackened slopes of Mt. Etna, this is round and plump, with aromas of blackberry and spice backed by black olive, bacon fat and crushed white pepper. It's silky, long and smooth.
title: Cottanera 2009 Sole di Sesta Syrah (Sicilia)

description: This is a pure expression of Nero d'Avola, with bright cherry and generous milk chocolate notes that are backed by toasted oak tannins and a fresh, spicy finish. The quality of the fruit is lively, rich and chewy.
title: Baglio del Cristo di Campobello 2010 Lu Patri Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: If you love Pinot Noir, you should definitely try Sicily's Frappato grape. The crowning achievement of dynamic vintner Arianna Occhipinti, this wine portrays the variety in it's purest form. Dark ruby in color, notes of forest fruit, blue flower, spice and smoked bacon abound.
title: Occhipinti 2010 Il Frappato (Sicilia)

description: This boasts oak-driven aromas of honey and vanilla, with notes of exotic fruit, citrus and Golden Delicious. It is soft and supple, with a lively, fruit-driven finish.
title: Marisa Cuomo 2010 Furore Bianco Fiorduva White (Costa d'Amalfi)

description: Part of the natural wine movement, this organically farmed blend of Nerello Mascalese, Nerello Cappuccio and Alicante shows harmony and elegance. It shows some age too, with aromas of tar, licorice, cassis, prune and dark tobacco. It feels supersmooth and silky.
title: I Custodi 2007 Aetneus  (Etna)

description: Part of the natural wine movement, this organically farmed blend of Nerello Mascalese, Nerello Cappuccio and Alicante shows harmony and elegance. It shows some age too, with aromas of tar, licorice, cassis, prune and dark tobacco. It feels supersmooth and silky.
title: I Custodi 2007 Aetneus  (Etna)

description: Mostly Negroamaro (with 5% Malvasia Nera), this is a sweet-smelling wine with candy-like aromas of Christmas bread, allspice and plum cake. The wine delivers dense, firm structure with nicely aged fruit flavors on the close.
title: Cantina Sociale Cooperativa di Copertino 2001 Riserva Negroamaro (Copertino)

description: This dark wine is characterized by jammy notes of blackberry marmalade and sweet Christmas spice. It's lean and compact in the mouth with long-lasting flavors of blueberry and black currant.
title: Cantina del Taburno 2005 Fidelis  (Aglianico del Taburno)

description: Gualdo del Re's honey-toned Vermentino offers rich saturation and density thanks to the Tuscan sunshine. The wine is thick and glossy with warm notes of peach, nectarine and apricot. The finish is creamy and rich and would stand up to cheese-based dishes.
title: Gualdo del Re 2007 Valentina Vermentino (Val di Cornia Suvereto)

description: This inky-black Barbera boasts granite and slate aromas with black fruit, cassis, wild mushroom, tobacco and wet earth. These are the characteristic aromas of this native grape variety, although the deep extraction and sweet oak flavors on display here denote a very modern interpretation.
title: Cascina Garitina 2006 Neuvsent  (Barbera d'Asti Superiore Nizza)

description: This organically farmed Dolcetto delivers surprising sophistication with tones of wild mushroom and spice behind bright red fruit and berry. The wine is slightly tannic but closes with a smooth, polished texture.
title: Cascina Corte di Barosi Alessandro 2007 Vigna Pirochetta  (Dolcetto di Dogliani)

description: This organically farmed Dolcetto delivers surprising sophistication with tones of wild mushroom and spice behind bright red fruit and berry. The wine is slightly tannic but closes with a smooth, polished texture.
title: Cascina Corte di Barosi Alessandro 2007 Vigna Pirochetta  (Dolcetto di Dogliani)

description: This Barbera d'Asti Superiore opens with brambly notes of underbrush and wild berry followed by wet earth and smoked ham. Give it two or three years in the bottle and pair this fruit-forward wine with lasagna or meatloaf.
title: Cantina Sociale di Mombercelli Terre Astesane 2007 Terre Astesane  (Barbera d'Asti Superiore)

description: Dark, concentrated and oak-driven, this is a smooth and sophisticated Barbera d'Alba with intense aromas of black fruit, cassis and cherry. The wood notes are still a bit raw and apparent, so give this wine two more years in the bottle to integrate.
title: Bric Cenciurio 2007 Naunda  (Barbera d'Alba)

description: The wine opens with a thick, black and dense appearance and segues to raw aromas of blackberry, cherry, tobacco, spice and natural rubber. There's a vinous, chewy quality here that needs more time in the bottle to unwind.
title: Alfonso Boeri 2007 Porlapà  (Barbera d'Asti Superiore)

description: The wine opens with a thick, black and dense appearance and segues to raw aromas of blackberry, cherry, tobacco, spice and natural rubber. There's a vinous, chewy quality here that needs more time in the bottle to unwind.
title: Alfonso Boeri 2007 Porlapà  (Barbera d'Asti Superiore)

description: Here is a raw, chewy and vinous expression of Dolcetto with loads of bright berry and fruit intensity. The wine is easy and fresh with dense pulp and texture on the close.
title: Prunotto 2008 Mosesco  (Dolcetto d'Alba)

description: This dark expression of Dolcetto opens with richly concentrated fruit and generous aromas of black fruit, plum, slate roof and granite stone. The wine is correct but simple in the mouth and offers a tannic bite at just the right level of firmness to pair with meat or cheese.
title: Poderi Alasia 2008  Dolcetto d'Asti

description: The longer this wine sits in the glass, the more beautiful its aromas become. It opens with a dark and rich appearance and vibrant notes of blueberry, wild berry and exotic spice. There's a slightly lactic note at first that slowly evolves into milk chocolate and fudge.
title: Pecchenino 2007 Quass  (Barbera d'Alba)

description: Smoke and graphite notes, coupled with a solid base of black fruit and cassis, give this wine many aromatic layers to contemplate. There are drying mineral notes here yet the wine is ultimately very plush and velvety in the mouth and it ends with a touch of oak sweetness and bitter cherry.
title: L'Armangia 2007  Barbera d'Asti Superiore Nizza

description: Here's a Barbera with a cheerful level of complexity that is enhanced by extra tones of spice and vanilla. The aromas are well integrated and there's plenty of fruit freshness here to pair with oven-roasted pasta.
title: La Spinosa Alta 2007 La Punta  (Barbera del Monferrato Superiore)

description: Despite the infamous heat of the 2003 vintage, Piano Alto Barbera d'Asti Superiore is a surprising and impressive wine. There are pretty linear notes of black stone and granite backed by some ripe berry and blackberry. The wine seems younger than it really is.
title: Bava 2003 Piano Alto  (Barbera d'Asti Superiore)

description: Here's a harmonious and well-balanced Barbera d'Asti Superiore with pretty mineral tones that are woven tight within a fabric of wild berry fruit and spice. The wine is tart and fresh on the finale with a long blast of blackberry and cherry on the close.
title: Agostino Pavia & Figli 2007 Molisse  (Barbera d'Asti Superiore)

description: This pretty Pecorino opens with bright tones of apricot and honey followed by a thick, viscous mouthfeel. Pair it with asparagus or creamy artichoke risotto.
title: Torre Raone 2010 Pecorino (Colline Pescaresi)

description: This Rosso Conero (mostly Montepulciano with a small element of Sangiovese) proves to be a simple and fresh option that would work with pasta or chicken roast.

description: There's a spicy touch of white pepper or dried sage backed by peach and melon that gives this Friulano extra lift and intensity. It feels simple and thin in the mouth but it does shows signs of territorial identity thanks to its unique bouquet.

description: Here's a great deal for a soft, plush and easy-drinking Italian red that would pair with lasagna or fettuccine with meat ragù. You will detect fresh notes of blackberry and blueberry as well as dried aromas of cassis and candied raspberry.
