description: Simple, clean and bright, Le Pianette is all about fresh fruit. The blend is 70-30 Sangiovese and Colorino, and it offers lively cherry and blueberry notes.
title: Fattoria Fibbiano 2011 Le Pianette Red (Toscana)

description: This Vermentino opens with distinct tones of almond skin and stone fruit. The mouthfeel is lean and clean, with a compact feel and medium intensity.
title: Ceralti 2011 Vermentino (Bolgheri)

description: Trebbiano, Sémillon, Roussanne, Sauvignon and Pinot Bianco form this unique blend. It offers subtle tones of peach, pineapple and honeysuckle.
title: Tenuta del Buonamico 2011 White (Montecarlo)

description: Trebbiano, Sémillon, Roussanne, Sauvignon and Pinot Bianco form this unique blend. It offers subtle tones of peach, pineapple and honeysuckle.
title: Tenuta del Buonamico 2011 White (Montecarlo)

description: From the Marchesi d'Orsi di Villanoca winemaking family, this blend of Sangiovese, Merlot and Ancellotta offers tones of raw cherry and raspberry that give the wine a clean bouquet. The fresh, easy mouthfeel would pair well with pasta dishes.
title: Casaloste 2009 Rosso Maniero Red (Toscana)

description: A blend of mostly Sangiovese, with a touch of Merlot, this delivers a fresh flower tone and a tangy forest-berry flavor. It feels creamy, with medium density, and it has crisp acidity that keeps the palate refreshed.
title: Castello di Ama 2011 Rosato (Toscana)

description: A mix of 70% Sangiovese and other international red grapes, this would pair well with pizza or pasta with meat ragù. It shows flavors of cherry, forest berry, cola, almond and a touch of mild tobacco.
title: Carpineto 2011 Dogajolo Red (Toscana)

description: Here's a fun and fresh Italian Pinot Grigio with piquant aromas of citrus and peach. The wine is informal and easy-drinking. A good food pairing would be chicken salad or lightly roasted fish. Screwcap.
title: La Villa 2008 Pinot Grigio (Veneto)

description: Ripe plum, iris, violet and underbrush aromas lead the nose. The firm palate offers dried black cherry, raspberry, licorice, clove and a hint of tobacco. Tightly knit but ripe tannins and fresh acidity provide support. Drink 2016–2022.
title: Fattoria di Corsignano 2012 L'Imperatore Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Made with Sangiovese and 10% Canaiolo, Colorino and Ciliegiolo, this boasts an alluring aroma of red berry, fragrant iris, anise, underbrush and a balsamic note. The bright palate offers ripe black cherry, menthol, baking spice, grilled herb and a tobacco note. It's nicely balanced, with ripe tannins and freshness. Drink through 2020.
title: Badia a Coltibuono 2010 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Made with Sangiovese and 10% Canaiolo, Colorino and Ciliegiolo, this boasts an alluring aroma of red berry, fragrant iris, anise, underbrush and a balsamic note. title: Badia a Coltibuono 2010 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: A blend of 90% Sangiovese and 10% Cabernet Sauvignon, this has enticing scents of fragrant blue flower, wild berry, anise and a whiff of exotic spice. The palate boasts structure and finesse, offering black cherry, cinnamon, white pepper and a hint of tobacco backed up by lithe tannins and bright acidity.
title: Marchesi Antinori 2012 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: A blend of 90% Sangiovese and 10% Cabernet Sauvignon, this has enticing scents of fragrant blue flower, wild berry, anise and a whiff of exotic spice. The palate boasts structure and finesse, offering black cherry, cinnamon, white pepper and a hint of tobacco backed up by lithe tannins and bright acidity.
title: Marchesi Antinori 2012 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: A bizarre blend of lime, unipe pineapple, banana and tropical fruit marks this clumsy, disjointed wine. It's not bad, but it's all elbows, with hard edges sticking out all over.
title: San Giuseppe 2001 Pinot Grigio (Veneto)

description: Light, with simple pineapple flavors. Hints of green tea enliven the nose, while the finish is clean and citrusy.
title: Bolla 2001  Soave

description: Here's a fresh, berry-driven Rosso di Montalcino with an emphasis on ease and drinkability. This is the kind of wine you can pair with oven-roasted pasta or pork dishes because it offers bright acidity and lean structure.
title: Tenuta Friggiali 2008  Rosso di Montalcino

description: Made with the native Carricante grape, this elegant effort shows a dusty mineral nuance, backed by subtle tones of citrus and stone fruit. It shows structure and acidity that will help it age for more years to come.
title: Benanti 2008 Pietramarina  (Etna)

description: This is a unique wine for enthusiasts of the natural wine movement. It shows a dark garnet color, with spicy aromas of dried fruit, currant and Indian spice. A bright tone of dried mint and rosemary lingers on the finish.
title: Frank Cornelissen NV MunJebel 7 10th Anniversary  (Etna)

description: This offers creamy richness and notes of apple-cinnamon, citrus and pear. The mouthfeel is not too dense but is rather fresh and zesty.
title: I Capitani 2011 Gaudium  (Fiano di Avellino)

description: Elegant and tight, this blend offers savory tones of cured meat and dried fruit, followed by green notes of curry leaf and herb. The wine is tangy, thick and persistent on the palate.
title: Agricola Punica 2010 Montessu Red (Isola dei Nuraghi)

description: This offers blackberry, prune and cooked plum flavors, with tones of leather and tobacco. The mouthfeel is smooth and silky.
title: Principi di Spadafora 2008 Schietto Cabernet Sauvignon (Sicilia)

description: This is round, soft and velvety, with notes of cherry, blackberry, spice, leather and tobacco. With no sharp edges, its acidity is well balanced within the many layers of fruit.
title: Planeta 2010 Merlot (Sicilia)

description: This is round, soft and velvety, with notes of cherry, blackberry, spice, leather and tobacco. With no sharp edges, its acidity is well balanced within the many layers of fruit.
title: Planeta 2010 Merlot (Sicilia)

description: There's a wild, untamed quality to this 100% Nero d'Avola that comes forth as almond, wild berry, cola and dried ginger. Made according to biodynamic principles, this is fresh, tart, focused and complex. It offers a thrilling experience.
title: Occhipinti 2010 Siccagno Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: There's a wild, untamed quality to this 100% Nero d'Avola that comes forth as almond, wild berry, cola and dried ginger. Made according to biodynamic principles, this is fresh, tart, focused and complex. It offers a thrilling experience.
title: Occhipinti 2010 Siccagno Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: This blend of Uva di Troia and Negroamaro shows sophisticated tones of toasted nut and spice behind the notes of ripe fruit and prune. The mouthfeel is soft and smooth.
title: Torre Quarto 2007 Quarto Ducale Riserva  (Rosso di Cerignola)

description: This blend of Uva di Troia and Negroamaro shows sophisticated tones of toasted nut and spice behind the notes of ripe fruit and prune. The mouthfeel is soft and smooth.
title: Torre Quarto 2007 Quarto Ducale Riserva  (Rosso di Cerignola)

description: This Nero d'Avola shows a dark, rich color and inky concentration. It presents aromas of smoked bacon, black cherry and exotic spice, with a rich, velvety mouthfeel.
title: Marabino 2009 Archimede Eloro Pachino Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: The nose isn't very expressive but eventually reveals underbrush and dried earth aromas. The palate offers tart black currant, green pepper, coffee and toast alongside supple tannins and fresh acidity.
