Opulent aromas are of forest fruit, cherry cola, licorice, mesquite shavings and root beer. The wine has all the qualities for a long aging future including acidity, tannins and pulpy fruit tones.
title: Castello di Verduno 2007 Massara  (Barolo)

description: Barolo Coste di Rose is a darkly concentrated and rich wine with sweet spice overtones of clove, licorice and cinnamon over cherry fruit and raspberry. There's a soft, chewy quality to the mouthfeel that is typical of wines from the 2007 vintage.
title: Bric Cenciurio 2007 Coste di Rose  (Barolo)

description: Brezza's finely nuanced Cannubi expression of Nebbiolo delivers sweet spice tones of cinnamon, clove and nutmeg followed by delicate tones of root beer, drying mineral, soy sauce and forest fruit. The wine is fine, compact and chiseled on the close with a long, structured finish. It's very elegant overall.
title: Brezza 2007 Cannubi  (Barolo)

description: You'll love the powerful richness and natural concentration of this beautiful Barolo. It boasts masculine renderings of cherry liqueur, carob pod, red rose and sassy cinnamon spice. The wine shows great aging potential (10 years or more) thanks to its firm tannins and fresh acidity.
title: Aurelio Settimo 2007  Barolo

description: Barolo Vigna Rué is a meaty, beefy expression of Nebbiolo with generous tones of leather and tobacco backed by red cherry, spice, smoked beef jerky and soy sauce. Dark fruit concentration helps pad against the fresh oak tones that are also evident (and that will surely soften with more bottle aging).
title: Germano Angelo 2007 Vigna Rué  (Barolo)

description: Barolo La Rosa delivers bold, dark concentration with sweet spice tones of almond paste and vanilla cream backed by sharply focused aromas of red berry, cassis, plum and mocha. In the mouth, this beautiful Nebbiolo boasts a linear but long-lasting feel.
title: Fontanafredda 2007 La Rosa  (Barolo)

description: This Riserva Barbaresco hits a home run thanks to the pretty richness of its fruit and spice tones and the elegant aromatic accents offered in the form of violet, cola and licorice. The wine shows dark concentration, velvety richness and a sweet milk chocolate finish.
title: Roberto Sarotto 2006 Gaia Principe Riserva  (Barbaresco)

description: Punset releases its wines much later than others and its organic, Nebbiolo-based wines really do need a lot of time in the bottle before they are ready to drink. Take this 2004 Barbaresco: The wine is very alive and bright with firm tannins and a long finish that will gain traction over the next decade.
title: Punset 2004  Barbaresco

description: Punset releases its wines much later than others and its organic, Nebbiolo-based wines really do need a lot of time in the bottle before they are ready to drink. Take this 2004 Barbaresco: The wine is very alive and bright with firm tannins and a long finish that will gain traction over the next decade.
title: Punset 2004  Barbaresco

description: Ripe berry and mature fruit aromas of prune and candied cherry open the bouquet of this lovely, garnet-colored Barolo. The wine offers excellent intensity and depth with what can best be described as a lively mouthfeel. Indeed, this wine exudes life, health and brightness.
title: Podere Ruggeri Corsini 2007 San Pietro  (Barolo)

description: From the Monforte d'Alba area of Barolo, this deeply concentrated and rich wine is etched by sharp aromas of licorice, black pepper, red cherry, chocolate, leather and cigar box. The mouthfeel, with its soft, velvety tannins, is particularly pleasurable. Drink after 2015.
title: Cascina Chicco 2007 Rocche di Castelletto  (Barolo)

description: This is a lovely vineyard designate Barbaresco that combines fresh flavors of cassis and wild berries with ethereal notes of root beer, licorice and tar. It finishes with smooth, sturdy tannins and will only improve over the next 5–10 years.
title: Albino Rocca 2008 Vigneto Brich Ronchi  (Barbaresco)

description: Combining finesse and structure, this impressive wine opens with fantastic scents of new leather, woodland berry, baking spice and balsamic notes. A blend of Nebbiolo and 15% Vespolina, the enticing palate doles out juicy black cherry, raspberry and white pepper framed in firm refined tannins. An energizing mineral note carries the lingering finish. Despite the warm vintage, it still boasts freshness. Drink through 2026.
title: Le Piane 2009  Boca

description: Full-bodied and velvety, this opens with alluring aromas of baking spice, mature plum, violet, Alpine herb and a balsamic note. The concentrated palate is smooth and robust, but it also boasts a weightless quality, delivering dried black cherry, nutmeg, cinnamon, anise, dried date and pipe tobacco alongside firm polished tannins and fresh acidity. A mineral note closes the finish. This is the best Sfursat 5 Stelle I've tried so far. Drink 2018–2028.
title: Nino Negri 2013 5 Stelle  (Sforzato di Valtellina)

description: Full-bodied and velvety, this opens with alluring aromas of baking spice, mature plum, violet, Alpine herb and a balsamic note. The concentrated palate is smooth and robust, but it also boasts a weightless quality, delivering dried black cherry, nutmeg, cinnamon, anise, dried date and pipe tobacco alongside firm polished tannins and fresh acidity. A mineral note closes the finish. This is the best Sfursat 5 Stelle I've tried so far. Drink 2018–2028.
title: Nino Negri 2013 5 Stelle  (Sforzato di Valtellina)

description: Red berry, aromatic herb, pressed violet and dark spice aromas meld together in the glass. Firmly structured, the palate boasts intensity and energy, offering dark cherry, licorice and mint set against a backbone of fine-grained tannins and fresh acidity. It's well balanced but young so give this time to fully develop. Drink 2020–2032.
title: Gaja 2013 Costa Russi  (Barbaresco)

description: Intensely fragrant, this opens with stunning aromas of iris, violet, perfumed berry and a whiff of botanical herb. Linear and refined, the focused palate offers red cherry, strawberry, white pepper and a hint of star anise framed in taut refined tannins and bright acidity. It shows great tension and energy. Drink 2023–2035.
title: Paolo Scavino 2013 Carobric  (Barolo)

description: Underbrush, scorched earth, ripe berry, blue flower and leather aromas take shape in the glass. The full-bodied enveloping palate doles out black cherry marinated in spirits, fleshy raspberry, truffle game and dark baking spice alongside firm, velvety tannins. A licorice note marks the finish. It's evolving quickly and won't need years to come around. Drink 2020–2030.
title: Gigi Rosso 2013 Arione  (Barolo)

description: This full-bodied wine opens with aromas of crushed berry, tobacco, leather, clove and a balsamic note. The robust enveloping palate offers cherry marinated in spirits, licorice, peppercorn and dried herb framed in firm velvety tannins.
title: Giacomo Fenocchio 2011 Bussia Riserva 90 Dì  (Barolo)

description: Aromas of menthol, red berry, coffee and blue flower waft from the glass along with whiffs of chopped aromatic herb. The aromas follow through to the velvety palate along with Marasca cherry, raspberry and licorice. Firm, fine-grained tannins provide a structured framework. Drink 2025–2033.
title: Ceretto 2013 Brunate  (Barolo)

description: Red berry, camphor, dried Alpine herb and a whiff of espresso are some of the aromas you'll find on this firmly structured red. On the young, taut palate, assertive fine-grained tannins frame red cherry, star anise and coffee bean. It's still young, with a tight, tongue-drying finish. Drink 2023–2033.
title: Ceretto 2013 Bricco Rocche  (Barolo)

description: Red berry, camphor, dried Alpine herb and a whiff of espresso are some of the aromas you'll find on this firmly structured red. On the young, taut palate, assertive fine-grained tannins frame red cherry, star anise and coffee bean. It's still young, with a tight, tongue-drying finish. Drink 2023–2033.
title: Ceretto 2013 Bricco Rocche  (Barolo)

description: Aromas of overripe cherry, vanilla extract, toast and espresso continue to the palate, along with dark chocolate and oak. The palate has rough, astringent wood tannins that gives this a bitter, drying close.
title: Cava d'Onice 2009  Brunello di Montalcino

description: The rather faded hue of this wine indicates some evolution. On the nose, it offers an unusual but intriguing combination of aromas including sweet black fruit, A.1. sauce, thyme and sage. The palate offers ripe red and black cherry accented with notes of espresso and black pepper, but the fruit richness is already fading.
title: Tassi 2009 Franci  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Aromas include ripe red and black fruit, spice, mint, espresso and oak. The palate is extremely soft and forward, showing mature black plum, toast, coffee and vanilla extract alongside evolved tannins. Reflecting the hot vintage, it lacks energy for the long term so enjoy over the next few years.
title: San Polo 2009  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Aromas include ripe red and black fruit, spice, mint, espresso and oak. The palate is extremely soft and forward, showing mature black plum, toast, coffee and vanilla extract alongside evolved tannins. Reflecting the hot vintage, it lacks energy for the long term so enjoy over the next few years.
title: San Polo 2009  Brunello di Montalcino

description: This opens with aromas of leather, black fruit, spice and balsamic herbs along with earthy notes. The palate delivers black cherry flavors accented with notes of vanilla, cinnamon. espresso and a hint of grilled herbs. However, it's evolved with a short finish, so enjoy soon.
title: Renieri 2009  Brunello di Montalcino

description: The wine opens with aromas of oak, toast, coffee, black fruit and spearmint. The palate offers black currants, sour cherry, espresso and mint alongside dusty, drying tannins. Reflecting the vintage, this young Brunello is already accessible, so drink 2015–2019.
title: Poggio Nardone 2009  Brunello di Montalcino

description: The wine opens with aromas of oak, toast, coffee, black fruit and spearmint. The palate offers black currants, sour cherry, espresso and mint alongside dusty, drying tannins. Reflecting the vintage, this young Brunello is already accessible, so drink 2015–2019.
title: Poggio Nardone 2009  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Aromas of mature black fruit, spearmint and espresso come with the barest whiff of earthy farmyard. The palate offers up black cherry, raspberry and black pepper accented with toast and espresso, all alongside assertive but drying tannins. It's forward and evolved with ideal drinking time 2015–2019.
title: Pinino 2009  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Crosè is a hearty rosato made from Nebbiolo, the grape behind Barolo and Barbaresco. It has a bright character with ripe cherry-berry fruit balanced by crisp acidity. While structured, it's also very drinkable.
title: Pasquale Pelissero 2012 Crosè' Nebbiolo (Langhe)

description: Overripe black berries, vanilla, leather and a touch of coconut lead the nose. The palate delvers fleshy black cherry layered with chocolate and a coffee note alongside evolved, rather tired tannins. It's not an ager so enjoy this soon.
title: Molino di Sant'Antimo 2009  Brunello di Montalcino

description: With its pretty, delicate fragrance of white flowers, this Arneis shows that Piedmont can also make interesting whites, especially from native grapes. On the palate it delivers pear, green apple and a hint of mineral along with a smooth texture and crisp acidity. Saranty Imports, Pleasure Elite.
title: Mauro Sebaste 2012  Roero

description: With its brick color, this wine appears far older than it is, a common trait of this difficult vintage. It opens with aromas of forest floor, dried tobacco leaf, mushroom and ripe berry, all of which carry over to the palate along with subtle cherry and a hint of cinnamon. However, this wine is already tired, with evolved tannins. Drink soon.
title: Lazzeretti 2009  Brunello di Montalcino

description: With its brick color, this wine appears far older than it is, a common trait of this difficult vintage. It opens with aromas of forest floor, dried tobacco leaf, mushroom and ripe berry, all of which carry over to the palate along with subtle cherry and a hint of cinnamon. However, this wine is already tired, with evolved tannins. Drink soon.
title: Lazzeretti 2009  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Aromas of black fruit, baking spices and meat juices carry over to the palate along with ripe berry, vanilla and hints of mocha. This is very soft and ready with a sweet, almost sugary finish. Drink soon.
title: San Filippo 2009 Le Lucere  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: This wine opens with aromas of leafy underbrush, meat juices and stewed prunes. The palate initially reveals rich black plum combined with extremely sweet sensations of cherry syrup. But the fruit doesn't stand up to the assertive and astringent tannins that generate a hollow midpalate and an abrupt, bitter finish.
title: Poggio Rubino 2009  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Aromas of dried tobacco leaf, oak and toast take the forefront, with prunes marinated in spirits and a whiff of farmyard hovering in the background. The palate shows muddled flavors of overripe black cherry, bitter dried sage, vanilla and espresso with notes of sweet-and-sour soy sauce alongside fleeting tannins.
title: Podere La Vigna 2009  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Aged for a year in new oak, this hefty wine opens with aromas of vanilla, chocolate, plum and toast. The dense, juicy palate delivers concentrated blackberry, blueberry extract and vanilla, but you'll also notice an alcoholic warmth.
title: Morgante 2011 Don Antonio Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: Aromas of blue flower, mature black fruit, underbrush and subtle oak lead the nose of this Taurasi. The palate offers solid tannins and flavors of mature plum, stewed prune and plum cake, accented by a hint of allspice.
title: Pietracupa 2010  Taurasi

description: Aromas of blue flower, mature black fruit, underbrush and subtle oak lead the nose of this Taurasi. The palate offers solid tannins and flavors of mature plum, stewed prune and plum cake, accented by a hint of allspice.
title: Pietracupa 2010  Taurasi

description: Made from the native grape Nerello Mascalese grown on Mount Etna, this salmon colored rosato offers bright red cherry, juicy pink grapefruit, nectarine, white pepper and mineral sensations. The savory palate is balanced by vibrant acidity.
title: Graci 2013 Rosato Nerello Mascalese (Etna)

description: Made from organically farmed grapes, this savory wine opens with aromas of crushed violet, black cherry, wild raspberry, plum, white pepper and baking spices. The succulent fruit palate is supported by chewy tannins and fresh acidity. A licorice note marks the finish.
title: Il Conventino 2013  Rosso di Montepulciano

description: Crushed blue flower, succulent black cherry, wild raspberry and baking spices jump from the glass. The juicy fruit palate is balanced by soft, round tannins. It closes on a lively mineral note. Drink through 2015.
title: Bersano 2012 Paisan  (Nebbiolo d'Alba)

description: Fans of Vino Nobile will adore this pretty and accessible Rosso. It opens with a delicate fragrance of violet, perfumed berries and baking spices. The refined palate delivers juicy wild cherry and raspberry lightly accented with cinnamon notes alongside supple tannins and fresh acidity. A hint of licorice marks the close.
title: Avignonesi 2012  Rosso di Montepulciano

description: Made entirely with Sangiovese, this straightforward wine offers aromas of forest floor, violet, red berry and spices. The juicy palate delivers ripe black fruit accented with notes of white pepper, cinnamon, black tea and clove alongside firm but ripe tannins. Enjoy this now through 2018.
title: Castelli del Grevepesa 2011 Castelgreve  (Chianti Classico)

description: A potpourri of violets, sweet baking spices and woodland berries take center stage. The savory palate offers up wild cherry, black raspberry and cinnamon alongside supple tannins and fresh acidity. Drink soon.
title: Veglio 2012  Nebbiolo d'Alba

description: A blend of 50% Sangiovese and 50% Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, this savory wine boasts structure and drinkability. Aromas of toast, chocolate and ripe plum carry over to the palate along with dark cherry, white pepper and smooth, velvety tannins. It's made for early drinking so enjoy soon.
title: Tua Rita 2012 Rosso dei Notri Red (Toscana)

description: A pretty fragrance of crushed flowers, woodland berries and sweet spices waft from the glass of this savory Rosso. The juicy palate offers upfront wild cherry, black raspberry, cinnamon and vanilla alongside dusty tannins. Pair it with cold cuts, hearty first courses or medium seasoned cheeses.
title: Tornesi 2012  Rosso di Montalcino

description: Composed of Sangiovese, Sagrantino, Merlot and Montepulciano, this offers pretty tones of spice and wild berry, with background tones of tobacco and worn leather.
title: Fongoli 2009  Montefalco Rosso

description: Composed of Sangiovese, Sagrantino, Merlot and Montepulciano, this offers pretty tones of spice and wild berry, with background tones of tobacco and worn leather.
title: Fongoli 2009  Montefalco Rosso

description: Dark and savory, this has spicy aromas of clove, cinnamon, prune and red currant. It shows freshness and medium density overall.
title: Castelli del Grevepesa 2009 Clemente VII  (Chianti Classico)

description: A blend of Sangiovese, Montepulciano and Sagrantino, this is a rich, chewy red with savory aromas of cured meat and spice. There's a touch of ripe fruit and even a note on the finish that resembles cinnamon or ground nutmeg.
title: Roccafiore 2008 Prova d'Autore Red (Umbria)

description: A blend of Sangiovese, Montepulciano and Sagrantino, this is a rich, chewy red with savory aromas of cured meat and spice. There's a touch of ripe fruit and even a note on the finish that resembles cinnamon or ground nutmeg.
title: Roccafiore 2008 Prova d'Autore Red (Umbria)

description: Made with organically farmed Sangiovese, this pretty red delivers savory aromas of spice, cola and steak sauce, with cool, fruit intensity and bright acidity on the finish.
title: Tenuta Amalia 2010 Bio-571  (Sangiovese di Romagna)

description: Made with organically farmed Sangiovese, this pretty red delivers savory aromas of spice, cola and steak sauce, with cool, fruit intensity and bright acidity on the finish.
title: Tenuta Amalia 2010 Bio-571  (Sangiovese di Romagna)

description: This Sangiovese from central Italy offers abundant freshness and pretty aromas of wild berry, almond, cola and dried ginger. There's a touch of dried herb and licorice that gives the wine a bright, buoyant finish.
title: Rontana 2008 Sangiovese (Colli di Faenza)

description: The Albana varietal is usually made into dessert wine, but this interesting rendition is vinified dry. It opens with fragrant aromas of honey, peach and apricot. A touch of subtle sweetness marks the finish.
title: Tre Monti 2011 Vigna Rocca  (Albana di Romagna)

description: A blend of 50% Merlot and 50% Cabernet, this delivers sassy aromas of leather and cinnamon, with ripe, pulpy fruit. There's a touch of cherry that gives the wine a soft, velvety finish.
title: Tenuta Vitalonga 2010 Elcione Red (Umbria)

description: Ramitello is a beautiful wine (85% Prugnolo and 15% Aglianico for power and structure) with soft, lush aromas of chocolate, espresso, leather, clove and dense blackberry fruit. The wine is yielding and generous and has absolutely no sharp edges.
title: Di Majo Norante 2005 Ramitello Red (Terra degli Osci)

description: This is a modern, New World wine that boasts plush softness and a thick, velvety texture. Pair this wine with succulent beef, lamb or any meat that can stand up to its firm texture and solid tannins. Aromas include chocolate fudge, leather, allspice and clove.
title: Di Majo Norante 2005 Contado Aglianico (Molise)

description: Here's a cheerful and beautifully aromatic blend of Pinot Grigio, Traminer and Riesling that boasts both freshness and complexity. The Pinot Grigio gives it weight and structure and the other two varieties create a fragrant bouquet of stone fruit and white flowers.
title: Lis Neris 2006 Confini White (Venezia Giulia)

description: This popular white wine from Tuscany is aged three months in oak for extra softness and creaminess. Aromas include honey, peach and slightly roasted almond. Pair this pretty wine with spicy Indian or Thai curries.
title: Teruzzi & Puthod 2006 Terre di Tufi White (Toscana)

description: This popular white wine from Tuscany is aged three months in oak for extra softness and creaminess. Aromas include honey, peach and slightly roasted almond. Pair this pretty wine with spicy Indian or Thai curries.
title: Teruzzi & Puthod 2006 Terre di Tufi White (Toscana)

description: Ripassá is a wine that has been refermented on the skins to produce extra richness and intensity of aromas. This distinctive wine offers tones of blackberry jam, currant, clove and curry powder. It's a luscious and slightly sweet tasting wine with chewy tannins.
title: Stefano Accordini 2005 Ripassá  (Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso)

description: Here's a Riserva interpretation of Uva di Troia with a solid base of berry fruit backed by more sophisticated aromas of toasted oak and spice. The wine is firm and solid in the mouth with long, wood-driven tannins.
title: Santa Lucia 2004 Riserva Le More Uva di Troia (Castel del Monte)

description: This mature red wine from the Castel del Monte area of Southern Italy is made with 100% Uve di Troia and delivers thick layers of cherry fruit, chocolate fudge and exotic spice (it sees 14 months of oak aging). Its color is rich and saturated and the wine has a polished but ripe finish.
title: Agrinatura 2005 Giancarlo Ceci Parco Marano Uva di Troia (Castel del Monte)

description: Caparzo's lush and full 75-25 blend of Chardonnay and Traminer is faithfully representative of a white wine from Tuscany. You'll get aromas of peach and passion fruits backed by warm tones of vanilla and mature melon.
title: Caparzo 2005 Le Grance White (Sant'Antimo)

description: Caparzo's lush and full 75-25 blend of Chardonnay and Traminer is faithfully representative of a white wine from Tuscany. You'll get aromas of peach and passion fruits backed by warm tones of vanilla and mature melon.
title: Caparzo 2005 Le Grance White (Sant'Antimo)

description: Smokey, volcanic notes of slate, ash and charcoal are followed by blackberry, plum and prune. You'll also get resin, tar, asphalt and tobacco lavished over the wine's thick consistency and drying tannins.
title: Cantina del Taburno 2004 Delius  (Aglianico del Taburno)

description: Toast, espresso, oak and grilled sage aromas lead the way while the firm palate delivers ripe raspberry, fleshy cherry, powdered sage and star anise. Astringent tannins provide support but also dry out the finish.
title: Enzo Boglietti 2012 Case Nere  (Barolo)

description: This savory selection offers a spicy bouquet of black pepper, nutmeg and clove, along with blackberry and cherry notes. It has a refined and vibrant palate, with black cherry, pepper and spice notes framed by silky tannins and refreshing acidity.
title: Novaia 2010 Vigneto I Cantoni  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore)

description: Made with the Friulano grape—formerly known as Tocai Friulano—this white offers lemon peel and mineral aromas that carry over to the palate. It's long and linear, with a crisp finish.
title: Mario Schiopetto 2011 Friulano (Collio)

description: This has a fragrance of black fruit, vanilla and oak. On the palate, it shows mature blackberry and plum-cake flavors, along with very evident oak and toasted notes. While this is still alluring, the fruit and freshness are starting to fade, so drink soon.
title: Musella 2008 Riserva Fondatori  (Amarone della Valpolicella)

description: This has a fragrance of black fruit, vanilla and oak. On the palate, it shows mature blackberry and plum-cake flavors, along with very evident oak and toasted notes. While this is still alluring, the fruit and freshness are starting to fade, so drink soon.
title: Musella 2008 Riserva Fondatori  (Amarone della Valpolicella)

description: This leads with pretty fragrances of plum and black cherry, with hints of oak and vanilla. The palate is soft and round, offering dark fruit and chocolate flavors layered with cinnamon and nutmeg.
title: La Dama 2010  Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso

description: This is a straightforward Amarone, with red fruit and spice aromas. The palate delivers cherry and raspberry flavors and a hint of white pepper. It's not as rich as some Amarones, but the lithe tannins and fresh acidity make it very drinkable.
title: Recchia 2006 Ca' Bertoldi  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: This is a straightforward Amarone, with red fruit and spice aromas. The palate delivers cherry and raspberry flavors and a hint of white pepper. It's not as rich as some Amarones, but the lithe tannins and fresh acidity make it very drinkable.
title: Recchia 2006 Ca' Bertoldi  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Here's a delicious and bright wine that boasts plum, black cherry, white pepper and nutmeg sensations. It combines the freshness of Valpolicella with the ripeness of Amarone, and is very food friendly.
title: Farina 2011 Montecorna  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso)

description: Here's a delicious and bright wine that boasts plum, black cherry, white pepper and nutmeg sensations. It combines the freshness of Valpolicella with the ripeness of Amarone, and is very food friendly.
title: Farina 2011 Montecorna  (Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso)

description: This delivers dense and chewy flavors of spirit-soaked raspberry, nutmeg and chocolate-covered orange. Its velvety smoothness is energized by fresh acidity, making this very easy to enjoy. Pair it with mushroom risotto or semi-seasoned cheeses.
title: Fabiano 2010  Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso

description: Sour cherry, apple and a hint of baking-spice aromas carry over to the easygoing palate along with a confectionery note. It's bright and simple, with fresh acidity.
title: Massimo Ronca 2016  Bardolino Chiaretto

description: Aromas suggesting nail polish remover, stewed plum, cellar floor and oak lead the nose. The evolved palate reflects the scorching vintage, offering raisin, powdered sage and balsamic notes alongside bracing grainy tannins and the heat of evident alcohol. Drink sooner rather than later.
title: Signae 2011  Montefalco Sagrantino

description: Almond, toast, vanilla bean and other oak-related aromas drive the nose of this vibrant Riserva from one of the most beautiful estates in Radda-in-Chianti. The wine has good harmony in the mouth where the natural fruit shines through and is powered by the wine's smooth structure and polished tannins.
title: Terrabianca 2005 Riserva Croce  (Chianti Classico)

description: Almond, toast, vanilla bean and other oak-related aromas drive the nose of this vibrant Riserva from one of the most beautiful estates in Radda-in-Chianti. The wine has good harmony in the mouth where the natural fruit shines through and is powered by the wine's smooth structure and polished tannins.
title: Terrabianca 2005 Riserva Croce  (Chianti Classico)

description: There's a subtle candy-like element to this wine's pretty nose that recalls vanilla and cherries sprinkled with dried flowers and green herbs. The wine has a lean, compact feel in the mouth and refreshes the palate thanks to its blueberry flavors and crisp close.
title: Tenuta di Lilliano 2005 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Asian spice and vanilla are the most immediate aromas but just past them are plum, prune and fresh blackberry. The wine has grit and sophistication and a smooth, velvety feel in the mouth that helps elevate the overall experience.
title: Castello Vicchiomaggio 2004 Riserva La Prima  (Chianti Classico)

description: Dark amber in color, this sophisticated vin santo offers aromas of resin, pine nut, caramel candy, molasses, chestnuts, honey and dried apricots. It has some spicy tones in the mouth, buffered around its sweet core, and long nutty flavors on the finish.
title: I Veroni 1999  Vin Santo del Chianti Rufina

description: This Riserva takes on an elegant, harmonious personality and boasts delicate notes of berry fruit and vanilla in the background. It's not particularly thick or extracted, nor is it meant to be. Instead, it is elegant and easy on the senses and offers tight, chewy tannins.
title: Castello d'Albola 2004 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: There's a fun, spicy layer in the foreground of this wine that helps shape a modern, luscious and intense Chianti Classico with noticeable sophistication and dimension. It offers a lot of consistency and flavor and carries those elements forward over its long finish. Only 250 cases were made.
title: Montecalvi 2006  Chianti Classico

description: Made with Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and a drop of Petit Verdot, this polished linear red has aromas of black-skinned fruit, bell pepper, coconut and toasted oak. The vibrant, elegantly structured palate offers black currant, chopped herb, clove and licorice alongside fine-grained tannins.
title: Guado al Tasso 2013  Bolgheri Superiore

description: Made entirely with organically farmed Sangiovese, this opens with aromas mature black-skinned fruit, French oak, exotic spice and a whiff of blue flower. The vibrant palate is both elegant and structured, delivering juicy black cherry, pomegranate, mocha, licorice and a potpourri of cooking spice. It's well balanced, with bright acidity and fine-grained tannins. It already dazzles, but hold for even more complexity. Drink 2018–2028.
title: Fontodi 2013 Flaccianello della Pieve Sangiovese (Colli della Toscana Centrale)

description: Woodland berry, blue flower, dried mint and a whiff of sunbaked soil take center stage on this easy-drinking red. The straightforward palate offers ripe red cherry and ground pepper alongside round, supple tannins.
title: Castellani 2015 Guadalmare  (Morellino di Scansano)

description: Woodland berry, blue flower, dried mint and a whiff of sunbaked soil take center stage on this easy-drinking red. The straightforward palate offers ripe red cherry and ground pepper alongside round, supple tannins.
title: Castellani 2015 Guadalmare  (Morellino di Scansano)

description: Aromas of fragrant blue flower and wild berry waft out of the glass. The easygoing no-frills palate offers juicy wild cherry and a hint of baking spice alongside supple tannins. It's enjoyable but already accessible and extremely straightforward by Brunello standards. Drink through 2019.
title: Bonacchi 2011  Brunello di Montalcino

description: This blend of Sangiovese and 10% Merlot opens with delicate aromas of violet, berry and baking spices. The palate delivers black cherry, toast and clove alongside close-grained tannins that grip the finish.
title: Tenuta Sette Ponti 2014 Crognolo Red (Toscana)

description: Made with 85% Sangiovese, 10% Cabernet Sauvignon and 5% Merlot, this shows subdued aromas of dark berry and cooking spice. The straightforward palate doles out crushed plum and clove alongside assertive tannins.
title: Tenuta di Ceppaiano 2015 Alle Viole Red (Toscana)

description: A blend of 38% Cabernet Sauvignon, 35% Syrah, 17% Sangiovese and 10% Merlot, this has aromas of French oak and black-skinned fruit. The dense palate delivers plum, toast and a hint of chocolate alongside rather abrasive tannins.
title: Tenuta Cappellina 2013 Dianne Red (Toscana)

description: You'll find aromas of wild berry, violet and a touch of leather in this wine. Straightforward by Brunello standards, the medium-bodied no-frills palate offers dried cherry and dark baking spice alongside solid tannins. It has a rather abrupt finish. Drink through 2020.
title: Sommavite 2010  Brunello di Montalcino

description: You'll find aromas of wild berry, violet and a touch of leather in this wine. Straightforward by Brunello standards, the medium-bodied no-frills palate offers dried cherry and dark baking spice alongside solid tannins. It has a rather abrupt finish. Drink through 2020.
title: Sommavite 2010  Brunello di Montalcino

description: Made entirely with Sangiovese, the shy nose eventually reveals red berry and a hint of thyme. The straightforward easygoing palate delivers red cherry and clove alongside smooth tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Podere Il Castellaccio 2015 Dinostro Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: Made with Sangiovese, Ciliegiolo, Foglia Tonda and Pugnitello, this offers delicate aromas of black cherry and cinnamon. The aromas cross over to the easygoing palate together with a hint of thyme and smooth, pliant tannins. Enjoy soon.
title: Podere Il Castellaccio 2014 Valente Red (Toscana)

description: Made entirely with Trebbiano and vinified in oak, this opens with aromas of mature orchard fruit, citrus, chopped herb and a whiff of toast. The linear, rather lean palate offers toasted almond, coffee, oak and green pear.
title: Pieve de' Pitti 2013 Tribiana Trebbiano (Toscana)

description: Here's an easy Sangiovese-based wine (with a small percent of Petit Verdot for extra darkness and color) that would pair wonderfully with stay-home pizza or pasta. The wine offers bright berry nuances of cherry and raspberry and a touch of distant spice and smoke on the fade.
title: Fattoria Scopone 2006 Il Gregoriano Red (Sant'Antimo)

description: Mostly Sangiovese with smaller percentages of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah, this informal wine offers freshness and simplicity. You'll recognize balanced aromas of red fruit, spice, leather and a touch of chewy pipe tobacco.
title: Ciacci Piccolomini d'Aragona 2007 Red (Toscana)

description: Nemus pairs the light fruit and crisp acidity of Sangiovese against the hearty firmness of Cabernet Sauvignon to produce an informal, food-friendly wine that would match pasta dishes and pizza with fresh mozzarella.
title: Scopetani 2007 Nemus Red (Toscana)

description: This is an informal and fresh Cabernet that would pair perfectly with easy pasta dishes or lasagna. Aromas include black cherry and plum and the wine offers a polished and compact feel overall.
title: Tommasi 2008 Poggio al Tufo  (Maremma)

description: This is an informal and fresh Cabernet that would pair perfectly with easy pasta dishes or lasagna. Aromas include black cherry and plum and the wine offers a polished and compact feel overall.
title: Tommasi 2008 Poggio al Tufo  (Maremma)

description: Bixio offers a tight, compact expression of Amarone that seems bursting at the seams with fresh fruit, cherry and berry aromas. The wine is syrupy and thick in the mouth with a refreshing touch of acidity at the close.
title: Bixio 2008  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico

description: There's a distinctive touch of dark cola and licorice here that frames a solid core of blackberry and cherry liqueur. The wine is darkly concentrated with firm tannins and a soft, sweet endnote of mature fruit and cinnamon spice.
title: Viviani 2007  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico

description: No doubt, this is a big, bold wine that hits the palate like a ton of bricks. Aromas include maple syrup, brown sugar, molasses, dark fruit and plum, spice and leather. Not surprisingly, it delivers loads of sticky chewiness as well.
title: Gino Fasoli 2006 Corte del Pozzo  (Amarone della Valpolicella)

description: What sets this wine apart is its gorgeous, creamy intensity on the finish. Made from Trebbiano, this expression shows the qualitative heights this variety can achieve. Notes of vanilla cream, peach cobbler, dried sage and pineapple appear on the bouquet. The finish is long and full. Try aging this for five years or longer.
title: Masciarelli 2008 Castello di Semivicoli  (Trebbiano d'Abruzzo)

description: This wine's most outstanding quality is the elegant and delicate manner with which the bouquet slowly reveals itself. This vineyard-designate wine is a traditional blend of Sangiovese and Canaiolo, opening with subtle aromas of red cherry, dried violet, moist earth, vanilla and cured meat.
title: Lungarotti 2007 Rubesco Riserva Vigna Monticchio Red (Torgiano)

description: This ruby-colored Brunello opens with notes of fresh fruit, forest floor, cedar wood, exotic spice and blackberry preserves. It shows a bright berry mouthfeel, with cherry intensity and a clean, fresh finish.
title: Pietroso 2007  Brunello di Montalcino

description: From one of Italy's most important showcase designer wineries, this blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot lives up to its super Tuscan celebrity. It is gently redolent of dark chocolate, ripe fruit, leather, tobacco and crushed black pepper—the bouquet's elegant moderation is one of its strongest points. The mouthfeel is rich, creamy and long. Drink after 2018.
title: Petra 2008 Petra Red (Toscana)

description: Made with 100% dried Zibibbo grapes, this complex dessert wine offers aromas of fresh apricot, tangerine jam and a hint of sage. The rich palate doles out mature yellow peach, candied fig and a touch of lemon peel while bright acidity lends freshness and balance.
title: Donnafugata 2013  Passito di Pantelleria

description: A blend of 65% Grillo and 35% Carricante, this offers subtle aromas of ripe orchard fruit, wild flower and a whiff of almond. The vibrant, savory palate boasts green apple, creamy white peach, citrus and aromatic herb alongside an energizing mineral vein. It finishes crisp and clean.
title: Le Casematte 2015 Peloro Bianco White (Terre Siciliane)

description: Subdued aromas of yellow stone fruit and a whiff of acacia honey give way to the round ripe palate, along with notes of apricot and citrus zest. Bitter almond marks the close.
title: Podere La Berta 2015 Albana (Romagna)

description: This opens with aromas of yellow flower, hay and beeswax. The crisp straightforward palate delivers apple, white peach and lemon. Enjoy soon.
title: Vigna degli Estensi 2013 Soteria  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi)

description: Subtle aromas suggesting toasted oak, acacia and grapefruit take shape in the glass. On the racy palate, yellow apple, bitter almond and a hint of lemon zest are set against vibrant acidity.
title: Panizzi 2014 Vigna Santa Margherita  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: Subtle aromas suggesting toasted oak, acacia and grapefruit take shape in the glass. On the racy palate, yellow apple, bitter almond and a hint of lemon zest are set against vibrant acidity.
title: Panizzi 2014 Vigna Santa Margherita  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: Here's a bright wine that opens with aromas of white field flowers, pears and a hint of nut. The straightforward palate offers yellow apple and a hint of bitter almond alongside fresh acidity.
title: Massimo Daldin 2015  Vernaccia di San Gimignano

description: Here's a bright wine that opens with aromas of white field flowers, pears and a hint of nut. The straightforward palate offers yellow apple and a hint of bitter almond alongside fresh acidity.
title: Massimo Daldin 2015  Vernaccia di San Gimignano

description: Mature apricot, Spanish broom and a hint of candied citrus aromas lead to the extremely ripe dense palate along with honey and a confectionery note. A taste of almond backs up the rather bitter finish.
title: La Sabbiona 2015 Alba della Torre Secco Albana (Romagna)

description: Aromas evoking tropical fruit, cut grass and a whiff of tomato vine lead the nose. On the straightforward palate, notes of medicinal herb underscore pineapple and ripe peach.
title: Castello Montauto 2015  Vernaccia di San Gimignano

description: Made with 70% Sangiovese, 15% Sagrantino and 15% Merlot, this opens with subtle aromas of red berry and underbrush. The straightforward palate delivers black plum, clove and tobacco alongside smooth tannins. Enjoy through 2018.
title: Cantina Fratelli Pardi 2014  Montefalco Rosso

description: Ripe yellow stone fruit and a floral whiff of pressed Spanish broom lead the nose while the bright round palate offers mature yellow pear and orange zest. It closes on a note of bitter almond.
title: Tenuta La Vigna 2015  Vernaccia di San Gimignano

description: Inky purple, this has aromas of prune, toast and mocha that carry over to the firm palate along with a touch of clove. Assertive close-grained tannins provide the framework. Drink through 2019.
title: Podere dal Nespoli 2013 Il Nespoli Riserva Sangiovese (Romagna)

description: Floral aromas of blue flower and bright berry take center stage in this pretty blend of 85% Montepulciano and 15% Syrah. The palate delivers juicy raspberry and cherry flavors, alongside soft, supple tannins. This is round and extremely accessible now so enjoy soon.
title: Fattoria Le Terrazze 2012 Praeludium  (Rosso Conero)

description: Floral aromas of blue flower and bright berry take center stage in this pretty blend of 85% Montepulciano and 15% Syrah. The palate delivers juicy raspberry and cherry flavors, alongside soft, supple tannins. This is round and extremely accessible now so enjoy soon.
title: Fattoria Le Terrazze 2012 Praeludium  (Rosso Conero)

description: This Verdicchio opens with floral aromas of Spanish broom and acacia, along with a hint of petroleum that recalls Riesling. The linear palate is a bit lean but offers up lemon, bitter almond and mineral notes alongside bright acidity.
title: Conti di Buscareto 2008 Ammazzaconte  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi)

description: This wine opens with aromas of oak, butterscotch and dill that carry over to the palate alongside flavors of vanilla, lemon zest and apricot. This would be a nice alternative for fans of oaked Chardonnay.
region: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico
title: Vignamato 2008 Riserva Ambrosia  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico)

description: Coconut, black currant, toasted oak and grilled bell pepper lead the nose on this blend of Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot. The polished, full-bodied palate offers dried black cherry, raspberry, licorice and espresso framed in silky tannins.
title: Tenuta di Biserno 2012 Biserno Red (Toscana)

description: Aromas of dark-skinned berry, leather and truffle take shape in the glass. The full-bodied palate doles out fleshy wild cherry, orange zest, licorice, clove and coffee bean while notes of chopped mint lift the finish. Firm fine-grained tannins give it structure and finesse. Drink 2018–2028.
title: Fattoria La Lecciaia 2010 Riserva  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Aromas of dark-skinned berry, leather and truffle take shape in the glass. The full-bodied palate doles out fleshy wild cherry, orange zest, licorice, clove and coffee bean while notes of chopped mint lift the finish. Firm fine-grained tannins give it structure and finesse. Drink 2018–2028.
title: Fattoria La Lecciaia 2010 Riserva  (Brunello di Montalcino)

description: Here is a tight, traditional expression of Nebbiolo with a streamlined mouthfeel that is peppered with ripe fruit, licorice and root beer aromas. There's a note of bitterness and astringency on the close that will soften with time. Drink after 2018.
title: Villadoria 2008  Barbaresco

description: Organic and biodynamic Punset offers Nebbiolo-based wines that are very difficult to assess. Try them too young (as in this case) and the wines often lack clarity and balance. Wait ten years or more and they blossom into something very special indeed. The 2008 Campo Quadro illustrates this point exactly.
title: Punset 2008 Campo Quadro  (Barbaresco)

description: There's a grittiness or tightness of texture here that recalls carob or dried prune. This quality makes for an interesting, food-friendly red that is further colored by tones of chocolate, leather and pipe tobacco. Pulpy, dark concentration is backed by drying tannins.
title: Monchiero Carbone 2008 Sru  (Roero)

description: There's a grittiness or tightness of texture here that recalls carob or dried prune. This quality makes for an interesting, food-friendly red that is further colored by tones of chocolate, leather and pipe tobacco. Pulpy, dark concentration is backed by drying tannins.
title: Monchiero Carbone 2008 Sru  (Roero)

description: This is a lovely Nebbiolo that serves as a perfect introductory wine for those interested in eventually expanding their knowledge of Barbaresco and Barolo. Made with the same grape, this wine offers small berry aromas backed by ethereal tones of violet and licorice.
title: Damilano 2008  Nebbiolo d'Alba

description: Bright and savory, this floral scented Pecorino offers juicy tropical fruit and lemon drop sensations accented by notes of mint and thyme. The ripe fruit is balanced by brisk acidity that leaves the palate feeling cleansed and refreshed.
title: Colli Ripani 2012 Rugaro Gold  (Offida Pecorino)

description: This opens with an alluring fragrance of Spanish broom, wild flowers and a whiff of sea breeze. The palate delivers creamy white peach, juicy pineapple and lemon accented by hints of saline and mineral. It's still fresh and should develop more complexity. Drink now through 2015.
region: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore
title: Accadia 2011 Cantorì  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore)

description: This opens with an alluring fragrance of Spanish broom, wild flowers and a whiff of sea breeze. The palate delivers creamy white peach, juicy pineapple and lemon accented by hints of saline and mineral. It's still fresh and should develop more complexity. Drink now through 2015.
region: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore
title: Accadia 2011 Cantorì  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore)

description: Here's a classic rendition of Central Italy's premier white wine. It has a lovely fragrance of yellow spring flowers and spice, along with tropical fruit notes. The palate shows nice depth, offering juicy peach, pineapple and tangerine notes alongside spice and dried herb sensations.
region: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore
title: Marchetti 2012 Tenuta del Cavaliere  (Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore)

description: Here's a Verdicchio that shows off the grape's quintessential aromas of yellow spring flowers and whiffs of stone fruit. It offers creamy peach and lemon flavors alongside hints of sea salt and almond. Crisp, refreshing acidity leaves the palate feeling cleansed.
title: Fattoria Laila 2012  Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi

description: Here's a Verdicchio that shows off the grape's quintessential aromas of yellow spring flowers and whiffs of stone fruit. It offers creamy peach and lemon flavors alongside hints of sea salt and almond. Crisp, refreshing acidity leaves the palate feeling cleansed.
title: Fattoria Laila 2012  Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi

description: This delicious Amarone has both structure and finesse. It offers a fragrance of pressed iris petals along with dark, ripe fruit and spice. The silky smooth palate delivers black cherry layered with cocoa, nutmeg and black pepper along with a hint of dried fig.
title: Cà La Bionda 2009 Vigneti di Ravazzol  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Made from organically grown grapes, this impressive sparkler is made with no sugar or liqueur added. It has an expressive fragrance of white flowers and stone fruit, while the palate offers apple, citrus and roasted almond notes along with hints of spice. It's a perfect apéritif but will also pair beauitfully with shellfish.
title: Barone Pizzini 2009 Nature Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: This delicious blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Merlot has an inviting fragrance of cedar wood, black currant and a whiff of toasted oak. The palate delivers a solid core of black cherry, raspberry, white pepper and a tobacco note along with firm but refined tannins and just enough fresh acidity. Drink 2015–2020.
title: Renieri 2010 Re di Renieri Red (Toscana)

description: A new product from Rotari, this Riserva sparkling wine (from 90% Chardonnay and 10% Pinot Nero) demonstrates great intensity and round, toasty flavors of fresh baguette, baked apple, honey and fruit. The wine rests on the lees for 48 months for extra creaminess.
title: Rotari 2003 Talento Riserva Sparkling (Trento)

description: Red berry, dried wild herb and yellow spring flower aromas mingle in the glass. The bright refreshing palate offers up juicy morello cherry and raspberry before closing on a tangy note.
title: Taverna 2016 Maddalena Rosato (Basilicata)

description: Made with Aglianico, this shows red-berry, wildflower and Mediterranean herb aromas. Fresh and straightforward, the palate gives juicy morello cherry and a light note of dark spice. Bright acidity gives it a clean, refreshing finish.
title: Re Manfredi 2016 Rosato (Basilicata)

description: Aromas of honeysuckle, exotic fruit and a whiff of Mediterranean scrub take center stage. The tangy palate offers grapefruit, peach and pineapple alongside crisp acidity.
title: Curto 2016 Poiano Inzolia (Terre Siciliane)

description: Aromas of white rose, sage, citrus and grapefruit carry over to the palate along with ripe peach and orange zest. It's semisweet and lightly sparkling, with a slightly sweet finish and a frothy mousse.
title: Stella Rosa NV Imperiale Fior d'Arancio Orange Moscato (Colli Euganei)

description: Aromas of white rose, sage, citrus and grapefruit carry over to the palate along with ripe peach and orange zest. It's semisweet and lightly sparkling, with a slightly sweet finish and a frothy mousse.
title: Stella Rosa NV Imperiale Fior d'Arancio Orange Moscato (Colli Euganei)

description: Aromas of pring flower, gold apple and Anjou pear lead into the crisp refreshing palate along with a hint of nectarine. Tart acidity gives it a bright, juicy finish.
title: Ornella Molon NV Brut  (Prosecco Treviso)

description: Aromas of pring flower, gold apple and Anjou pear lead into the crisp refreshing palate along with a hint of nectarine. Tart acidity gives it a bright, juicy finish.
title: Ornella Molon NV Brut  (Prosecco Treviso)

description: Deep-amber colored, this orange wine has aromas of sunbaked earth, brimstone, overripe orange zest and pressed wild flower. The lean but lively palate offers dried nectarine slices, toasted almond and a hint of dried apricot alongside bright acidity. A salty note closes the finish. While lovers of orange wine might embrace this, it's definitely not for everyone.
title: Miklus 2011 Natural Art Ribolla Gialla (Delle Venezie)

description: Subdued aromas of ripe orchard fruit and pressed yellow flower slowly take shape on this. The big soft palate shows ripe apricot, candied lemon drop and a buttery note.
title: Inama 2015 Vigneti di Foscarino  (Soave Classico)

description: Alluring aromas of exotic spice, purple flower, dark-skinned berry and a balsamic note lead the nose. The concentrated palate delivers dried cherry, ripe plum, mint, licorice and a hint of game alongside velvety tannins that wrap around the finish. It nicely balances weight and finesse.
title: Le Salette 2013 La Marega  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Wild berry, leather, tobacco, tilled earth, aromatic herb and floral aromas meld together on this impressive red. The full-bodied structured palate delivers black cherry marinated in spirits, dried plum, chocolate and licorice alongside a backbone of firm velvety tannins. Drink 2018–2026.
title: Masi 2011 Costasera Riserva  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: This bold red opens with aromas of resin, stewed plum, leather, cake spice and a balsamic note. The chewy palate doles out dried black cherry, blackberry jam, candied nectarine zest and licorice while big velvety tannins provide enveloping support. A pipe tobacco sensation closes the finish. Drink 2018–2028.
title: Venturini Massimino 2010 Campomasua  (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico)

description: Aromas recall blue flower, new leather, truffle and crushed raspberry. The bright palate offers wild cherry, cake spices, alpine herbs and a sprinkling of cocoa. It's well balanced and fresh with firm but fine tannins.
title: Alessandro Rivetto 2010  Barbaresco

description: Aromas suggest underbrush, coffee and a hint of meat juices. The palate delivers dense black raspberry accented with grilled herbs, vanilla and light toasted notes alongside the heat of evident alcohol. It's monolithic and ready so drink soon.
title: Fornacina 2012  Rosso di Montalcino

description: Aromas suggest underbrush, coffee and a hint of meat juices. The palate delivers dense black raspberry accented with grilled herbs, vanilla and light toasted notes alongside the heat of evident alcohol. It's monolithic and ready so drink soon.
title: Fornacina 2012  Rosso di Montalcino

description: Subdued aromas recall leafy undebrush, red berries and grilled herbs. The brisk palate offers red berry, espresso, mocha and clove alongside fresh acidity. It's simple but well made and will pair well with everything from grilled vegetables to mildly seasoned cheeses.
title: Fattoria del Cerro 2012  Rosso di Montepulciano

description: Aromas of toast, scorched earth, espresso, game, and spice lead the nose. The forward palate offers roasted coffee bean, black pepper, vanilla and overripe plum. It's evolving fast so drink now.
title: Coldisole 2011  Rosso di Montalcino

description: Crushed flower and bright berry aromas waft from the glass. The fresh palate offers crunchy red cherry, orange zest and a hint of clove. It's simple and made to be drunk young so enjoy soon.
title: Cantine Lanzavecchia 2013 Cren del Gufo  (Nebbiolo d'Alba)

description: Oak extract, spearmint, espresso and mature plum aromas lead the nose on this simple, medium-bodied wine. The forward palate delivers overripe black berry fruit, vanilla and oak that finish on an almost sugary-sweet note. It's already evolved so drink soon.
title: San Polo 2012  Rosso di Montalcino

description: Sensations of mature black plum are layered with notes of chocolate and roasted coffee bean. It's ripe, dense and evolved, with a markedly sweet finish. Drink now.
title: Palazzo 2012  Rosso di Montalcino

description: This sparkling wine opens with oak aromas. It has a frothy palate that reveals tropical fruit, citrus and oak notes, sprinkled with Mediterranean herbs. Despite the creamy texture, the flavors are lean and close on a bitter walnut note.
title: Il Mosnel 2009 Brut Satèn Chardonnay (Franciacorta)

description: This sparkling wine opens with oak aromas. It has a frothy palate that reveals tropical fruit, citrus and oak notes, sprinkled with Mediterranean herbs. Despite the creamy texture, the flavors are lean and close on a bitter walnut note.
title: Il Mosnel 2009 Brut Satèn Chardonnay (Franciacorta)

description: Not very expressive, but this wine's fragrance does reveal delicate aromas of rose and berry, which carry over to the palate. It doesn't have quite enough fruit richness to support the vigorous, almost aggressive, bubbles and drying finish.
title: Antica Fratta 2009 Essence Rosé Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: Matiú Brut is a very beautiful Prosecco with delicate floral and peach aromas offset by fresh, tonic effervescence. Pair this wine with crab cakes or shrimp cocktail.
title: L'Antica Quercia 2009 Matiú Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Some creamy yeasty tones are supported by background notes of banana and apricot and give this Soave Classico a rich, generous mouthfeel. Pair this wine with pasta, eggplant sauce and mozzarella.
title: Inama 2010 Vin Soave  (Soave Classico)

description: Packaged in a screwcap bottle with an eye-catching purple label, Re Midas is a textbook expression of Soave with fresh aromas of melon, peach and honey. This well-priced white delivers a compact but crisp mouthfeel.
title: Cantina di Soave 2010 Re Midas  (Soave)

description: There's a fine, pristine quality to this Soave Classico that translates into aromas of lively peach and crisp citrus. This luminous white wine has the natural density to match Salad Niçoise with extra vinaigrette.
title: Ca' Rugate 2009 Monte Fiorentine  (Soave Classico)

description: This offers subdued aromas of vanilla, toasted oak and a whiff of dried orchard fruit. The palate isn't very expressive, displaying buttery notes, white almond and just a hint of citrus peel but it lacks fruit richness to stand up to the racy acidity.
title: Guidi 1929 2012 Aurea Riserva  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: This opens with aromas of oak, tire rubber, fennel and underbrush. The palate is dominated by oak and oak-driven spices alongside a confectionary note and green, astringent tannins. It lacks fruit richness.
title: Lunadoro 2008 Quercione Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: This opens with aromas of oak, tire rubber, fennel and underbrush. The palate is dominated by oak and oak-driven spices alongside a confectionary note and green, astringent tannins. It lacks fruit richness.
title: Lunadoro 2008 Quercione Riserva  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: Tropical fruit and peach aromas take center stage on this bright wine. The round, friendly palate doles out white peach, green apple and passion fruit alongside lively acidity.
title: Cantina Altarocca 2014 Arcosesto  (Orvieto Classico Superiore)

description: Tropical fruit and peach aromas take center stage on this bright wine. The round, friendly palate doles out white peach, green apple and passion fruit alongside lively acidity.
title: Cantina Altarocca 2014 Arcosesto  (Orvieto Classico Superiore)

description: Heady aromas of honeysuckle and orange blossom waft from the glass. The easygoing palate offers green apple and citrus alongside bright acidity. It closes on a note of bitter almond.
title: Guicciardini Strozzi 2014 Villa Cusona  (Vernaccia di San Gimignano)

description: Crisp and savory, this lively white delivers aromas and flavors of mature yellow apple, nectarine zest and a hint of nut. Bright acidity gives it refreshing support.
title: Guicciardini Strozzi 2014  Vernaccia di San Gimignano

description: This dessert wine is such a deep amber color, it is reminiscent of a gleaming copper pot. Aromas of resin, pine nut, roasted almond, maple syrup and butterscotch denote a Vin Santo that shows its years without seeming old. It's thick and syrupy in the mouth with loads of honey-roasted nut flavors.
title: Le Caniette 2000 Sibilla Appeninica Vin Santo Passerina (Marche)

description: This is a vibrant and lively wine with a sweet portfolio of aromas including red fruit, spice, rose bud, milk chocolate and almond nut. The wine is modern and upfront in terms of its delivery and has a chewy, succulent bite. Its fruity flavors are slightly sweet and the wine ends on a bright, cheerful note.
title: Fattoria Fibbiano 2004 L'Aspetto Red (Toscana)

description: What a surprise to find such a delicate and berry-driven Pinot Nero from sunny Umbria in central Italy. This tastes very much like a Pinot you'd find in any northern region with feminine fruit and floral nuances lavished over by raspberry, vanilla, honey, cola and lavender. It's fragrant and buoyant in the mouth with loads of personality and bright acidity on the close: a pleasure to drink.
title: Barberani 2006 Pinot Nero (Lago di Corbara)

description: Baked black fruit, scorched earth, eucalyptus and a toasted note come together on the nose. The palate brings black cherry, with intense licorice and mint supported by tightly wound, fine-grained tannins. It ends on a coffee note. Drink 2018–2028.
title: Castello di Verduno 2010 Rabajà Riserva  (Barbaresco)

description: Baked black fruit, scorched earth, eucalyptus and a toasted note come together on the nose. The palate brings black cherry, with intense licorice and mint supported by tightly wound, fine-grained tannins. It ends on a coffee note. Drink 2018–2028.
title: Castello di Verduno 2010 Rabajà Riserva  (Barbaresco)

description: This opens with earthy aromas of scorched soil, underbrush and a funky whiff of game while the palate offers candied cherry, white pepper and a hint of tobacco alongside firm tannins. It closes on an aniseed note.
title: Cascina Saria 2012 Colle del Gelso  (Barbaresco)

description: This offers aromas of ripe dark fruit, crushed rose, and a warm whiff of toast. On the palate, notes of clove and grilled sage accent a core of wild cherry. It's still young, with nervous acidity and assertive but refined tannins. Drink after 2018.
title: Beni di Batasiolo 2012  Barbaresco

description: This offers aromas of ripe dark fruit, crushed rose, and a warm whiff of toast. On the palate, notes of clove and grilled sage accent a core of wild cherry. It's still young, with nervous acidity and assertive but refined tannins. Drink after 2018.
title: Beni di Batasiolo 2012  Barbaresco

description: Spicy, structured and fruity, this savory wine opens with aromas of ripe berry and dark cooking spice. The full-bodied palate doles out crushed blackberry, plum, black cherry, ground black pepper and star anise alongside firm, velvety tannins.
title: Argiolas 2013 I Selis Rosso Superiore  (Monica di Sardegna)

description: Spicy, structured and fruity, this savory wine opens with aromas of ripe berry and dark cooking spice. The full-bodied palate doles out crushed blackberry, plum, black cherry, ground black pepper and star anise alongside firm, velvety tannins.
title: Argiolas 2013 I Selis Rosso Superiore  (Monica di Sardegna)

description: Dark berry, grilled herb and underbrush aromas float out of the glass along with a whiff of rose. The firm palate offers juicy dark cherry, raspberry, clove, anise and tobacco framed in velvety tannins.
title: Vite Colte 2012 La Casa in Collina  (Barbaresco)

description: This full-bodied white opens with aromas of ripe yellow peach, Spanish broom, chamomile flower and Mediterranean brush. The round, creamy palate doles out juicy pineapple, baked yellow apple, sea spray and candied nectarine zest alongside soft acidity.
title: Vigne Surrau 2014 Sciala Vendemmia Tardiva  (Vermentino di Gallura)

description: Made with 65% Nebbiolo, 20% Vespolina and 15% Uva Rara, this polished red from Piedmont offers aromas and flavors of dried red cherry, clove, baking spice and rust. It's well balanced, with silky tannins and fresh acidity while a graphite note closes the finish.
title: Vallana 2009  Boca

description: Made with 65% Nebbiolo, 20% Vespolina and 15% Uva Rara, this polished red from Piedmont offers aromas and flavors of dried red cherry, clove, baking spice and rust. It's well balanced, with silky tannins and fresh acidity while a graphite note closes the finish.
title: Vallana 2009  Boca

description: Aromas of toast, wild berry and cake spice come together in the glass. The firm, structured palate delivers dried red cherry, crushed raspberry, white pepper and grilled herb. It's still young and tannic so let this unwind and fully develop. Drink 2018–2030.
title: Ugo Lequio 2010 Gallina Riserva  (Barbaresco)

description: Muddled aromas of yellow flower and beeswax come along with sensations that recall Band-Aids and antiseptic. The bitter medicinal notes carry over to the palate along with minerality and a hint of rock candy, and the wine lacks fruit richness.
title: Vigneti Villabella 2012 Ca' del Lago  (Lugana)

description: Muddled aromas of yellow flower and beeswax come along with sensations that recall Band-Aids and antiseptic. The bitter medicinal notes carry over to the palate along with minerality and a hint of rock candy, and the wine lacks fruit richness.
title: Vigneti Villabella 2012 Ca' del Lago  (Lugana)

description: This one-dimensional wine has muted aromas that recall tropical fruit. The palate doesn't give much away either, revealing subtle citrus and pear notes alongside racy acidity.
title: Tinazzi 2013 Ca' de' Rocchi  (Lugana)

description: Delivering elegance and structure, this stunning wine opens with delicate aromas of bread crust, toast, dried fruit, pastry cream and nectarine zest that all carry over to the silky palate. It boasts a lovely depth of flavors that are exalted by tangy acidity and an ultrafine perlage. It's already enjoyable but will continue to develop complexity over the next decade. Drink 2016–2026.
title: Ca' del Bosco 2006 Cuvée Annamaria Clementi Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: Linear and intense, this elegant blend of 70% Pinot Nero and 30% Chardonnay opens with aromas of fragrant flowers, yeast and a whiff of orchard fruit. The firm, focused palate delivers ripe apple, citrus zest, almond and energizing mineral notes alongside an ultrafine, persistent perlage that carries through to the quenching, bone dry finish. It's overflowing with finesse.
title: Maso Martis 2010 Dosaggiozero Riserva Sparkling (Trento)

description: A beautifully balanced wine that abounds in elegance and restrained richness, this wine offers enticing floral, almond and citrus aromas. The crisp, creamy palate brings nectarine zest, yellow apple, mineral notes and bread crust. Tight acidity and an intense, elegant perlage provide the framework. Drink now or hold for complexity.
title: Ca' del Bosco 2010 Vintage Collection Brut Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: This is the first vintage of this wine that will be available in the United States and it makes a positive first impression. It's a delicious blend of spice, floral notes and strawberries that finishes with soft, caressing tannins.
title: Marchesi de' Frescobaldi 2000 Campo ai Sasso  (Rosso di Montalcino)

description: Here's a ruby-colored Rosso from Montalcino with fresh berry aromas and subtle tones of forest underbrush and exotic spice. There are hints of cherry and vanilla as well and the wine is fruity and genuine in the mouth.
title: Col d'Orcia 2008  Rosso di Montalcino

description: Lightly hued and luminous, this offers aromas of dried rose petal, red berry and a whiff of baking spice. The elegant palate delivers wild strawberry, red raspberry, wild cherry, licorice and white pepper alongside silky tannins. It shows a more subtle and delicate side to Barolo. Drink through 2024.
title: Mascarello Giuseppe e Figlio 2009 Villero  (Barolo)

description: Alluring aromas of blue flower, leather, menthol, dark berry, baking spice and a balsamic note lead the way on this full-bodied, elegant red. The palate doles out ripe black cherry, while notes of clove, white pepper, tobacco, sage and licorice add depth. It's nicely balanced with firm, ripe tannins. Drink through 2023.
title: Prinsi 2008 Fausoni Riserva  (Barbaresco)

description: Aromas suggest ripe blackberry, baking spice, mocha and a balsamic note of menthol. The brooding palate opens with mature black cherry, savory herb and black pepper alongside tightly knit but velvety tannins that still need to unwind. Drink 2016–2021.
title: Ca' Viola 2009 Sottocastello di Novello  (Barolo)

description: Aromas suggest ripe blackberry, baking spice, mocha and a balsamic note of menthol. The brooding palate opens with mature black cherry, savory herb and black pepper alongside tightly knit but velvety tannins that still need to unwind. Drink 2016–2021.
title: Ca' Viola 2009 Sottocastello di Novello  (Barolo)

description: Smooth and delicious, this opens with aromas of violet, mature dark fruit, leather and a touch of menthol. The palate delivers dried black cherry, raspberry, white pepper and licorice alongside polished tannins. It's already accessible but will also age well for another five or six years. Drink through 2020.
title: Manzone Fratelli 2009 Vigna Fraschin  (Barolo)

description: Smooth and delicious, this opens with aromas of violet, mature dark fruit, leather and a touch of menthol. The palate delivers dried black cherry, raspberry, white pepper and licorice alongside polished tannins. It's already accessible but will also age well for another five or six years. Drink through 2020.
title: Manzone Fratelli 2009 Vigna Fraschin  (Barolo)

description: Exotic spice, vanilla, dark-skinned fruit and French oak aromas lift out of the glass. The palate shows toasted oak, coconut, espresso raspberry and cherry alongside tight close-grained tannins that grip the austere finish. It's still on its oak so give it time to come around. Drink after 2023.
title: Parusso 2013 Bussia  (Barolo)

description: Aromas of oak, coconut, blue flower and a whiff of exotic spice lead the nose. The linear palate is on the lean side, offering tart red cherry, raspberry, anise and oak-driven spice alongside fine-grained tannins and firm acidity.
title: Mamete Prevostini 2014 Sassella  (Valtellina Superiore)

description: This Cabernet-Merlot blend is definitely dominated by spice that takes shape as cumin, turmeric and ground clove. The fruit is present, although there's not much, in the form of mature plum and dried prunes. The wine tastes ripe, slightly sweet and is a bit short on the finish.
title: Antonino Tringali-Casanuova 2004 Patrimonio  (Bolgheri)

description: This Cabernet-Merlot blend is definitely dominated by spice that takes shape as cumin, turmeric and ground clove. The fruit is present, although there's not much, in the form of mature plum and dried prunes. The wine tastes ripe, slightly sweet and is a bit short on the finish.
title: Antonino Tringali-Casanuova 2004 Patrimonio  (Bolgheri)

description: Made from a blend of 60% Alicante, 30% Nocera and 10% Calabrese, this wine has aromas of violet, tilled earth, mature plum, prune and black cooking spice. The soft, savory palate delivers ripe black cherry and black berry, accented by black pepper and nutmeg. It's balanced, with velvety tannins and fresh acidity. Made for early drinking pleasure, so enjoy soon.
title: Hauner 2012 Hierà Red (Salina)

description: Made from a blend of 60% Alicante, 30% Nocera and 10% Calabrese, this wine has aromas of violet, tilled earth, mature plum, prune and black cooking spice. The soft, savory palate delivers ripe black cherry and black berry, accented by black pepper and nutmeg. It's balanced, with velvety tannins and fresh acidity. Made for early drinking pleasure, so enjoy soon.
title: Hauner 2012 Hierà Red (Salina)

description: This structured blend of 50% Nero d'Avola, 30% Cabernet Sauvignon and 20% Merlot opens with earthy aromas of underbrush, tobacco leaf, mature black fruit and exotic spice. The palate boasts polished tannins as well as flavors of ripe blackberry, red currant, grilled pepper and a hint of cocoa.
title: Ceuso 2009 Red (Sicilia)

description: This version of Calanìca (made from 60% Frappato and 40% Syrah) offers a low impact bouquet of earthy forest fruit and bramble. It's a light, lean wine with a touch of soft spice on the close.
title: Duca di Salaparuta 2009 Calanìca Frappato-Syrah Red (Sicilia)

description: Made from organically-farmed Nerello Mascalese, this simple wine does show true varietal characteristics of wild fruit, dark mineral and cola. The aromas are mild and the mouthfeel delivers medium intensity.
title: Di Giovanna 2009 Nerello Mascalese (Sicilia)

description: Corvo Bianco is a tried and true white wine that helped introduce Sicilian wines to international markets. It's worth revisiting this wine if you are looking for something fresh to wash down seafood.
title: Corvo 2010 Bianco White (Sicilia)

description: Corvo Bianco is a tried and true white wine that helped introduce Sicilian wines to international markets. It's worth revisiting this wine if you are looking for something fresh to wash down seafood.
title: Corvo 2010 Bianco White (Sicilia)

description: The wine that first introduced Americans to Sicily, this classic Corvo blend offers a light, bright appearance followed by easy tones of red berry, bitter almond and cassis.
title: Corvo 2008 Red (Sicilia)

description: This is a fresh, tonic and light Grillo that would pair with endive salad and sliced oranges or red beets in vinaigrette. The wine offers citrus, green herb and fresh kiwi aromas.
title: Tasca d'Almerita 2009 Sallier de la Tour Grillo (Sicilia)

description: There's a touch of sulfur that takes a few seconds to blow off. Once it does, this wine offers yellow rose, exotic fruit, peach and almond skin.
title: Viticultori Associati Canicatti 2010 Aquilae Grillo (Sicilia)

description: Baglio di Serramarrocco opens with a slightly browning hue and savory aromas of cured beef and black currant. There's an earthy tone as well, backed by mild grittiness in the mouth.
title: Tenuta di Serramarrocco 2008 Baglio di Serramarrocco Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: A great value choice, I Versi Bianco (made with Grecanico, Inzolia and Grillo) is a crisp wine, with easy aromas of lemon zest, cut grass, almond skin and crushed brimstone. Pair it with Southwestern grilled chicken salad.
title: Fondo Antico 2010 I Versi Bianco White (Sicilia)

description: Pressed acacia flower, orchard fruit and yeasty bread-dough aromas waft out of the glass. On the lean racy palate, tangy acidity underscores yellow apple, tangerine and bitter almond before a crisp close.
title: Bellenda NV Cosmo E' Col Fondo  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Aromas of ripe pear, yellow apple and a hint of almond follow over to the linear bone-dry palate. It's exceedingly fresh, with brisk acidity and a vigorous perlage.
designation: Rive di Col San Martino Brut 26° Primo
title: Andreola 2016 Rive di Col San Martino Brut 26° Primo  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: White spring flower and apple aromas lift out of the glass. On the palate, bracing acidity and brisk bubbles offset ripe pear and a hint of thyme.
title: Althéa 2016 Brut  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This soft sparkler offers sensations of green apple, white peach and a hint of lemon drop. Bright acidity gives it a refreshing finish.
title: Borgoluce NV Brut  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Bright and crisp, this bright sparkler has aromas of lime and apple that follow through to the lively palate. Vibrant acidity gives it a refreshing finish.
title: Bellenda 2016 San Fermo Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Aromas and flavors of green apple, pear and a hint of citrus drop come together on this bright easygoing sparkler. Lively acidity keeps it fresh.
title: La Tordera 2016 Saomì Brut  (Prosecco Treviso)

description: Deeply gold-colored, this opens with aromas of oak, bread crust and toasted nut. The scents carry over to the lean palate along with hints of overripe orange peel, a suggestion of dried apricot and a dollop of vanilla. Drink now to capture the remaining fruit and freshness.
title: Miklus 2014 Malvasia (Collio)

description: Honeysuckle and orchard-fruit aromas lead the nose while the bright enjoyable palate offers ripe pear, green apple and candied citrus peel. It's easygoing, with fresh acidity and soft continuous bubbles.
title: Gino Fasoli 2016 Tasi Brut  (Prosecco)

description: A deep gold color sends up warning flags, and the flavors bear that out. Has simple apple flavors with a touch of shellac and no depth. Kosher.
title: Bartenura 2000 Pinot Grigio (Veneto)

description: Light, and seems mature already, with modest cherry and tobacco flavors and tea leaves on the finish.
title: Piccini 2001  Chianti

description: Shows the ill effects of age on this style of wine already. The vibrant, fresh fruit is fading, being replaced by some dusty spice notes.
title: Santi 2001 Sortesele Pinot Grigio (Trentino)

description: A surprisingly poor showing from this normally reliable winery, the 2000 Classico, a blend of Pinot Bianco, Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc, shows some lemony aromas, a plump, custardy mouthfeel and a tangy finish.
title: Cantina Terlano 2000 Classico White (Alto Adige)

description: Light and lean pear fruit, with subtle lime notes and a hint of sweetness appearing on the finish.
title: San Giuseppe 2002 Pinot Grigio (Veneto)

description: Frank Cornelissen doesn't like Malvasia, nor does he like Inzolia. Therefore he added 20% Nerello Mascalese and decided to make a rosé instead. Copper-colored Susucaru offers aromas of butterscotch and ripe melon over resin and maple syrup. In the mouth, you'll feel slight tannic firmness. Only 900 bottles are made.
title: Frank Cornelissen 2008 Susucaru 2 Rosato Rosé (Etna)

description: Here's a small producer with a vineyard and bed & breakfast in coastal Tuscany that proves to be a promising newcomer. This 60-40 blend of Cabernet and Syrah (aged in cement tanks and barrique) shows dark, inky notes of black fruit and graphite. The fruit is succulent, rich and the wine shows a big, bold style.
title: Eucaliptus 2008 Clarice  (Bolgheri)

description: If you can accept a slight hint of jamminess, this blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot is for you. Beyond the ripe cherry and blackberry is a beautiful blast of pleasure and opulence. Pair this wine with succulent cuts of red meat.
title: Cipriana 2007 San Martino  (Bolgheri Superiore)

description: Lagone is a pleasurable and rich blend of Merlot, Cab Sauvignon, Cab Franc and Sangiovese that opens with rich, dark color and intense aromas of sweet spice, chocolate, cherry and tobacco. The wine feels chewy and smooth in the mouth with a long, velvety feel on the close.
title: Aia Vecchia 2008 Lagone Red (Toscana)

description: Lagone is a pleasurable and rich blend of Merlot, Cab Sauvignon, Cab Franc and Sangiovese that opens with rich, dark color and intense aromas of sweet spice, chocolate, cherry and tobacco. The wine feels chewy and smooth in the mouth with a long, velvety feel on the close.
title: Aia Vecchia 2008 Lagone Red (Toscana)

description: This Riserva Chianti Rufina offers clean, crisp aromas of wild berry and white cherry with distant renderings of spice and earth in the background. Pair this wine with roast chicken or pork.
title: Bellini 2005 Riserva  (Chianti Rufina)

description: Banfi presents an easy, no-fuss Chianti Classico that showcases Sangiovese typicity and personality. This is a profoundly food-friendly wine with built-in natural acidity that pairs it with butter or cream-based pasta dishes.
title: Banfi 2007 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)

description: Terra Rossa (red earth) Riserva really does recall moist soil aromas with iron-rich notes of rust, clove and red berry fruit. Those warm, earthy tones are backed by mouth-freshening acidity.
title: Tenuta di Trecciano 2006 Terra Rossa Riserva  (Chianti Colli Senesi)

description: Terra Rossa (red earth) Riserva really does recall moist soil aromas with iron-rich notes of rust, clove and red berry fruit. Those warm, earthy tones are backed by mouth-freshening acidity.
title: Tenuta di Trecciano 2006 Terra Rossa Riserva  (Chianti Colli Senesi)

description: Piccini offers good value deals from Tuscany and this Riserva Chianti Classico follows in that tradition. The wine is compact and clean, in typical Sangiovese fashion, and ends with a bright blast of mouth-freshening acidity.
title: Piccini 2006 Riserva  (Chianti Classico)
